jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** We are accepting applications from individuals with backgrounds in deep learning, model research, and related areas of artificial intelligence to join our AI Research Engineer expert network for future independent project consideration. Potential projects involve carefully reviewing AI\-generated explanations and examples, evaluating research reasoning, and identifying where proposed answers are inaccurate, incomplete, or misleading. **Apply at https://work.atasc.ai/join?entry\=profile** **Duties** Depending on the scope of a future project, contributions may include: * Review AI\-generated explanations and examples involving deep learning, model architectures, training methods, and model research. * Evaluate research reasoning, including experimental assumptions, methods, supporting evidence, and conclusions. * Identify potential problems such as confounded experiments, data leakage, inappropriate baselines, inconsistent evaluation protocols, and unsupported performance claims. * Assess whether ablation studies and model comparisons isolate the intended variables and support the conclusions presented. * Provide clear feedback explaining what needs correction and why, including limitations affecting reproducibility or interpretation. * Suggest appropriate checks that could strengthen an answer without claiming experiments, tests, or results that have not been completed. **Experience** * Relevant background in deep learning, model research, machine learning experimentation, or related areas through professional work, research, relevant study, or practical projects. * Ability to explain your individual contributions, research decisions, and methods for checking your conclusions. * Strong analytical reasoning and attention to detail when examining experimental designs, model evaluations, and technical explanations. * Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and identify missing information, uncontrolled variables, or misleading conclusions. Applicants at different career stages, including those with early\-career experience, are welcome. Describe your background and contributions honestly. A human reviewer evaluates your contributions and supporting evidence rather than assuming expertise from a job title. **Application Process** Applicants must be **18 or older**. Complete one profile application with your background, education, résumé, and responses to short expertise questions. Select all specialty areas that match your experience. For this specialty, the intake includes the following example: *An ablation claims a gain but changes the training data and evaluation protocol together. Explain how you would isolate variables, compare baselines, and report reproducibility limits.* Focus on your reasoning and proposed checks. Do not disclose confidential work or present unperformed experiments, tests, or outcomes as completed results. Profiles are reviewed before any later verification steps. Identity documents and a separate expertise file are not required to apply. Submitted evidence is not automatically considered verified. Regulated work requires a separate review of relevant credentials and the actual project scope. Approval means eligibility for future project matching, not professional licensure or guaranteed work. Any assignment depends on availability and agreed project terms. Compensation is agreed separately for each actual project. **This is an application for future project consideration, not a currently open paid assignment or funded vacancy.** Enrollment is free. Acceptance into the network does not guarantee assignments or earnings. Pay: $50\.00 \- $100\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: If you thrive in fast paced environments, enjoy hands\-on problem solving, and want to make a measurable impact while working with modern automation and control systems, this role offers the challenge, autonomy, and growth opportunities to take your engineering career to the next level. In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print\-and‑apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities. What You’ll Do * Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety. * Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package. * Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on\-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed. * Inspect systems to ensure the operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieve operational conditions prescribed by the client. * Oversee scope of development, work request initiation, scheduling, and inspection of work performed by outside contractors, which includes proprietary work, licensed installations, upgrades, and maintenance and inspection of specialized systems. * Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation. * Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS\-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems. * Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies. * Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts. * Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents. * Perform controls systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability. * Clearly communicate technical issues, project timelines, and product impacts with site leadership, operations and maintenance teams. * Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members. * Perform other job\-related duties as needed or assigned. What You’ll Need * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. * Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2\-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered. * Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming. * 2\+ years of experience working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA\-based monitoring and control systems. * Ability to be available and work in a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays. * Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight. * Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more. * Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems. Preferred Qualifications * 2\+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming. * Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems. * Experience with robotic maintenance. * In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc. * Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset. * Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial\-related calculations. You should be proficient in: * PLC Programming Experience * SCADA Experience

jobs.title: Chief Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION DUTIES:** Serves as Chief Engineer on a diesel self\-propelled trailing suction hopper dredge up to 1520 HP and up to 512 cubic yard capacity. Is in complete charge of the engine department with responsibility for the efficient operation, maintenance, inspection and repair of all shipboard machinery, propulsion systems, engines, generators, hydraulic motors and pumps, auxiliaries and facilities of the vessel, including plumbing, heating, ventilating, communicating systems, dredging and propelling machinery, fire pumps, water filters, galley equipment, deck winches and capstans, etc., maintaining them in good order and directing necessary repairs. Directs subordinates in making repairs, applying troubleshooting techniques and installing new equipment. Performs the most difficult and complicated repairs. Is on call 24 hours a day. **1\.)** Plans work, arranges schedules, and assigns employees to regular shifts and particular duties. Through subordinates directs the operation and maintenance of all mechanical equipment used in the operation of the vessel, including engines, generators, motors, starters, plumbing, heating, ventilating and communicating systems, fire pumps, water filters, hydraulic equipment, dredging and propelling machinery, deck winches, capstan and various other similar and related mechanical mechanisms. Manages preventative maintenance system for the engine department. **2\.)** Make periodic inspections, covering all mechanical equipment to ensure correct performance, correct repairs and maintenance. Sees that equipment is kept properly lubricated and clean. Checks to see that equipment operates without overheating to avoid undue damage and time delays. Direct and performs repair work from minor jobs to complete overhauls. Makes periodic inspection of firefighting and lifesaving equipment to insure readiness for emergency needs. Sees that all mechanical equipment requiring paint is cleaned and painted periodically or as needed according to regulations. **3\.)** Requisitions fuel, water, lubricants, repair parts, materials, and supplies, and maintains stock thereof, for engine room department repairs and operations; keeps inventories and reports of amounts used and on hand. **4\.)** Compiles and submits recommendations for all mechanical and electrical overhauls and repairs required to keep the vessel in first\-class operating condition. Submits recommendations on repairs performed by contractor forces during dockside or shipyard periods. **5\.)** Directs oiler and other personnel in Engine Department engaged in oiling, greasing, operating, and repairing machinery and equipment. Plans and assigns work, establishing priorities and deadlines, considering relative difficulty of the work and capabilities of employees. Reviews and accepts or rejects finished work and provides input on performance. Gives instructions and answers questions on work and administrative matters. **6\.)** Receives and attempts to resolve complaints by employees, referring to supervisors of a serious or unresolved nature. Initiates and recommends personnel actions to include selection of applicants, re\-description of duties, disciplinary actions, etc. Ensures proper training and development is provided. **7\.)** Responsible for the safety of members of engine room crews. Participates and ensures all safety program requirements are adhered to. Creates and updates activity hazard analysis when needed. Stays abreast of any pertinent regulation or policy. Performs other duties as assigned. **SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGES:** Must possess and maintain a current U.S. Coast Guard license for Chief Engineer and/or a DDE with the necessary horsepower and tonnage (limited near coastal or higher) of Motor Vessels of not less than 2,000 HP or higher. Must possess and maintain Transportation Worker Identification Credentials (TWIC). Must have knowledge of U.S. Coast Guard regulations pertaining to the engine department. **1\.)** Knowledge of the diesel, electric, mechanical, hydraulic and/or electronic equipment, systems, dredging equipment, and auxiliary plant and machinery, and the related knowledge and skill requirements to diagnose problems and malfunctions and supervise and participate in the repair, replacement, and modification of such machinery, engines, and systems. Applies the knowledge to understand how such equipment and systems operate individually or in combination and the ability to plan and lay out repair replacement, maintenance, and modification plans and requirements ranging from those of a minor nature to those of extreme complexity. Applies knowledge of the fuel, water, and waste treatments associated with the various equipment and systems. **2\.)** Knowledge and ability to interpret and apply working drawings, sketches, diagrams, blueprints, and other information reflected in technical manuals. Applies knowledge of electronic equipment, air conditioning and heating, refrigeration and mechanical dimensions, tolerances and voltages. Applies skill and knowledge in the use of a variety of testing instruments including refrigeration gages, ammeters, ohmmeters, and temperature testers in diagnosing problems and malfunctions, and a variety of measuring devices including feeler gages, vernier calipers, inside and outside calipers and micrometers, thread gages, dial indicators, screw pitch gages, protractors, dividers, composers, steel squares, clinometers, etc. **3\.)** Knowledge of the uses of lathes, shapers, and milling machines to understand the processes necessary for certain repairs. Knowledge and skill in the use of drill press, honing equipment, grinders, jig borers, jig grinders, power hacksaws, electric and acetylene welding and flame cutting processes, and a variety of electric and hand tools common to the trades involved. Applies a knowledge of the characteristics of a variety of metals and alloys such as stainless, Monel, brass, bronze, Babbitt, silver, aluminum, mild and hardened steels, etc. **4\.)** Knowledge of all applicable rules and regulations pertaining to floating plant for the engine room including Coast Guard, USACE, OSHA, ANSI, ABS, and EPA. **RESPONSIBILITY:** Works under the direct supervision of the Master and Chief Operating Officer. Receives job assignments in terms of objectives to be attained and policies and procedures to be followed. **WORKING CONDITIONS:** Work is performed inside and outside, subjected to various climatic conditions. Considerable muscular effort is required in making general and technical repairs, and in walking over the vessel decks and up down stairways and ladders. Hazards encountered are burns, injury from moving machinery, electric shock, falls from stairs, ladders, and on icy or slippery decks, excessive heat and noise, fumes, dirty and greasy equipment, and moving machinery and, in the event of collision, there is the danger of being thrown against or into moving equipment, and danger of drowning if vessel takes water. Incumbent works regularly in areas where noise exceeds 80 decibels and is exposed to the effects of paints, acids, and solvents. Must be able to pass through 18 inch man holes. This position requires the use of personal protective equipment as identified by Federal Regulations. Candidate is subject to random drug test administered in accordance with Federal Regulations with date identified by Master and/or Chief Operating Officer. **PHYSICAL EFFORT:** Incumbent is required to exert moderate to heavy physical effort in handling engine room equipment. Frequently lifts, carries, and set up parts and equipment that weighs up to 40 pounds. Works from ladders, scaffolding, and platforms and where the part, equipment, or systems are in hard\-to\-reach places. Work requires the incumbent to stand, stoop, bend, kneel, crawl, climb, and work in tiring and uncomfortable positions. Incumbent must possess color perception to perform troubleshooting and repair work on the full range of equipment. Pay: $550\.00 \- $650\.00 per day Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, you’ll build and operate reliable cloud environments that help teams deliver software with confidence. You’ll connect development and IT operations, automate repeatable work, and strengthen the security and scalability of cloud services. Your impact: By improving deployment processes and infrastructure reliability, you help application teams release services smoothly and give users more dependable access. **Duties** * Design, manage, and optimize cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and other public cloud environments. * Automate provisioning and software deployment with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps automation tools. * Operate Linux and Windows systems, virtualization platforms, containers, and distributed systems; support Kubernetes and Docker environments. * Monitor cloud services, troubleshoot incidents, and apply system hardening and identity and access management (IAM) controls. * Collaborate with software development teams using Agile practices and support the software development life cycle (SDLC). **Skills** * Experience with cloud computing, cloud architecture, cloud management, and IT infrastructure; familiarity with VMware, OpenStack, Rackspace, Citrix, and Meraki is useful. * Hands\-on knowledge of Terraform, Ansible, Chef, Puppet, Jenkins, Git, scripting, Bash, PowerShell, Python, Go, Ruby, Java, JavaScript,.NET, or Node.js. * Understanding of service\-oriented architecture, microservices, RESTful APIs, web services, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, virtual private clouds, VPNs, and S3\. * Familiarity with SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, T\-SQL, PL/SQL, NoSQL, and application development is beneficial. * A degree in computer science or related experience is preferred. Knowledge of operating systems, UNIX, scalability, Internet of Things, and cloud development is an advantage. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Data Scientist (Databricks, Mosaic AI)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology, in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will build, evaluate, and put into production the machine learning and generative AI models a federal agency relies on. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $110,000 to $140,000 per year. It is a remote position. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms. It also requires the ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you taking models and AI agents from experiment to production on Azure Databricks, with the evaluation evidence to show they work. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Develop and train machine learning models on Azure Databricks, tracking experiments, models, and versions in MLflow. * Build reusable features in the Databricks Feature Store, and serve models through Databricks Model Serving. * Build retrieval and agent applications with Agent Bricks and Databricks AI Search (formerly Vector Search), using Azure OpenAI models through Microsoft Foundry. * Evaluate model and agent quality with MLflow evaluation, including large language model (LLM) judges, labeled test sets, and human review. * Monitor models in production for drift and quality, and write the documentation a model review asks for. You deliver models the agency can trust and explain. You measure quality before and after release, record what each model is for and where it fails, and leave the team pipelines it can retrain and rerun without you. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of data science or machine learning engineering experience, including models deployed to production * Bachelor's degree * Python for data science and machine learning, including pandas, scikit\-learn, and PySpark * Hands\-on Azure Databricks work, including MLflow for experiment tracking and model management * Deploying and monitoring models in production, including model serving, versioning, and drift monitoring * Building LLM applications, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) * Evaluating model and LLM output against defined metrics, test sets, and human review * Structured Query Language (SQL) and Git\-based version control * Delivery experience in a federal government environment, working to its security, access, and review processes * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel * United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms * The ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements **Preferred** * Experience on a federal system accredited at Impact Level 5 (IL\-5\) or higher * Agent Bricks, Databricks AI Search (formerly Vector Search), or MLflow 3 evaluation for generative AI * Experience with a second managed machine\-learning platform, such as Azure Machine Learning, Amazon SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI * Azure OpenAI or other models in Microsoft Foundry * Databricks certification, or a Microsoft Azure AI or data science certification * Model risk management or model validation experience, including the documentation a model review asks for * Familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted developer tooling **Who you are** You care whether a model works, not only whether it trains. You define what good looks like before you build, test against it, and say so when a model is not ready. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Hands\-on machine learning on Azure Databricks, including MLflow, feature engineering, and model serving. * Working experience building LLM applications, including retrieval and evaluation. * The evaluation discipline that production models demand, including test sets, metrics, and monitoring. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: BrightLedger Solutions is hiring a DevOps Engineer to build, maintain and improve the cloud infrastructure and deployment workflows used by its software development teams. This role focuses on automating software releases, developing infrastructure\-as\-code solutions and maintaining reliable systems across development and production environments. You will work closely with software engineers and technical teams to improve deployment processes, strengthen monitoring and resolve infrastructure issues. The position also includes participation in an on\-call rotation, so the ability to respond calmly and methodically to production incidents is important. The regular work schedule is Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with additional on\-call responsibilities as scheduled. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate application building, testing and deployment. * Develop and manage infrastructure using Terraform or comparable infrastructure\-as\-code tools. * Configure and maintain cloud environments to support software development and production workloads. * Work with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Automate routine infrastructure, deployment and system administration tasks through scripting. * Monitor system performance, application availability and infrastructure health. * Improve logging, alerting and monitoring processes to help teams identify problems early. * Investigate deployment failures, infrastructure errors and production incidents. * Support software releases and coordinate deployment activities with development teams. * Maintain infrastructure configurations, access controls and operational procedures. * Participate in the on\-call rotation and respond to incidents according to established procedures. * Prepare and maintain technical documentation, deployment instructions and operational runbooks. * Identify recurring operational problems and develop automation or process improvements to prevent them. **What We're Looking For** * Three or more years of professional experience in DevOps, cloud engineering or a related infrastructure role. * Practical experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. * Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform. * Experience with containerisation technologies, particularly Docker and Kubernetes. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform. * Scripting skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell or comparable languages. * Understanding of networking, Linux systems, application deployment and cloud infrastructure. * Experience with monitoring, logging and troubleshooting production environments. * Knowledge of version control systems such as Git. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Clear written communication and technical documentation skills. * Ability to participate in an on\-call rotation and manage incidents responsibly. **What We Expect** We expect careful automation, thorough runbooks and calm handling of incidents. Deployment processes should be tested before implementation, infrastructure changes should be documented and operational risks should be communicated early. The successful candidate should take responsibility for assigned systems, investigate problems methodically and keep development teams informed during service disruptions. We value engineers who understand the importance of reliable releases, accurate documentation and practical incident management. **How to Apply** Submit your résumé directly through Indeed using the **Apply Now** button. jobs.title: Distillery Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Tradition looking forward.** **Sempreon™ brings together Branded Spirits, Distilling Solutions and Ingredient Solutions under one corporate identity, building on more than 85 years of expertise, craftsmanship and trusted relationships. Its capabilities span spirits brand building, distilling, blending, bottling and specialty ingredients. Rooted in its heritage and focused on growth and innovation, Sempreon continues to evolve while creating long\-term growth and value.** **The name Sempreon reflects the company’s strong foundations, heritage and history, while looking ahead to its future and the legacy it will build. “Semper,” derived from the Latin word for “always,” represents the enduring foundation on which the company was built, while “Aion,” drawn from the Greek word for “eternity,” reflects its forward\-looking vision for the future and a legacy designed to last. Together, the name represents a company that honors where it came from while continuing to evolve for what’s next.** **Sempreon’s mission, “Creating moments that matter. Building a legacy that lasts,” reflects its commitment to honoring its heritage while continuing to grow, innovate and create lasting impact for generations to come.** **THE OPPORTUNITY:** The Distillery Controls Engineer provides technical leadership and oversight for the plant’s distributed control systems (DCS) and operational technology (OT) environment to ensure reliable, secure, and efficient plant operations. This role leads control system projects, supports system reliability and cybersecurity, and partners cross functionally to maintain and improve process control, instrumentation, and automation capabilities. **WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:** **Project Management** * Lead large\-scale DCS and OT hardware and software upgrade projects from concept through commissioning. * Develop project scope, schedules, budgets, and resource plans for capital and continuous improvement initiatives. * Select control system hardware, software, and instrumentation solutions that meet operational and safety requirements. * Coordinate internal resources and external contractors to execute projects safely, on schedule, and within budget. * Oversee installation, testing, documentation, and transition of completed projects to operations. **OT System Administration** * Lead large\-scale DCS and OT hardware and software upgrade projects from concept through commissioning. * Develop project scope, schedules, budgets, and resource plans for capital and continuous improvement initiatives. * Select control system hardware, software, and instrumentation solutions that meet operational and safety requirements. * Coordinate internal resources and external contractors to execute projects safely, on schedule, and within budget. * Oversee installation, testing, documentation, and transition of completed projects to operations. **Engineering Services** * Provide subject matter expertise for DCS programming, troubleshooting, modifications, and system enhancements. * Develop, modify, and deploy control logic, HMI screens, and instrumentation configurations. * Partner with Process Engineering, Maintenance, Production, Warehouse, and Quality teams to support operational goals. * Create, maintain, and control technical documentation for control system hardware, software, and network architecture. **Maintenance Support** * Plan and coordinate control system activities for annual shutdowns and major maintenance events. * Identify required materials, spare parts, and labor resources to support scheduled maintenance work. * Verify instrumentation and control equipment meet calibration, performance, and safety standards. **Leadership \& Technical Guidance** * Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to engineering, maintenance, production, and warehouse teams. * Support contractor onboarding and ensure technical alignment with plant control system standards. * Respond to critical control system issues, including providing after\-hours support when required. **WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:** * A safety minded individual who possesses a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electro\-mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, or an accredited associate degree combined with at least five (5\) years of relevant industrial experience. * Complete and apply training on plant control systems, including DCS programming, HMI development, input/output configuration, and system troubleshooting. * Configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot a wide range of industrial instrumentation and control devices. * Create and maintain electrical and control system drawings using AutoCAD or equivalent electronic drafting tools. * Apply working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC) and NFPA 70E standards; utilize NFPA 70B and DISCUS standards where applicable. * Perform control system engineering work in a manufacturing or industrial environment, preferably within distillation, grain processing, or simil s. * Execute control system project development, implementation, testing, and commissioning activities. * Configure and support I/O devices, instrumentation, and associated control software platforms. * Apply engineering principles to the design, operation, and troubleshooting of industrial control systems, instrumentation, and electrical power systems. * Evaluate and implement current industrial control technologies to improve system reliability, safety, and performance. * Administer and support control system infrastructure within a virtualized operational technology (OT) environment. * Diagnose and resolve control system issues across hardware, instrumentation, networking, DCS, and HMI platforms. * Prioritize and respond to critical operational system issues to restore safe and reliable plant operations. * Coordinate effectively with contractors and service providers performing instrumentation and control system work. * Use administrative and technical software tools to document, track, and support engineering activities. * Provide after hours technical support, remotely or on site, when required to address critical system issues and maintain operational continuity. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook, SAP, copier/printer. * Standard office equipment, computers, administrative software, manuals, technical documentation, books, and other written resources. * Hand tools, power tools, two\-way radios, sanitation equipment, and laboratory or field equipment. * Electrical measurement meters and programming devices. * Industrial control system and automation software, including DCS and PLC programming platforms, HMI development software, virtualization tools, and instrumentation configuration and calibration systems. * Electronic drafting and documentation software, including AutoCAD or equivalent. * Material handling and access equipment, including fork trucks and JLG man lifts. * Electrician’s hand tools and required personal protective equipment (PPE), including arc flash protection. This position involves significant physical activity. You must be able to lift to 50 pounds to shoulder height on occasion and remain physically mobile throughout the entire shift, including extensive walking, climbing, kneeling, stooping, and using stairs. You must be able to stand for periods of up to six hours. You will need sufficient dexterity to operate phones, computers, and precision mechanical tools. The role may occasionally require driving. Full sensory capability is required, including the ability to hear, smell, touch, speak, taste, and distinguish colors. You must be able to work in tight spaces and tolerate exposure to both high heat and cold for the full duration of the shift. Some tasks require remaining stationary at a computer for up to six hours. **If the above speaks to you, we’re excited to learn more about you! At Sempreon, we know that our people are our greatest strength. At Lawrenceburg, we are extremely focused on our 2026 Safety initiative, and we hope you want to be a part of that. With different perspectives and unique ways of thinking, our employees are as varied as our products. We believe that inclusivity strengthens the organization and champions a company culture that is evolving to reflect all of us. Culture results from our behaviors, our personal commitment, our curiosity, how we collaborate, and the ways we courageously share our perspectives and expect others to do the same. Each of us can make a difference by fostering thinking and actions that empower us to connect, belong, and grow together.** **Sempreon offers exceptional medical, dental, vision, short\- and long\-term disability, life insurance, 401(k) Match and PTO.** **All successful candidates for this position will be required to submit to a criminal background check and drug test as well as physical assessment.** **Candidates will also be required to achieve a qualifying score on a pre\-employment mechanical assessment.**

operational excellence. **Primary Deliverables** * UAT strategies, test plans, test cases, and validation documentation. * Release readiness assessments and go/no\-go recommendations. * Defect, incident, and problem management reporting. * Root cause analyses and corrective action plans. * Operational runbooks, support documentation, and knowledge articles. * Release shakeout reports and jobs.title: IT Engineer
jobs.description: We’re seeking a skilled IT Engineer to secure and scale the internal infrastructure that powers our mission\-critical work. Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting\-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission\-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure. Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real\-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success. **What you’ll do** ------------------ We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include: * Administer Google Workspace, manage Identity Provider (IdP), and set up SSO. * Manage device enrollment and device scripting in Iru/Kandji. * Author, maintain, and audit internal security policies and procedures. * Enforce CMMC 2\.0 Level 2 and NIST security frameworks with Vanta. * Safeguard credentials and secrets across the team using 1Password. * Harden AWS account security, IAM policies, and role\-based access controls. * Secure network access using Tailscale VPN. * Develop Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi alongside the infrastructure team. * Investigate security incidents and conduct routine vulnerability assessments. **Who you are** --------------- We’re looking for someone with strong IT Engineering skills who shares our most important values: * You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your configurations are documented, policies are enforced, and nothing slips through the cracks. * You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that the systems and policies you put in place are airtight and auditable. * You obsess over security. You’re always thinking about the attack surface and how to reduce it without making engineers miserable. * You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You read the spec, not just the summary. * You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop. * You’re a great teacher. You know how to communicate security requirements to engineers in a way that makes sense and gets buy\-in. **Why work with us** -------------------- * We ship — We don’t work on 18\-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished. * Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture. * We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values. * We’re remote — Work from wherever you want. We collaborate in real time on Slack or asynchronously via GitHub. * We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success. * We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here. * We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads. **Important skills** -------------------- * Hands\-on experience with CMMC, FedRAMP, or NIST 800\-171 compliance frameworks. * Experience writing and maintaining security policies and procedures. * Experience with MDM platforms such as Kandji, Jamf, or similar. * Experience administering Google Workspace at an organizational level. * Experience managing SSO and IdP solutions such as Authentik, Okta, or Google Identity. * Proficiency with AWS IAM, security groups, and access management. * Experience with security and compliance platforms such as Vanta, Drata, or Tugboat Logic. * Experience with secrets management tools such as 1Password or HashiCorp Vault. * Experience managing and securing macOS, Linux, and Windows endpoints. * Experience configuring and managing VPN solutions. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience working in a defense contracting or government\-adjacent environment. * Familiarity with Pulumi or other Infrastructure as Code tools. * Proficiency in bash/shell scripting and Python. **What we offer** ----------------- * Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work\-life balance. * Dedicated sick time — Your health and well\-being come first. * Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected. * 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend time with loved ones. * Professional development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career. * Collaborative environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter. * Mission\-driven work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real\-world impact. * Growth opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future. **Additional benefit opportunities when you choose Spear AI:** -------------------------------------------------------------- * 401(k) with company match. * Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent). * Relocation assistance (position dependent). * Referral bonuses. * Performance bonuses. * Life insurance and disability coverage. * Technology home office setup stipend. * Professional certification reimbursement (position dependent). We offer competitive compensation tailored to your experience, location, and the impact you’ll make. We’re committed to equitable pay and will share a range aligned to your level and geography during the hiring process. In accordance with state law, candidates in jurisdictions such as CA, CO, WA, NY, and others, where applicable, will be provided a good\-faith salary range upon request and throughout the hiring process. This is a full\-time, exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and is not eligible for overtime pay. Compensation for this position is provided on a salaried basis and is not subject to reduction based on hours worked. At Spear AI, you’ll find more than just a job; you’ll join a mission\-driven team where your work directly contributes to national security. Our flat organizational structure means your voice matters, your ideas reach leadership, and your impact is visible. As we grow, we’re committed to building robust processes and infrastructure that support both our mission and our people. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and the expertise each team member brings to the table. If you’re looking for a place to grow professionally while working on projects that truly matter, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Industrial Controls Engineer, Networks & Data Integration
jobs.description: **Build the nervous system of modern manufacturing** ---------------------------------------------------- At Prysmian, we connect the world with advanced energy and telecom cable systems—spanning underground and submarine power transmission and distribution, as well as medium/low‑voltage solutions for construction and infrastructure. Our telecom capability covers optical fiber, copper, and connectivity for voice, video, and data. With 30,000 teammates across 50\+ countries, your work here shapes how the world is powered and communicates. **Make Your Mark at Prysmian \- Join Us** ### **Your mission** Own the reliability and evolution of our plant’s automation, control systems, and SCADA stack. You’ll translate machine behavior into insights that accelerate decisions, strengthen uptime, and pave the way for new equipment and smarter processes. ### **Impact in your first 90 days** * **Days 1–30:** Learn the lines, review PLC/HMI code bases, map Ethernet/IP topologies and historian data flows, and align on controls standards (UDTs, AOIs, modular patterns). * **Days 31–60:** Deliver an ISA‑101‑aligned HMI refresh for a priority cell, standardize tag naming, implement a PLC‑to‑SCADA OPC UA improvement, and document backup/change procedures. * **Days 61–90:** Lead a targeted automation upgrade, tune critical VFDs, close a root‑cause corrective action, and present a controls/SCADA roadmap with capital justifications. ### **How you’ll contribute** * Engineer and sustain PLC logic in Studio 5000 for Allen‑Bradley ControlLogix/CompactLogix; maintain clean, standard‑driven code. * Design HMIs using high‑performance (ISA‑101\) principles for clarity and speed. * Commission, integrate, and diagnose variable‑frequency drives (VFDs). * Lead SCADA architecture, dashboarding, historian integration, and reliable data acquisition. * Define data models and tag conventions; deliver dashboards, trends, and reports that guide operators, supervisors, and engineers. * Configure PLC‑SCADA communications, OPC UA, and historian structures. * Develop and maintain industrial networking: Ethernet/IP, managed switches, and segmentation tuned to plant needs. * Be the primary technical authority for SCADA/data; ensure changes are controlled and thoroughly documented. * Own automation upgrades, controls retrofits, and new installs; write control specs, review vendor designs, manage schedules/budgets/integration, and support ROI and cost‑benefit analyses. * Serve as escalation during downtime; build Maintenance troubleshooting capability; author standard work, playbooks, and training materials. * Advance continuous improvement across safety, quality, uptime, throughput, and scrap reduction. * Champion safety and compliance: electrical safety practices, arc‑flash documentation, safe work policies, and energy isolation. Contribute to cybersecurity and formal change management. ### **Qualifications** #### **Must‑haves** * BS in Electrical/Controls/Automation Engineering or related discipline. * 3\+ years of manufacturing controls experience. * Allen‑Bradley ControlLogix/CompactLogix and Studio 5000 proficiency; Ethernet/IP fluency. * HMI development/troubleshooting with FactoryTalk View, InTouch, Red Lion, Ignition, or similar. * Industrial networking fundamentals: IP addressing, managed switches, VLANs, and protocols. * VFD setup, tuning, and integration. * Ability to read/create/interpret electrical schematics, P\&IDs, and machine documentation. * Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and root‑cause skills. * Hands‑on presence on the plant floor; committed to safe work with control and power voltages/currents. #### **Nice‑to‑haves** * Historian experience: Wonderware, Ignition, OSI PI, or SQL‑backed systems. * SQL skills, data structures knowledge, and basic scripting (Python, VB, or similar). * Exposure to MES, OEE, downtime tracking, or broader manufacturing data systems. * Experience with ISA‑101 (HMI) and ISA‑18\.2 (alarm management) practices. * Leadership of automation projects and/or SCADA development in fast‑moving plants. ### **Work environment** * Frequent presence on the production floor among operating machinery. * Ability to move safely around manufacturing equipment. * Occasional extended hours or off‑shift response when necessary. ### **What’s in it for you** * Direct your plant’s SCADA and controls trajectory. * Visible, high‑impact outcomes on uptime and automation capability. * Backed by a supportive team and leadership modernizing automation and data systems. * A culture of continuous improvement and professional development.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to develop, train and evaluate machine learning models using real\-world data. Based at 804 E 10th Ave, Vancouver, BC V5T 2B1, this role involves working across the model development process, from preparing experiments and training models to analysing performance and documenting results. You will work with technical teams and clients to understand requirements, evaluate model behaviour and identify areas where improvements are needed. The position requires strong Python programming skills, sound analytical thinking and a careful approach to testing and interpreting results. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, train and maintain machine learning models for relevant business and technical applications. * Prepare datasets and assess their suitability for model training and evaluation. * Build and run experiments to compare different modelling approaches. * Evaluate model performance using real\-world data and appropriate performance metrics. * Investigate inaccurate predictions, unexpected outputs and model performance issues. * Identify data quality problems, model limitations and potential sources of bias. * Improve model performance through testing, refinement and systematic experimentation. * Maintain clear records of experiments, model configurations, evaluation results and technical decisions. * Document findings in reports that explain model performance, limitations and recommended improvements. * Work with development teams to support the integration and ongoing use of machine learning models. * Communicate technical findings and model behaviour to clients in understandable language. * Investigate client\-reported issues and provide technical support when model outputs do not meet expectations. * Keep up with relevant developments in machine learning methods and engineering practices. **What We're Looking For** * Three or more years of professional experience in machine learning, applied data science or a related technical field. * Strong programming skills in Python. * Practical experience developing, training and evaluating machine learning models. * Understanding of data preparation, feature selection, model validation and performance measurement. * Ability to work with real\-world datasets and recognise data quality issues. * Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to experimentation. * Ability to investigate model errors and understand why particular approaches may fail. * Familiarity with machine learning libraries and development tools. * Strong written communication and technical documentation skills. * Ability to explain model performance, limitations and technical findings to clients and colleagues. * Good organisation and attention to detail when managing experiments and project requirements. **How You'll Approach the Work** We expect careful experiments, plain reporting and curiosity about why things fail. Model performance should be assessed using appropriate data and evaluation methods, with limitations documented honestly. The successful candidate should be willing to question unexpected results, investigate failures rather than overlook them and explain technical findings without unnecessary jargon. Reproducibility, accurate documentation and responsible interpretation of model outputs are important parts of the role. **How to Apply** Submit your résumé directly through Indeed using the **Apply Now** button. Applications received through Indeed will be included in the recruitment process and reviewed within the same week they are submitted. Every submitted résumé will be counted in the application review process. **Equal Opportunity Statement** **Applicants will be considered based on job\-related skills, experience, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable employment laws.** Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $154,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: Mechanical Designer / CAD Designer **iDA\-MECH Engineering — Rupert, Idaho** **Pay:** $25–$50 per hour, depending on experience **Position:** Full\-Time \| Primarily In\-Office \| Flexible Work Arrangements About iDA\-MECH Engineering iDA\-MECH Engineering is a small engineering consulting firm located in Rupert, Idaho. We provide mechanical design, CAD, and engineering support to food processing plants, equipment manufacturers, fabrication shops, equipment installers, and other engineering firms. Our projects are diverse and include custom machinery, conveyors, piping systems, factory layouts, structural steel platforms, catwalks, and detailed fabrication drawings. We also provide P\&ID development, 3D scanning, and BIM support for industrial plant design and construction projects. We are looking for a motivated Mechanical Designer or CAD Designer who enjoys solving problems, working with industrial equipment, and turning ideas into practical designs. What We're Looking For Our ideal candidate is someone who enjoys designing, understands how things are built, and can work independently on a variety of projects. Many of our projects begin with little more than a customer describing a problem, a rough sketch, or a few field measurements. We need someone who can interpret those requirements, ask the right questions, and develop a practical solution. **We value practical experience and problem\-solving ability as much as formal education.** A degree in mechanical, civil, or structural engineering is welcome but not required. Candidates with backgrounds in industrial fabrication, machining, welding, maintenance, construction, or equipment manufacturing are encouraged to apply. Primary Responsibilities * Develop 3D CAD models and detailed manufacturing and fabrication drawings, primarily using SolidWorks. * Design and modify custom machinery, conveyors, industrial equipment, piping systems, and structural supports. * Work directly with customers to understand project requirements, refine designs, and resolve technical challenges. * Manage multiple smaller design projects while meeting schedules and maintaining drawing accuracy. * Visit local manufacturing facilities and fabrication shops to take measurements, perform 3D scans, review equipment, and coordinate installations. * Develop designs that consider fabrication, assembly, installation, maintenance, and cost. * Collaborate with other engineers, designers, and fabrication personnel. Desired Qualifications * Strong CAD skills, preferably SolidWorks, or demonstrated ability to quickly learn new CAD software. * Good mechanical aptitude and understanding of manufacturing or fabrication processes. * Ability to independently develop practical designs from limited information. * Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. * Good written and verbal communication skills. * Comfortable spending substantial time working on detailed computer\-based design projects. * Willingness to learn new software, industries, and design disciplines. Additional Experience We'd Love to See * Hands\-on welding, machining, fabrication, industrial maintenance, or construction experience. * Food processing, agricultural equipment, material handling, or conveyor design experience. * Civil or structural engineering experience, including structural steel design and detailing. * AutoCAD, AutoCAD Plant 3D, Revit, or Navisworks experience. * BIM coordination, factory layout, and piping system design. * 3D laser scanning, point clouds, and as\-built modeling. * Engineering calculations and SolidWorks Simulation / FEA. Location and Work Arrangements **This position is based at our office in Rupert, Idaho.** We prefer applicants from the Mini\-Cassia area, Magic Valley, and surrounding communities who can work in our office and visit local industrial facilities when needed. Flexible work arrangements may be available depending on experience and the ability to work independently. Experienced candidates who are interested in a remote arrangement are welcome to inquire, provided they can meet the position's communication, coordination, and occasional on\-site requirements. Travel has historically been limited, but occasional customer and fabrication shop visits are part of the position. Compensation and Benefits * $25–$50 per hour, based on experience and ability. * Paid overtime. * Paid holidays and time off. * Flexible work arrangements depending on experience and project requirements. * Wide variety of interesting design projects. * Opportunity to work directly with customers and see your designs fabricated and installed. * Opportunity to develop additional skills in mechanical, structural, and industrial plant design. How to Apply Please submit your resume and a brief description of your relevant design, CAD, manufacturing, or fabrication experience. Examples of previous CAD models, fabrication drawings, or design projects are encouraged, where permitted by previous employers or customers. We are especially interested in applicants who enjoy solving practical engineering problems and want to become a long\-term part of a small, growing engineering firm. Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Principal AI Ops Engineer
jobs.description: **Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure** Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.\-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high\-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system. Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI\-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** You will build the systems that let AI agents, not people, do most of the work of running Crux's TPU fleet. Reporting to our Director, AI Ops, you will be one of the first engineers on the team, writing the telemetry pipelines, correlation logic, and agents that detect, triage, and remediate failures across facilities, TPU hosts, the network, and the control plane before a customer notices. You will turn every runbook into code and every repeat incident into automation. This is a hands\-on engineering seat: you write and ship the software, then operate it in production. **In this role, you will:** * Build and own the telemetry and event pipeline that ties together power, cooling, TPU hosts, interconnect, and the control plane, with the correlation to tell a failing pump from a failing chip from a failing job. * Write AI agents that triage alerts, execute runbooks, drain and requeue workloads, and open hardware repair and RMA requests with Google, with every action logged, reversible, and measured. * Turn runbooks into code, so that every critical failure mode for the first build maps to a signal, an alert, an automated response, and an owner. * Build the guardrails that keep autonomous actions safe: blast\-radius limits, approval gates for high\-risk changes, and tested rollback paths. * Define and instrument SLOs and error budgets with Compute, Network Engineering, and Facility Operations, and build the views the team reviews every week. * Take part in on\-call and incident response, and drive postmortems that end in a fix that ships, not an action item that ages. * Measure the share of operational work that closes with zero human touch, and drive that number up release over release. **SIGNALS OF SUCCESS** **After 60 days in this role:** * Gained a complete understanding of the first\-build architecture, the failure modes that matter most, and the tooling in place today, and shipped a first working agent against a real, repeat failure. * Stood up the first version of the unified telemetry pipeline for the first build. * Adapted to a fast\-paced environment, triaging appropriately and continuously improving our function. **After 6 months:** * Taken the first Stage 1 cluster into production with automated detection and remediation in place for its top failure modes. * Shipped agents the team relies on every day, with a measured share of incidents resolved without human intervention. * Built the guardrails and audit trail that let the team trust autonomous actions in production. **After 1 year:** * Running automation across a multi\-site fleet where most repeat operational work executes autonomously, with measurable gains in availability, recovery time, and cost per chip. * Built a library of agents and runbooks\-as\-code that every new site inherits on day one. * Become a reason strong SRE and operations engineers choose Crux. **EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH** **Experiences** * 10\+ years in software engineering, SRE, or production engineering for large\-scale infrastructure, including operating a fleet across many sites against hard SLAs. * Built and shipped AI\-driven operations systems in production, such as event correlation, anomaly detection, auto\-remediation, or agentic triage, with measurable results. * Strong software skills in Python or Go, and hands\-on experience with observability stacks (for example Prometheus or OpenTelemetry), Kubernetes, and large\-scale data pipelines. **Attributes** * You are outcome driven and hands\-on. You read the telemetry and write the agent yourself. This is a builder's seat, not a supervisory one. * You are close enough to the hardware to be useful. You understand how power, cooling, accelerators, and networks fail, not just how software does. * You have a high tolerance for ambiguity. You absorb ambiguity and navigate complexity rather than passing it along. **Mindset** * You are skeptical by default. "90% automated" is a hypothesis until it survives a bad night at a new site. You build the system that makes the next incident boring. * You deliver reliability through discipline, not heroics. You would rather fix the cause once than page someone twice. * You are AI\-agentic first. Fluent with AI agents, or committed to becoming so quickly, you embed them as first principles in how you and your team work, defaulting to agentic workflows before adding headcount or process. **Nice to have (Preferred, not required):** * SRE or production engineering at a hyperscaler (Google, Meta, Microsoft, AWS) or a neocloud (CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe). * Experience operating TPU or GPU clusters for large training and inference workloads, including hardware health, repair workflows, and fleet telemetry. * Experience with data center infrastructure telemetry such as BMS, DCIM, or power and cooling systems. * Experience building LLM\-based agents with tool use, evaluations, and safety controls in production. * Experience with predictive maintenance, ML\-based anomaly detection, or failure prediction at fleet scale. **Salary Range Information** The annual salary range for this position has been estimated based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. **About Crux** * We offer generous base, bonus and additional incentive based compensation * Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents * Company\-paid life insurance and disability * Full suite of other optional benefits * 401(k) Plan with 4% company match * Hybrid schedule offering four days in\-office collaboration paired with one remote workday for focused, individual work

jobs.description: **Build Your Engineering Career with Maxim Crane Works** -------------------------------------------------------- Are you an early\-career engineer looking to put your technical skills to work on challenging, real\-world projects? Recent graduates are encouraged to apply. **Technical Skills** * Basic to intermediate proficiency in AutoCAD; 3D AutoCAD experience is a plus. * Foundational knowledge of structural analysis and engineering calculations. * Basic familiarity with AISC steel construction standards and structural connection design. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, and communication skills. * Ability to interpret technical drawings and translate project requirements into practical engineering solutions. * Willingness to learn, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and develop technical expertise. **Work Environment and Travel** ------------------------------- This position combines office\-based engineering and design work with occasional field exposure. jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer (Forward Deployed) [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event\-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco. **About the role** ------------------ Applied AI is where Concurrence meets the real world. Our core engineering team builds the platform. We take it into health systems and build what each customer actually needs on top of it, as durable software that runs in production. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you own an entire customer use case, not a ticket or a slice of one. You take a deployment from brief to production. You make the architecture calls inside it, commit the timeline, and carry the outcome. Success isn't your agent staying up. It's the customer's number moving: more intake handled, fewer denials, faster time to billing close. Your work doesn't stop at one customer. We build custom first, on purpose. When the same shape shows up under two customers, you're the one who sees it, and the pattern you proved becomes part of the platform everyone builds on next. Applied AI runs ahead of the platform, not behind it. Our field work is the R\&D that decides what Concurrence becomes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own a whole use case, end to end.** You run the build from the deployment brief to production and beyond. You set its internal design, commit the timelines, and ship at a bar that doesn't need anyone checking behind you. * **Build agent systems that hold up in clinical settings.** That means hierarchies of agents and skills rather than one monolith, and evals that measure distributions, not vibes. Nothing reaches a patient until it clears our safety floor and eval gate. * **Take on the integration reality.** EHRs, legacy systems, and customer data come in every shape. You find the path from what the customer has to what the platform needs. * **Make it compound.** You turn field\-proven patterns into first\-class platform capabilities. You also push proven work down from agent reasoning into deterministic data lookups, the move where twenty tool calls become one. That's how we grow without turning into a services shop. * **Push back early.** When a spec was never vetted, an integration isn't supported, or scope quietly changed mid\-build, you raise it before the build pays for it. * **Raise the people around you.** Mentor the engineers on your use case and help set how the team builds. Write documentation good enough that a coding agent or a new hire could pick up your work. **You might be a great fit if you** ----------------------------------- * Have shipped and owned complex production systems end to end, with real users depending on them. * Have real experience building with LLMs and agents in production, or the engineering depth to get there fast. * Treat non\-deterministic systems with rigor. You know three runs of an agent is a feeling, not evidence. * Hold the near term and the long term at once: what a decision costs now, and what it makes easier or harder for the team later. * Are comfortable in the room with customers and clinicians. You'd rather understand the workflow than wait for a perfect spec. * Care about craft. Your systems fail loudly to you before they fail to a customer, and they keep working while you're on vacation. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Healthcare experience: EHR integrations (Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth), HL7, FHIR, or clinical workflows. * Experience with Databricks, voice agents, or forward deployed or customer engineering. * Time at an early\-stage startup. **Why this role** ----------------- * **Stakes.** Your work runs inside health systems and touches patient care. * **Ownership, early.** You own whole use cases from the start. At a 35\-person company, scope arrives fast. * **Leverage.** What you build in the field becomes the platform. Few roles let you shape the product this directly. * **A clear path.** Our Applied AI ladder runs from Senior to Staff or Tech Lead. You move up by the kind of work you can be trusted to own, not by how much you ship. * **A week built for deep work.** Collaborative in\-office sprints early in the week, a protected focus day on Thursday, and Friday to consolidate what we learned. **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $200K \- $260K
