jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life\-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— **we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 3\.6 million patients!** We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round. **About The Role** ------------------ We're looking for a **Senior Full Stack Engineer** who wants to build AI products that do real work in healthcare. You'll take an idea from a conversation with the people who'll use it to a feature running in production, across the experience, the services behind it, and the AI that powers it. You'll work closely with our product, AI, and operations teams, and you'll see the impact of what you ship. Some of the problems you'd own: * **AI that meets prescribers where they are.** You'll build the AI that reads clinical notes, works through insurance rules, and moves each request toward a decision, right inside the tools prescribers already use. * **Workflows where AI and people work side by side.** Requests move between agents, our operations team, prescribers, and insurers over days or weeks. You'll design and own the state machines that coordinate it all. * **Making sure nothing gets lost on the way to the insurer.** Hundreds of insurance plans, incomplete patient data, and a patient waiting on the other end. You'll own the system that gets every request to the right place, from the AI behind the scenes to what prescribers see . * **Fast, AI\-assisted development that stays reliable.** We ship quickly with coding agents. You'll enhance the automated QA, deploy safeguards, and PR review that keep quality up as we go faster. This is a hybrid role, with **3 days per week onsite in either Menlo Park or San Francisco.** **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * At least 5 years building and shipping production software. You're strong at architecting systems and making the right technical decisions across the full stack, and it's a bonus if you love the frontend. * You figure out what the user actually needs before you start building, and you speak up early when scope starts to drift. * You're curious about how things really work, from the healthcare rules behind a request to the system that handles it, and you ask why before you build. * You reach for the simplest design that works and can explain why, including when it's time to add more. * You work with coding agents every day and hold their code to the same bar as your own. * You make the team around you better, whether that's fixing a broken process or helping a teammate get unstuck. * You own your work through rollout and check whether it did what it was supposed to do. **You Don't Need** ------------------ Healthcare experience. We'll teach you the domain. You also don't need a PM background, experience building for planet\-scale traffic, or management experience. **How We Work** --------------- We start simple and add complexity when we have a reason to. We care a lot about getting things right, because a dropped request here means a patient waits longer for their medication, and we handle protected health information every day. Engineers own their work from the first customer conversation through launch and after. The people who do well here push hard, take feedback well, and ask a lot of questions. **What We Offer** ----------------- * 150K–220K base plus meaningful early\-stage equity * Medical, dental, and vision. We pay 100% of your premiums and 50% for dependents * 401(k) with a 4% match * Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, starting from your first day * Flexible PTO and all major holidays * A high\-end workstation and budget for the AI tools you want to use * A $5K relocation bonus Visa sponsorship will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. As an early\-stage company, our ability to provide immigration support depends on the role, applicable immigration requirements, anticipated costs, and timing. Support is subject to review by immigration counsel and company approval. At this time we do not support new H1\-B visas for candidates outside the United States. **Interviewing With Us** ------------------------ There are three steps: a recruiter call, an engineering skills screen built around a realistic problem instead of trivia, and an onsite at one of our Bay Area offices. The whole process usually takes about two weeks, and we'll get back to you within a day after each step. Develop Health is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants of every background. Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Platform Engineer, Enterprise Deployments
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- US **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **About Quilter** ================= At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time\-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high\-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades\-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full\-speed toward our goal. No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there: * Curiosity * Conviction * Rigor We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Platform Engineer to lead customer\-facing deployments and integrations of Quilter in enterprise environments. Quilter uses AI to automate printed circuit board placement and routing. Our Platform team builds the infrastructure that runs these compute\-intensive workloads and supports our cloud service and customer\-managed deployments. You’ll own systems from design through operation and help shape a growing team’s technical direction. You’ll work directly with customer engineering and IT teams and our go\-to\-market team, carrying deployments from discovery through validation and handoff. Customer conversations, identity integration, and hands\-on troubleshooting are central to the role. You’ll also build automation and diagnostic tools with the engineers who own our shared deployment platform, so each engagement improves how we serve the next customer. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Lead customer deployment planning.** Understand the customer’s environment, goals, and constraints; identify dependencies; agree on success criteria; and create a clear path to a working deployment. * **Deploy and integrate Quilter.** Work with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, networking, storage, identity providers, and access controls across customer\-managed and dedicated environments. * **Own enterprise identity integrations.** Configure and debug OpenID Connect (OIDC) SSO with customer IT teams, including application registration, login flows, claims, and access mapping. Maintain integrations through credential and policy changes, and turn repeated fixes into setup guides and automated validation. * **Own troubleshooting through resolution.** Investigate failures across application and infrastructure boundaries, work effectively with limited access, and keep customers and internal teams informed about findings and next steps. * **Make installations and upgrades repeatable.** Partner with Platform engineers on deployment automation, preflight checks, configuration validation, upgrade and rollback procedures, and useful diagnostics. * **Help customers integrate Quilter into their workflows.** Build practical scripts and integrations around supported interfaces, coordinate with product and engineering teams, and recognize patterns that should become shared capabilities. * **Make customer handoffs clear.** Validate the deployment and identity integration, teach customer teams how to use and support their environment, and document the operating responsibilities and escalation paths shared between Quilter and the customer. * **Connect customer needs to engineering priorities.** Explain tradeoffs, distinguish confirmed capabilities from proposed work, manage scope, and coordinate commitments with engineering and go\-to\-market partners. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * Experience delivering and supporting production software in cloud or customer\-managed environments, with ownership through deployment and operation. * Demonstrated ability to work directly with external customers or partners on technical implementation, integration, or troubleshooting. * Hands\-on experience implementing and debugging OIDC\-based SSO with enterprise identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID or Okta. You understand OAuth 2\.0 fundamentals, tokens, claims, and application access, and can resolve integration issues with customer IT. * Practical Kubernetes and container fluency: you can inspect and debug workloads, understand deployment configuration, and investigate failures involving networking, storage, or permissions. * Solid cloud infrastructure fundamentals, including compute, networking, IAM, and storage. AWS experience is particularly useful; experience in other clouds transfers well. * Experience using infrastructure as code and building maintainable automation. You can read application code, follow logs and traces, and write tools or integrations in a language such as Python or Go. * Clear verbal and written communication across technical audiences. You ask useful discovery questions, explain uncertainty, teach effectively, and leave people with a concrete action plan. * Strong ownership and judgment: you follow through, escalate when needed, make sensible scope tradeoffs, and work with teammates to turn one\-off fixes into lasting improvements. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building reusable installers, upgrade checks, or diagnostic tooling for customer\-managed deployments. * Experience with Helm, Terraform, and deployments across AWS, Azure, or customer\-managed Kubernetes. * Experience with on\-premises, restricted\-network, offline, hybrid, or bring\-your\-own\-cloud deployments. * Familiarity with observability and support tooling for environments where direct production access is limited. * Experience supporting security\-sensitive enterprise customers or working with their IT and security review processes. * Familiarity with compute\-intensive workloads, GPUs, or engineering software. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Customers reach a validated deployment, can sign in through their identity provider with the intended access, and have clear operating responsibilities and support paths. Installations and upgrades become easier to repeat, and recurring deployment and identity issues are resolved through shared tooling and product improvements. **Please note**: We are an equal opportunity employer. At this time, we are focused on hiring primarily within the US, with occasional exception to accommodate exceptional talent. **What we offer:** ================== * Interesting and challenging work * Competitive salary and equity benefits * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Regular team events and offsites (\~4x / year) * Unlimited paid time off * Paid parental leave

This role is responsible for managing development projects, establishing engineering standards, coordinating technical resources, and ensuring that software solutions meet business requirements and quality expectations. The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge with leadership and project management abilities. The successful applicant will guide developers, support technical decision\-making, improve development workflows, and promote a collaborative engineering environment. Key Responsibilities * Lead and manage software development teams throughout the software development lifecycle. * Plan, prioritize, and coordinate software development projects and technical deliverables. * Establish project timelines, milestones, resource requirements, and development priorities. * Supervise software engineers, developers, QA specialists, and other technical team members. * Guide architecture decisions and promote scalable, maintainable software solutions. * Review technical designs, source code, and development documentation. * Coordinate frontend, backend, database, and application development activities. * Implement and maintain software development standards, coding practices, and quality procedures. * Work with product managers and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical plans. * Monitor project progress, identify risks, and resolve development challenges. * Oversee software testing, debugging, deployment, and maintenance activities. * Support continuous integration, continuous delivery, and release management processes. * Encourage the use of modern development tools, frameworks, and engineering practices. * Conduct performance reviews, provide technical mentoring, and support employee development. * Identify opportunities to improve development productivity and software reliability. * Communicate project updates, technical risks, and delivery status to senior management. Qualifications and Requirements * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. * Several years of professional experience in software development or engineering. * Previous experience leading software developers or managing technical projects. * Strong understanding of software development methodologies and the software development lifecycle. * Knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript, C\#, or similar technologies. * Understanding of databases, APIs, cloud platforms, and application architecture. * Experience with version control systems and collaborative development tools. * Strong project planning, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities. * Demonstrated ability to mentor technical employees and build effective teams. Preferred Skills * Experience managing Agile or Scrum\-based software development teams. * Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. * Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. * Experience with microservices, distributed systems, and scalable application architecture. * Familiarity with project management platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools. * Understanding of cybersecurity, software performance, and application reliability. * Strong technical decision\-making and stakeholder management skills. * Ability to introduce process improvements and support engineering innovation. Work Environment * Professional software development and technology environment. * Regular collaboration with software engineers, QA teams, product managers, designers, and business stakeholders. * Combination of strategic planning, technical reviews, team leadership, and project coordination. * Fast\-paced environment requiring effective communication and deadline management. * Primarily office\-based or remote/hybrid, depending on company policy. * Occasional meetings with clients, partners, or other technical departments may be required. Benefits * Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications. * Health and wellness benefits, where offered. * Paid time off and company holidays, subject to eligibility. * Professional development and technical training opportunities. * Access to modern development tools and technologies. * Collaborative and innovation\-focused work environment. * Opportunities for career advancement into senior engineering or technology leadership roles. *Benefits depend on company policy, employment status, and eligibility.* About the Company Lupa Technology is presented here as a technology\-focused business. The Software Development Manager will support these goals by leading engineering teams, coordinating development priorities, maintaining quality standards, and helping align technical work with business objectives. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit an updated resume highlighting relevant experience in software engineering, development team leadership, technical project management, or application development. Applicants should include relevant technical skills, leadership experience, and examples of successfully delivered software projects. jobs.title: Solutions and Lakehouse Architect
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology, in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will help design and build the lakehouse that a federal agency's data products, reporting, and machine learning run on. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year. It is a remote position. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms. It also requires the ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements. **Your first project** A lakehouse keeps data in open, low\-cost storage, as a data lake does, and adds the transactions, schemas, and governance of a data warehouse. Your first project will likely have you owning defined parts of the target lakehouse architecture on Azure Databricks and guiding their implementation within the program's established architecture. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Design components of the lakehouse on Azure Databricks, including the medallion layers that carry data from raw ingestion to curated, business\-ready tables, and the Delta Lake storage beneath them. * Implement and extend the agency's Unity Catalog governance model, including catalogs, schemas, access controls, lineage, and the data classifications the agency's policies require. * Build the data models the business reads from, using dimensional models for reporting and Data Vault where history and auditability matter. * Connect the lakehouse to the sources it does not hold through Lakehouse Federation, and to the analysts who use it through Databricks Structured Query Language (SQL) and Power BI. * Document design decisions and reference patterns for the components you own, and review implementation against them. You deliver components the agency can explain, govern, and extend. You make the tradeoffs explicit, write them down, and leave the team patterns it can apply without you in the room. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of data architecture, data engineering, or analytics engineering experience, including design work on a production data platform * Bachelor's degree * Hands\-on Azure Databricks work, including Delta Lake and the medallion architecture * Data governance in Unity Catalog, including access control, lineage, and data classification * Data modeling for analytics, including dimensional modeling; Data Vault is a plus * Advanced SQL and working Python, including PySpark * Serving data to analysts and reporting tools, for example through Databricks SQL and Power BI * Writing the decision records, standards, and diagrams that engineers and reviewers follow * Delivery experience in a federal government environment, working to its security, access, and review processes * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel * United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms * The ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements **Preferred** * Experience on a federal system accredited at Impact Level 5 (IL\-5\) or higher * Data architecture work in Microsoft Azure and at least one additional cloud platform, such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Google Cloud * Lakehouse Federation, Databricks SQL warehouses, or Azure Data Factory * Databricks certification, or a Microsoft Azure architecture or data certification * Federal data governance experience, including records, privacy, and security controls * Familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted developer tooling **Who you are** You think in systems and in the people who will use them. You can explain why a table belongs in one layer and not another, and you would rather settle a design question once in a written decision than reopen it in every review. You work within an established architecture and improve it from the inside. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Hands\-on design work on Azure Databricks, including Delta Lake, the medallion architecture, and Unity Catalog. * Data modeling judgment across dimensional and Data Vault approaches, and a sense of which one a problem needs. * The writing discipline that turns an architecture into standards a team can follow. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Engineer (Forward Deployed) [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event\-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco. **About the role** ------------------ Applied AI is where Concurrence meets the real world. Our core engineering team builds the platform. We take it into health systems and build what each customer actually needs on top of it, as durable software that runs in production. As a Staff Applied AI Engineer, you own our most complex customer use cases and set technical direction across deployments. You take a deployment from brief to production. You make the architecture calls inside it and across shared systems, commit the timeline, and carry the outcome. Success isn't your agent staying up. It's the customer's number moving: more intake handled, fewer denials, faster time to billing close. Your work doesn't stop at one customer. We build custom first, on purpose. When the same shape shows up under two customers, you're the one who sees it, and the pattern you proved becomes part of the platform everyone builds on next. Applied AI runs ahead of the platform, not behind it. Our field work is the R\&D that decides what Concurrence becomes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own our most complex use cases, end to end.** You run the build from the deployment brief to production and beyond. You set technical direction within and across deployments, resolve tradeoffs with the platform team, commit the timelines, and stay hands\-on in the hardest parts of the build. * **Build agent systems that hold up in clinical settings.** That means hierarchies of agents and skills rather than one monolith, and evals that measure distributions, not vibes. Nothing reaches a patient until it clears our safety floor and eval gate. * **Take on the integration reality.** EHRs, legacy systems, and customer data come in every shape. You find the path from what the customer has to what the platform needs. * **Make it compound.** You turn field\-proven patterns into first\-class platform capabilities. You also push proven work down from agent reasoning into deterministic data lookups, the move where twenty tool calls become one. That's how we grow without turning into a services shop. * **Push back early.** When a spec was never vetted, an integration isn't supported, or scope quietly changed mid\-build, you raise it before the build pays for it. * **Raise the people around you.** Mentor engineers across deployments and help set the team's architecture and engineering standards. Write documentation good enough that a coding agent or a new hire could pick up your work. **You might be a great fit if you** ----------------------------------- * Have shipped and owned complex production systems end to end, with real users depending on them. * Have set technical direction across multiple projects or teams, and helped other engineers make sound architecture decisions. * Have real experience building with LLMs and agents in production, or the engineering depth to get there fast. * Treat non\-deterministic systems with rigor. You know three runs of an agent is a feeling, not evidence. * Hold the near term and the long term at once: what a decision costs now, and what it makes easier or harder for the team later. * Are comfortable in the room with customers and clinicians. You'd rather understand the workflow than wait for a perfect spec. * Care about craft. Your systems fail loudly to you before they fail to a customer, and they keep working while you're on vacation. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Healthcare experience: EHR integrations (Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth), HL7, FHIR, or clinical workflows. * Experience with Databricks, voice agents, or forward deployed or customer engineering. * Time at an early\-stage startup. **Why this role** ----------------- * **Stakes.** Your work runs inside health systems and touches patient care. * **Ownership, early.** You own complex use cases and shared technical decisions from the start. At a 35\-person company, scope arrives fast. * **Leverage.** What you build in the field becomes the platform. Few roles let you shape the product this directly. * **Technical leadership.** Set direction across Applied AI while staying close to the code. Your impact grows through the decisions and patterns the whole team builds on. * **A week built for deep work.** Collaborative in\-office sprints early in the week, a protected focus day on Thursday, and Friday to consolidate what we learned. **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $240K \- $300K

jobs.description: ABM (NYSE: ABM) is a leading provider of facility solutions with revenues of approximately $8\.7 billion and over 130,000 employees in 300\+ offices deployed throughout the United States and various international locations. ABM’s comprehensive capabilities include electrical \& lighting, energy solutions, facilities engineering, HVAC \& mechanical, janitorial, landscape \& turf, mission critical solutions and parking, provided through stand\-alone or integrated solutions. Reporting directly to the SVP \& CISO, the Director, AI Security Enablement will build and lead ABM's enterprise AI security strategy to include imbedding security into artificial intelligence, machine learning, and agentic AI across the business, spanning ABM’s AI security tooling, internal AI/ML development, and third\-party AI products and vendors. This leader designs and champions the guardrails, governance, and technical controls that allow ABM to adopt AI and agentic AI capabilities quickly and confidently, while protecting the business, its customers, and its employees from the emerging risks these technologies introduce. The role carries direct people\-leadership responsibility, building and developing a team of approximately three AI/ML security specialists, and also requires strong matrix\-management skills to coordinate and drive security outcomes through engineers, developers, data scientists, and vendor teams who do not report directly to this role. Highly organized program and stakeholder management is essential: this leader will run multiple concurrent security\-enablement initiatives across internal development teams and third\-party AI vendors, track them to completion, and communicate progress clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders and executive leadership. The Director, AI Security Enablement must have hands\-on depth in both traditional cybersecurity and modern AI security — including large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and agentic AI architectures where autonomous or semi\-autonomous agents take actions, call tools, and access systems and data on behalf of users or other systems. This role will establish cross\-functional partnerships across Security, Engineering, Data Science \& AI/ML teams, Legal, Risk, Privacy, and Operations to enable innovation while protecting the organization from emerging AI risks. **Benefits**: ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM Employee Benefits \| Staff \& Management **Pay:** $176,505 \- $260,000 The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data. You will also be eligible to participate in a company incentive or bonus program. ***Hybrid Model****: This leadership position is hybrid Monday\-Thursday. The role may require occasional travel based on business needs.* **Key Responsibilities** * Define and execute the enterprise AI security strategy, roadmap, and governance framework. * Establish policies, standards, and risk management practices for AI technologies. * Embed security\-by\-design principles across the AI lifecycle. * Lead AI threat modeling, security assessments, red teaming, and risk evaluations. * Build and develop a high\-performing AI Security team. * Provide executive\-level reporting on AI security posture, risks, and program maturity. * Partner with business and technology leaders to accelerate secure AI adoption. * Oversee AI\-related incident response, investigations, and remediation efforts. * Drive continuous improvement through metrics, industry benchmarking, and emerging threat monitoring. **What You'll Bring** **AI Security Expertise** * Deep understanding of AI and generative AI security concepts, including large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, autonomous agents, multi\-agent systems, and tool/function\-calling architectures. * Hands\-on experience evaluating and securing AI systems, including prompt injection defenses, jailbreak testing, data leakage prevention, and secure Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) implementations. * Knowledge of AI/ML security controls, governance practices, and security tooling used to monitor, assess, and protect AI environments. **Cloud \& Technology Platforms** * Experience securing AI solutions deployed on major cloud platforms, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. * Familiarity with cloud\-native AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI Service, and Vertex AI, including associated security controls. **Executive Communication \& Influence** * Ability to translate complex AI security risks into practical business recommendations for technical teams, business leaders, and executive stakeholders. * Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional leadership skills. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field. * 12\+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience. * 5\+ years of experience leading and developing technical security teams. * 3\+ years leading AI security, AI governance, generative AI, or related cybersecurity programs. * **Governance, Risk \& Compliance** + Working knowledge of leading AI security and governance frameworks, such as NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Security Guidance, MITRE ATLAS, ISO 42001, or similar standards. + Understanding of AI\-related regulatory, privacy, and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act, HIPAA, or comparable frameworks. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or related field. * CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CDPSE, AI Governance Professional (AIGP), or equivalent architectural standards. * Conduct pairing sessions, code reviews, and workshops to help junior and mid\-level developers level up their development, architectures, and overall engineering skills. * jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000\+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations. Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands\-on experience, certifications, industry training and more. Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward! A Data Engineer is responsible for building, automating, and optimizing the infrastructure and processes that enable rapid, reliable software delivery. This role sits at the intersection of development and operations, focusing on creating CI/CD pipelines, managing cloud environments, and implementing Infrastructure as Code to ensure systems are scalable, secure, and resilient. Data Engineers work closely with developers to integrate automation, improve deployment workflows, and monitor application performance to maintain high availability across environments. A DevOps Engineer is responsible for building, automating, and optimizing the infrastructure and processes that enable rapid, reliable software delivery. This role sits at the intersection of development and operations, focusing on creating CI/CD pipelines, managing cloud environments, and implementing Infrastructure as Code to ensure systems are scalable, secure, and resilient. DevOps Engineers work closely with developers to integrate automation, improve deployment workflows, and monitor application performance to maintain high availability across environments. Beyond technical implementation, a DevOps Engineer fosters a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and shared ownership across engineering teams. They proactively identify bottlenecks, recommend architectural enhancements, and champion practices such as containerization, configuration\-as\-code, and automated testing. technical field. * Internship, co\-op, research, academic project, or early professional experience in a regulated, safety\-critical, medical device, robotics, automation, or high\-reliability engineering environment. * Demonstrated ability to test and verify developed hardware and software against requirements. * Ability to develop system\-level requirements for motion control systems and effectively integrate both individual components into a system and sub\-systems into a larger system. * Experience or strong academic/project exposure working with automated or robotic systems and their components (motor controllers, drive electronics, sensors, etc.), including low\-level firmware, mid\-level software interfaces/device drivers, APIs, and robot controls middleware. * Experience developing robotics, motion control, or embedded software in regulated, safety\-critical, or high\-reliability environments. * Experience programming digital motion controllers, including configuration and utilization of digital I/O for motion control applications. * Self\-starter who can make progress independently while seeking guidance appropriately, collaborating with peers and management as needed. * Demonstrated experience developing, building, debugging, or deploying software in Linux\-based environments. * Exposure to 3D CAD modeling software (SolidWorks preferred) and virtualization tools for robotics applications. * Exposure to Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) and parallel computing concepts. * Proficiency with linear algebra, rigid transformations, coordinate frames, and/or robotics software for serial\-link manipulators. * Proficiency in working with databases, including querying, data manipulation, and schema design. * Strong foundational knowledge in jobs.description: **Role summary** ---------------- Full\-stack engineer building enterprise applications on Azure. Customers specify their model, instructions, tools, skills, memory, and execution limits. AgentCore Harness manages the agent loop, secure execution environment, session isolation, identity, networking, observability, and deployment lifecycle. This allows developers to move quickly from an idea to a production agent while retaining the flexibility to integrate custom tools, models, and environments. You will collaborate with engineers across these services to integrate capabilities, improve cross\-service APIs, and reduce friction throughout the agent development lifecycle. You will work backward from customer needs to turn complex infrastructure and orchestration tasks into intuitive configuration, sensible defaults, reusable templates, and guided workflows. jobs.title: Intermediate .NET Developer
jobs.description: **We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this** **link** **directly.** **Who we are** At Aquila, we invest in category\-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought\-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well\-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities. We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen. At Emphasys HFA (Housing Finance Agency), a division of Emphasys, we build and support the only end\-to\-end financial software in the U.S. dedicated to affordable housing. As the largest full\-service provider in this space, we enable State Housing Finance Agencies and other public organizations to administer programs that help families access affordable homeownership or rental housing. Our solutions power the financial backbone that processes funding, manages compliance, and ensures every dollar of support is tracked and maximized. **Who we need** Reporting to the Development Manager, we are hiring an Intermediate .NET Developer to play a key technical role in transforming established financial software used by Housing Finance Agencies across the United States. You will join at the early stages of a major replatforming initiative, helping shape the architecture and design of a modern system while taking ownership of back\-end development for assigned products. Working closely with the Development Manager and a collaborative development team, you will turn complex legacy applications into modern, reliable solutions, influence technical decisions, and help guide the work from initial design through delivery. *This is a full\-time, remote role based in the United States, working 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern time.* **What’s in it for you** *Ownership from the start.* You will join at the early stages of replatforming established financial applications, helping shape the architecture and design of the new system. As a technical lead on the project, you will influence key decisions, guide other developers, and see your ideas take shape in a modern platform. *Meaningful technical challenges.* You will take on the complexity of transforming legacy applications that customers rely on, using modern .NET technologies and cloud\-hosted environments. You will tackle architectural challenges, improve performance and maintainability, and help establish technical standards for the evolving platform. You will see the impact of your work as established applications become more modern, reliable, and scalable. *Explore emerging technologies.* You will join a team that actively encourages and supports the use of AI\-assisted development tools. Whether you already use these tools or want to gain experience, you will have the opportunity to experiment, build practical skills, and explore how AI can improve coding, testing, and problem\-solving. **How you will make an impact** * **Lead the replatforming effort.** You will take a technical lead role in modernizing our financial software, helping transform legacy applications into a modern, integrated platform. Starting with an established financial module, you will work with the team to translate existing functionality into new solutions, improve the user experience, and build a foundation for modernizing additional modules. * **Own back\-end architecture and development.** You will define service structures, API contracts, and data\-access patterns for assigned products, working closely with the Development Manager on technical direction. You will design, build, and maintain web applications and RESTful APIs using C\# and modern .NET technologies, making thoughtful architectural decisions that support security, performance, and long\-term maintainability. * **Build connected, reliable solutions.** You will collaborate closely with our database and front\-end developers to ensure the application, database, and front\-end layers work together effectively. You will develop and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures, contribute to Angular functionality as needed, and troubleshoot complex issues across the application stack. * **Drive development and delivery.** You will work with Product Management to turn requirements and the product roadmap into technical plans, development tasks, and realistic estimates. You will contribute throughout the agile development lifecycle, from design and coding to testing, deployment, and ongoing support, documenting key technical decisions and ensuring the team has the information needed to maintain and evolve the platform. * **Guide tec maintain front\-end functionality, integrate applications with APIs, and investigate issues across the application stack without needing to be a front\-end specialist. * **The database skills.** You have experience working with SQL Server, T\-SQL, stored procedures, and relational database design. You understand how to optimize queries and work with data\-access technologies such as Entity Framework Core or Dapper to support application performance and reliability. * **The problem\-solving approach.** You have worked with complex, established applications and can understand existing functionality, troubleshoot issues, and identify opportunities for modernization and improvement. You bring experience with automated testing, code reviews, and cloud technologies such as Azure or AWS. Exposure to legacy migrations, microservices, or financial software would be valuable. * **The adaptability and curiosity.** You are comfortable learning new technologies and exploring tools that improve how software is developed. You may have experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Cursor, or you are interested in building those skills. Familiarity with development and DevOps tools such as Git and Azure DevOps is an asset. * **The collaboration.** You communicate technical ideas clearly, work effectively with product stakeholders and distributed development teams, and enjoy sharing knowledge with others. You are comfortable balancing development with technical guidance and bring curiosity and a willingness to learn, experiment, and incorporate emerging tools into your work. **Join us.** As an Aquila company, Emphasys Software brings together bright, talented people who aspire to excellence and share a commitment to upholding our mission: To be a company of outstanding people delivering vertical market software solutions through long\-term partnerships with clients. Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support. **Apply now.** Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we are looking for and want to play an integral role in changing an industry, apply to express your interest. **What you can expect from our interview process:** * A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor discussing your interest in the role, the team’s culture and your experience. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI\-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview. * A virtual technical interview with the Development Manager and members of the technical team, focused on your .NET development experience, architectural decision\-making, problem\-solving approach, and ability to evaluate technical trade\-offs. The conversation may include practical technical questions and scenarios to understand how you approach solutions. * A final virtual interview with the General Manager, focused on your approach to collaboration, ownership, adaptability, and contributing to the team's long\-term success. Aquila and Emphasys Software promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and accommodations are available on request. \#LI\-DNI **We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. jobs.title: Control System Engineer
jobs.description: Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together. **Role description:** Arcadis is looking for an Instrumentation \& Control (I\&C) Systems Engineer with 5 to 7 years of experience to join our Water Business Line in our White Plains, New York office. Please note that this is a hybrid position that will require approximately 50% travel mainly throughout Westchester County and surrounding Connecticut areas. This is an exciting opportunity for an I\&C Systems Engineer with experience in industrial control systems, process automation, and SCADA system integration and networking to join our team. The selected candidate will be responsible for SCADA system design, SCADA network design, implementation, programming, and configuration services, and startup activities for diverse clients and projects for environmental remediation, industrial \& municipal water and wastewater treatment, conveyance systems, and facilities. **Role accountabilities:** Position requires the knowledge and experience to perform the following tasks: **Design and Engineering** Development of PLC programs and HMI applications based on process and operational requirements will be a key function of this position. The ideal candidate must be able to demonstate proficienty in this skill while also being able to incorporate client and operator needs into the system design. Arcadis is a multi\-disciplinary company so you must be able to coordinate with other disciplines and perform engineering to develop design documents including P\&IDs, SCADA architecture diagrams, and network diagrams and specifications. In addition to PLC and HMI applications we are also looking for someone that can develop process and equipment control strategies in collaboration with process, mechanical, electrical, and other engineering disciplines. Lastly, the design and development of control panel layouts, including PLC hardware and other control system components is a a desired skill **Software Development \& System Configuration** A successful candidate in this position will be able to perform PLC programming using Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram, and Structured Text, applying modular programming concepts, add\-on instructions, and user\-defined function blocks. Some of the platforms we would ideally like candidates to have experience using to develop SCADA applications will included but are not limited to, VTScada, Ignition, FactoryTalk View, and GE iFIX. In this position our expecatation is that you will be able to configure historical data collection, database integration, data archiving, and reporting systems. Addtionals skills in this area include but are not limited to: * Design and configure industrial networking, and troubleshoot industrial communication networks utilizing protocols including EtherNet/IP and Modbus TCP/IP. * Understand, apply, and test operating system, application, and vendor\-specific requirements for software implementations in accordance with manufacturer best practices. * Implement OT infrastructure solutions utilizing physical and virtualized hardware platforms. * Configure and support Windows operating systems, Active Directory integration, Group Policy settings, security configurations, and related software dependencies. **Startup, Commissioning, and Field Deployment** We are looking for someone who will be able to utilize technical knowledge and experience in the testing, startup, commissioning, and cutover of SCADA systems and networks. This responsbility will involve being able to conduct factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), field checkout, troubleshooting, and startup activities. A strong candidate must be able to interpret industrial control schematics, MCC drawings, and electrical diagrams to support installation, startup, and troubleshooting efforts and also maintain accurate as\-built documentation and configuration management records. **Qualifications \& Experience:** **Technical Qualifications:** * Experience with PLC programming, HMI software configuration, and control system startup. * Experience implementing and working with standards, policies, frameworks, and compliance requirements related to SCADA, OT, IT, and industrial networking systems. * Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical or Environmental Engineering, or a closely related field of study. **Professional Skills** * Experience with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and MS Project. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Excellent teamwork, coordination, and client communication skills. **Travel Requirements** * Valid driver's license with a clean driving record. * Willingness to travel up to 50%. Continue your career journey as an Arcadian. We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together. You do meaningful work, and no matter where your next role in Arcadis takes you, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark; on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you. Together, we can create a lasting legacy. Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to a policy of non\-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Arcadis offers benefits for full time and part time positions. These benefits include medical, dental, and vision, EAP, 401K, STD, LTD, AD\&D, life insurance, paid parental leave, reward \& recognition program and optional benefits including wellbeing benefits, adoption assistance and tuition reimbursement. We offer nine paid holidays and 15\-20 days PTO that accrue per year. The salary range for this position is $110,000 \- $130,000\. Actual salaries will vary and are based on several factors, such as experience, education, budget, internal equity, project and location. \#LI\-ET1

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: #### **New York, New York, United States** Data and AI Consulting Americas Region    NEW00029T Requisition \# **Joining Arup** Arup’s purpose, shared values, and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Arup works on some of the world's most complex challenges across the built and natural environment, from designing the infrastructure and cities of the future to improving how critical systems operate today. Artificial intelligence is opening up new ways to address these challenges. We are investing in our AI and machine learning capabilities to explore what is possible, develop innovative approaches and deliver practical solutions for our clients. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced technology and real\-world engineering, alongside specialists from across Arup's global business. You'll have access to interesting problems, the freedom to explore new ideas and the opportunity to shape how AI is applied across our projects and markets. **The Opportunity** We are looking for an ambitious and curious AI/ML Engineer to play a key role in developing and delivering our AI capabilities across the Americas. Above all, we want someone who is excited by problems and the potential of AI to solve them. Someone who enjoys working with engineers, scientists, designers and consultants to understand complex challenges, recognise where new technologies could make a difference, and turn those opportunities into practical solutions. The role spans applications across infrastructure, energy, transport, water, buildings and the environment. You might be developing predictive models for critical infrastructure, applying computer vision to understand the physical world, using generative AI to transform engineering workflows, or exploring entirely new approaches to longstanding challenges. You will be a key technical member of our growing AI/ML team, with the opportunity to lead projects, shape technical approaches and develop junior colleagues. We also want someone who embraces the changing nature of software development. We encourage the use of AI\-assisted coding, agents and emerging development tools to accelerate experimentation, improve productivity and rethink how technical solutions are built. You'll have the opportunity to explore these tools, bring new approaches into our work and help others adopt them effectively. **Key responsibilities include:** * **Lead AI/ML projects:** Take technical ownership of projects from identifying opportunities and developing concepts through to building, validating and deploying solutions. * **Explore new applications of AI:** Work with specialists across Arup to understand their challenges, identify where AI could add value and develop creative approaches to solving problems. * **Develop technical solutions:** Design and build machine learning models, AI applications and supporting data pipelines, selecting the most appropriate technologies for each challenge. * **Embrace AI\-assisted development:** Make effective use of AI coding assistants, agents and emerging tools to accelerate development, experiment with new ideas and improve how we deliver technical work, while maintaining quality and technical rigour. * **Develop our team:** Mentor junior engineers and data scientists, provide technical guidance, share knowledge and help build a collaborative and ambitious technical team. * **Shape our AI capability:** Contribute to client discussions, proposals, technical strategy and the development of reusable solutions that can be applied across projects and markets. This is a role with considerable variety, autonomy and opportunity to grow. You'll be encouraged to challenge conventional approaches, explore emerging technologies and help define how Arup uses AI to solve some of the most important challenges facing our clients and communities. At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve. **Is this role right for you?** We are particularly interested in people who are motivated by the potential of AI, enjoy tackling unfamiliar problems and want to take responsibility for technical delivery and developing others. * **Background and experience:** A degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, data science or a related field, with typically 5\+ years of relevant experience applying AI/ML to practical problems, including experience leading technical work. * **Strong technical skills:** Proficiency in Python and modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit\-learn, alongside experience with data engineering, cloud technologies and deploying models into practical app bution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts. **Benefits at Work** – At Arup, we have a comprehensive and valuable benefits program that works for our employees and their families while keeping costs low. These benefits provide health and welfare security for you as well as paid time off for rest and renewal. As a member of Arup, everyone shares in our success through a global profit share scheme (payments are dependent on the firm’s financial performance). Our Global Profit Share Plan (paid bi\-annually) provides an opportunity for you to share in the success of the Firm. As a valued employee of Arup, you can also choose to participate in our 401(k) plan with up to 10% company match to help you save for your future. **Flexible Working** – We believe that flexible arrangements create a more inclusive way of working that supports our diversity and the wellbeing of our people. Options for alternative schedules and the ability to work outside of the office for a portion of your workweek are available. **New York City, New York – United States of America Hiring Range** – The good faith base salary hiring range for this job if performed in New York City is $115,000 to $125,000 per year. This range is commensurate with experience, educational background, and skill level. Benefits are not included in the base salary. Please note hiring ranges for candidates performing work outside of New York City will differ. **Different People, Shared Values** Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence. Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup. **Our Application Process** We will be reviewing our candidates for this position on a rolling basis. Once you have applied you will be evaluated and potentially moved on to the next round, at which point a member of the talent resourcing team will reach out to you directly. **Arup is an equal opportunity employer**. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, spouse of a protected veteran, or disability. **Stay safe online**. Recruitment fraud is on the rise, and Arup’s name, logo, and branding have been used in fraudulent job advertisements. Arup will never ask for bank information as part of our recruitment process. \#LI\-VK1
