jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Search Backend
jobs.description: **Vacancy No** VN449 **Status** Active **Location** Remote US **Location Country** United States **Location Region** **Location City** **Description** Who are we? Auction Technology Group (ATG) is transforming the multi\-billion\-dollar global auction industry. Our platforms connect thousands of auction houses with buyers in over 170 countries, powering more than $15 billion in annual sales. Through innovative online auction technologies, we help auctioneers expand their reach, boost efficiency, and maximize value, while giving bidders unrivaled access to rare and specialized items. As a publicly traded company, ATG has scaled from $18 million to $170 million in revenue, with sustained growth beyond the pandemic. We’re modernizing one of the last industries to fully go digital, building a global, category\-defining business in the process. What are we hiring for? We’re seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our Search \& Discovery team, the team that owns how millions of buyers find one\-of\-a\-kind items across our marketplaces (LiveAuctioneers, Proxibid, and our whitelabel platform). You’ll own the design and evolution of the shared search backend that serves every keyword search, suggestion, and results page: the query APIs, the real\-time indexing pipelines that keep tens of millions of listings fresh in Elasticsearch, and the data workflows that feed ranking signals back into search. At Staff level, success is measured by whether the work outlasts your direct involvement; the architecture you set, the standards you raise, and the engineers you develop should hold up as the platform grows. Our stack is Python\-centred (FastAPI services on Kubernetes) with Go services at the edges, Elasticsearch at the core, RabbitMQ\-driven indexing, MySQL and Redis for supporting data, and Airflow\-orchestrated batch workflows against our data warehouse. You’ll shape technical direction with the engineering manager and architects, drive initiatives that span the search team and its neighboring teams (Product, Data, platform, and the marketplace front\-ends), and mentor the Senior engineers around you. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on a platform serving millions of users worldwide. Search is the front door of our marketplaces, and the systems you design directly move what buyers find, what sellers sell, and what the platform costs to run. **Key Responsibilities** What you’ll be doing: Own the design and evolution of the search backend (query serving, indexing, and the ranking\-signal data loop), introducing architectural patterns that improve scalability, reliability, and maintainability Stay hands\-on: design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and RESTful APIs in Python (FastAPI) powering search across our marketplaces Own and evolve how we query Elasticsearch (query construction, mappings and analyzers, relevance and ranking) for a catalog of tens of millions of live and historical listings, including capacity, latency, and cluster\-cost trade\-offs Drive the health and throughput of the event\-driven indexing pipelines from RabbitMQ into Elasticsearch, setting the standards for freshness, blast\-radius control, and replay/backfill safety Design batch and data workflows (Airflow, data warehouse) that compute ranking signals, search suggestions, and related searches feeding back into the live search experience Drive delivery across teams: decompose complex problems into well\-scoped initiatives, identify risks early, improve predictability, and unblock others without becoming a bottleneck Determine when technical spikes and proof\-of\-concepts are needed, define their success criteria, and validate outcomes; sponsor and review spikes led by Senior engineers Set and raise engineering standards for the team: testing practices, deployment quality gates, observability (Dynatrace/DataSet), and incident readiness of a business\-critical serving path Lead incident response for the search domain when it matters most, and turn incidents into prevention through post\-incident improvements Weigh technical decisions against operations, cost, and customer experience; make the trade\-offs explicit when proposing direction Integrate AI and automation into engineering workflows to improve productivity, quality, and early risk detection, with sound judgment about when not to rely on it Mentor Senior engineers and support their growth into broader technical ownership; act as a key technical interviewer and contributor to hiring decisions Write the technical documentation and decision records that let your architectural decisions survive contact with a growing organization **Key Requirements** Who are we looking for? Required Experience \& Skills: 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on backend development (or 6\+ years with a Master’s degree, or a PhD with 3\+ years, or equivalent) Expert\-level Python with production experience building and operating scalable backend services; this is a must Production experience with at least one statically typed language (Go, Java, Kotlin, C\#, or similar) in addition to Python Production experience with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch at scale: query DSL, index mappings and analyzers, performance/relevance tuning, and capacity planning A track record of owning the design and evolution of systems or significant components, applying architectural thinking to scalability, reliability, and maintainability Experience driving delivery across teams: decomposing complex problems into well\-scoped initiatives, guiding sound technical trade\-offs, and improving execution predictability Experience with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) including schema design, optimization, and query tuning Experience deploying and operating containerized services on Kubernetes Experience with workflow orchestration and batch data pipelines (Airflow or similar) Knowledge of message queuing systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) and event\-driven architectures Strong understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and distributed systems Experience with testing frameworks and comprehensive test suites, and with observability tooling (Dynatrace/Datadog or similar) Experience with on\-call rotation and incident management: able to independently triage incidents in your domain, without guidance, from alert to root cause and resolution, and to lead incident response when multiple teams are involved A record of mentoring senior\-level engineers and contributing to hiring (interviewing, calibration, raising the bar) Clear understanding of how technical decisions impact operations, cost, and customer experience Familiarity with AWS cloud services Soft Skills: Leads cross\-team initiatives and defines execution standards that improve consistency and scalability Makes data\-backed decisions that impact multiple teams and medium\-term objectives; develops strategic insight from data and experience Excellent communication skills: tailors messages to technical and non\-technical audiences, from engineers to mid\-management, and articulates trade\-offs clearly Engages cross\-functional teams to align on business priorities, influencing beyond immediate team boundaries Leads change initiatives: addresses resistance, secures buy\-in, and reinforces long\-term behavioral shifts Coaches and develops others; models engineering excellence in reviews, design discussions, and hiring Addresses cross\-functional challenges with systemic process improvements rather than one\-off fixes Proactive about technical investment: balances short\-term delivery with long\-term maintainability, and can defend the balance Nice\-to\-Have: Production experience with Go; several of our services are written in Go Exposure to TypeScript (you may occasionally touch front\-end or tooling code) Search relevance and information\-retrieval depth: BM25 tuning, ranking metrics (NDCG, CTR), learning\-to\-rank, vector or hybrid search Experience with data warehouses (Snowflake, Bigquery) and analytics pipelines Experience in eCommerce, marketplace, or auction platforms (e.g. LiveAuctioneers, Proxibid, Chairish); high\-traffic or real\-time systems Auction Technology Group is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay is up to $200,000\. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. **Employment Type** Permanent **Duration** **Business Name** **Function Name** Technology

jobs.title: Applied AI and Security Engineer
jobs.description: The role of Applied AI and Security Engineer is to protect AOD digital assets, networks, and data from cyber threats by implementing security measures, monitoring for vulnerabilities and incidents, and responding effectively to mitigate risks and safeguard against potential breaches. They work to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information systems, thereby maintaining the trust and operational continuity of the organization. **ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES** ============================== * Assist in the implementation, maintenance, and monitoring of cybersecurity measures and tools to protect the organization's systems, networks, and data. * Perform regular security assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities, recommend remediation actions and compliance. * Monitor security events and alerts to detect and respond to potential security incidents in a timely manner. * Educate and train staff on information system security best practices. * Participate in the development and enforcement of cybersecurity policies, procedures, and standards. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate security best practices into the design and implementation of new technologies and systems. * Provide support and guidance to the service desk on security\-related issues and best practices. * Stay up to date on the latest cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies through continuous learning and professional development activities. * Assist in the investigation and resolution of security incidents, including root cause analysis and post\-incident remediation efforts. * Contribute to the development and improvement of security tools, processes, and methodologies. * Assist with remediation testing and deployment for all AOD systems. * Plan, develop, implement, and update company’s information security strategy. * Participate in regular testing of Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, Security Incident Response. * Drive tabletop testing exercises with all of IT and OT, simulating intrusions and continuously improving the AOD IT Security Incident Response Plan, and AOD IT’s ability to respond effectively and quickly to any intrusion. * Collaborate with IT Operations to ensure all CMDBs and BIAs are maintained and kept up to date. **OTHER REQUIRED RESPONSIBILITIES** =================================== * Excellent communication skills, especially when working with users or other IT team members to resolve technology issues. * Periodic after\-hours and weekend work required to resolve urgent problems and to carry out certain types of routine maintenance. * Other duties as assigned. **COMPETENCIES REQUIRED FOR SUCCESS** ===================================== Analysis Skills Judgement/Decision Making Pragmatism Initiative Follow Through Problem Resolution Excellence Adaptability Customer Focus Team Player Communication – Oral / Written Initiative Emotional Intelligence Organization / Planning Independence Creativity Pragmatism **KNOWLEDGE \& EXPERIENCE** =========================== * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience. * Solid understanding of networking protocols, operating systems, and security principles. * Knowledge of common cybersecurity technologies and tools, such as firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, antivirus software, EDR, SIEM solutions, etc. * Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks, such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO/IEC 27001, CIS Controls, etc. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and creatively under pressure. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders at all levels of the organization. * Relevant certifications, such as CompTIA Security\+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), etc., are a plus. * Experience collaborating with outside partners such as Security Operations Centers and Managed Security Services Providers preferred. * Prior experience in a cybersecurity\-related role preferred. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** ========================= Must be able to work safely in plant and farm environments; to lift up to 50 lbs., work with equipment on the floor (under desks) and from a ladder. Regular standing, walking, bending, stooping, sitting in various positions for long periods of time. Use of hands to handle, grasp and reach with hands and arms for long periods of time. Climb, balance, kneel, crouch, and crawl. Available for regular scheduled travel to remote facilities via automobile or airline.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Frameworks
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all. We are searching for a Staff Software Engineer to join Aurora's Autonomy Frameworks team. This team builds the robotics middleware that powers the Aurora Driver: the runtime framework that every Autonomy and Simulation application uses to communicate, execute, and interact with the vehicle platform, both on the road and offline in the cloud. **In this role, you will** * Define and evolve the architecture of Aurora's AV runtime framework across on\-vehicle and offline execution * Design and implement high\-performance, low\-latency inter\-module communication, including shared\-memory, zero\-copy IPC, and RPC * Own stack configuration, deployment, and process lifecycle management on the vehicle compute platform * Improve the determinism, fidelity, and performance of offline execution so on\-vehicle behavior can be faithfully reproduced at scale * Build framework capabilities for fault traceability, health monitoring, and recovery that support Aurora's safety case * Design intuitive C\+\+ APIs that make the right patterns easy for Autonomy engineers * Provide engineering support for field testing and fleet operations * Mentor senior engineers, set coding standards, and drive the long\-term roadmap for the AV framework **Required Qualifications** * BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent industry experience * Expert\-level C\+\+ programming skills and the ability to design high\-performance, thread\-safe, and memory\-efficient systems in a Linux environment * Proven experience building middleware, runtime frameworks, or distributed systems, such as pub/sub messaging, IPC, schedulers, or executors * Deep understanding of concurrency, memory models, and Linux systems internals (processes, threads, scheduling, shared memory) * Ability to work across multiple programming languages and paradigms * A passion for writing robust, intuitive, and pragmatic production code * Ability to navigate and work effectively in large codebases * Strong verbal and written communication skills * Ability to work autonomously and collaborate effectively with colleagues across time zones **Desirable Qualifications** * Experience with robotics middleware such as ROS 2 or ThreadX or FreeRTOS, or with soft real\-time systems * Experience with deterministic simulation, log replay, or reproducible execution * Experience with performance evaluation and optimization * Experience with safety\-critical systems *For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA:* The salary range for this position is $171,000 \- $273,000 per year. *For roles based in San Francisco, CA, Mountain View, CA, and Seattle, WA:* The salary range for this position is $189,000 \- $303,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in\-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs. Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom. **Our commitment to safety** At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long\-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what. **Our commitment to inclusion** Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech. *For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.*

jobs.title: Marketing AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** Avenue Z is a digital marketing and PR agency engineered to move fast. Brands partner with us to drive revenue and reputation through high\-impact public relations, performance media, AI search optimization (AEO), and our creator network. Trusted by leaders in emerging tech, finance and consumer brands, ***we drive influence*** across all channels \- from AI Search to The Wall Street Journal, Shopify to TikTok, Meta to Google. **The role** ------------ You are a growth marketer who builds. You have bought media on Meta, Google, or TikTok with your own hands, you know what a good ROAS looks like before the dashboard loads, and when something is manual, repetitive, or slow, your instinct is to open an editor and wire it to the platform API rather than schedule a working session. The Marketing AI Engineer builds and ships the AI agents, automations, and reporting systems that run paid media, creator and affiliate campaigns, CRO, and client reporting at Avenue Z. The work is concrete: agents that launch and QA ads across Meta, TikTok, and Snap; systems that reallocate budget toward top\-performing creators; reporting that ties creator content, ad spend, and attributed revenue into one picture; alerts that catch an expiring TikTok Shop affiliate code or a Meta partnership permission before spend stalls. You are also the technical lead for our AI builders. You set the standard for how agents are designed, reviewed, and shipped across service lines, you review their work, and you are the person leadership turns to when a build needs a decision. You will embed with the paid media, creator, and ecommerce teams to find where throughput or margin is lost, build the system that fixes it, drive adoption, and move to the next one. This is a builder and a leader role. You ship working systems yourself, and you raise the bar for everyone else who ships them. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Build against the marketing platforms our revenue runs on** * Integrate with the Meta Marketing API, TikTok Business and TikTok Shop APIs, Google Ads API, Snap, Shopify, and affiliate and creator platform APIs: OAuth and token refresh, rate limits, webhooks, and partnership\-access flows. * Build agents and automations for ad launching and QA, budget pacing and reallocation, creative tagging and performance intelligence, anomaly detection, and cross\-platform commission tracking. * Build the reporting layer that shows a brand what actually drove revenue, cross\-referenced against Shopify as the source of truth. **Embed with the teams and ship against real problems** * Sit with paid media, creator and affiliate, CRO, and ecommerce teams. Audit how they work today, map the workflow from input to output, and find the steps that should run automatically. * Turn a messy manual process into a working system inside weeks, not quarters. Define where a human approves and where the system acts on its own, especially where money or brand safety is on the line. * Drive adoption. A system that ships and sits unused does not count. Train the team, gather feedback, and iterate. **Build Innovative AI Driven Marketing SolutionsAI** * Provide technical leadership on product roadmap. Be an expert in building and shipping production ready solutions. * Set the standard for how Avenue Z designs, reviews, documents, and ships agents and automations across service lines, and enforce it through code review and design review. * Review and mentor the engineers and builders already working on AI automation across PR, SEO and AEO, organic social, and ecommerce. Unblock them, raise their quality bar, and own the outcome of their work. * Run the intake and prioritization of automation requests so the team builds what moves revenue, time saved, or client retention, in that order. * Report progress, blockers, and measured impact to the CTO and present to leadership. **Invent new capability** * Build things that create new advantages for the business, not just faster versions of old tasks: autonomous media buying, creative\-to\-landing\-page pipelines, creator performance ranking, and whatever you see next that we have not. **What you won't do** --------------------- * Be a passive project coordinator or a pure strategist with no build capability. * Spend months planning without shipping. * Wait for perfect requirements before building. * Build for novelty instead of business value. * Replace human judgment where brand, strategy, or client context still matters. * Treat marketing as someone else's domain. You have to understand the ad account as well as the people running it. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A background in growth marketing. You have personally run paid media on at least one of Instagram and Facebook, Google, or TikTok, and you understand campaign structure, pixels and events, attribution windows, creative testing, and what the numbers mean. * Hands\-on experience working with the Meta Marketing API and the TikTok Business or TikTok Shop APIs, plus other marketing platform APIs (Google Ads, Shopify, Klaviyo, affiliate and creator platforms). You have built something real against them, not read the docs. * Deep, current, hands\-on knowledge of the digital marketing industry: how agencies and brands actually operate, where the manual work sits, and what clients pay for. * Extensive hands\-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) and a working command of good coding practice: version control, code review, environment and secrets management, testing, and documentation. jobs.description: **Job Description** At BAE Systems Space and Mission Systems (SMS), we design and deliver advanced defense, intelligence, and security solutions that protect national interests and enable mission success. Our teams tackle complex, high‑impact challenges using cutting\-edge technology, rigorous engineering, and data\-driven insight. We are seeking an AI Data Scientist to help shape the next generation of intelligent systems across our Space and Mission Systems Division. The Operations Strategic Capabilities Unit plays a fundamental role in enabling efficient business and program execution – from strategic capital investments, industrial operations and an efficient supply chain, to state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing and test operations and top\-notch facilities management. **What You’ll Do:** * **Lifecycle Leadership:** Adhere to and actively promote the MPA project lifecycle and Data Integration, Reporting/Visualization processes and best practices. * **Project Ownership:** Independently lead high\-complexity, cross\-functional, or ambiguous analytical projects. Demonstrate solid problem decomposition skills to turn vague business needs into concrete technical roadmaps. * **Technical Mentorship:** Provide direct technical guidance and mentorship to less\-experienced analysts and data scientists. Promote best practices in experimentation, modeling, and code quality across the entire team. * **Operational Management:** Accurately estimate and budget hours and milestone dates for assigned projects: track and report on hours to ensure alignment with budget and schedule. * **Quality Assurance:** Maintain a high standard of delivery where technical errors are minimized and manageable, ensuring stability in tool deployments. * **AI Development:** Design, develop, and deploy robust machine\-learning algorithms, with a specific focus on Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic frameworks, and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems. * **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work directly with a wide range of stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into actionable, user\-driven technical solutions. * Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule. * Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Units, Strategic Capabilities Units and the Company. Interact appropriately with others in order to maintain a positive and productive work environment. * Perform other duties as necessary. **On\-Site Work Environment:** This position requires regular in\-person engagement by working **on\-site three or more days** each normally scheduled week in the primary work location. Travel and local commute between company campuses and other possible non\-company locations may be required. **Working Conditions:** * Work is performed in an office, laboratory, production floor, or cleanroom, outdoors or remote research environment. * May occasionally work in production work centers where use of protective equipment and gear is required. * May access other facilities in various weather conditions. **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills** * BS degree or higher in Engineering or a related technical field is required plus 4 or more years related experience. * Each higher\-level degree, i.e., Master’s Degree or Ph.D., may substitute for two years of experience. Related technical experience may be considered in lieu of education. Degree must be from a university, college, or school which is accredited by an agency recognized by the US Secretary of Education, US Department of Education. * Proficiency in Python and SQL. * Solid Data Science background in Machine Learning (ML), statistical methods, and data modeling techniques. * Experience designing AI\-driven applications using API\-accessible LLMs (agent workflows, tool design, RAG). * Solid understanding of prompt/context engineering and system design for agent\-like architectures and evaluation techniques. * Extensive knowledge of modern LLM capabilities, limitations, and failure modes. * Experience with embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval systems. * Experience with AI workflow platforms (Dataiku, Stack AI, Open WebUI). \#LI\- JL2 **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $97008 \- $164914 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. **About BAE Systems, Inc.** BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, Space \& Mission Systems is a leading provider of national defense and civil space applications, advanced remote sensing, scientific and tactical systems for government and commercial customers. We continually pioneer ways to innovate spacecraft, mission payloads, optical systems, and other defense and civil capabilities. Powered by endlessly curious people with an unwavering mission focus, we continually discover ways to enable our customers to perform beyond expectation and protect what matters most. This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified. Multiple positions may be available on this opening.

APIs and GraphQL services. * Experience working with authentication technologies including JWT, OAuth2, Azure AD, Okta, Auth0, or OpenID Connect. * Strong understanding of responsive web design, accessibility (WCAG), semantic HTML, and cross\-browser compatibility. * Familiarity with modern front\-end build tools including Vite, Webpack, Babel, npm, and Yarn. * Experience working with Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or Bitbucket. * Experience using CI/CD platforms including GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Jenkins, or GitLab CI. * Strong debugging and performance optimization Scrum development environments. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience building enterprise SaaS platforms supporting thousands of concurrent users. * Familiarity with Next.js, Server\-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR). * Experience implementing Micro Frontend architecture using Module Federation. * Knowledge of Progressive Web Applications (PWA) and offline\-first web applications. * Experience integrating real\-time communication using SignalR, WebSockets, or Firebase. * Familiarity with cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform. * Experience with automated testing using Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium. * Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment. * Familiarity with OpenAPI (Swagger), GraphQL, Apollo Client, and API Gateway integrations. * Experience developing reusable enterprise component libraries and design systems. * Exposure to OpenTelemetry, application monitoring, and front\-end observability tools. **Project Environment** You will be joining a digital engineering team responsible for modernizing enterprise applications and delivering cloud\-native customer experiences. jobs.title: Software Delivery Lead
jobs.description: **Software Delivery Lead** **Driving Digital Transformation Through Successful Customer Deployments.** **Delivering Measurable Business Outcomes Through Technology, Leadership, and Execution Excellence.** **Partner with the best** Baker Hughes is scaling a dedicated global delivery function for the Cordant suite of digital solutions. The **Software Delivery Lead (SDL)** is the single point of accountability for a Cordant deployment from contract signature through go\-live and value realization. The SDL does not own a department—they own an outcome. For the duration of each engagement, the SDL stands up, leads, and is accountable for a cross\-functional delivery team assembled from consultants, software configuration experts, domain SMEs, data scientists, and forward deployed engineers, while those employees remain aligned to their home functions. This is a high\-visibility, high\-trust role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, builds credibility quickly with both customer executives and internal leaders, and treats delivery commitments as personal accountability rather than project plan milestones. SDLs report into the global Cordant Delivery organization and are assigned to engagements based on customer requirements, technical complexity, and geography. **Fuel your passion** As a **Software Delivery Lead**, you will serve as the delivery leader responsible for ensuring successful implementation, customer adoption, and value realization of Cordant Digital Solutions. You will lead matrixed teams, manage customer relationships, oversee delivery execution, and drive commercial and operational success throughout the engagement lifecycle. **As a Software Delivery Lead, you will be responsible for:** **Engagement Leadership \& Team Assembly** * Serving as the named delivery leader for Cordant deployments from post\-win handoff through project closeout. * Partnering with consulting, software configuration, data science, forward deployed engineering, and domain leadership teams to assemble the appropriate delivery team for each engagement. * Negotiating resource allocation and capacity requirements across multiple functions. * Leading matrixed teams throughout the engagement lifecycle without direct line management authority. * Establishing direction, removing obstacles, and driving accountability across the delivery team. **Project \& Program Management** * Owning engagement scope, schedule, budget, resourcing, and risk management from kickoff through go\-live and transition to support. * Managing governance activities including steering committees, milestone reviews, and status reporting. * Driving disciplined scope management and change control processes. * Identifying risks and issues early while providing mitigation options and recommendations. * Tracking engagement financial performance, including cost\-to\-serve, margin, and utilization metrics. * Partnering with Finance and Commercial teams to ensure successful delivery performance. **Customer Relationship Ownership** * Serving as the customer's primary point of contact and trusted advisor throughout the deployment lifecycle. * Building relationships across both working teams and executive sponsor levels. * Managing customer expectations proactively and driving customer satisfaction. * Leading executive steering committee meetings and business reviews. * Translating technical progress into measurable business value and outcomes. * Driving customer adoption, value realization, and deployment success. **Internal Stakeholder Management** * Communicating project health, risks, opportunities, and resource requirements to Cordant Delivery leadership. * Acting as the liaison between customer\-facing delivery teams and internal organizations providing resources. * Identifying capacity constraints, skills gaps, and quality concerns before they become escalations. * Supporting commercial and sales teams during deal reviews, scoping activities, and future engagement planning. **Delivery Quality \& Continuous Improvement** * Ensuring delivery outputs meet customer expectations and quality standards across software, engineering, and data science workstreams. * Maintaining accountability for overall engagement outcomes. * Capturing lessons learned and supporting continuous improvement of deployment methodologies, playbooks, and templates. * Supporting customer training and knowledge transfer activities to enable sustainable post\-go\-live adoption. * Contributing to the evolution and maturity of Cordant's global delivery capabilities. **To be successful in this role you will:** * Have a **bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Computer Science, or a related field**. * Have **8–12\+ years of experience delivering complex technology, software, or digital transformation projects for enterprise and industrial customers**. * Have experience within a consulting organization at the Engagement Manager, Project Leader, or Senior Manager level, or within an industrial softwa caling delivery organizations, methodologies, and deployment frameworks. * MBA or other advanced degree. **Core Competencies** * **Leadership without Authority** – Ability to influence and align diverse technical teams toward common goals without direct management authority. * **Executive Communication** – Ability to communicate effectively with both executive stakeholders and technical teams. * **Commercial Acumen** – Strong understanding of scope, contracts, budgets, margins, and business outcomes. * **Risk \& Issue Management** – Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate risks before they impact delivery success. * **Adaptability** – Ability to rapidly learn new industries, technologies, and customer environments. * **Customer Centricity** – Focus on customer adoption, business value realization, and long\-term success. **Work in a way that works for you** We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns: * Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive. * Up to 30–50% travel based on active customer engagements, kickoffs, site visits, and milestone reviews. **Working with us** Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged, and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well\-being of our workforce, train and reward talent, and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other. **Working for you** Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. This role will establish the standards and patterns for task decomposition, orchestration, context and memory management, tool use, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and failure recovery that product teams will build from. The Head of AI Engineering will own the evaluation harness and baselines used to guide iteration and inform release and acceptance decisions for both internally developed and third\-party agents. This role will also own the Compass agents and agentic experiences end to end, including Ask Compass, the firm’s expert front door. As the Agent Factory continues to grow, this leader will help build and mentor the team, establish engineering and design standards, and partner closely with internal teams and external experts to advance Baker Tilly’s agentic engineering capabilities. This is a hands\-on engineering leadership role for someone who leads by building, participates directly in code and design reviews, and translates emerging agentic engineering practices into scalable, firm\-owned standards. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Define and build agentic reference patterns, including task decomposition, orchestration, context engineering, memory management, tool use, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and failure containment and recovery. * Maintain the agent pattern library and establish orchestration standards that product teams can consistently build from. * Own the Compass agents and full\-stack product experiences end to end, on the intelligence layer built by the Data \& AI Platform team. * Build and own the evaluation harness, baselines, and regression discipline used to drive iteration and inform release and acceptance decisions for internally developed and third\-party agents. * Establish evaluation and acceptance criteria in partnership with Product, Architecture, Platform \& Production Engineering, Quality Engineering, and other key stakeholders. * Partner with Platform \& Production Engineering to enable evaluation capabilities to operate at scale in production. * Lead the Agent Factory as it grows, setting a high standard for agent design, engineering quality, and full\-stack product development. * Conduct hands\-on design and code reviews across product teams and mentor engineers in agentic engineering practices. * Hire and develop full\-stack, forward\-deployed AI engineers who can build both agents and the applications in which they operate. * Partner with expert agentic\-engineering resources to absorb leading practices and translate them into Baker Tilly\-owned standards, patterns, and runbooks. * Direct third\-party and partner engineers delivering solutions against Baker Tilly’s technical standards. * Evaluate third\-party and vendor agents against the firm’s established technical and evaluation standards. * Partner with the Chief Architect to establish evaluation standards and promote proven patterns into the platform’s shared library. * Collaborate closely with Data \& AI Platform, Product, Design, Quality Engineering, Platform \& Production Engineering, subject matter experts, and engineering teams in India. * Engage in special projects and perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred. * 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years building and deploying LLM\-based or agentic systems in production. * Staff\- or principal\-level engineering experience with demonstrated success personally designing and shipping production agent systems. * Deep experience designing and building evaluation harnesses and using evaluation results, baselines, and regression testing to drive iteration and release decisions. * Strong knowledge of the modern agentic technology stack, including orchestration frameworks, tool/function calling and MCP, retrieval using vector and graph approaches, and context and memory management. * Experience with evaluation methodologies, including evaluation design, baselines, regression discipline, confidence frameworks, and LLM\-as\-judge patterns and limitations. * Full\-stack product engineering experience, including building the applications and user experiences in which agents operate. * Experience designing human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, checkpoints, review experiences, and failure\-containment mechanisms. * Strong hands\-on software engineering skills with recent experience writing production\-quality code in Python and/or TypeScript. * Experience with observability and tracing for agentic systems. * Experience directing third\-party or partner engineers against established technical standards. * Experience evaluating third\-party technologies or vendor agents against internal technical and quality standards. * Demonstrated ability to use AI and agentic development tools as a force multiplier in day\-to\-day engineering work. * Strong ability to collaborate across engineering, product, design, platform, and business teams while translating emerging technical practices into repeatable standards. * No certifications or licenses required. The pay range for this position is $250,000 to $400,000\. This range represents a good\-faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation the firm expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will depend on a variety of relevant factors, including an applicant’s skills, experience, qualifications, professional certifications, work arrangements, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range, and compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. Baker Tilly offers a compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Title: AI Engineer Department: IT Department Reports To: Director, Information Technology Services Revised Date: October 2026 SUMMARY The AI Engineer is responsible for identifying, developing, and implementing artificial intelligence solutions that improve organizational efficiency, productivity, and effectiveness across BCH. This position partners with departments throughout the organization to identify opportunities for AI integration, develop automated workflows, enhance existing business systems, and implement innovative technology solutions. The role also supports responsible AI adoption through technology evaluation, security and governance practices, employee training, and ongoing support. The AI Engineer serves as a technical resource and organizational partner in leveraging emerging technologies to streamline processes, improve decision\-making, and strengthen BCH's ability to fulfill its mission. QUALIFICATIONS: * A personal relationship with Jesus and committed to the mission of equipping the church to care for vulnerable children and families. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent education and relevant experience may be considered. * Three or more years of experience in software development, systems integration, automation, AI implementation, or a related technical field preferred. * Demonstrated experience implementing AI tools, developing automations, or integrating technology solutions into business processes. * Experience working with APIs, system integrations, workflow automation platforms, and enterprise applications. * Familiarity with generative AI platforms, large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and prompt engineering. * Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, or similar technologies preferred. * Knowledge of data security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI practices. * Experience with enterprise platforms such as Workday, Paycor, HubSpot, Microsoft 365, or similar systems is beneficial. * Meets the general qualifications for employment as outlined in the institution's personnel policies. * Must have a valid N.C. driver’s license, safe driving record, and periodically travel to agency and other locations. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 1\. AI Strategy and Opportunity Identification * Collaborate with departments across BCH to identify opportunities to leverage AI to improve processes, productivity, and service delivery. * Evaluate existing workflows and business processes to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency, and innovation. * Partner with department leaders to understand operational challenges and recommend appropriate AI\-driven solutions. * Maintain awareness of emerging AI technologies, capabilities, and industry trends. 2\. AI Development and Implementation * Design, develop, implement, and maintain AI\-powered solutions, tools, and automations. * Develop AI agents, workflow automations, and other solutions that reduce manual tasks and improve operational efficiency. * Configure and implement existing AI platforms and technologies to address organizational needs. * Test, troubleshoot, and refine AI solutions to ensure accuracy, reliability, usability, and effectiveness. * Monitor implemented solutions and identify opportunities for ongoing improvement. 3\. Systems Integration and Technical Solutions * Integrate AI capabilities into existing BCH business applications and technology platforms, including Workday, Paycor, HubSpot, and other enterprise systems. * Collaborate with IT team members and external vendors to develop integrations and ensure compatibility with existing technology infrastructure. * Evaluate APIs, automation platforms, and other technologies to support AI implementation. * Ensure AI solutions align with BCH's technology architecture, data standards, and security requirements. 4\. AI Governance, Security, and Responsible Use * Help establish and maintain organizational guidelines, standards, and best practices for the responsible use of AI. * Partner with IT leadership to address data privacy, information security, access controls, and regulatory considerations associated with AI technologies. * Evaluate AI tools and applications for security, reliability, accuracy, and organizational suitability before implementation. * Help ensure appropriate safeguards are in place when using sensitive, confidential, or personally identifiable information. * Monitor developments in AI governance and recommend updates to organizational practices and policies. 5\. Training, Adoption, and Organizational Support * Educate and train employees on available AI tools, capabilities, and appropriate use. * Develop resources, guidance, and training materials to support effective AI adoption across BCH. * Provide technical assistance and support to departments implementing AI solutions. * Encourage innovation a nologies. * Assess the effectiveness of implemented solutions and identify opportunities to improve organizational performance and productivity. CORE COMPENTENCIES: * Technical Expertise: Demonstrates the technical knowledge and skills necessary to develop, implement, integrate, and support AI solutions. * Innovation and Creativity: Seeks new and better ways to accomplish work and applies emerging technologies to solve organizational challenges. * Analytical Thinking: Evaluates complex processes, identifies opportunities, and develops practical solutions based on data and sound reasoning. * Collaboration: Builds effective working relationships across departments and works collaboratively to understand and address organizational needs. * Communication: Explains technical concepts in an understandable manner and effectively communicates solutions, recommendations, and training. * Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Demonstrates curiosity and a commitment to staying current with rapidly evolving technologies. * Stewardship and Accountability: Exercises sound judgment in the use of technology, resources, and confidential information while maintaining a focus on organizational priorities. FAITH AND MISSION ALIGNMENT: BCH is a Christ\-centered organization committed to sharing hope and changing lives, with beliefs rooted in Jesus Christ. Employees are expected to support BCH’s mission, purpose, and spiritual emphasis through professional conduct and service. * Professes to be a Christian believer. * Submits an individual Statement of Faith, Acknowledgement, and Pledge as part of employment requirements. EQUIPMENT: Ability to operate standard office machines such as copier, computer, fax, calculator, multimedia visual aids, etc. and to work within Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word software programs. LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read, analyzes, and interprets general information. Ability to effectively communicate with others, including managers, clients, customers, and the general public. CONTACT WITH OTHERS: Regular contact with colleagues in all departments, as well as with outside individuals and groups; should represent Baptist Children's Homes of NC, Inc. in a positive manner. Contacts outside of the agency where proper handling of situations is of utmost importance as the agency’s image could be affected. MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Excellent mathematical skills and the ability use accounting software and calculator to calculate figures. MENTAL / VISUAL / AUDITORY DEMAND: Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form and ability to draw conclusions. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, and ability to adjust focus. Must be able to talk and hear both in personal and on the telephone. CONFIDENTIAL DATA: Complies with agency policies and procedures concerning confidentiality and HIPAA regulations which include including employee, payroll and benefits, and may include aspects of client information, day to day care of the children, case records, family information, medical information, psychological services, etc which if disclosed, would have adverse internal and/or external effect, and could result in termination of employment. PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and stand, use hands and fingers, walk, reach with hands and arms, and occasionally lift 20 pounds. Periodic travel required to agency locations. WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job; usual office working conditions.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Server Infrastructure
jobs.description: Barnes \& Noble is the leading book retailer in the United States, with roots dating back to 1873 and a long history of growth through innovation and expansion. Today, under CEO James Daunt and private ownership by Elliott Advisors, Barnes \& Noble operates approximately 700 bookstores nationwide, serves over 700 communities across all 50 states, and maintains a robust digital presence through BN.com, NOOK® eBooks and audiobooks, and educational resources such as SparkNotes. The company also includes complementary retail brands such as Paper Source, Books Inc., Tattered Cover, and B. Dalton, further strengthening its market reach. Following a period of revitalization, Barnes \& Noble is experiencing strong momentum, with plans to open approximately 60 new stores in 2026, underscoring renewed confidence in physical retail and local bookselling. Combining expansive store networks, curated selections, enhanced in\-store experiences, and growing omnichannel capabilities, Barnes \& Noble remains the \#1 bookseller in the U.S. and a trusted, evolving partner within the publishing and retail ecosystem. Position Overview: The Sr. Manager, Server Infrastructure leads the Unix/Linux and Windows engineers and administrators responsible for installing, upgrading, and migrating servers on Linux, Unix, and Windows platforms to improve application security and performance. The role partners with business and application development teams to gather requirements and design tactical and strategic solutions, including server architecture and standards, that meet the company’s technical objectives. The role provides oversight and guidance, and steps in hands\-on when needed, for the enterprise Unix/Linux and Windows server environment: physical and virtual servers in on\-premises data centers, plus Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). The Senior Manager leads all levels of support for the enterprise automation platform (Ansible), identity management, and the Windows\-based DNS environment, as well as the enterprise Active Directory and email (Microsoft 365\) environments. The goal is a server environment for both databases and applications that is available, stable, high\-performing, scalable, maintainable, and reliable. This is a hands\-on role. It requires strong technical skills along with excellent leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills. It is a hybrid role requiring at least 3 days/week in our Monroe, NJ office. An employee in this position can expect a starting rate between $175,000 \- $185,000 annually, depending on experience, seniority, geographic locations, and other factors permitted by law. Position Responsibilities: * Manage a team of approximately 6 internal Unix/Linux engineers and Windows administrators, plus Tier 2 and Tier 3 consultants based both onshore and offshore * Define and maintain architecture and technical standards for the Unix/Linux and Windows server platforms across on\-premises, Azure, and OCI, and guide the roadmap and design decisions for new and migrating workloads * Administer Linux and HP\-UX server environments, including new installations, upgrades, and patching * Support the enterprise automation environment using Ansible and Git * Drive adoption of DevOps practices, including CI/CD and infrastructure as code, across Azure, OCI, and on\-premises server builds * Administer internal and external DNS environments * Administer the Windows Server environment, including new installations, upgrades, and patching * Support the enterprise Active Directory environment, including Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) * Administer the Microsoft 365 Exchange environment * Administer Unix/Linux server nodes in virtualized environments * Support Oracle Linux Virtualization Manager (OLVM) environments * Support Microsoft Hyper\-V virtualized environments Position Requirements: * Strong time\-management, prioritization, multitasking, and problem\-solving skills * Ability to think critically, analytically, and strategically * Expert\-level experience patching operating systems in large\-scale environments (1,000\+ nodes) * Expert\-level experience administering Unix operating systems and variants (RHEL 6/7/8/9, Oracle Enterprise Linux 8/9, SUSE, CentOS, Ubuntu; macOS and HP\-UX a plus) * Experience administering DNS using both BIND and Infoblox * Extensive experience administering Windows Server (2012 R2, 2016, 2019, 2022, 2025\) * Experience administering Microsoft 365, Exchange, and Active Directory * Experience with Group Policy (GPO), DNS, DHCP, print servers, and Windows file systems * Strong foundation in creating, implementing, and maintaining processes and procedures for infrastructure teams * Experience designing or contributing to enterprise server architecture, including platform standards, reference designs, and technology roadmaps across on\-premises and cloud environments * Understanding of enterprise storage and backup environments (highly preferred) * Experience proposing and implementing standards within infrastructure areas * Solid foundation in networking concepts (Ethernet configuration, NIC bonding, TCP/IP troubleshooting, packet capture and analysis with tcpdump/Wireshark) * Experience administering NTP, NFS server/client, sudo, and LDAP clients * Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible and Puppet, including creating deployment playbooks for server builds and application deployments * Experience with SFTP setup and administration * Experience with shell scripting (e.g., sh, csh, ksh, bash), automation programming (e.g., sed, awk, Python), and performance monitoring, tuning, and troubleshooting * Experience managing Microsoft 365 and Azure cloud environments * Experience with DevOps practices and tooling (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub) for infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, and source\-controlled configuration * Experience deploying Unix/Linux systems in virtualization and cloud environments: o Oracle Linux Virtualization Manager (OLVM) o VMware o Microsoft Azure o Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) * ServiceNow experience preferred Position Qualifications: * At least 10 years of experience in Unix/Linux and/or Windows server environments, covering the full operating system life cycle: installation, performance tuning, patching, upgrading, and decommissioning of physical and virtual systems * Retail enterprise experience highly preferred * Experience managing and leading technical teams * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field; master’s degree preferred. jobs.title: Associate Director AI Product Engineer - Financial Institution Operations & Technology
jobs.description: **We Do Consulting Differently** -------------------------------- Preferred locations: New York, Chicago, Washington, D.C., Dallas, and Boston. Other locations considered case by case. **About the Practice** Berkeley Research Group is building a Financial Services Operations \& Technology practice focused initially on Commercial and Consumer Banking. We combine banking expertise, technology, and AI to help clients improve operations. **The Role** ------------ We are hiring a hands\-on AI Product Engineer focused on evaluation: proving whether AI products are accurate, reliable, and safe for banking operations. You will build automated tests, investigate failures, and provide evidence for release decisions while contributing to product development. Working with banking experts and engineers, you will define correct results, measure performance, and turn findings into product improvements. Your core responsibility is evaluation from early development through live use. Client stakeholders retain release and risk\-acceptance authority. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ **Own the Evaluation Approach** ------------------------------- * Define what each product must get right, how errors could affect customers or operations, and what evidence is needed before use. * Build reusable software that runs tests, scores results, and compares versions. Make testing part of everyday development, not a final checkpoint. * Work with engineers to reproduce failures, identify causes, and verify fixes. Contribute product code where needed to improve accuracy and control. **Design Tests and Measure Results** ------------------------------------ * Set pass criteria and scoring rules with business and risk teams. Distinguish minor defects from errors that must block release. * Maintain representative test cases, including incomplete records and rare, high\-impact errors. Reserve unseen examples for final testing to avoid overstating performance. * Have banking experts establish expected answers and resolve scoring disagreements. Measure factual accuracy, missing information, incorrect additions, and support from cited sources. * Check automated scoring against expert review. Test whether reviewers agree and whether AI\-based scoring misses important errors. * Compare versions on the same tests. Report results by task and error severity, with sample sizes and uncertainty, not just averages. **Verify Accuracy and Explain Failures** ---------------------------------------- * Test whether the system finds the right information and whether its answer reflects that information. Separate source problems from answer errors. * Check extracted facts against original records. Independently verify amounts, dates, and totals, and test whether citations actually support each important claim. * Test when the product should answer, request clarification, or refer work to a person. Verify that reviewers can detect and correct material errors. **Manage Risk and Monitor Performance** --------------------------------------- * Test for invented facts, unsupported recommendations, unfair outcomes, disclosure of sensitive information, and attempts to make the system ignore its safeguards. * Protect client data, restrict access and permitted actions, and use only approved services. Verify that safeguards work in practice. * Document repeatable test results, unresolved failures, and limitations. Recommend release, restricted use, or further development; support independent review and required client approvals. * Sample live outputs and track error rates and user corrections. Add confirmed failures to repeatable tests; trigger investigation or suspension when quality falls below agreed standards. Explain findings clearly, coach colleagues, and develop reusable tests and controls. Support proposals, technical estimates, and recruiting. * **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required** ------------ * Minimum 5 years of working experience with a minimum of 1 year experience in AI evaluation. * Demonstrated ownership of AI evaluations that informed real release decisions, including test design, expert\-reviewed answers, scoring, and failure investigation. * Strong Python skills and experience building automated test software, connecting data sources, and recording repeatable results across product versions. * Ability to select representative samples, interpret error rates and uncertainty, and distinguish genuine improvement from weak tests or inconsistent scoring. * Experience building or improving AI products used in operations, with practical controls for sensitive data, output accuracy, and human review. * Experience in financial services or another regulated environment, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical tests and controls. Strong communication and teamwork skills, ability to mentor colleagues, and willingness to travel to client sites as needed. * **Preferred** ------------- * Banking experience in lending, payments, servicing, collections, or default operations. * Experience independently evaluating AI products, checking automated scoring against expert judgment, or testing security and fairness in financial institutions. * Experience evaluating document review, summaries, information search, or automated workflows, including comparisons across AI services and conventional software. Consulting or product delivery experience, including client discovery, implementation planning, and user adoption. * **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Success means reliable evidence of what a product gets right, where it fails, and whether it is ready for use. Evaluations catch important errors before release, guide measurable improvements, and detect declining quality in live operations. Testing supports sound decisions, not simply a passing score. Associate Director Salary range: $180,000 \- $250,000 Job title and level will be determined based on qualifications and experience. Candidates must be able to verify their legal right to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. **About BRG** BRG combines world\-leading academic credentials with world\-tested business expertise and purpose\-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead. At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading\-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real\-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe. Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world. At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen. jobs.title: Senior Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: Biohub is the first large\-scale initiative bringing frontier AI models, massive compute, and frontier experimental capabilities under one roof. We're building a general\-purpose system to accelerate scientific discovery, integrating frontier AI models, biological foundation models, and lab capabilities, with the ultimate goal of curing disease. Our technology powers scientists around the world, translating AI capabilities into tools that accelerate research everywhere. **The Team** ------------ Biohub is a 501(c)(3\) biomedical research organization building the first large\-scale scientific initiative combining frontier AI with frontier biology to solve disease. We build the technology to help scientists around the world use AI\-powered biology to study how cells operate, organize, and work as part of systems to understand why disease happens and how to correct it. With our compute capacity, AI research and engineering, and state\-of\-the\-art technology for measuring, imaging, and programming biology, we are enabling scientists worldwide to use AI\-powered biology to advance our understanding of human health. **The Opportunity** ------------------- The role is part of the Data Engineering team, which focuses on owning the strategy, sourcing and implementation for data supporting AI research and development. Our goal is to maximize the speed, agility, and capability of biological AI research by connecting public data resources and Biohub's experimental platforms to AI systems. The data that trains biological frontier models comes in dozens of modalities (sequences, images, spatial coordinates, time series, molecular structures, metadata, publication artifacts) each with its own noise characteristics, biases, and information content. The question of how to represent this data for learning is one of the most important open problems in biological AI. As a Senior Staff Data Engineer at Biohub, you'll be designing systems that ingest data from public repositories, transform heterogeneous biological formats into AI\-ready datasets, combine that with proprietary datasets, and deliver training datasets to researchers pushing the boundaries of what's possible in biological AI. The infrastructure you build will directly shape what our models can learn. We're a small team with significant resources and long time horizons. We use AI tools aggressively in our own work—Claude Code, agents for workflow automation, LLMs for metadata extraction. We care about code quality, operational reliability, and building systems that scale. And we care about the biology: we want engineers who can recognize when a pipeline output is technically correct but scientifically wrong. If you want to work at the intersection of large\-scale infrastructure and frontier science, with real autonomy and the chance to build something genuinely new, we'd like to talk. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design and build data pipelines that process genomic and imaging data at petabyte scale * Solve performance and bandwidth challenges with creative engineering * Build agent\-based systems for automated dataset curation, quality control, and workflow generation * Create tooling for data cataloging and registration that makes datasets discoverable and accessible * Collaborate with AI Research teams to translate model requirements into data specifications, and with our scientists to integrate public and internal data into large\-scale ai\-ready datasets * Improve pipeline reliability and observability, working toward 99%\+ success rates without manual intervention **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 12\+ years of experience building reliable, operable data systems at petabyte scale * Strong software engineering fundamentals * Experience deploying distributed computing frameworks like Databricks, Spark, or Ray for large\-scale data processing * Experience building and deploying large scale data platform solutions using infrastructure as code like Terraform or CDK * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and on prem infrastructure * Comfort with ambiguity; ability to make progress when requirements are evolving * Interest in AI\-native development practices and tooling * Nice to have: Background in computational biology, bioinformatics, or life sciences and experience with genomics datasets and formats (FASTQ, BAM, VCF) or imaging formats (OME\-Zarr, HDF5\) **Compensation** ---------------- The anticipated base pay ranges for this role in Redwood City, CA and New York City, NY is $270,000–$300,000 annually for the Senior Staff level. New hires are typically hired into the lower portion of the range, enabling employee growth in the range over time. Actual placement in range is based on job\-related skills and experience, as evaluated throughout the interview process. This position may be eligible to participate in Biohub's discretionary annual performance bonus program. Bonus eligibility and targets are determined in accordance with Biohub's total rewards philosophy and may vary by role. **Better Together** ------------------- As we grow, we're excited to strengthen in\-person connections and cultivate a collaborative, team\-oriented environment. This role is a hybrid position requiring you to be onsite for at least 60% of the working month, approximately 3 days a week, with specific in\-office days determined by the team's manager. The exact schedule will be at the hiring manager's discretion and communicated during the interview process. **Benefits for the Whole You** ------------------------------ We're thankful to have an incredible team behind our work. To honor their commitment, we offer a wide range of benefits to support the people who make all we do possible. * Provides a generous employer match on employee 401(k) contributions to support planning for the future. * Paid time off to volunteer at an organization of your choice. * Funding for select family\-forming benefits. * Relocation support for employees who need assistance moving If you're interested in a role but your previous experience doesn't perfectly align with each qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply as you may be the perfect fit for this or another role. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-Onsite

jobs.description: ### **Build the systems that expand human capability** At Blackrock Neurotech, we’ve spent decades making the impossible possible – helping people move, speak, and reconnect with the world when they otherwise could not.
