jobs.title: Applications Engineer
jobs.description: **Bradken** is a global manufacturer of custom\-engineered products and solutions for the resources sector. Our products operate in some of the toughest mining environments in the world, where performance, reliability, innovation, and practical engineering support are critical to customer success. We partner closely with some of the largest mining companies globally, delivering solutions that improve equipment performance, productivity, safety, and lifecycle valu ### **About the Role** We are seeking an **Applications** **Engineer** to support the development, improvement, and customization of Bradken's mining equipment product lines, with a primary focus on **Crawler Systems for Electric Rope Shovels and Hydraulic Excavators**. This is more than a traditional design engineering role. While strong mechanical design capabilities are fundamental, this position also requires engineers who are comfortable working directly with customers, participating in technical discussions, presenting solutions, and supporting product evaluations in the field. You will collaborate across Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Sales, and end users to transform operational challenges into practical engineering solutions. The role offers excellent exposure to mining operations, customer problem\-solving, and the performance of large\-scale equipment operating in demanding environments. Success in this role requires someone who enjoys both technical engineering work and customer interaction. You should be comfortable explaining technical concepts, presenting recommendations, gathering customer requirements, and building credibility through engineering expertise. This is an outstanding opportunity for engineers who want to see their designs perform in real\-world applications rather than working exclusively behind a desk. While previous mining experience is beneficial, we are equally interested in candidates with strong machinery design fundamentals who are eager to learn the mining industry, develop product expertise, and immerse themselves in customer challenges and field applications. ### **Key Responsibilities** You will work across product design, reverse engineering, modelling, drafting, simulation, technical analysis, field evaluations and customer support activities. You will: * Create and update 3D models, detailed drawings, and engineering documentation. * Support reverse engineering, product improvements, and new concept development. * Complete engineering calculations, analysis, simulations, and technical verification activities. * Collaborate with Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams to ensure designs are practical, manufacturable, and cost\-effective. * Participate in customer discussions to understand operational requirements and technical challenges. * Present engineering solutions, product recommendations, and technical findings to both internal and external stakeholders. * Support field evaluations, product inspections, and site investigations. * Conduct visits to customer and manufacturing locations to gather data and support product performance reviews. * Capture specifications, product data, and design updates within Bradken's Product Lifecycle Management system. * Provide technical guidance to Sales, Operations, and Customer Support teams. * Contribute to safety, quality, continuous improvement, and product innovation initiatives. This role is primarily office/shop\-based with regular interaction with customers and operational teams. Travel to customer, mine, and manufacturing sites is expected. What We're Looking ForRequired Qualifications * Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. * Experience in mechanical design, product design, reliability engineering, or product development. * Strong proficiency in 3D CAD modelling, detailed drafting, and engineering analysis. * Experience working with manufactured products, design changes, and technical documentation. * Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, manufacturing, commercial, and operational teams. * Strong verbal communication and presentation skills. * Current driver's license and ability to travel regionally. * Spanish language capability is highly preferred. * French language capability would be considered an asset. ### **Ideal Industry Backgrounds** We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in: * Mining equipment * Mobile equipment * Heavy industrial machinery * Material handling equipment * Construction equipment * Power generation equipment * Rotating equipment * Industrial manufacturing * Structural mechanical systems * Crushers, conveyors, processing equipment, or similar industrial products **Machinery design experience is strongly preferred.** Candidates coming from industries involving large industrial equipment, heavy mechanical assemblies, mobile machinery, or power generation environments will likely find the strongest alignment with this opportunity. While all engineering backgrounds will be considered, candidates whose experience is primarily focused on **building services, HVAC systems, commercial building design, or MEP consulting** may find the role less aligned due to the heavy equipment and industrial machinery focus of the position. ### **Technical Skills Valued** Experience with the following tools and technologies is highly regarded: * Siemens NX * ANSYS * Siemens Teamcenter PLM * 3D Scanning Technologies * Product Lifecycle Management Systems * Finite Element Analysis (FEA) * Reverse Engineering Processes ### **Location \& Work Authorization** This position is based in **Phoenix (Mesa), Arizona, USA**. Candidates must either be currently located within reasonable commuting distance of the Phoenix metropolitan area or be willing to relocate at their own expense. Please note that **Bradken is unable to provide visa sponsorship or employment sponsorship for this position**. Applicants must have valid authorization to work in the United States at the time of application and for the duration of employment. ### **Bradken Benefits** * A strong **safety\-first culture** * Competitive salary and **performance bonuses** * Educational Assistance Program * Flexible work options * Global career opportunities * Learning \& development support * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Paid parental leave and wellbeing initiatives ### **Why This Role?** This role offers a unique opportunity to combine **mechanical design engineering**, **customer engagement**, and **field exposure** within the global mining industry. If you enjoy designing large\-scale machinery, solving complex engineering challenges, presenting technical solutions, learning directly from customer operations, and seeing your work applied in some of the world's most demanding mining environments, this role will provide an exciting next step in your career. If you are interested in joining a team that is making a significant impact in the industry, we invite you to submit your application, along with your resume and a concise cover letter outlining why this position aligns with your career aspirations. **Shortlisting for candidates will commence immediately.** Everyone has a story... become a part of ours! **How We Hire** **About Our Screening Process:** As we work with teams around the world, time‑zone differences can make live screening challenging. To support a fair, consistent, and inclusive evaluation, we may invite candidates to complete a one‑way video screening at a time that suits them. If you require adjustments or an alternative format, we're happy to discuss this. **Before commencing employment**, you will be required to complete a psychometric assessment and a pre\-employment medical, including drug and alcohol testing. ***WE RESPECTFULLY REQUEST NO APPROACHES FROM RECRUITMENT AGENCIES.*** ***Bradken is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to fostering a diverse, inclusive, engaging, and flexible work environment for our employees, as we believe that remarkable outcomes arise when individuals are empowered to express their authentic selves in their work. All employment decisions will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs.***

jobs.description: Site: The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc. Projects include developing novel biomechanical tools for radiation oncology applications and validating open\-source, commercially available and prototype biomechanical modeling tools. The Fellow will also perform retrospective data extraction and statistical analysis and conduct counterfactual radiotherapy treatment planning studies. You will spend most of your time building and then sharing what you build. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Agentic Reference Systems:** Architect and ship end\-to\-end reference agents and starter kits on Crusoe that developers can use as a starting point for production, covering tool use, MCP, multi\-agent orchestration, RAG, structured outputs, memory, and evals. * **Examples \& Documentation:** Own the code examples, tutorials, and documentation that help developers go from first API call to working agent, and keep them tested and up to date as the ecosystem changes. * **Open Source \& GitHub:** Own Crusoe's developer\-facing GitHub presence, including examples, cookbooks, and integrations. Contribute upstream to agent frameworks, inference engines, and developer tooling (for example LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, the OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP, vLLM, and SGLang) so they work well with Crusoe. * **Technical Content \& Video:** Turn the systems you build into content developers rely on: deep\-dive blog posts, notebooks, YouTube videos, livestreams, and short technical clips. * **Building in Public:** Share your work on X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Discord, Reddit, Hacker News, etc. Answer technical questions, review community projects, and become a trusted technical voice in the agent and open\-source community. * **Use\-Case Blueprints:** Partner with GTM/Solutions Engineering to spot recurring customer patterns and turn them into open reference architectures for developer segments such as Physical AI, robotics, simulation, and other industry verticals. * **Product \& Research Partnership:** Join Product, Engineering, and Research workflows. Test features and models before launch, make sure samples and docs are ready on launch day, and bring developer friction back as concrete product input, following each issue until it is fixed or explicitly deprioritized. * **Talks \& Workshops:** Give technical talks, live demos, and hands\-on labs at conferences, meetups, hackathons, and workshops. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Engineering Experience:** 5\+ years as a software engineer, ML engineer, applied AI engineer, forward\-deployed engineer, or in a similar hands\-on engineering role, with strong Python. A Developer Relations title is not required. * **Engineering Credibility:** Ability to earn credibility with both AI infrastructure engineers and ML/AI engineers. * **Agentic AI:** Hands\-on experience building LLM applications and agents with tool calling, MCP, retrieval, memory, and evaluation, using one or more frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, or the OpenAI Agents SDK. You have well\-formed opinions about what works and what breaks in production. * **Cloud Infrastructure:** Experience working with cloud computing platforms (such as AWS, GCP, or Azure) or managed AI solutions, with a foundational understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts. * **Inference \& Model Serving:** Working knowledge of how models are served, including OpenAI\-compatible APIs, open\-weight models, and serving engines such as vLLM or SGLang. You can explain cost and latency tradeoffs credibly. * **Public Track Record:** Evidence of sharing technical work in public through GitHub repos, open\-source contributions, blog posts, videos, talks, or an active technical presence on social platforms. Please include links when you apply. * **Technical Communication:** Strong communication skills across written and verbal formats, including technical documentation, white papers, video explainers, and presentation decks. * **Ownership \& Collaboration:** You work well across teams, set your own priorities, and ship in a fast\-moving environment. * **Travel Requirement:** Ability to travel up to 20%. * **Education:** Bachelor's/Master's/PhD degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. **Bonus Points** * Maintainer or significant contributor to an open\-source AI, agent, or inference project * Experience producing technical video content such as YouTube tutorials, livestreams, or screencasts * Experience fine\-tuning or post\-training open\-weight models (SFT/RL/LoRA) * An existing technical audience that trusts your views on models, agents, and tooling **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $180,000\-$220,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **The Role** CubX is looking for a **Senior Full Stack Product Engineer** who can take a business need from concept to production. This is a hands\-on role for someone who combines strong full\-stack engineering with product thinking and design judgment. You’ll work directly with business leaders and users to understand problems, design thoughtful solutions, and build polished internal applications that improve how our managed service business operates. **AI\-assisted development is a core part of this role.** We’re looking for someone who has successfully used AI coding tools to accelerate professional software development while maintaining ownership of architecture, quality, security, and the final product. ### **What You'll Do** * Lead discovery with stakeholders to understand business problems, requirements, workflows, and constraints. * Translate complex needs into clear user journeys, product designs, and technical solutions. * Create wireframes and prototypes and establish the visual direction for intuitive, polished interfaces. * Design application architecture, data models, APIs, integrations, permissions, and workflows. * Build and maintain full\-stack applications using **React, TypeScript, Node.js, and MongoDB**. * Partner with DevOps on **Docker, CI/CD, Azure deployments, and production reliability**. * Use AI tools throughout planning, development, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation. * Review and verify AI\-generated code rather than treating AI output as production\-ready by default. * Own solutions through release and continue improving them based on user feedback and production behavior. ### **What We’re Looking For** * Proven experience taking products or significant workflows from an ambiguous business need through **design, development, deployment, and ongoing improvement**. * Strong hands\-on experience with **TypeScript, React, Node.js, and MongoDB**. * Experience with **Azure, Docker, Git, CI/CD, REST APIs, authentication, authorization, and automated testing**. * Strong product judgment and the ability to simplify complex business workflows. * Experience creating and implementing user interfaces, not simply working from someone else’s designs. * Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with business and technical stakeholders. ### **Show Us What You’ve Built** During the interview process, we’ll ask you to walk us through **two examples of software you delivered using AI\-assisted development**. At least one should demonstrate your involvement from **stakeholder discovery and original product/design thinking through development and production release**. Be prepared to discuss: * The business problem and how you approached it. * Your design and architecture decisions. * How you used AI during development. * An AI\-generated mistake or issue you identified and how you caught it. * What ultimately shipped and how you improved it after release. Working demonstrations, anonymized case studies, and redacted materials are welcome. **Requirements** **Product and engineering requirements** * A track record of leading discovery and personally taking products or substantial workflows from an ambiguous need through visual design, architecture, implementation, production release, and continued improvement. * Deep hands\-on proficiency in TypeScript, React, and Node.js, with the ability to explain, debug, and maintain the full application and the code generated by AI. * Strong practical experience with MongoDB, Docker, Azure, Git, and CI/CD; REST APIs, service boundaries, authentication, authorization, and automated testing. * A portfolio or case studies showing visual direction you personally created and implemented; strong product judgment, stakeholder communication, and the ability to simplify complex workflows. **Required AI development experience** You use AI coding tools and agents as a repeatable part of professional software delivery. Be ready to demonstrate the following: * Substantial hands\-on experience with one or more tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot, supported by production work you personally shipped. * Effective agentic coding: define the task, establish acceptance criteria, guide work across relevant files and services, inspect changes, and correct the approach when needed. * Practical context engineering: give agents the relevant requirements, repository context, architectural constraints, and examples. Maintain concise project instructions and reusable workflows where they improve results. * Independent verification of AI output through code review, type checks, appropriate automated tests, and direct inspection of the application. Identify invented APIs, missed requirements, security issues, and regressions. * Good judgment about when to delegate work to AI, when to investigate directly, and when to reject or rework a proposed solution. Balance tool capability, cost, speed, and reliability. * Careful handling of company and customer information, credentials, tool permissions, and production access when using AI tools. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience building **AI\-powered application features** using LLM APIs, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, or model evaluations. * Experience improving AI\-development workflows through reusable agent instructions, automated checks, or **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** integrations. * Experience with **MSP operations, enterprise administration, or internal business applications**. **Benefits** * Competitive salary range * Paid time off and company holidays * Health, dental, and vision insurance options * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * On\-site gym for employee wellness * Modern, collaborative office environment * Ongoing training and professional development * Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology * Team events and employee appreciation initiatives * Strong company culture focused on innovation and teamwork

jobs.description: Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. **Job Description** ------------------- What you will ownOne or more platform components end to end: model gateway (routing, failover, caching, per\-line cost attribution), agent runtime and orchestration, evaluation harness, guardrail engine, tool and agent registry, or shared product services The training and adaptation loop: pipelines that turn production traces and evaluation verdicts into reinforcement learning and fine\-tuning datasets, and the infrastructure to train, evaluate, and serve NewCo\-tuned LLMs and SLMs behind the same gates as vendor models Reliability, latency, and cost of what you build; platform services carry baselines and you hold them The self\-service surfaces product engineers use: your components ship with documentation, sane defaults, and no ticket queue Co\-building with product teams: new shared services start embedded with a product line and graduate to platform services when proven What you will need Strong production engineering: Python plus one systems language (Go or Rust welcome), Kubernetes, infrastructure\-as\-code, and one major cloud Hands\-on experience with LLM infrastructure: a model gateway pattern (such as LiteLLM or in\-house), model serving (such as vLLM or managed endpoints), and vector or retrieval systems Agent\-systems experience: you have built with an agent orchestration framework (such as LangGraph or first\-party agent SDKs) and understand tool calling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Evaluation engineering: you have built or operated eval harnesses (golden datasets, regression gates in CI, LLM\-judge calibration) and can explain why they gate merges Post\-training fluency: you have fine\-tuned or post\-trained a model, built the data pipeline behind one, or reproduced techniques from recent papers in production systems Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding assistants as part of your own development workflow We care about depth in four or five of these areas more than surface familiarity with all of them. What sets you apart Guardrail\-engine or AI\-observability experience (NeMo Guardrails, OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, LangSmith, Braintrust, or equivalent) Reinforcement learning infrastructure (reward modelling, RLHF or GRPO\-class pipelines) or SLM distillation experience Multi\-tenant SaaS infrastructure: tenancy isolation, metering, usage\-based billing Financial services engineering (banks, insurers, or payment providers) is the ideal background; other regulated\-industry or security engineering depth also counts Open\-source contributions or a portfolio of deployed agents and eval suites (we would rather see this than a CV) The reference stack The reference technology stack for this role is our supported paved road: self\-hosted LangSmith and LangGraph Platform as the agent runtime and evaluation plane, model providers behind a swappable gateway seam, PostgreSQL with pgvector plus ClickHouse and S3\-compatible object storage as the data platform, Neo4j Enterprise as the semantic knowledge graph, an agent memory plane serving episodic and precedent memory over MCP, MCP\-native connectors, OpenTelemetry and Grafana for observability, all on CNCF\-conformant Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD, deployable to any hyperscaler or on\-prem. A tool\-for\-tool match is not expected: analogous experience counts fully. If you have built and operated systems of this shape on comparable components (a different orchestration framework, graph engine, evaluation platform, or serving stack), you have what we are looking for. How we work Engineers write specs, harnesses, evals, and guardrails; AI agents execute the implementation loops. Review, not typing, is where engineering judgment goes. jobs.description: **“I can be myself at work.”** You are more than a job title. We want you to feel comfortable doing great work and bringing your best, authentic self to everything you do. We value your talents, traditions, and uniqueness—and we’re committed to fostering a strong sense of belonging in a respectful workplace. We intentionally seek diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds, investing in a culture designed to celebrate differences. We believe that belonging leads to better outcomes and a stronger community of associates united by our mission. At Capital, we live our core values every day: Integrity, Client Focus, Diverse Perspectives, Long\-Term Thinking, and Community. **“I can influence my income.”** You want to feel recognized at work. Your performance will be reviewed annually, and your compensation will be designed to motivate and reward the value that you provide. You’ll receive a competitive salary, bonuses and benefits. Your company\-funded retirement contribution will factor in salary and variable pay, including bonuses. **“I can lead a full life.”** You bring unique goals and interests to your job and your life. Whether you’re raising a family, you’re passionate about where you volunteer, or you want to explore different career paths, we’ll give you the resources that can set you up for success. * Enjoy generous time\-away and health benefits from day one, with the opportunity for flexible work options * Receive 2\-for\-1 matching gifts for your charitable contributions and the opportunity to secure annual grants for the organizations you love * Access on\-demand professional development resources that allow you to hone existing skills and learn new ones **“I can succeed as an AI Scientist at Capital Group.”** -------------------------------------------------------- As an AI Scientist, you will drive the development of innovative applications that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI to transform asset management. Comfortable stepping into front\-end work when the problem calls for it. * You're aligned to a product team and typically work alongside one or two other engineers on any given project, pairing on tough problems, reviewing each other's work, and shipping together rather than in parallel. * Uphold a high\-quality bar. With the only constant in life being change, we will always listen, learn, and improve for the betterment of our teams, customers, and communities. CMG is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description: **At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. Backed by cutting\-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: *“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”* That question drives everything we do. But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose. **Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.** **Position Summary** Caris Life Sciences serves hundreds of thousands of molecular cases a year and continues to grow at double\-digit rates. The engineering environment supports advanced AI coding assistants and agentic workflows across design, implementation, and test generation. testable, documented code that holds up in a regulated production environment. * Contribute to design and architecture discussions, understanding the technical options and trade\-offs that inform the team's decisions. * Give and receive peer code review, upholding code\-quality standards and surfacing issues that could affect system correctness, performance, or compliance. * Work with product management to clarify requirements, understand technical constraints, and estimate backlog items. * Help maintain the technical record: design documents, architecture decision records, and operational complex architectural or compliance questions. * Identify technical\-debt and reliability concerns and propose and carry out remediation work that improves system maintainability or compliance posture. * Work AI\-first: use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as daily practice across design, implementation, and test generation, with peer and engineering review as the quality gate. engineering experience building and maintaining production software systems. * Hands\-on experience across the full SDLC in a team setting: requirements refinement, design, implementation, testing, and release. * A track record of writing and maintaining automated tests for production software, at the unit, integration, or end\-to\-end level. * Working proficiency in code review and in applying engineering standards to shared codebases. * Hands\-on experience with AI coding assistants and agentic development workflows in real engineering work. * Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Word, Excel, Outlook, and general working knowledge of Internet for business use. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in healthcare, clinical laboratory, diagnostics, or life sciences software environments. * Familiarity with agile delivery frameworks and the tooling around them. * Exposure to cloud\-native application development and deployment patterns. * Interest in growing into technical design and architecture discussions, with the ability to explain ideas clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Willingness to participate in pair programming, knowledge sharing, or structured peer learning. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills applied to complex, regulated production systems. * Experience in environments governed by FDA requirements, SOX controls, CLIA, or HIPAA. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Who We Are Centauri delivers data\-driven technology solutions that transform fragmented clinical and member data into actionable intelligence — maximizing accuracy, quality performance, and outcomes for health plans and health systems. Through close collaboration with our customers, Centauri improves patient and member outcomes by providing advocacy, advanced data insights, and intelligent clinical data delivery. The company addresses critical healthcare challenges for complex populations and improves access and quality of care. Headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, Centauri Health Solutions employs 1100 dedicated associates across the country and has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list, the 2020 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™, and has been recognized as 2026 Best in KLAS for ADT Notifications. Your Daily Mission The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for planning, designing and developing cloud\-based software working as part of a SCRUM team. Managing individual project priorities and timelines, meeting expected deadlines and ensuring deliveries on the estimated schedule. Designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining and improving software using most appropriate technologies. Staying up to date with expanding cloud offerings and trends in software architecture. Who You Are * 8\+ years' experience with InterSystems HealthShare, IRIS, or Health Connect (Ensemble/Caché). * 8\+ years' experience with XML/XSLT and parsing complex clinical data (CCDA, HL7 v2/v3\). * 5\+ years' experience with Caché ObjectScript, REST, SOAP API, and HL7v2\. * 5\+ years' experience with SQL Concepts specifically within InterSystems Caché/IRIS. * 5\+ years' experience with FHIR (R4\) and building/consuming RESTful healthcare APIs. * 5\+ years' experience in Modern Software Engineering: Source Control (Git/GitLab), CI/CD pipelines, and Test\-Driven Development (TDD). * Agile Proficiency: Extensive experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. * Integration Leadership: Proven track record of leading technical "Tiger Teams" or high\-pressure vendor integrations (e.g., Epic, Clear, MedAllies). * Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with GCP, AWS, or Azure; specifically, BigQuery exposure or GCP GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine). * Specialized HealthShare: Experience with HealthShare Patient Index. * Interoperability Standards: 3\+ years' experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks or large\-scale HIE Interoperability. * Systems Knowledge: Familiarity with Unix/Linux commands and core systems concepts (Load Balancing, HA/DR, etc.). The Reality of the Role * Translates logical applications specifications into physical application design * Writes new application and service code within SES secure coding guidelines. * Codes, tests and troubleshoots complex applications and services utilizing the appropriate hardware, database, and programming technology. * Develops and implements comprehensive test plans and unit tests * Tests and develops programming modifications. * Analyzes performance of applications and takes action to correct deficiencies. * Documents programming problems and resolutions for future reference. * Defines individual work assignments for junior members of the team. * Mentors junior members of development team. Why You’ll Love Centauri (Our Promise to You) We believe that caring for our members starts with caring for our team, and we are committed to providing a rewarding environment where employees can grow, excel, and achieve both personal and professional goals. * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage * Wellness program supporting overall well\-being * Company\-paid basic life and AD\&D insurance * 401(k) plan with company match * Tuition reimbursement opportunities * Paid time off for vacation and illness * Six paid company holidays * Floating holiday * Company\-paid training and computer equipment * Performance\-based bonus program * Paid time off for volunteer activities * Employee referral bonus program * Career development and training opportunities, including leadership growth Compensation Transparency Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. Equal Employment Opportunity and Accommodation Centauri Health Solutions is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer I
jobs.description: **Position Purpose:** The Cloud Platform Engineer I is a position for a motivated developer who will be joining our engineering team and help design, develop, and operationalize AI\-enabled applications and solutions. This role is ideal for an early\-career software engineer who has strong programming fundamentals and practical exposure to Cloud technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs), and machine learning through academic work, internships, personal projects, or professional experience. The successful candidate will work alongside software engineers, AI engineers, architects, and product teams to incorporate AI capabilities into enterprise applications, developer workflows, and business processes. * Develop, manage, and administer cloud infrastructure as code on the cloud platform (e.g. AWS, or Azure). * Ensures security of cloud components, review reported vulnerabilities and remediate within SLA. * Follow Centene audit standards, controls, and processes to monitor and optimize cloud infrastructure. * Maintains up\-to\-date knowledge of cloud products, technology, and best practices. * Executes code\-based CI/CD deployment plans for new and existing infrastructure based on standards and best\-practices provided * Build AI agentic solution using Large Language Models, Machine Learning, Generative AI. * Write production\-quality code with appropriate tests and documentation. * Progress from prototype development toward deploying and supporting production AI capabilities. * Partner with the other teams to manage enhancements, and software migrations to drive the successful deployment of cloud infrastructure and applications. * Communicates regularly with Development, Network and Security groups and integrate their requirements in all environments build plans * Builds and maintains capacity plans to include cloud\-based deployments * Develops and implement technical efforts to design, build, and deploy cloud applications at the direction of lead architects, including large\-scale data processing and advanced analytics * Delivers continuous integration and delivery pipeline and standards by enabling common DevSecOps tooling in cloud environment and providing development teams with the ability to execute builds, run tests, and deploy in automated fashion * Performs other duties as assigned * Complies with all policies and standards **Education/Experience:** A Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g., statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science) and requires 0 – 2 years of related experience. Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position. Or completion of a Centene\-sponsored emerging talent program. **Technical Skills:** * 0\-2 years experience with Python through coursework, internships, research, professional work, or personal projects. * Understanding of fundamental software engineering concepts, including APIs, data structures, algorithms, databases, and version control. * Understanding of Machine Learning, Generative AI, and LLM platforms and APIs. * Experience building at least one AI/ML application or project through coursework, internships, hackathons, research, or independent development/ open\-source contributions. * Integrate AI models and services into applications using REST APIs, SDKs, and microservices. * Familiarity with Git/GitHub or GitLab. Pay Range: $30\.58 \- $55\.09 per hour **At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day.** You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday. Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job\-related factors permitted by law, including full\-time or part\-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility. Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. jobs.title: DATA QUALITY ENGINEER I/II/III
jobs.description: The Data Quality Engineer supports institutional data quality across Central Michigan University by profiling, validating, cleansing, converting, reconciling, and improving data used by enterprise systems, reporting, compliance, decision\-making, and ERP migration efforts. The position develops and applies data quality rules, validates source\-to\-target mappings, documents findings, tracks issues, troubleshoots data problems, and coordinates with functional and technical partners to improve the accuracy, completeness, consistency, reliability, security, and usability of institutional data. The position will support ERP migration, operational data quality, reporting, integration, and ongoing data governance activities across student, finance, human resources, payroll, procurement, research administration, and other administrative data domains. **Required Qualifications** Data Quality Engineer I: Foundational knowledge of data analysis, reporting, data quality, or enterprise data concepts. Familiarity with relational databases, SQL, spreadsheets, reporting tools, or data extraction methods. Ability to troubleshoot routine data issues, follow established procedures, and learn institutional systems and data processes. Strong attention to detail, communication, customer service, and collaboration skills. Data Quality Engineer II: All the qualifications of Data Quality Engineer I, plus: Four years of experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience, related to data analysis, data quality, reporting, data migration, data integration, or enterprise systems. Experience supporting data profiling, validation, cleansing, reconciliation, reporting, or data conversion activities. Experience with enterprise data support technologies such as SQL databases, reporting tools, ETL or data integration tools, data warehouses, dashboards, or enterprise application data services. Ability to recommend and implement improvements to data validation, data remediation, documentation, or operational practices. Working knowledge of data quality rules, source\-to\-target mapping, validation logic, and ongoing data management processes. Experience with data issue analysis, root\-cause investigation, troubleshooting, or performance support. Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and collaboration skills. Data Quality Engineer III: All the qualifications of Data Quality Engineer II, plus: Six years of experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience, related to data analysis, data quality, reporting, data migration, data integration, or enterprise systems. Experience contributing to data quality planning, validation strategies, remediation approaches, or operational improvement efforts for enterprise data and related systems. Strong working knowledge of relational data structures, SQL, reporting, ETL, integration, or data warehouse technologies used to support enterprise data quality work. Strong working knowledge of relational data structures, SQL, reporting, ETL, integration, or data warehouse technologies that support enterprise data quality work. Experience working with ERP, cloud\-hosted, vendor\-managed, or hybrid application data environments. Ability to mentor, support, or share knowledge with other staff. Experience supporting integrations or data exchange activities across multiple systems. Ability to contribute to the design, improvement, or long\-term support of enterprise data quality solutions. Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills. Senior Data Quality Engineer: All the qualifications of Data Quality Engineer III, plus: Eight years of experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, related to data analysis, data quality, reporting, data migration, data integration, or enterprise systems. Experience leading data quality, data conversion, reconciliation, remediation, or enterprise data management work across multiple complex data domains or services. Strong understanding of data governance, data stewardship, security practices, risk mitigation, and operational reliability in enterprise data environments. Ability to lead or significantly contribute to the design, scalability, resiliency, and long\-term support of enterprise data quality solutions, validation processes, and reconciliation practices. Demonstrated ability to identify improvement opportunities and develop practical recommendations for implementation. Demonstrated professionalism and sound judgment in working with faculty, staff, students, vendors, implementation partners, and other stakeholders. Demonstrated leadership in communication, coordination, or stakeholder engagement for complex data quality work. Models collaborative, service\-oriented, and values\-based behavior in support of team and university goals. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with enterprise platforms and technologies such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, SQL Server, data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, t approaches, software solutions, and works with business offices to address business needs or improve processes. **Supervision Exercised** None. **Message to Applicants** Central Michigan University is dedicated to fostering an environment that is reflective of the communities we serve. We are especially interested in highly qualified candidates who will advance and promote CMU’s mission, vision, and leadership standards. You must submit an on\-line application in order to be considered as an applicant for this position. Cover letters may be addressed to the Hiring Committee. This position will remain open until filled. The university reserves the right to close the recruitment process once a sufficient applicant pool has been identified. **For best consideration, please submit application materials on or before November 17th, 2026\.** **Employee Group** Professional \& Administrative \-Salary **Staff Pay Level** **Pay Range** $60,000 \- $85,000 **Division** President **Department** Application Support \& Dev \- OIT **Position Status** Provisional **Position End Date** 12/01/2031 **Employment Status** Full\-Time **FTE** 1\.0 **Position Type** 12 month **Weekly Work Schedule** M\-F, 8\-5 **Location** Mount Pleasant, MI **About the Department** **About CMU** Central Michigan University has a more than 125\-year legacy of preparing students to become leaders and changemakers in their communities and in their personal and professional lives. We serve nearly 15,500 students on our Mount Pleasant campus, in satellite locations around the state and throughout the country, and through flexible online programs. Many of our approximately 300 undergraduate, master’s, specialist and doctoral programs in the arts, media, business, education, human services, health professions, liberal arts, social sciences, medicine, science and engineering are nationally ranked for excellence. CMU leads the nation in leadership development programming through our Sarah R. Opperman Leadership Institute, and we are proud to be among only 5% of U.S. universities in the top two Carnegie research classifications. Our faculty work with graduate and undergraduate students in areas such as Great Lakes research, medical innovation, engineering technology and more. Central is home to 17 men’s and women’s Division 1 sports including football, basketball, gymnastics, baseball, wrestling and more. Our student\-athletes achieve great success in competition and in the classroom, capturing Mid\-American Conference championships and maintaining an average cumulative GPA of 3\.17\. CMU is located in Mount Pleasant, a community that blends the best of small\-town living with big\-city amenities. It’s part of the culturally varied and vibrant Great Lakes Bay Region that also includes Saginaw, Bay City, Midland and the state’s largest Native American community, centered on the Saginaw Chippewa Isabella Reservation in Mount Pleasant. Area residents enjoy the mix of outdoor activities, cultural events, shopping and dining options, and family attractions. Other major Michigan destinations and attractions — Lansing, Grand Rapids, Detroit, Traverse City, wineries, beaches, golf and ski resorts, and many more — are within easy reach of the city’s central location in Michigan’s Lower Peninsula. CMU employees enjoy access to a nationally recognized wellness program along with health care and benefits that exceed regional, state and national norms. **CMU Leadership Standards** Central Michigan University is a place where we value students and work for their success, where we act as family, and where employees are engaged, appreciated and have extraordinary opportunities to make a difference. We intentionally maintain and strengthen the hallmark CMU culture that sets us apart from our peers by expecting CMU leaders and employees to model the following Leadership Standards and develop them within their teams. jobs.title: Senior FinOps Engineer, Global Data & Analytics
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE** AI is generating cost at a scale and complexity that traditional FinOps tooling was not built for — and this role exists to solve that problem. As FinOps Engineer, you will design and maintain the data pipelines that move metered AI usage from our internal AI Studio platform into clean, trusted, reporting\-ready datasets. You will build and automate the dashboards that surface weekly exceptions and drive monthly billing accuracy, ensuring that chargeback across business units, platforms, applications, models, and environments is always defensible and timely. This is a hands\-on engineering role with direct visibility into how the organization understands and governs its AI investment. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** **Pipeline Engineering \& Data Architecture** * Design, build, and maintain data pipelines that ingest metered usage data from AI Studio and API\-sourced datasets, transforming raw consumption signals into normalized, reporting\-ready structures * Ensure spend is accurately attributed at every relevant dimension — business unit, platform, application, model, and environment — with consistent lineage and auditable methodology * Integrate data from multiple sources (AI Studio, cloud billing APIs, Snowflake, Databricks) into a coherent, trusted cost dataset that Finance and Engineering teams can rely on for decisions * Implement data quality controls, reconciliation checks, and anomaly detection logic to catch attribution errors, missing data, and billing discrepancies before they reach downstream consumers * Maintain pipeline reliability and timeliness — cost data that arrives late or with gaps is not useful for governance; build with that constraint in mind * Evolve the data architecture as new AI platforms, models, and usage patterns come in scope, keeping the system extensible without accumulating technical debt **Reporting \& Dashboard Automation** * Build and automate Power BI dashboards that track weekly cost exceptions — surfacing anomalies, budget variances, and unallocated spend with enough context that owners can act without additional investigation * Develop monthly billing metrics dashboards that drive chargeback processing, giving Finance clear visibility into actuals by business unit and cost category * Automate recurring reporting workflows — month\-end close support, variance summaries, trend analysis — reducing manual effort and eliminating recurring rebuild cycles * Design reports that serve multiple audiences: technical detail for engineering owners, financial summaries for Finance partners, and executive\-ready rollups for leadership * Instrument unit economics views — cost per model, cost per application, cost per environment — that help teams understand the financial weight of their AI choices **Cost Attribution \& Chargeback** * Own the technical implementation of the chargeback model: ensuring spend is tagged, allocated, and attributed consistently across all dimensions required for accurate billing * Partner with the FinOps Team Lead and Finance to translate business rules for cost allocation into pipeline logic and reporting outputs * Identify and remediate attribution gaps — untagged resources, missing ownership metadata, inconsistent naming — through automation rather than manual correction * Build alerting and threshold logic that flags exceptions in near\-real\-time, enabling the operating team to investigate and resolve before monthly close * Track and report on chargeback accuracy over time, building confidence in the numbers with Finance stakeholders who rely on them for business unit P\&L **Practice Development** * Contribute to the evolution of the FinOps data model as AI consumption patterns grow in complexity — new models, new providers, new usage types require a pipeline that keeps pace * Evaluate and adopt relevant standards (e.g., FOCUS — FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification) to ensure the organization's cost data aligns with emerging industry norms * Document pipeline design, data definitions, transformation logic, and dashboard specifications in a way that makes the system maintainable and understandable across the team * Identify opportunities to automate manual processes upstream and downstream of the pipeline — reducing toil and improving the timeliness and reliability of cost data * Solid data engineering background: experience building and maintaining production data pipelines that ingest, normalize, and transform data from multiple sources at scale * Proficiency in Python, including data jobs.title: AI Lead Engineer, Vice President
jobs.description: **Discover your future at Citi** -------------------------------- Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. **Job Overview** ---------------- Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations \& Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first\-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services. Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well\-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together. **Position Overview:** We are seeking a highly motivated AI Lead Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered applications and agentic solutions that enhance business processes and client delivery capabilities. jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Ideal Candidate** We're looking for an engineer who takes ownership rather than simply completing assigned tasks. The right person can walk into an unfamiliar environment, assess the infrastructure, identify risks, develop a solution, present that solution to a client, and lead the implementation. They should be equally comfortable troubleshooting a complex outage, designing a network for a new office, mentoring another engineer, or meeting with a business owner to discuss technology strategy. Most importantly, they should demonstrate strong technical judgment, accountability, and the ability to independently deliver results. **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years of progressive IT infrastructure, network, or systems engineering experience. * 5\+ years of experience in a senior engineering, technical lead, or equivalent role. * Strong hands\-on experience designing and implementing business networks. * Advanced knowledge of firewalls, VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs, and wireless networking. * Advanced experience administering Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, and Windows Server. * Experience with virtualization platforms such as Hyper\-V, VMware, or Proxmox. * Experience planning and independently executing complex infrastructure projects. * Demonstrated ability to resolve high\-level technical escalations. * Excellent documentation, organizational, and client communication skills. * Ability to independently prioritize responsibilities and manage multiple client environments. **Position Overview** Our team is seeking an experienced Senior Solutions Engineer to serve as a senior technical resource responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT environments for our managed services clients. We are a fast growing technology integration company, and want to add you to our team if we are the right fit for you! This role combines advanced technical engineering, project leadership, network architecture, and client\-facing technology consulting. The ideal candidate is a highly skilled, hands\-on engineer who can independently design and deploy infrastructure, lead projects from planning through completion, resolve complex technical issues escalated by other engineers, and confidently advise business owners and IT decision\-makers. This is not a traditional help desk position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of technical challenges, develop practical solutions, and ensure successful outcomes without requiring constant oversight. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Network \& Infrastructure Architecture** * Design and implement secure, reliable, and scalable client networks. * Architect LAN, WAN, VLAN, VPN, wireless, and multi\-site network environments. * Configure and troubleshoot enterprise firewalls, switches, wireless access points, and routing. * Design Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, and hybrid infrastructure solutions. * Plan and execute server deployments, virtualization projects, infrastructure upgrades, and cloud migrations. * Conduct infrastructure assessments and recommend improvements related to security, reliability, and performance. * Develop network diagrams, technical documentation, and implementation plans. **2\. Technical Project Leadership** * Serve as the technical lead for complex client implementations, migrations, and infrastructure projects. * Translate business requirements into technical designs and project scopes. * Identify hardware, software, licensing, labor, and resource requirements. * Develop implementation plans, milestones, testing procedures, and rollback strategies. * Coordinate project execution with internal engineers, vendors, and client stakeholders. * Delegate technical tasks while maintaining ownership of overall project quality. * Ensure projects are completed on schedule, within scope, and according to standards. * Conduct post\-implementation reviews and facilitate knowledge transfer to the support team. **3\. Level III Escalation \& Advanced Troubleshooting** * Serve as a senior escalation resource for complex incidents that cannot be resolved by Level I and Level II engineers. * Troubleshoot advanced issues involving networking, Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, virtualization, and endpoint infrastructure. * Diagnose intermittent performance issues, complex outages, and cross\-platform problems. * Lead technical response and recovery efforts during critical client incidents. * Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent corrective solutions. * Mentor junior engineers in advanced troubleshooting methodologies. * Identify recurring technical issues and recommend improvements that reduce future support demand. **4\. Client Consulting \& Technical Advisory** * Act as a trusted technical advisor to Cloudable clients. * Participate in client meetings to discuss infrastructure needs, technology challenges, and business objectives. * Recommend practical technology solutions aligned with client budgets, operational requirements, and growth plans. * Assist with developing technology roadmaps and infrastructure lifecycle plans. * Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to nontechnical stakeholders. * Support the sales and account management teams with technical scoping, solution design, and project recommendations. * Identify opportunities to improve client security, productivity, and operational efficiency. **5\. Security \& Technical Standards** * Apply security best practices across Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoint, and network environments. * Design solutions incorporating multifactor authentication, conditional access, least privilege, network segmentation, and endpoint protection. * Support incident investigation, remediation, and recovery. * Establish and maintain standardized network configurations and deployment procedures. * Review existing environments for technical debt, vulnerabilities, and operational risks. * Help improve Cloudable's engineering documentation, automation, and service delivery processes. **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years of progressive IT infrastructure, network, or systems engineering experience. * 5\+ years of experience in a senior engineering, technical lead, or equivalent role. * Strong hands\-on experience designing and implementing business networks. * Advanced knowledge of firewalls, VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs, and wireless networking. * Advanced experience administering Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, and Windows Server. * Experience with virtualization platforms such as Hyper\-V, VMware, or Proxmox. * Experience planning and independently executing complex infrastructure projects. * Demonstrated ability to resolve high\-level technical escalations. * Excellent documentation, organizational, and client communication skills. * Ability to independently prioritize responsibilities and manage multiple client environments. **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience working for a Managed jobs.title: Data Scientist I – Production Analytics
jobs.description: PLEASE NOTE BEFORE APPLYING: CODOXO IS NOT ABLE TO OFFER SPONSORSHIP OR ACCOMMODATE ANY CANDIDATES THAT ARE CURRENTLY BEING SPONSORED NOW OR IN THE FUTURE Of the $3\.8T we spend on healthcare in the United States annually, about a third of it is estimated to be lost due to waste, fraud and abuse. Codoxo is the premier provider of artificial intelligence\-driven solutions and services that help healthcare companies and agencies proactively detect and reduce risks from fraud, waste, and abuse and ensure payment integrity. Codoxo helps clients manage costs across network management, clinical care, provider coding and billing, payment integrity, and special investigation units. Our software\-as\-a service applications are built on our proven Forensic AI Engine, which uses patented AI\-based technology to identify problems and suspicious behavior far faster and earlier than traditional techniques. We are venture backed by some of the top investors in the country, with strong financials, and remain one of the fastest growing healthcare AI companies in the industry. ***Position Summary***: Our Data Science team builds and runs the statistical detection, scoring, and reporting engines behind Codoxo’s products. Everything that team has shipped is now live across a growing client base, and supporting it well has become a substantial body of work in its own right. That is where you will start. As Data Scientist I, you will join the Data Science team to help run and support the analytics we already have in production — the client configurations, the recurring reporting workflows, the detection logic, and the code and pipelines underneath them. Early on you will focus on the recurring work and on learning how our systems fit together: configuring clients onto existing products, validating scheduled reports, and investigating issues with a senior data scientist alongside you. As you build that knowledge, you will take on more of this work independently and contribute directly to the production codebase. This is a hands\-on technical role and a deliberate entry point into our platform. You will learn our claims data, our statistical methodology, and a large production Python codebase from people who built it, with support and code review throughout. It is a role designed to grow: the more of our production analytics you can carry, the more time our senior data scientists have for open research questions — reducing false positives, learning patterns across our client base, and catching new forms of fraud, waste, and abuse earlier — and the sooner you will be working on those questions yourself. ***Key Responsibilities****:* Support production analytics and client reporting* Configure new clients to run the analytical workflows and reports included in their purchased solutions, and help maintain those configurations as client needs change. * Validate the monthly and quarterly reporting cadences: confirm jobs execute on schedule, and validate output for accuracy and completeness before delivery. * Investigate failures and unexpected results, and resolve them or escalate with a clear picture of what you found. * Support client\-specific requests for claims examples, analytical validation, and supporting data. * Help turn recurring problems into durable fixes: automate manual steps, add validation checks that catch issues earlier, and document configurations, known issues, and resolutions. Learn and contribute to the production codebase * Contribute to the changes our production analytics code needs to stay secure, compliant, and supported — for example, updating how our jobs authenticate to our databases in response to a security requirement, or upgrading a framework version across the pipelines that depend on it. You will pair with senior data scientists and engineers on this work at first, and take on more of it as you go. * Get comfortable in a large existing Python codebase: read code you did not write, trace how a workflow actually runs, and find every place a pattern is used rather than only the obvious ones. * Write and update unit tests, take your changes through code review and CI, and validate them in a development environment before they reach production. * Build an understanding of how a change behaves in production — not only whether it works, but whether it holds up inside a long\-running job, at a large client’s data volume, or on a path that only one client exercises. * Work with Data Engineering and Platform Engineering on data quality, pipeline, and infrastructure issues that cross team boundaries. Investigate and help improve existing analytical logic * Keep an eye on the output quality of our production statistical detectors and scoring logic. * Investigate detectors flagged as noisy, low\-value, or behaving unexpectedly: analyze the underlying claims and flagged entities to determine whether the cause is data quality, client configuration, detector parameters, or the statistical logic itself. * Handle wel dependently, investigate issues on your own, and make your first reviewed changes to the codebase and to detector configuration. * **Toward the end of your first year:** own a meaningful share of our production analytics end to end, lead maintenance and compliance changes through review, and begin contributing to new analytical work. Growth Path As your depth in our data, code, and payment integrity methodology grows, the scope of your work grows with it — designing and evaluating new statistical detectors, contributing to new product capabilities, improving peer grouping and risk methodologies, and partnering with senior Data Scientists on open research problems. ***Qualifications:**** Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. * 0–2 years of experience in data science, analytics, data engineering, or software engineering. Strong internships and academic projects count. * Working proficiency in Python and SQL, and the confidence to read code you did not write. * Familiarity with git and the basics of code review and testing. * Foundational statistics: distributions, variability, and how to tell a real signal from noise. * Strong debugging instincts — given an unexpected number, you are willing to work backward through data, code, configuration, and workflow to find where it went wrong. * Strong attention to detail. Much of this work reaches clients, and quietly wrong output is worse than a failed job. * Ability to keep several recurring deliverables on schedule. * Clear written communication, and good judgment about when to keep going and when to ask for help. * Genuine curiosity about complex healthcare data and a willingness to learn the payment integrity domain. * Remote Work Requirements: To ensure reliable performance on the company\-issued CODOXO laptop, employees working remotely must have a stable high\-speed internet connection. Internet performance should be measured using a speed test conducted directly on the CODOXO laptop, not based solely on the internet plan purchased from the provider. * Physical Requirements: Work is performed in an office environment (either in our office or work\-from home) and requires the ability to work on a computer, operate standard office equipment, and work at a desk. Nice to Have * Experience with healthcare claims data or healthcare analytics, and coding systems such as ICD\-10, CPT, or HCPCS. * pandas, NumPy, or comparable Python data libraries. * Exposure to production data pipelines or scheduled workflows (Airflow or similar). * AWS or another major cloud platform; Spark or other distributed processing. * SQL\-based data warehouses and query performance tuning. * Statistical testing, regression, anomaly detection, or clustering in practice. * Awareness of security or compliance requirements in a regulated environment (HIPAA, FedRAMP, SOC 2\). * Familiarity with machine learning concepts and model evaluation. *Accessibility Notice: If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process due to a physical or mental disability, please send an email to careers@codoxo.com with the subject "Accommodation". Reasonable accommodation requests will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis.* **Benefits for You*** Health, Dental, and Vision insurance with 100% employee premium coverage (Starts Day 1\) * Unlimited PTO * Annual Professional Development stipend * Annual home office stipend * 401K Match (after 90 days) **We are an Equal Opportunity Employer**: Codoxo provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Data Engineer** ### **In this role, you will:** * Experience with using AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Databricks Genie, OpenRouter, or similar) to accelerate coding, troubleshooting, and documentation, while reviewing and testing all AI\-generated output before it reaches production. * Develop new data pipelines in Azure Databricks, and contribute to the enterprise data lakehouse. * Enhance and extend existing SQL Server Agent jobs, stored procedures, views, functions and SSIS packages, including the surrounding schema changes each enhancement requires. * Develop, enhance and extend data integrations with external systems and APIs using Salesforce MuleSoft * Write and tune complex T\-SQL against large data volumes; analyze execution plans and apply indexing and statistics strategies to resolve performance problems. * Build and maintain data models and datasets that support Power BI reporting, including publishing, scheduled refresh and gateway configuration. * Perform data validation, reconciliation and data\-quality checks across source and target systems. * Provide production support for approximately 300 data integration jobs: monitor, triage, diagnose and resolve failures, and drive root\-cause analysis so the same failure does not recur. * Partner in person with team members, application developers, and business stakeholders across academic and administrative departments to gather requirements and deliver solutions. * Communicate status, root causes and business impact clearly to non\-technical stakeholders in written and verbal English. At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 5 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Irvine, CA. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. ### **What you need to have to be considered** * 5\+ years of hands\-on Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL development experience. * Advanced set\-based T\-SQL. Fluency with window functions (ROW\_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE\_RANK), common table expressions, deduplication and latest\-record\-per\-key patterns, and conditional aggregation. Candidates should expect a hands\-on exercise in this area – see the selection process below. * SQL Server Agent – building, scheduling, monitoring and troubleshooting job chains in a production environment. * SSIS – developing and maintaining packages, including debugging failures in deployed packages. * Azure Databricks – demonstrable hands\-on experience. Notebooks, jobs and workflows, Spark SQL and/or PySpark, and Delta Lake. This is a firm requirement, not a nice\-to\-have. * MuleSoft – hands\-on development of API integrations, including Mule flows, DataWeave transformations, error handling, deployment, and production monitoring. * AI\-assisted development ("vibe coding"). Demonstrated productive use of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Databricks Genie, OpenRouter, or Cursor to write, refactor, troubleshoot and document code – together with the engineering judgment to review, test and validate AI\-generated output before it reaches production. Given how much of this role involves working inside unfamiliar inherited code, we regard this as a genuine productivity multiplier and we will ask candidates how they use these tools. * Performance tuning – execution plan analysis, index design, statistics maintenance, and diagnosing queries that regress in production. * Production support discipline – working incidents to resolution against service\-level expectations, and communicating clearly while an issue is open. * Professional written and spoken English sufficient to explain a technical problem, its cause and its business impact to a non\-technical stakeholder such as a dean or department head. * Ability to work 100% on site in Irvine, California during standard Pacific business hours. Remote work is not available for this position. ### **Salary and Other Compensation** Applications will be accepted until December 2, 2016\. The annual salary for this position is between $64,000 \- $94,500 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable plans. Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: * Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance * Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off * 401(k) plan and contributions * Long\-term/Short\-term Disability * Paid Parental Leave * Employee Stock Purchase Plan Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.description: **Job Description** =================== **Position Summary:** --------------------- In the summer of 2026, CIRA was awarded two year’s worth of funding by the Weather Program Office to conduct a project, “Using Quick Response Surveys to Develop and Pilot Test Flood Risk Communication”. The Quick Response Survey (QRS) project seeks a part\-time (70% FTE) Research Data Engineer or Statistical Programmer to develop and maintain a reproducible data\-management system for surveys of public perception and response to hazardous weather. The existing QRS repository includes approximately 13,000 responses from 34 survey waves organized into three distinct but structurally similar hazard databases. The initial work will include regularizing the historical databases and processing approximately 15 to 20 additional survey waves. The selected individual will develop a system that can scale to support future national implementation involving as many as 150 forecast offices conducting an average of four surveys per year. The position will be performed remotely, will involve regular collaboration with QRS researchers and institutional partners, and will report directly to the SBES Data and Methods Advisor. The period of performance for this project runs through April 2028\. The individual in this position will work in a fully remote capacity.
