and harmonize approximately 13,000 historical responses from 34 survey waves into three consistently structured and documented hazard databases. * Develop and maintain a master variable crosswalk and standardize variable names, labels, response codes, missing\-value conventions, and derived\-variable procedures across survey waves. * Design and implement a reproducible pipeline using Stata, Python, and other appropriate tools to import, clean, validate, harmonize, and append survey data from Qualtrics and other approved sources. * Develop the pipeline to process a set of approximately 15 to 20 survey waves and scale to approximately 600 waves annually without substantial rewriting of the core processing system. * Incorporate forecast\-office\-distributed surveys and purchased probability, quota, panel, or other vendor\-provided samples while preserving recruitment source, survey wave, weights, quotas, and other available sample\-design information. * Establish procedures for identifying, documenting, and managing changes to survey questions, response options, variable names, survey modules, and incoming data structures. * Create automated quality\-control checks and exception reports for unexpected variables, coding changes, duplicate records, missing metadata, invalid values, and other data inconsistencies. * Produce fully documented and analysis\-ready data files in Stata, R, and CSV formats, with Stata files and processing decisions readable and auditable by project researchers. * Maintain processing code, variable crosswalks, codebooks, data dictionaries, change histories, and standard operating procedures in an approved version\-control environment. * Follow applicable Institutional Review Board requirements. **Conditions of Employment:** ----------------------------- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States by the start of the position and through the entirety of the project (2 years from start date), because CIRA will not sponsor any type of visa for this position now nor in the future. **Supervision:** ---------------- The individual in this position will not supervise employees. **Required Qualifications:** ---------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, statistics, information science, social science, or a related field, plus three years relevant professional experience, OR Master’s degree in data science, computer science, statistics, information science, social science, or a related field. * Experience managing and programming data in Stata, including reproducible .do files, merges, appends, macros, loops, labels, and data\-validation procedures. * Experience producing fully labeled, documented, and analysis\-ready Stata files. * Experience writing data\-processing or scientific software in languages such as in Python. * Experience developing reproducible an  * Experience harmonizing multi\-wave, longitudinal, repeated cross\-sectional, or multi\-source datasets. * Experience working with confidential, restricted, or human\-subjects research data. * Familiarity with survey weights and sample\-design variables. * Experience using R and packages such as haven or the tidyverse. * Experience producing consistent Stata, R, and CSV outputs from a common data\-processing workflow. * Experience using LLM\-assisted programming tools for code development, schema comparison, testing, or documentation. * Experience working in an academic research center, government agency, policy institute, or similar research setting. * Experience in social science research. * Strong technical writing, documentation, problem\-solving, and communication skills as evidenced by an appropriate cover letter. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote research environment as evidenced by prior remote work experience. * **Application Instructions:** ----------------------------- * Applications must be submitted via online portal. We will not accept materials sent via email or other mode. * COVER LETTERS ARE REQUIRED. * In the body of your resume, please specifically address all required qualifications and applicable preferred qualifications when describing your work experience. A resume that fails to address the qualifications of this position may not be further considered after review by the search committee. * Likewise, an online application with a generic cover letter or missing a cover letter may not be further considered after review by the search committee. * References will be requested for finalists and will not be contacted without prior notification of candidates. * Search contact: Jennifer.Raab@colostate.edu. **Salary Range** ================ $45,000\-$50,000 at 70% FTE, 28 hrs/week Full salary is calculated at max of $72,000 which takes into consideration organizational RA II salary, level of education/experience and project budget. **Required Application Documents** ================================== To apply, please upload the following applicant documents. Cover Letter, Resume/CV **Employee Benefits** ===================== Colorado State University is not just a workplace; it’s a thriving community that’s transforming lives and improving the human condition through world\-class teaching, research, and service. With a robust benefits package, collaborative atmosphere, and focus on work\-life balance, CSU is where you can thrive, grow, and make a lasting impact. * **Background Check Policy Statement** ===================================== Colorado State University strives to provide a safe study, work, and living environment for its faculty, staff, volunteers and students. jobs.title: Product Engineer

jobs.title: MEC Plant Engineer
jobs.description: Under the direction of the Plant Manager, the Plant Engineer provides technical leadership and engineering support to ensure the safe, reliable, environmentally compliant, and cost‑effective operation of the Middletown Energy Center. This role supports day‑to‑day plant operations, maintenance and outage planning, reliability and performance improvement initiatives, capital projects, and regulatory compliance efforts. Plant Engineer serves as a key technical resource for plant personnel and collaborates closely with operations, maintenance, contractors, vendors, and corporate support teams to optimize plant performance, equipment reliability, and overall availability. The Middletown Energy Center is 1x1 gas fired combined cycle facility utilizing Mitsubishi 501 GAC Gas Turbine and Toshiba Steam Turbine. The facility uses city water in a cooling tower for condenser cooling. The 475 MW facility is interconnected to the PJM market. ### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Provide hands\-on engineering support for all combined cycle plant systems, equipment, and processes. * Troubleshoot equipment and system issues, supporting root cause analyses for forced outages, equipment failures, and performance deviations. * Monitor and analyze plant performance, heat rate, and reliability metrics to identify optimization and improvement opportunities. * Maintain accurate and current technical drawings, engineering files, system documentation, and reference materials. * Engineer, evaluate, justify, and implement plant modifications, upgrades, and reliability improvement initiatives. * Support planning and execution of scheduled and emergent outages, including scope development, contractor coordination, schedule support, quality oversight, and post‑outage reviews. * Develop scopes of work, technical specifications, bid packages, and engineering documentation for maintenance activities and outages. * Support reliability programs including Management of Change (MOC) and Root Cause Analysis (RCA), ensuring proper documentation and corrective action implementation. * Assist in development, optimization, and execution of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance strategies within the CMMS. * Support capital project development, budgeting, execution, and cost tracking. * Coordinate and provide technical oversight of contractors, consultants, and vendors working on site. * Responsible for NERC compliance at plant level. * Support regulatory and corporate compliance requirements, including environmental, safety, and internal standards. * Assist with development and continuous improvement of plant procedures, operating practices, and maintenance programs. * Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with all safety policies and regulatory requirements. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to operations and maintenance personnel. * Support workforce development and qualification programs. * Participate in plant call‑out and emergency response activities as required. * Perform other duties as assigned. ### **Qualifications and Skills** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (or equivalent combination of education, technical training, and industry experience). * 5–10 years of experience in power generation operations, maintenance, engineering, or related industrial environments. * Strong technical knowledge of combined cycle power plant systems, including gas turbines, steam turbines, HRSGs, generators, balance‑of‑plant systems, instrumentation, controls, and electrical systems. * Demonstrated troubleshooting, analytical, organizational, and communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced operational environment. **Preferred** * Experience supporting plant commissioning, outage execution, reliability engineering, and capital projects. * Familiarity with reliability‑centered maintenance (RCM) practices. * Experience with CMMS platforms such as Maximo or EAM. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel. * Ability to read and interpret P\&IDs, electrical schematics, and other engineering drawings. * Experience coordinating contractors and managing technical projects in an industrial or power generation setting. **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** This position involves a combination of office and field work in an operating power plant environment. The Plant Engineer must be available for extended hours during outages and emergent conditions and participate in an on‑call rotation as required. Physical requirements include the ability to: * Climb ladders and stairs and work at heights * Enter confined spaces * Lift up to 50 pounds * Perform frequent walking, standing, bending, kneeling, reaching, and extended periods of physical activity Applicants must possess a **valid driver's license** and maintain a clean driving record, as this position requires occasional travel for company business. Candidates should be comfortable operating a vehicle as part of their job responsibilities and must meet any applicable company and insurance requirements. We offer a variety of excellent benefits. Full\-time employees are offered the following: medical, dental, vision, LTD, STD, and Life insurance plans. You can even select additional “al la carte” benefits to meet all your needs. You can also enroll in our 401k, flex spending accounts for medical and childcare needs, and participate in our employee referral and tuition reimbursement programs. Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States. We believe in transparency and providing candidates with important information to make informed decisions. The salary range for this position is commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, and relevant qualifications. This range represents the base salary and does not include other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, benefits, or equity, which may be offered in addition to the base pay. The company reserves the right to modify compensation ranges at any time in accordance with business needs and market conditions. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Lead Software Engineer applies advanced knowledge of software engineering principles, modern architectural patterns, and emerging delivery methodologies to drive the technical direction of complex, distributed software platforms at the Release Train level. Serving as an influential participant in solution discovery and architectural decision\-making, this role leads milestone and epic\-level technical solutioning across the value stream's product portfolio; defines reference implementations and engineering standards for the teams it supports; and partners across release trains to ensure architectural coherence as the platform evolves. This role applies effective influence and collaboration\-without formal management authority\-across Engineering, Product, Architecture, and SRE to drive decisions and unblock delivery throughout the software development lifecycle. The Lead Software Engineer takes the lead on difficult technical problem\-solving and cross\-team coordination, predicts and documents potential architectural risks and constraints, and leverages AI\-assisted engineering tooling to compound their own and the broader engineering organization's productivity. As engineering teams increasingly rely on AI\-generated code, the Lead Software Engineer serves as a thought leader in evolving solution discovery practices to meet this shift \- defining how architectural intent, integration contracts, and implementation patterns are embedded into spec\-driven development workflows and AI coding agent configurations, ensuring technical direction is established at the point of generation rather than discovered through downstream rework. **What You'll Do** * Owns milestone and epic\-level solution discovery for the assigned value stream portfolio, producing implementation\-ready technical specifications that AI Transformed and AI Enabled delivery teams can execute while reducing the need for iterative clarification. * Defines technical standards and reference implementations for the value stream's product architectures, ensuring consistency across the portfolio and clear patterns for delivery teams to follow. * Partners with Value Stream Architects, peer Release Train level engineers, and adjacent release trains to align technical direction, surface architectural risks, and drive cross\-train decisions before they become delivery blockers. * Identifies teams with architectural drift, technical debt, or capability gaps and embeds to lead remediation \- coaching on patterns, driving solution design, and verifying technical readiness before delivery commitments are made. * Drives adoption of spec\-driven development across the value stream's delivery teams, embedding architectural intent and integration contracts into the artifacts AI coding agents and engineers consume \- rather than relying on post\-implementation correction. * Serves as the right hand to the incident commander during production incidents, providing technical depth across the value stream's product surface, accelerating diagnosis, and driving decisive remediation. * Remains the tip of the spear on emerging engineering technologies \- including AI\-assisted development, spec\-driven workflows, and modern integration patterns \- through hands\-on adoption, then transfers that capability to delivery teams through structured mentorship and reference work. * Identifies architectural risks within the value stream's technology footprint, defines mitigation strategies, and drives them to documented decisions that set forward\-looking technical direction. **Who You Are** * Bachelor's degree (list any requirements of discipline here) and 6 years' experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master's degree and 4 years' experience; a Ph.D. and 1 year of experience; or 18 years' experience in a related field. * Hands\-on experience with full\-stack development, including technologies such as StencilJS and C\#, in addition to designing and delivering distributed software systems, including API design, integration patterns, and cloud\-native architectures (AWS or equivalent). * Hands\-on experience leading technical solution discovery for complex initiatives, producing specifications and architectural artifacts that other engineers execute against. * Experience with modern delivery methodologies including spec\-driven development, Agile practices at scale, and AI\-assisted engineering workflows. * Reviews product requirements and system designs with an architectural lens, contributing technical direction during discovery and driving implementation patterns that support maintainability, scalability, and resilience. * Skilled at building partnerships with Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams both inside and outside of the organization, and at driving decisions across organizational boundaries without formal authority. * Remains current on software engineering tooling, architectural patterns, and emerging methodologies, recommending and driving adoption of approaches that measurably improve delivery throughput, technical quality, or engineering productivity. * Demonstrated experience working with AI coding tools (such as Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) and the ability to define and implement architectural guardrails within agent configurations, constitutions, or briefings **Compensation:** Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $0\.00 \- $0\.00\. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** 911 is the front door to American healthcare — and for millions of people, it's the wrong one. Americans place an estimated 240 million calls to 911 every year, and roughly 70–80% of EMS responses end in an ambulance ride to the emergency department — even when the patient doesn't need emergency\-level care. The system was built to transport, not to navigate. Crosswalk Health is building the navigation layer 911 was never designed to have. We partner with first responder agencies, community providers, and payors to route patients in crisis to the right care, in the right setting, at the right time. EMS is one of the most critical entry points in healthcare, and one of the most underutilized. We're changing that — aligning incentives across payors and providers to drive down costs at every level of the system, improve outcomes, and get high\-needs populations the care they actually need. **About the Role** Every day, people in crisis call 911\. Many of them don't need an emergency room. They need the right care, in the right setting, at the right time. Instead, they're transported to ERs, costs compound, and outcomes suffer. We're seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to own our AWS environment and infrastructure as code. This is a true zero\-to\-one opportunity on a lean engineering team, where you'll build the system rather than inherit it. This is not a role for someone who wants a finished playbook to execute. You'll make real calls on how things get built, work alongside engineers at the top of their craft, and help shape how we use AI responsibly in a healthcare environment. If you want to build something that meaningfully changes how care gets delivered, and you want your AI\-native skills to get sharper rather than rustier, keep reading. **Reports to:** Director of Engineering **What You'll Do** * **Own Our AWS Environment:** Architect, administer, and evolve our cloud infrastructure on AWS, with reliability, security, and performance in mind. * **Build Infrastructure as Code:** Define and maintain our infrastructure through code so environments are repeatable, reviewable, and easy to reason about. * **Be AI\-Native, Without Cutting Corners:** Use AI tools to move faster while holding the line on the engineering fundamentals that keep software safe in production, don't break other systems, and stay understandable to humans. * **Help Define Responsible AI Autonomy:** Work with the team to figure out how to give AI more autonomy with the right guardrails and assurances in place. This is thought leadership you rarely get outside of your own side projects. * **Make Real Technical Calls:** Shape architecture and tooling decisions on a team small enough that your judgment matters. * **Partner Across the Department:** Work closely with our senior engineers and technical leaders on systems that handle sensitive healthcare data. **What We're Looking For** **Requirements:** * **Senior\-Level Cloud Experience:** 4\-8 years of experience in cloud or infrastructure engineering. * **AWS Depth:** Hands\-on experience administering AWS environments, not just using them. We're an AWS shop, so this is a must. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Strong experience defining and managing infrastructure through code. * **AI\-Native Mindset:** Comfortable using AI as a core part jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description: For more than 60 years, Data Device Corporation (DDC) has been recognized as a world leader in the design and manufacture of high\-reliability Connectivity, Power, and Control solutions for the Aerospace, Defense, and Space industries. Our dedication to supplying quality products, on\-time delivery, and superior support, has contributed to the success of our customers and the critical missions they serve. **This position is 100% onsite at our Bohemia, NY office.** ***The salary range for this position is $80,000 to $105,000 annually and will depend upon experience.*** This position requires a U.S Person or a person who can qualify for a Department of State or Department of Commerce License. **Position Summary:** The Test Engineer designs, develops, integrates, maintains, troubleshoots, and modernizes production test equipment, ranging from manual fixtures to complex automated test systems. These systems support testing of hybrid microelectronic components, circuit card assemblies, and avionics equipment. The role combines hands\-on electronics troubleshooting, test software development, instrumentation, and system\-level problem solving to sustain reliable manufacturing operations and deliver new testing capabilities. Success requires technical ownership, timely completion of assigned deliverables, proactive communication, and effective collaboration across engineering and manufacturing teams. **Key Position Accountabilities:** * Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair production test equipment; diagnose root causes, verify corrective actions, and minimize downtime and repeat failures. Using schematics and instruments (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, DMMs, and power supplies) to isolate faults, validate repairs, and confirm performance. * Develop, modify, and optimize automated test software using Visual Basic, C\+\+, C\# or other applicable languages, while creating and maintaining Cadence OrCAD schematics and integrating hardware/software changes to ensure accurate, reliable, and repeatable test system performance. * Troubleshoot CAN, I2C, GPIB, RS485, RS232, and MIL\-STD\-1553 interfaces to maintain reliable communication with units under test. * Develop, implement, and troubleshoot JTAG/boundary\-scan tests to improve fault isolation, detect assembly defects, and maintain appropriate coverage. * Create and maintain test procedures, validation records, and maintenance documentation to ensure consistent operation and effective troubleshooting. * Plan and own assigned work from requirements through verification and closeout; meet milestones, identify risks early, and communicate delays and resource needs. * Collaborate with Test, Product, and Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Operations, and suppliers to resolve issues, share expertise, and implement solutions. * Support and document qualification and certification testing to demonstrate compliance with applicable product and customer requirements. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering Technology (electronics focus) or related engineering discipline; minimum three years of relevant hands\-on test engineering experience. * Familiarity with electronic manufacturing and testing of circuit card assemblies, hybrid electronics, or similar products. Knowledge of AC/DC and semiconductor circuit theory, schematic interpretation, laboratory instrumentation, electronic fault isolation, and test hardware integration. * Ability to develop or troubleshoot test software in at least one relevant language (e.g., Visual Basic, C\#, or C\+\+). * Demonstrated ability to complete assignments on schedule, document technical work, communicate risks promptly, and collaborate across teams. * Hands\-on JTAG/boundary\-scan implementation or troubleshooting experience, including fault isolation and test coverage considerations. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with multiple programming languages, especially Visual Basic, C\+\+, and C\#; familiarity with scripting, LabVIEW, or test automation frameworks. * Experience with CAN, I2C, GPIB, RS485, RS232, or MIL\-STD\-1553 interfaces. * Experience modernizing legacy test platforms or integrating modular instrumentation, including VXI/PXI/PXIe. * Knowledge of MIL\-STD\-883, MIL\-PRF\-38534, MIL\-M\-38510, and IPC\-A\-610, as applicable. * Experience coordinating technical solutions with equipment vendors and outside suppliers. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office; familiarity with Microsoft Access. **Desired Characteristics:** * Proactive, hands\-on problem solver who takes responsibility for delivering complete and verified solutions. * Dependable and organized; balances independent execution with timely requests for input and collaborative problem solving. * Communicates transparently about progress, obstacles, priorities, and commitments. * Curious about emerging test technologies and practical continuous improvement. jobs.title: Manufacturing Tooling Engineer
jobs.description: Description Deploy's client designs, manufactures, and constructs buildings and delivers them as products across the country. We fabricate the steel for uber modules, the structural frame the DMC system is built on, and we make the hardest parts of complex buildings on our own lines: headwalls, surgery ceilings, MEP racks, Central Energy Plants, exam rooms, bathrooms, and whole building modules. Twelve production lines, five programs, more than 800 teammates. We are the OEM and our own Tier 1 and Tier 2 supplier at once: the part, the subassembly, and the module that ships all come off our lines, and your tooling has to hold at every level. Everything we build on those lines runs on tooling. Jigs, fixtures, assembly tables, weld fixtures, and the gauges that prove the part is right. When the tooling is good, the line runs to takt and quality is built in rather than inspected in. When it is not, everything downstream pays for it. This is a new position because tooling needs an owner. The job starts with design and ends on the floor. You work out how a part should be held and located, with manufacturing process engineering and product design still at the table, and you model the fixture that does it. You run the stack\-up until the tolerances close, get it built in our own shop or at a vendor you manage, and stand at the line while the first parts come off it. When a fixture slows a line or a part comes out wrong, you are there that day. Some of that tooling serves lines already running; some is for lines that do not exist yet and must be proven before launch. You also inherit what is already on the floor: the drawings, the bills of material, the revision control, the asset records, and the calibration and repair schedules you keep with our Maintenance group. What we are looking for: * Five or more years designing and building jigs, fixtures, or production tooling in a manufacturing environment. * Fluent with tooling design software (SolidWorks, Inventor, or similar) and Revit for the building model. * Working knowledge of GD\&T and tolerance stack\-up, applied to real parts. * Hands\-on fabrication experience. Welding, metal fabrication, basic machining. * Comfort managing outside vendors on cost, lead time, and quality. * The judgment to explain why a fixture you built is designed the way it is, and what you rejected along the way. * A mechanical engineering degree helps and is not required. Our manufacturing has grown 2x in 24 months and looks to double again. The tooling backlog is real. If you want a queue someone else prioritizes for you, this is not the right seat. If you want to set the standard for how a company builds its tooling, it is. What you lead and what you do not. You get a dedicated fabricator to start, and each internal tooling project carries a budget you manage. The work arrives as a brief, owned by the General Manager or the Chief Launch Engineer, who triages competing priorities. You do not own the product design, the line's production schedule, or Maintenance. You influence all three. You sharpen the brief into a problem statement and a proposed answer, present to our internal review, iterate, and build. Our CEO is a designer and builder and works directly with the launch team. The seat: Manufacturing Tooling Engineer, reporting to Vesko Bozadzhiev, Manager of Manufacturing Engineering. Onsite in Birmingham, Alabama, with occasional travel to vendors and job sites. Relocation assistance available. **Do not send a resume. Send the problem statement for a fixture you designed, a simple sketch showing how you solved it, and a few sentences on what went wrong the first time and what you changed. Write it yourself. We check first that all three pieces are there and that you wrote them. What clears goes to Vesko Bozadzhiev, who judges the fixture and the thinking. What clears him goes to Chris Giattina, our CEO, who reads it himself and answers. We will ask for the resume when we talk. We are reading through November 16, 2026\.** Hiring Manager: Vesko Bozadzhiev at VBozadzhiev@bloxbuilt.com. Benefits BLOX offers comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, paid time off, short\- and long\-term disability, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan. jobs.title: Network Engineer II
jobs.description: **Position Purpose** Individuals in the Network Engineer role are responsible for the secure design, implementation, and operation of Dartmouth’s campus network. This responsibility includes all wired and wireless components of the physical network on the Hanover campus in addition to equipment in remote locations. It extends to the network components of data center and cloud infrastructure, maintaining the ongoing operation and automation of the network, the configuration and maintenance of the performance and fault monitoring systems, and escalation on the maintenance and configuration of the cloud\-based telephony system. Network Engineers serve as an escalation point for Network Technicians and respond to incidents and problems, and partner with IT organizations within Dartmouth to architect and implement point solutions. Security is a core responsibility of the role. Network Engineers build and maintain the network as a primary layer of defense for Dartmouth, implementing and enforcing network security controls, remediating vulnerabilities, and partnering closely with Information Security on threat detection, incident response, and the protection of institutional systems and data. **Description** **Required Qualifications \- Education and Yrs Exp** Bachelors plus 3\-5 years' experience or equivalent combination of education and experience **Required Qualifications \- Skills, Knowledge and Abilities** * Bachelor’s degree and 3 or more years of experience supporting production networks, or 7 or more years of equivalent experience * Demonstrated competency and experience in at least one area of network specialization, such as routing and switching, wireless, or VoIP, including independent configuration and troubleshooting * Working knowledge of network security principles, including segmentation, access control, and secure configuration practices * Ability to investigate and resolve complex network issues with minimal supervision, including responding to incidents as part of an on\-call rotation * Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain network designs, issues, and changes to both technical and non\-technical audiences * Collaborative and adaptable working style, with demonstrated initiative and ability to prioritize work in a fast\-paced environment **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with two or more network platforms, such as Cisco IOS and Junos * Experience with network security technologies, such as next\-generation firewalls, network access control (NAC), or VPN * Experience building and operating networks using automation and scripting (e.g., Ansible, Python, Git\-based workflows) * Experience deploying and supporting network services in public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, OCI) **Department Contact for Recruitment Inquiries** Paul Schmidt **Department Contact Phone Number** 603\-646\-8119 **Department Contact for Cover Letter and Title** Paul Schmidt, Network Architect **Department Contact's Phone Number** **Equal Opportunity Employer** Dartmouth College is an equal opportunity employer under federal law. We prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other legally protected status. Applications are welcome from all. **Background Check** Employment in this position is contingent upon consent to and successful completion of a pre\-employment background check, which may include a criminal background check, reference checks, verification of work history, conduct review, and verification of any required academic credentials, licenses, and/or certifications, with results acceptable to Dartmouth College. A criminal conviction will not automatically disqualify an applicant from employment. Background check information will be used in a confidential, non\-discriminatory manner consistent with state and federal law. **Is driving a vehicle (e.g. Dartmouth vehicle or off road vehicle, rental car, personal car) an essential function of this job?** Not an essential function **Special Instructions to Applicants** Dartmouth College has a Tobacco\-Free Policy. Smoking and the use of tobacco\-based products (including smokeless tobacco) are prohibited in all facilities, grounds, vehicles or other areas owned, operated or occupied by Dartmouth College with no exceptions. For details, please see our policy. **https://policies.dartmouth.edu/policy/tobacco\-free\-policy** **Additional Instructions** Key Accountabilities **Description** Network Operations Works on teams that will include some of the following responsibilities: * Accountable for the security of the network; implements, maintains, and enforces network security controls, such as firewall policy, segmentation, access control lists, and secure device configuration standards, in partnership with Information Security. * Owns the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of network automation; actively seeks new automation opportunities and improves existing solutions. * Designs, implements, and improves wired, wireless, data center, security, and cloud network components, including configuration changes to meet client requirements. * Accountable for network health, reliability, and performance, including configuration and maintenance of performance and fault monitoring systems. * Supports production network automation solutions and provides escalation support for the cloud\-based telephony system. * Works with stakeholders to plan and implement networks in new building construction and major renovations. * Serves as an escalation point for Network Technicians; investigates and resolves complex incidents and problems and designs corrective solutions for faults. * Performs software and hardware upgrades as part of regularly scheduled maintenance. * Remediates network device vulnerabilities in line with ITC vulnerability management standards and timelines. * Participates in a scheduled 24×7 on\-call rotation and supports incident response, including security incidents, as required. **Percentage Of Time** 50% **Description** Project Support * Contributes to and leads network project work with accountability for technical delivery and outcomes. * Participates in the review of requirements, including security requirements, for network\-connected equipment. * Partners with customers and IT organizations across Dartmouth to architect and implement solutions to business problems; participates in cross\-functional teams with network dependencies. * Communicates project status, plans, and changes clearly to team members and stakeholders. **Percentage Of Time** 30% **Description** Training and Development * Maintains working knowledge of evolving network technologies and cooperates with others to pass on new knowledge. * Creates internal training materials and teaches partners in the use of network automation solutions. * Provides guidance and technical mentorship to Network Technicians. **Percentage Of Time** 15% **Description** Diversity and Inclusion * Demonstrates commitment to inclusive practices through day\-to\-day interactions and team collaboration. * Engages in opportunities to build awareness and understanding across diverse perspectives. **Percentage Of Time** 5% * **\-** Demonstrates professionalism and collegiality through actions, interactions, and communications with others appropriate to an environment that is welcoming to all. **\-** Performs other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications
jobs.description: **Senior Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications** -------------------------------------------------------- **Enterprise Platform Group · Commercialization (Quote\-to\-Cash) · Mountain View, CA** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the Agentic Applications team, you will be the hands\-on technical lead for how Databricks quotes, orders, bills and recognizes revenue. Your core function is to build bespoke first\-party, agents\-first applications built on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You will own the technical architecture end to end, from quote to cash. You will design agents that work reliably inside revenue\-critical workflows, set the engineering standards the team builds on, and make sure every agent\-assisted decision can be observed, audited and trusted by Finance, Deal Desk and Sales. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role, not a people\-management role. You will write code, review designs, and be the most senior technical voice in a domain that touches every dollar Databricks books. ### **The impact you'll have** * **Own the agentic architecture for Quote\-to\-Cash.** Define and lead the target technical architecture across Configure\-Price\-Quote, deal management, ordering, subscriptions, investments, billing and revenue recognition. Drive the move from vendor\-configured workflows to first\-party, AI\-native applications built on Databricks Apps, Lakebase, Unity Catalog and Mosaic AI. * **Build production agents that sellers and Deal Desk trust.** Design and ship LLM\-powered agents for deal guidance, quote generation and summarization, multi\-option proposals, approval insights, and pricing and discount recommendations. Work directly with sales, Deal Desk and Finance to define what "good" looks like for each workflow. * **Make agent reliability a core system property.** Own the eval and quality system for this domain: per\-workflow quality criteria, offline eval suites, LLM\-as\-judge and human\-labeled benchmarks, behavioral regression testing in CI/CD, online tracing, and feedback loops that improve agents based on what users approve, edit and reject. * **Design human\-in\-the\-loop controls for revenue\-critical decisions.** Build the separation between what an agent proposes and what gets committed, plus diff\-based review, approval routing, audit logging, and policy guardrails. Together these decide when an agent can act on its own and when a person has to approve, especially for pricing, discounting, contract terms and order creation. * **Treat systems of record as agent tools.** Architect tool\-calling and MCP\-style interfaces that give agents governed, run\-time access to pricing, product catalog, order, contract, subscription and billing data. Follow single\-source\-of\-truth principles across CRM, ERP and billing systems. * **Protect financial integrity at scale.** Make sure agent\-assisted quoting and ordering produce accurate, compliance\-grade outputs downstream: order validation, billing, invoicing and revenue recognition, where errors directly affect financial reporting. * **Lead the migration path.** Act as the bridge between today's production quoting platform and the target agentic architecture. Sequence the migration so the business keeps scaling without disruption, and decide what to retire, rebuild or wrap. * **Raise the engineering bar.** Lead architecture reviews, establish design patterns for agents (orchestration, memory, retrieval, tool use, multi\-agent coordination), and mentor senior and mid\-level engineers on production\-grade agentic engineering. * **Earn cross\-functional credibility.** Partner with Finance, Deal Desk, Sales Ops, Legal and the broader Platform engineering org. Turn complex commercial processes into clear technical roadmaps and measurable business outcomes. ### **What we look for** * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership and ownership of large\-scale production systems. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience building and running LLM\-powered or agentic applications in production, such as agents, RAG pipelines, tool use, multi\-agent orchestration (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, DSPy or equivalent), and evaluation frameworks for generative outputs. * Strong backend and distributed\-systems skills: API and service design, data modeling, idempotency, consistency and transactional integrity, and observability. * Proven experience designing human\-in\-the\-loop systems: approval workflows, review interfaces, audit trails, and guardrails for probabilistic systems operating in regulated or high\-stakes domains. * Experience leading technical architecture for complex business domains, ideally Quote\-to\-Cash, Order\-to\-Revenue, billing, pricing or other revenue\-critical enterprise systems. * Full\-stack fluency. You are comfortable across modern web frameworks (React/TypeScript), backend services (Python, Java, Scala or Go), and data platforms. * Ability to work directly with non\-engineering stakeholders and turn ambiguous business workflows into clear agent and system architecture. * Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical execution across a team, without relying on positional authority. ### **Nice to have** * Domain experience with CPQ, deal management, subscription management, or revenue recognition in a high\-growth SaaS or consumption\-based business. * Experience building first\-party applications on top of, or as replacements for, enterprise SaaS platforms (e.g., Salesforce CPQ/Revenue Cloud, NetSuite, Zuora). Platform\-specific configuration expertise is a plus but not a requirement. * Experience with the Databricks platform (Databricks Apps, Lakebase, Unity Catalog, Mosaic AI Agent Framework, MLflow tracing and evaluation). * Familiarity with SOX controls, audit requirements, and financial\-systems compliance. **About Databricks** Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. **Benefits** At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. **Compliance** If access to export\-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== DoubleVerify is the leading independent provider of marketing measurement software, data and analytics that authenticates the quality and effectiveness of digital media for the world's largest brands and media platforms. DV provides media transparency and accountability to deliver the highest level of impression quality for maximum advertising performance. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best\-in\-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com . **Role Overview** ================= We are looking for a talented and driven **Senior AI Engineer** to join the Pinnacle AI (PinAI) team at DoubleVerify. In this role, you will be a core builder of **AgentOS** — our agentic AI platform that powers conversational, intelligent experiences across the Pinnacle advertising analytics suite. You will design and implement AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and LLM\-backed tools that allow Fortune 500 clients to interact with their advertising data through natural language. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who is passionate about applied AI, thrives in a fast\-moving environment, and wants to see their work directly impact how the world's largest advertisers make decisions. **What You'll Do** ================== ### **Agentic AI Development** * Design, build, and maintain AI agents within the AgentOS framework using architectures based on MCP (Model Context Protocol), LangChain, LangGraph, and related tooling * Develop new MCP servers and tools that expose Pinnacle analytics capabilities — including metrics, dimensions, settings, and user data — to AI agents * Implement multi\-turn conversational flows, tool\-use reasoning chains, and agent orchestration logic that handle complex, real\-world advertising analytics queries * Build and maintain the chat UI integration layer, connecting AgentOS to the Pinnacle front\-end experience ### **LLM Engineering \& Optimization** * Work with major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others) to select, prompt, and integrate models appropriate for specific agent tasks * Develop and own prompt engineering strategies, including system prompts, few\-shot examples, and chain\-of\-thought techniques * Implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ground AI responses in Pinnacle's proprietary data and documentation * Continuously optimize model performance through evals, latency tuning, and cost management ### **Evaluation \& Quality** * Build and maintain evaluation (evals) frameworks that measure agent accuracy, instruction\-following, hallucination rates, and user satisfaction * Define quality benchmarks and run regression evals on every agent change before production deployment * Instrument agents with observability tooling (e.g., LangSmith, Weights \& Biases, or custom tracing) to support debugging and continuous improvement ### **Integration \& Platform Engineering** * Integrate AgentOS with Pinnacle's existing platform services — including PIAM/Keycloak authentication, Settings APIs, and analytics data layers * Collaborate with backend teams to build and consume APIs that surface data cleanly and securely to AI agents * Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to technical design documents for new AI\-powered features ### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner closely with Product, UX, and Data Science to translate business requirements into agent capabilities and conversational flows * Work with QE teams to define testing strategies for AI features, including behavioral testing and adversarial prompting Contribute to the team's shared AI engineering standards, best practices, and documentation * **Who You Are** =============== **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- ### **Experience:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building production\-grade systems * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience developing LLM\-based applications or AI agent systems * Demonstrated experience shipping AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, from prototype to production ### **Technical Expertise:** * **Agentic AI Frameworks:** Solid hands\-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks * **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** Familiarity with MCP or similar modular tool\-integration protocols for AI agents (or strong appetite to ramp quickly) * **LLM Integration:** Experience calling and integrating with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or similar), including streaming, tool\-calling, and structured output patterns * **Python:** Strong Python proficiency; ability to build clean, testable, production\-quality backend services (FastAPI experience a plus) * **RAG \& Embeddings:** Understanding of retrieval\-augmented generation patterns, vector stores, and semantic search * **Evaluation Mindset:** Experience building or using eval frameworks to measure LLM/agent quality and regression\-test AI behavior * **Cloud \& Infrastructure:** Familiarity with cloud environments (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization basics (Docker/Kubernetes) ### **Soft Skills:** * Strong problem\-solving skills with a bias toward shipping and iterating * Clear communicator — able to explain AI behavior and limitations to both technical peers and non\-technical stakeholders * Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast\-paced, evolving AI landscape * Collaborative team player who contributes actively to shared standards and code quality ### **Education:** BS/MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related technical field * **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with MCP server development and tool\-use patterns in production agentic systems * Familiarity with IAM, Keycloak, or OAuth 2\.0\-based authentication patterns * Knowledge of advertising analytics, AdTech platforms, or BI tools (Looker, Snowflake, etc.) * Experience with modern front\-end frameworks (React/Angular) for conversational UI features * Contributions to open\-source AI projects or published work in AI/ML * Experience with agent evaluation tools such as DeepEval, LangSmith, or Braintrust Knowledge of responsible AI practices, including bias mitigation and hallucination reduction strategies * This position is full\-time and located in our New York City headquarters offices offering a hybrid work model from office and remote. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined by a number of non\-discriminatory factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and internal equity relative to peers at DV. The estimated salary range for this role, based on the qualifications set forth in the job description, is between $131,000 $241,000\. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits. The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted. **Not\-so\-fun fact:** Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: As an employee\-owned company, DMA prioritizes employees. Low turnover rates and tenured teams are living proof: * 2026 Great Places to Work Certified * Employee stock ownership program eligibility begins on day one of employment (ESOP contribution is targeted at 6% of your annual compensation) * Company paid parental leave * Generous time off package * Multiple benefit plans, eligibility begins on day one of employment * Culturally focused on work/life balance, and the overall wellness of our employees This is a hybrid position with an expectation to be in our Fort Wayne, IN office a minimum of two days per week. This position does not qualify for relocation assistance. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. This position does not qualify for employment\-based sponsorship. **Position Summary** The Data Analyst will be primarily responsible for creating and maintaining DMA’s infrastructure and systems that enable the collection, storage, and processing of data. This role is essential for ensuring data is accessible, reliable, and optimized for analysis and decision\-making. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines and ETL processes to ingest, transform, and deliver data from various sources. * Mine data from primary and secondary sources, then reorganize said data in a format that can be easily read by either human or machine * Use statistical tools to interpret data sets, pay particular attention to trends and patterns that could be valuable for diagnostic and predictive analytics efforts * Collaborate with programmers and engineers to improve efficiency and data organization; improve performance through data structure and query optimization * Ensure data integrity, quality, and security across all systems and platforms * Work with departments to provide insight and identify opportunities, improvements, recommend system modifications, and develop policies for data governance * Integrate structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources. * Monitor and troubleshoot data workflows, resolving issues proactively * Design, implement, and maintain critical data systems from ETL/ELT, Data Warehouse, BI Tools, and everything in between * Maintain documentation for data architecture, processes, and standards * Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and jobs.title: Builder Product Manager I
jobs.description: **Our LBM customers are small and mid\-size independent lumberyards, building material dealers and hardware stores who run their whole business on our ERP. It covers point of sale, inventory, special orders, delivery and contractor accounts. Dealers want software built for how a yard really works, so they can serve their contractors faster. The PM will need to be curious about the workflows end to end.**  Most ERP companies are trying to "add AI" as a sidecar. We are using AI to rewrite the rules of how enterprise software is built, tested, and operated from the ground up. As a Builder \- Product Manager focused on our Lumber \& Building Materials Products, you are the translator between ambition and execution. You aren't here to write PRDs that sit in Confluence; you are here to define the missions that the squad runs. You are likely the person who has replaced static roadmaps with living, AI\-generated prioritization models and is now looking for a place where that isn't just "allowed," but is the core requirement. As you build new customer value driven enhancements/products you will work with the Industry PM and the Value Stream PM to guide you in overall strategy goals and key metrics for the applicable value stream are achieved. CORE DNA — THE SHARED FOUNDATION ### **AI\-native workflow** You have moved past writing requirements in Word docs. You use LLMs to synthesize user research, generate acceptance criteria, and stress\-test your own assumptions before a single line of code is written. Agentic implementation You can specify and pressure\-test the behavior of autonomous agents. You understand what LangGraph state machines do, and you can write the "Mission Brief" that constrains one correctly. Legacy\-to\-modern bridge You aren't afraid of 20\-year\-old ERP workflows. You see them as a map of latent user intent waiting to be extracted, re\-expressed, and automated. Deterministic mindset You understand that "the PM said it was fine" isn't a guardrail. You define measurable acceptance criteria, quantitative evals, and the ground\-truth definitions that let engineers prove correctness. ELECTIVE SPECIALTY — THE MISSION ARCHITECT While you share the Core DNA with the squad, your "Superpower" is translating complex ERP business logic into precise, executable agent missions: Domain logic translation You can take a 50\-page accounting regulation or a decade of tribal knowledge from a SME and with the help of the Value Stream PM, turn it into structured system prompts, agentic constraints, and eval rubrics the squad can build against. Agentic UX definition Work with UX Research to define what "good" looks like when the interface is an AI agent, not a button. You write the behavioral specs (tone, escalation logic, failure modes) for generative UI experiences talking to customers to validate what you have built. Eval ownership You don't just define features; you define how correctness is measured. You co\-own the eval framework with the QA Builder, writing the "ground truth" definitions that judge agent output. Discovery Use AI to run your own user research, synthesize support tickets, usage telemetry, and interview transcripts, along with UX research and information from Signal to help prioritize insight. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO ### **Write the mission briefs** Replace traditional PRDs with structured "Mission Specifications", agent goals, tool constraints, success evals, and failure conditions that give Builders everything they need to ship without a kickoff meeting. Encode the business logic Interview subject matter experts and translate their knowledge into system prompts and agentic constraints that prevent hallucinations in workflows. Define the "ground truth" Co\-build the eval datasets and rubrics that the QA Builder uses to verify agent output against real ERP business logic; not vibes. Rapid mission prototyping Turn a "what if we automated X" into a working proof\-of\-concept prompt chain fast enough to validate before the squad commits to a build cycle. Own the modernization backlog Use AI\-assisted analysis of usage data, support volume, and codebase complexity to continuously prioritize which legacy modules the squad attacks next based on overall strategy objectives. **THE STACK** ------------- You don't need to build it, but you need to understand it well enough to spec it precisely. * Python (prompt scripting \& eval tooling) * SQL — ERP data fluency * LangChain / LangGraph — agent behavior specification * OpenAI / Anthropic APIs * DSPy — programmatic eval frameworks * GitHub — PR reviews \& spec versioning * Weights \& Biases — embedding and eval observability **WHO YOU ARE** --------------- ### **The "Requirements Hater"** You have a physical reaction to 40\-page PRDs nobody reads. If a requirement can't be expressed as a testable agent instruction, you question whether it's real. ### **Agent\-first thinker** You don't think in "features"; you think in "capabilities." You have already used an LLM to spec, critique, or prioritize your own work. Domain obsessive You find ERP business logic genuinely interesting. You understand the basics of how customer workflows work and leverage the Value Stream PM or other experts to drive why it matters and what breaks when it doesn't. Rigor over hype You know the difference between a compelling AI demo and an agent that's safe to run on a workflow. You won't ship the former as the latter. WHY JOIN US ### **No roadmap theater** We don't do quarterly planning decks. We run missions. You own the definition of what gets built and what "done" means. ### **The "Final Boss" of product complexity** ERP workflows are the most logic\-dense, high\-stakes product surface on earth. If you can spec agents that run a supply chain for example, you have mastered the hardest problem in product. ### **Agentic autonomy** You won't be writing tickets for engineers. You'll be defining the missions, the evals, and the ground truth then getting out of the way. ### **The BUILDER Tribe** You won't be the "only AI person" in the room. You'll be 1 of 4 like\-minded practitioners who are all obsessed with moving 10x faster.

AI is rewriting what software can do, and we have a narrow window to make sure that future puts the individual at the center rather than further behind. We start from one conviction: your digital identity should belong to you, travel with you, and give you real agency in how you show up online. You set the rules, you hold the keys, and you benefit from your own data. We are building toward that future across every layer it requires: the infrastructure that makes it possible, the standards that make it interoperable, and the experiences that bring it to life for the people who use it. We are early, and we are clear about what is built today and what is still ahead. The people who use what we build keep control of their own data, and we hold ourselves to that standard in everything we make.### **WHAT YOU WILL DO** We’re taking the EQUS Developer Toolkit to organizations of all kinds, from banks and other regulated institutions to employers, education providers, public bodies and digital platforms, and every one of them needs someone technical on our side to get them live. This is our first dedicated integration hire and a hands\-on, customer\-facing role. You’ll be the technical lead for each customer from the first architecture call to the first credential in production: designing the solution, connecting their identity and back\-end systems, and guiding them through security review. You’ll bring what you learn back into the product and the docs, and help shape how integration works as the team grows. You may be required to work on other EQUS products over time. Your day\-to\-day includes, but is not limited to:* Designing each customer’s solution, turning use cases such as KYC status, employee or student IDs, qualifications, age checks, membership and AI\-agent payment mandates into a Developer Toolkit design (issuance and presentation flows, wallet model and build method) that the customer’s architects can sign off * Running technical onboarding, provisioning sandbox and production tenants, issuing client credentials, setting up Issuers, Verifiers and credential schemas with the customer, and enabling and tracking on\-request features such as the Web Wallet, AP2 agent flows and quota increases * Connecting customer identity systems, guiding IAM teams through Bring Your Own IdP (OpenID Connect), Authorization Server registration and OAuth client\-credentials setup in both directions * Getting back\-end integrations live, specifying and reviewing each customer’s Attribute Provider endpoint and helping their engineers debug using request IDs, error codes and rate\-limit headers * Supporting front\-end teams as they embed our UI within strict security policies and allowed\-origin rules, apply their branding, and enable the browser Digital Credentials API where devices support it * Leading EU Digital Identity Wallet readiness, from moving Verifiers to X.509 and securing registration certificates from national Registrars to configuring trusted roots * Owning the technical side of security and procurement, answering due\-diligence questionnaires and joining security reviews using our data\-handling, encryption, DPA and TOMs documentation * Supporting business development in technical sales conversations, helping prospective customers understand what an integration involves and helping us close our first deals * Acting as the customer’s voice to product, logging and prioritizing the gaps that block deals and working with our engineering team and partners on fixes * Making every integration faster than the last, writing quickstarts, help\-center articles, sample code and a reusable customer integration pack with sector variants, including a flow decision tree, security answers and a go\-live checklist ### **WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED** You combine deep technical skill with real empathy for customers, and you’re as comfortable with a bank’s IAM team as with a startup’s two developers. You’re fluent in OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect and can work out why a token is rejected, you can read an OpenAPI spec and write enough back\-end code to build sample integrations, and you understand PKI well enough to untangle a certificate chain. You write clearly, whether it’s an integration design, a security answer or public documentation. You are comfortable with ambiguity, because parts of our product are still being built and you’ll design around the roadmap. You are self\-directed in a remote setting, managing your own time and keeping several customer integrations moving at once.### **YOUR EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** This role calls for 4 or more years in a customer\-facing technical role such as solutions engineer, integration engineer or technical consultant for an API or identity product. You’ve personally taken enterprise customers from pilot to production, ideally in regulated or security\-conscious sectors such as banking, insurance, government, healthcare or education, including security reviews and vendor due diligence. You bring hands\-on experience with REST APIs and at least one back\-end language (TypeScript/Node, Java/Kotlin or Python), and a working understanding of X.509 certificates, trust anchors and key management. Experience with verifiable credentials and digital identity standards (OID4VCI, OID4VP, SD\-JWT VC, ISO 18013\-5 mdoc), eIDAS 2\.0 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet ecosystem, enterprise identity providers such as Microsoft Entra, Okta or Ping, and payments, open banking or agentic\-payment protocols like AP2 are all a plus. ranking. * Own operational health for a high\-traffic service, including on\-call, runbooks, ops reviews, and incident response. * Coordinate your team's deliverables with Legal, Compliance, Finance, CX, and external partners on launches, and raise dependencies early. * Champion AI\-native engineering practices, including spec\-driven development and agentic tooling, and coach engineers to use AI jobs.title: Scientist I, High-Throughput Biology

You are an effective communicator and teammate who is eager to learn and collaborate with people from diverse scientific backgrounds. **What You'll Do** * Design, execute, and analyze robust and reproducible experiments to optimize, validate, and scale up live\-cell imaging\-based assays for high\-throughput screening using Eikon's proprietary super\-resolution microscopy platform. * Collaborate with computational biologists and software engineers to apply state\-of\-the\-art computational and statistical methods including machine\-learning to analyze large datasets. * Summarize and deliver timely, high\-quality and actionable data to drive project team decisions across drug discovery portfolios. * Exercise good scientific judgment and provide data\-driven recommendations to project teams. * Maintain organized and comprehensive electronic records of experiments, results, and protocols in adherence to company standards and regulatory requirements. * Work closely with the High\-Throughput Biology Operations Team to transfer optimized processes into productionized operations workflows with well\-documented standard operating procedures. * Collaborate and communicate across a diverse team of biologists, chemists, and engineers. * Contribute to the growth and training of junior scientists. **Qualifications** * Ph.D. or Master's plus 10 years of relevant experience or Bachelor's degree plus 12 years of relevant experience in Biology, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, or related field. * Proficiency in mammalian cell culture with sterile technique. * Proficiency in laboratory techniques and equipment relevant to molecular and cellular biological research. * Demonstrated experience in systematic optimization and validation of biological assays. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with novel assay technologies. * Working experience in quantitative fluorescence microscopy and/or super\-resolution microscopy. * Working experience with relevant quantitative and/or statistical analysis using common software tools (e.g., Microsoft Suite, GraphPad Prism, etc.). * Working experience with one or more high\-level programming languages (e.g., Python, MATLAB or R) to perform large dataset analysis and visualization. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey scientific concepts effectively. * Collaborative mindset with the capacity to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams. * Proactive and adaptable to evolving research priorities and challenges. * Working experience in protein dynamics using single\-molecule microscopy is preferred. * Working experience with high\-throughput instrumentation and automation systems is preferred. At Eikon, employee compensation also includes bonus and equity compensation, in addition to several generous benefit programs, including: * 401k plan with company matching * Medical (premiums covered by Eikon at 95%), dental and vision insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%) * Mental health and wellness benefits * Weeklong summer and winter holiday shutdowns * Generous paid time off and holiday policies * Life/AD\&D Insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%) and optional supplemental employee\-paid life/AD\&D policies * Enhanced parental leave benefit * Daily subsidized lunch program when on\-site The expected salary range for this role is $123,000 to $149,100 depending on skills, competency, and the market demand for your expertise. jobs.title: Research Scientist – Multimodal Foundation Models & Visual Reasoning
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ We are a well\-funded, early\-stage AI research and product lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers—including Andrew Dai, previously an engineering leader on Gemini—our mission is to push the frontier of visual and multimodal intelligence. Our first model, Glimpse, launched publicly in October 2026\. Our team currently consists of 25 world\-class scientists and engineers. We raised a $55M seed round led by Altimeter Capital, Menlo Ventures, Striker VC, and NVIDIA. We are tackling foundational problems in artificial intelligence and translating cutting\-edge multimodal research into scalable, real\-world systems. **About the role** ------------------ In this role, you will lead ambitious, high\-impact research across next\-generation model architectures, distributed training methodologies, multimodal visual reasoning, reinforcement learning, and data\-centric learning. Backed by dedicated, large\-scale compute clusters and deep engineering support, you will formulate first\-principles hypotheses and run large\-scale empirical experiments. You will collaborate closely with world\-class research and engineering peers to push the boundary of visual intelligence and translate core research breakthroughs directly into state\-of\-the\-art foundation models and real\-world capabilities. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Frontier Research:** Drive novel research at the intersection of foundation models, multimodal understanding, complex visual reasoning, and spatial intelligence. * **Architecture \& Training Innovations:** Conceive and build novel model architectures, pre\-training methodologies, and scalable post\-training techniques (e.g., preference tuning, reasoning\-focused RL) to systematically advance model capabilities. * **Large\-Scale Experimentation:** Design, execute, and analyze large\-scale distributed training experiments on modern accelerator clusters to push the frontier of model performance. * **Data\-Centric Intelligence:** Pioneer innovative approaches to multimodal data curation, synthetic data generation, automated filtering, and rigorous benchmark evaluation. * **Breakthrough to Capability:** Collaborate with cross\-functional research and systems engineering teams to turn fundamental algorithmic breakthroughs into robust, scalable foundation model capabilities deployed at scale. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * Ph.D. or equivalent industry research track record in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, or a related quantitative discipline. * Rigorous foundational understanding of deep learning principles, transformer/multimodal architectures, and modern large\-scale training dynamics. * Deep proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or JAX). * Demonstrated ability to independently define research agendas, design rigorous empirical experiments, and solve open\-ended, frontier\-level problems. **Nice to have** ---------------- * **Specialized Domain Expertise:** Deep theoretical and practical expertise in at least one of the following: foundation models, multimodal reasoning, visual/spatial intelligence, reinforcement learning, or post\-training * **Proven Research Impact:** Strong track record demonstrated through first\-author publications at top\-tier venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV) or key technical contributions to high\-profile foundation model releases. * **Distributed Systems \& Scale:** Hands\-on experience training, profiling, and scaling models across large distributed GPU or TPU clusters (e.g., FSDP, Megatron\-LM, DeepSpeed, Ray). * **Data \& Evaluation:** Demonstrated experience developing large\-scale multimodal data pipelines, synthetic reasoning trace generation, or designing rigorous evaluation suites for frontier models.
