jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (REMOTE)
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The Senior AI Engineer is a hands\-on individual contributor who builds, trains, and evaluates machine learning models. The role combines knowledge engineering and data analysis with applied reinforcement learning, and owns work end to end, from data and experiment design through training, evaluation, and reporting. The ideal candidate brings practical reinforcement learning experience, strong engineering discipline, and the ability to collaborate closely with domain experts and communicate results to technical and non\-technical audiences. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Work with domain experts to capture specialized knowledge and represent it in structured, usable form. * Analyze source material and datasets for quality, consistency, and coverage, and resolve issues with the appropriate stakeholders. * Perform exploratory and statistical analysis to inform data, modeling, and evaluation decisions. * Create and curate training and evaluation datasets, using both automated and human validation. * Design reinforcement learning environments, reward functions, and verifiers. * Train and fine\-tune language models using supervised and reinforcement learning methods such as PPO, DPO, and GRPO. * Establish baselines, run ablations, and diagnose training issues such as reward hacking, instability, and data leakage. * Follow the research literature and bring promising techniques into practice. * Manage experiments rigorously, including versioned configurations, reproducible runs, experiment tracking, and compute budgeting. * Design and extend evaluation frameworks, metrics, and benchmarks. * Compare models and approaches through structured experiments and A/B testing. * Document results, failures, and next steps in clear technical write\-ups. * Present findings to engineers, domain experts, and business leaders in language each audience can act on. ### **Requirements \& Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field; MS or PhD preferred. Equivalent hands\-on experience will be considered. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience training or fine\-tuning language models. * Demonstrated reinforcement learning experience, including designing an environment and reward function end to end and training a policy in it. * Working knowledge of policy optimization methods for language models, such as PPO, DPO, or GRPO, including their failure modes. * Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with fluency in the Hugging Face ecosystem and parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning techniques. * Experience building and evaluating LLM\-based agents or multi\-turn systems. * Experience designing evaluations for language models, including held\-out sets and automated grading. * Ability to analyze complex, detailed documentation and translate it into precise, structured, testable form. * Clear technical writing, with the ability to explain an experiment and its results concisely. * Comfort working directly with domain experts who are not machine learning practitioners. * Experience working with healthcare data or in another highly regulated industry is highly preferred. * Experience training models to produce structured or schema\-constrained output is highly preferred. * Experience with a broad range of reinforcement learning algorithms and advanced reward design is highly preferred. * Experience with knowledge representation approaches such as knowledge graphs or ontologies is highly preferred. * Experience generating and validating synthetic data for model training is highly preferred. * Publications or open\-source contributions in reinforcement learning, language model fine\-tuning, or model evaluation is highly preferred. * Experience handling sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA is highly preferred. * Timely and regular attendance. * Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered * To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. ### **Special Considerations and Prerequisites** * Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission. * This is a 100% hands\-on individual contributor role. The AI Engineer owns experiments from design through code, training, and results. * Expect roughly half of the role to focus on reinforcement learning and model training, with the remainder split between knowledge engineering, data analysis, and evaluation. * Success requires sustained, close collaboration with domain experts and a genuine working understanding of the subject matter. * The underlying knowledge evolves over time. The AI Engineer must design data, training, and evaluation approaches that adapt to change without starting over. * All work must comply with HIPAA and EnableComp data policies, using de\-identified or synthetic data wherever possible. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Plumbing and Mechanical Project Manager
jobs.description: **Position Overview** We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Contracting Project Manager to lead large\-scale commercial, healthcare, and industrial projects from preconstruction through completion. This individual will oversee project execution, financial performance, scheduling, manpower planning, procurement, and coordination of HVAC, plumbing, mechanical piping, and welding/pipefitting scopes. The ideal candidate has mechanical contracting experience, strong financial and technical skills, and a proven ability to deliver projects safely, on schedule, within budget, and profitably. **Key Responsibilities** * **Project Management:** Lead projects from contract award through closeout, including planning, budgeting, scheduling, procurement, risk management, and coordination with owners, general contractors, engineers, and field personnel. * **Financial Management:** Manage job costing, budgets, monthly forecasts, cost to complete projections, cash flow, progress billing, and profitability. Monitor labor and material costs, identify unfavorable trends, and implement corrective actions. * **Manpower \& Production:** Forecast labor requirements by trade, monitor productivity, coordinate field staffing, manage material procurement and long lead equipment, and promote prefabrication and installation efficiencies. * **Contract Administration:** Review contracts and scopes, manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, and project documentation, and ensure changes are properly documented and recovered. * **Technical Coordination \& Quality:** Coordinate HVAC, plumbing, mechanical piping, and welding/pipefitting activities, including constructability reviews, BIM/VDC coordination, inspections, testing, TAB, and commissioning. Promote safety and compliance with project specifications and applicable codes. * **Leadership \& Customer Relations:** Work closely with superintendents, foremen, project engineers/controls, estimating, purchasing, and accounting. Lead project meetings, resolve issues, communicate progress, and maintain strong customer relationships. * **Project Closeout:** Oversee punch lists, as\-built drawings, O\&M manuals, warranties, final billing, cost reconciliation, and project performance reviews. **Required Qualifications** Minimum of 5 years of project management experience in commercial construction, in the mechanical contracting and plumbing industry. * Experience managing substantial HVAC, plumbing, mechanical piping, and/or welding/pipefitting projects. * Proven ability to manage project budgets, job costing, forecasting, scheduling, labor productivity, and profitability. * Strong understanding of mechanical and/or plumbing systems, construction drawings, specifications, contracts, and field operations. * Experience with procurement, change orders, subcontractors, and project documentation. * Strong leadership, communication, analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * * Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and ability to travel to project sites as required. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with large\-scale healthcare, industrial, manufacturing, institutional, or complex commercial projects. * Experience with design\-build, design\-assist, cost\-plus, or Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) delivery. * Knowledge of prefabrication, BIM/VDC, and construction management platforms such as Procore, Autodesk, Trimble, Bluebeam, or Microsoft Project. * * Construction Management or trade background, or equivalent industry experience. **Performance Expectations** Deliver safe, high\-quality, profitable projects through accurate forecasting, proactive cost and schedule management, effective manpower planning, strong field coordination, and dependable customer communication.

jobs.title: Sr Platform Engineer, Data
jobs.description: **Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!** Ensemble is a leading provider of technology\-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end\-to\-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country. Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference! O.N.E Purpose: * **Customer Obsession:** Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations. * **Embracing New Ideas:** Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation. * **Striving for Excellence:** Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results. **The Opportunity:** **JOB SUMMARY** By embodying our core purpose of customer obsession, new ideas, and driving innovation, you will help ensure that every touchpoint is meaningful and contributes to our mission of redefining the possible in healthcare. As a Senior Platform Engineer, you are a hands\-on technical engineer who sits at the intersection of data engineering, cloud platform, and networking — building the infrastructure and pipelines that make Ensemble's data platform reliable, secure, and scalable. You will design and implement Azure\-based platform solutions, author data pipelines, harden network architecture, and apply solid software engineering discipline across everything you ship. This is primarily a delivery role. You will spend the majority of your time writing code, configuring infrastructure, reviewing pull requests, and solving hard operational problems — not managing people or setting org\-wide strategy. You bring strong opinions about platform reliability, cloud cost, and network security, and you translate those opinions into running systems. We are open to strong cloud/platform engineers who want to go deep on data, and to strong data engineers who have grown into platform and networking responsibility. What matters is that you have done hard, hands\-on work at the intersection of these disciplines — you understand both why a pipeline fails and why a Private Endpoint DNS record is wrong, and you are comfortable owning both. **JOB COMPETENCIES** **Platform \& Cloud Engineering —** Designs, builds, and operates Azure\-based platform infrastructure — compute, storage, networking, identity, and security — with a bias toward infrastructure as code, repeatability, and operational simplicity; balances speed of delivery with platform reliability and cost efficiency. **Data Engineering Depth —** Delivers scalable, well\-tested data pipelines and transformations on Databricks and Azure Data Factory; applies sound data modeling, performance tuning, and data quality discipline as standard practice rather than afterthoughts. **Network \& Security Awareness —** Understands Azure networking constructs — VNets, subnets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, DNS, and ExpressRoute/VPN — and applies them correctly in platform design; proactively identifies and closes network attack surface without creating unnecessary friction for engineering teams. **Software Engineering Craft —** Writes clean, testable, maintainable code; participates actively in code and design reviews; treats CI/CD and automated testing as the default way of working; holds a high bar for version control hygiene and deployment safety. **Operational Ownership —** Takes end\-to\-end accountability for the platform components and pipelines in scope — from initial design through production monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement; does not hand off and walk away. **Technical Communication —** Communicates clearly with both engineering peers and non\-technical stakeholders; can explain complex networking or data platform trade\-offs to a product manager or a VP without losing the audience or oversimplifying the substance. **Continuous Learning \& AI Fluency —** Stays current with the Azure, Databricks, and data engineering ecosystem; consistently applies generative AI tools to accelerate engineering work, improve code quality, and troubleshoot complex systems. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS** **Customer Obsession, New Ideas, Striving for Excellence** * Consistently deliver high\-quality platform and data solutions that improve the reliability, speed, and accuracy of data reaching internal and external stakeholders. * Apply generative AI tools in day\-to\-day engineering work to accelerate development, improve code quality, troubleshoot complex systems, and design scalable solutions. **Da . * Azure certifications relevant to the role (e.g., AZ\-305, DP\-203, AZ\-700\) are a plus, but not a substitute for demonstrated hands\-on experience. * Familiarity with FinOps practices, Databricks cost management, and Azure cost optimization tooling. **Education** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. **WORKING CONDITIONS** * Remote\-friendly with periodic travel for team meetings, onsite collaboration, or client engagements. * General office environment or work from home. * May require occasional off\-hours support for platform incidents or scheduled maintenance windows. * This position pays between $101,600 – $152,400 based on experience * Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences. \#LI\-SA1 \#LI\-REMOTE **Join an award\-winning company** Five\-time winner of “Best in KLAS” 2020\-2022, 2024\-2025 Black Book Research's Top Revenue Cycle Management Outsourcing Solution 2021\-2024 22 Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) MAP Awards for High Performance in Revenue Cycle 2019\-2024 Leader in Everest Group's RCM Operations PEAK Matrix Assessment 2024 Clarivate Healthcare Business Insights (HBI) Revenue Cycle Awards for strong performance 2020, 2022\-2023 Energage Top Workplaces USA 2022\-2024 Fortune Media Best Workplaces in Healthcare 2024 Monster Top Workplace for Remote Work 2024 Great Place to Work certified 2023\-2024 * Innovation * Work\-Life Flexibility * Leadership * Purpose \+ Values Bottom line, we believe in empowering people and giving them the tools and resources needed to thrive. A few of those include: * **Associate Benefits –** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial health of you and your family, including healthcare, time off, retirement, and well\-being programs. * **Our Culture** – Ensemble is a place where associates can do their best work and be their best selves. We put people first, last and always. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth, and innovation. * **Growth –** We invest in your professional development. Each associate will earn a professional certification relevant to their field and can obtain tuition reimbursement. * **Recognition –** We offer quarterly and annual incentive programs for all employees who go beyond and keep raising the bar for themselves and the company. Ensemble is an equal employment opportunity employer. It is our policy not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, military or veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Ensemble also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. Due to business, operational, payroll, and regulatory requirements, this position is limited to individuals who reside and are authorized to work within the United States. Applications generated from outside the United States will not be considered. Individuals may reapply when located within the United States. Ensemble provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law. If you require accommodation in the application process, please contact TA@ensemblehp.com. This posting addresses state specific requirements to provide pay transparency. Compensation decisions consider many job\-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location; knowledge; skills; relevant experience; education; licensure; internal equity; time in position. A candidate entry rate of pay does not typically fall at the minimum or maximum of the role’s range. Employment Disclaimers – Ensemble

jobs.title: ML/DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** Description **Purpose of Role:** As a ML/DevOps Engineer specializing in cyber security, you will be responsible for architecting, automating, and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure. You will act as a subject\-matter expert on secureML/DevOps (DevSecOps) practices, ensuring infrastructure resilience, compliance, and rapid delivery of high\-quality software. **Essential** **Responsibilities:** * **Design \& Automate:** Build and manage scalable, secure CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI) and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible). * **Secure Cloud Infrastructure:** Implement and maintain security controls across AWS (or Azure/GCP) environments, including IAM, network segmentation, and encryption in transit/at rest. * **AI/ML Tooling:** Familiarity with model servers, vector databases, GPU monitoring (DCGM), and agent orchestration * **Container \& Orchestration Security:** Harden Docker images, manage Kubernetes security policies, and integrate container\-scanning tools. * **Continuous Monitoring:** Deploy observability solutions to track system health, performance, and security posture; respond to alerts and conduct root\-cause analysis. * **Threat Modeling \& Risk Assessment:** Evaluate infrastructure changes for potential vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation measures. * **Compliance \& Governance:** Align infrastructure and processes with SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and other relevant standards; generate required evidence for audits. Handle model registries (MLflow, HuggingFace/NGC mirrors), vulnerability scanning supply\-chain hygiene, and role\-based access for AI coding tools or agentic wrappers * **Incident Response:** Partner with security and engineering teams on incident detection, triage, and post\-mortem analysis. * **Collaboration \& Enablement:** Coach development teams on secure coding and deployment practices; advocate for DevSecOps culture across the organization. * **Continuous Improvement:** Stay current with emerging DevOps and security trends, recommending and implementing tool and process enhancements. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. * **5\+ years** in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Engineering with demonstrable security responsibilities. * Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred). * Proficiency in infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD platforms. * Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, or Go) for automation. * Deep understanding of networking, containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS). * Experience with vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and identity \& access management. * Familiarity with log aggregation, metrics, and alerting stacks (e.g., ELK, Prometheus, Grafana). * Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills; ability to work independently and collaboratively. **Preferred** * Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA, or CISSP. * Experience with security platforms (Aqua, Prisma Cloud, Snyk, or similar). * Knowledge of zero\-trust architectures and secure SDLC frameworks. * Familiarity with compliance frameworks in regulated industries (healthcare, finance). * Experience with infrastructure cost\-optimization and FinOps practices. **Relevant Working Conditions/Physical Demands:** * Sitting/Stationary: Often requires sitting at a desk and looking at a computer screen for 70% \- 90% of the workday. * Fine Finger Dexterity: High use of keyboards, computer mice, and standard office equipment. * Lifting/Moving: Minimal physical exertion; occasionally required to lift or carry office supplies, files, or packages weighing up to 30 lbs. * Mobility: Intermittent standing, walking, and bending or stooping to retrieve files. ***Equiti is an Equal Opportunity Employer Committed to creating a diverse and inclusive company culture. jobs.description: **Location** ------------ St. Louis **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Research and Development **About Exegy** Exegy is a global leader in intelligent market data, advanced trading systems, and future\-proof technology. Exegy serves as a trusted partner to the complete ecosystem of the buy\-side, sell\-side, exchanges, and financial services technology firms around the globe. Headquartered in St. Louis with regional offices in North America, the UK/Europe and Asia Pacific, Exegy has the global footprint to deliver world\-class support and managed services to its customer base of elite financial market participants. **Job Summary** We are seeking an experienced System Engineer to join our Managed Services Engineering (MSE) team in St. Louis, MO. You will be our lead specialist in Linux systems, bare\-metal provisioning, and infrastructure networking, building and maintaining the automation that turns bare\-metal servers into production\-ready platforms. You will own our automated OS provisioning workflows, configuration management frameworks, Linux networking and routing services, and hardware validation tooling, and serve as a senior escalation resource for deployment and operations teams. **Responsibilities** * **Bare\-Metal Provisioning \& OS Lifecycle:** Design, maintain, and evolve automated provisioning workflows, including network boot environments, live boot images, and unattended Linux installations. Lead OS lifecycle work such as package and repository management, service administration, and platform upgrades * **Configuration Management \& Automation:** Build and maintain Puppet and Ansible automation, including custom modules, manifests, data hierarchies, and backend data stores * **Provisioning Tooling:** Develop and support Python and Bash s and scripts for preboot staging, hardware discovery, and automated hardware validation * **Linux Networking, Routing \& Security:** Administer, troubleshoot, and modernize Linux network services, including dynamic routing, VPN, proxy services, and SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle management * **Server Hardware Validation:** Define and validate Bills of Materials (BOMs) for enterprise server platforms, manage out\-of\-band configuration, and resolve hardware discrepancies during bring\-up * **Technical Escalation:** Act as the escalation point for deployment and support teams on provisioning failures, hardware mismatches, and complex Linux networking and routing issues **Required Qualifications** * **Enterprise Linux (5\+ years):** Senior\-level systems engineering experience on RHEL and Rocky Linux 9/10\. RHCSA or RHCE certification is a strong plus * **Configuration Management:** Hands\-on experience with Puppet (modules, manifests, Hiera, Facter, Ruby) and Ansible * **Bare\-Metal Provisioning:** Practical experience with PXE/iPXE, live boot image generation (dracut/initramfs), unattended installers (Anaconda/Kickstart), and provisioning tools such as Razor or Foreman * **Python \& Bash:** Proficiency in systems automation, CLI tooling, REST API integration, and structured data formats (JSON, YAML) * **Databases:** Experience with NoSQL and relational databases (such as CouchDB and PostgreSQL) that store infrastructure and configuration data * **Linux Networking \& Routing:** Deep knowledge of IP networking, NIC bonding, VLANs, multiple routing tables, policy\-based routing (ip rule/ip route), firewalling (iptables/nftables), and packet analysis (tcpdump) * **VPN, Proxy \& Routing Daemons:** Experience configuring and troubleshooting OpenVPN, SSL/TLS certificates (OpenSSL/PKI), proxy services (such as Squid), and routing daemons (such as BIRD) * **Linux Troubleshooting:** Strong command of systemd, dnf/yum/rpm, storage and filesystems, and diagnostic tools (journalctl, strace, lsof, ss, dmesg) * **Hardware \& Out\-of\-Band Management:** Familiarity with enterprise server hardware (Dell, Intel, AMD), BOM verification, and lights\-out management tools (iDRAC, IPMI, RACADM, Redfish) * **Collaboration:** Proficiency with Git, clear technical documentation, and effective communication across engineering and deployment teams **Preferred Qualifications** * **Containers \& Virtualization:** Experience with Docker and virtual machine or hypervisor environments * **Observability \& Service Management:** Familiarity with Telegraf, Prometheus, and Grafana, and with ServiceNow and Jira

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Builder
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI\-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550\+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80\+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management. **Senior AI Product Builder** ============================= **Location:** Richmond, VA or McLean, VA **Work Environment:** Hybrid **Who We Are** -------------- Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI\-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550\+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80\+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management. **Build the Next Generation of Super Intelligence Products** ------------------------------------------------------------ At Exiger, we're reimagining how AI\-powered products are conceived, built, and delivered. Our vision for Super Intelligence brings together advanced AI, intelligent agents, proprietary data, and human expertise to help organizations solve complex problems and make better decisions. We're looking for an experienced **Senior** **AI Product Builder** who thrives at the intersection of product, technology, and the customer. This is not a traditional Product Manager role focused solely on roadmaps and requirements, nor is it a purely engineering role focused only on implementation. We're looking for someone who can understand complex business challenges, work directly with customers and stakeholders, identify what should be built, and help turn those ideas into working AI\-powered products. You should be equally comfortable leading a conversation with business executives, collaborating with engineers on technical approaches, and rapidly prototyping solutions using AI tools, APIs, code, and automation platforms. The ideal candidate brings strong product instincts, hands\-on technical experience, and the ability to navigate ambiguity. You've worked directly with customers, understand how to uncover their underlying needs, and know how to translate those insights into products that deliver measurable value. You'll play an important role in shaping Exiger's next generation of Super Intelligence experiences while helping define a faster, more collaborative, AI\-enabled approach to product development. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Customer Discovery \& Stakeholder Engagement** * Work directly with customers, business leaders, and internal stakeholders to understand their challenges, workflows, and opportunities for improvement. * Lead discovery conversations, workshops, product demonstrations, and feedback sessions with both technical and nontechnical audiences. * Translate ambiguous business problems and customer requests into clear product opportunities, requirements, and actionable solutions. * Build strong relationships with stakeholders, manage expectations, and establish trust through clear communication and consistent follow\-through. * Challenge assumptions, ask thoughtful questions, and help customers distinguish between what they initially request and what will actually solve their problem. * Communicate product recommendations, technical tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes effectively to senior business leaders and cross\-functional teams. ### **Product Ownership \& Execution** * Take ownership of product initiatives from initial discovery and problem definition through prototyping, development, launch, and iteration. * Partner with engineers, designers, data specialists, and other product builders to translate customer needs into useful AI\-powered experiences. * Define product requirements, user journeys, workflows, success metrics, and acceptance criteria. * Prioritize opportunities based on customer impact, business value, feasibility, and available resources. * Make thoughtful tradeoffs around scope, speed, usability, technical complexity, and long\-term value. * Rapidly test ideas with customers, incorporate feedback, and refine solutions before investing heavily in development. * Use product analytics, customer feedback, and measurable outcomes to determine what to build, improve, or stop. * Drive alignment across teams and keep initiatives moving for ence, or Productboard. * Experience in government, defense, supply chain, procurement, risk management, compliance, or other complex enterprise environments. * A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, product management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **How We Work** --------------- Our product development lifecycle is AI\-enabled from beginning to end. We use AI to accelerate research, explore ideas, analyze information, generate and review code, create tests, document decisions, and improve the products we deliver. We believe the most effective AI products are built by people who understand both the technology and the customers using it. Our AI Product Builders are expected to work across disciplines, engage directly with stakeholders, test ideas early, and help teams move quickly from a customer problem to a useful working solution. AI accelerates the process, but human judgment, customer understanding, and accountability remain essential. We value curiosity, ownership, strong communication, thoughtful experimentation, and the ability to turn ambiguity into action. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- During your first year, you will: * Develop a strong understanding of Exiger's customers, platform, proprietary data, and AI capabilities. * Build trusted relationships with customers, business stakeholders, and internal product and engineering teams. * Independently lead customer discovery conversations and translate complex business challenges into actionable product opportunities. * Successfully guide AI\-powered product initiatives from problem identification through launch and iteration. * Collaborate with engineering teams to design and deliver practical, reliable, and scalable AI\-enabled experiences. * Demonstrate strong judgment in prioritizing product opportunities, evaluating technical approaches, and making informed tradeoffs. * Present product concepts, demonstrations, recommendations, and outcomes confidently to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Help deliver AI\-powered capabilities that achieve measurable customer adoption, efficiency improvements, or business value. * Contribute to Exiger's evolving Super Intelligence product vision and help establish better ways of building products with AI. **Show Us What You've Built** ----------------------------- We welcome examples of products, applications, AI\-powered workflows, prototypes, or initiatives you've helped bring to life. We're particularly interested in understanding the problems you've solved, how you engaged with customers or stakeholders, the decisions you made, the solutions you helped build, and the impact they delivered. Learn more at **Exiger.com** and follow Exiger on **LinkedIn**. At Exiger, our values define how we work and why we lead. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law. *Exiger's hybrid work policy is periodically reviewed and adjusted to align with evolving business needs.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Introduction to Team** Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting\-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success. This Senior Software Developer role is part of the BEX Product team which sits within our Technology division. The team delivers end\-to\-end Brand Expedia experiences across Home, Attach, and Trip Management, with a focus on creating differentiated lodging experiences and supporting travelers, particularly families and One Key members. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain high\-quality software solutions that empower travel growth and enhance user experiences. **What you will do** * + Design, build, and evolve full\-stack products and services, contributing to system design, API design, data modeling, user interfaces, and technical implementation. + Develop high\-quality production software using appropriate frontend and backend technologies, with an emphasis on maintainability, performance, accessibility, security, and automated testing. + Translate customer, product, and design requirements into intuitive traveler experiences and resilient service integrations across the Trips Experience domain. + Own features and services through the full lifecycle: technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. + Collaborate with product managers, designers, data partners, and engineers across Brand Expedia to clarify problems, evaluate trade\-offs, and deliver measurable outcomes. + Lead technical discussions and design reviews, establish practical engineering standards, and make thoughtful decisions in ambiguous or evolving problem spaces. + Improve system reliability and operational excellence through observability, performance tuning, automation, incident response, and post\-incident learning. + Use experimentation, product analytics, and operational metrics to validate hypotheses, prioritize work, and measure the impact of delivered experiences. + Contribute to a culture of engineering excellence through code reviews, documentation, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and inclusive collaboration. Use AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly to accelerate design exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and operational work while validating output for quality, security, privacy, and maintainability. + **Minimum Qualifications** * + Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience. + 8\+ years of professional software development experience building and operating production software in a team environment, including full\-stack or comparable end\-to\-end product engineering experience. + Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and hands\-on experience with both backend service development and modern web application development. + Demonstrated ownership of services or product features across system design, implementation, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and operational support. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, system design, API design, data modeling, distributed systems, and software quality practices. + **Preferred Qualifications** * + Experience designing and evolving multi\-service, full\-stack architectures with well\-structured APIs, reusable components, reliable data flows, and clear integration boundaries. + Demonstrated success improving customer\-facing or high\-traffic systems through performance tuning, resilience engineering, accessibility improvements, and reliability hardening. + Strong operational\-excellence practices, including instrumentation, logging, metrics, alerting, SLOs, on\-call participation, incident response, and post\-incident analysis. + Experience with experimentation, feature flags, A/B testing, product analytics, or other data\-informed methods for guiding technical and product decisions. + Experience applying AI/ML capabilities or AI\-assisted development workflows responsibly, including evaluation, privacy and security considerations, guardrails, and measurement of quality or productivity impact. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ . **Equal Opportunity** Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. jobs.title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description: At ExtraHop, we're on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you'd like to spend the next chapter of your career, we'd love to hear from you. **Position Summary** We are seeking a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to ensure the 24x7 availability and performance of our infrastructure through secure, scalable cloud solutions and automation. This is a hybrid architectural, implementation, and support role. You will design and manage production monitoring, streamline workflows, contribute to documentation, and write efficient, maintainable code. With 8\+ years of experience, strong Unix/Linux expertise, and knowledge of networking protocols, you'll collaborate across teams to solve complex problems, improve system reliability, and proactively address security risks. You will work within a team of mid\-level and senior IT engineers and developers spanning the network and systems infrastructure, identity management, security, and integration spaces, expanding our service portfolio following business needs and iterating and improving upon our existing infrastructure. This role offers the opportunity to tackle new challenges and grow within a dynamic, fast\-paced environment. **Key Responsibilities** * Ensure 24x7 responsiveness of services and infrastructure, including on\-call rotation for production services. * Design and manage production system monitoring, using ExtraHop wire data products and conventional tools. * Add to our internal and stakeholder\-facing knowledge bases, including design documents, playbooks, diagrams, and documentation. * Design and construct secure, future\-proof, hybrid/multi\-cloud services and networks. * Implement and improve human and automated workflows for operations and support. * Write elegant, extensible, sustainable code to solve current and future problems as simply as possible, but no simpler. * Learn and grow as an engineer and as a colleague. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience in Unix/Linux systems administration and software development. * Proficiency in using Shell/Bash and other automation tools within a Linux/Unix environment. * Familiarity with a distributed version\-control workflow in a team setting (e.g., Git). * Competency in web infrastructure operations, including development and deployment. * Experience or strong interest in cloud and serverless infrastructure. * Understanding of virtualization platforms such as Linux KVM. * In\-depth knowledge of enterprise networking and application protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP, SSH, DNS, LDAP, TLS. * Strong communication skills (verbal and written), with an ability to collaborate effectively across teams. * Self\-directed problem\-solving ability, with skills in building consensus among peers and partners. * Security\-focused mindset across all operational activities. * Ability to express and defend well\-formed opinions on technical topics, even in respectful disagreement (e.g., emacs vs. vi). * Willingness to take on new, undefined challenges and explore innovative solutions. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with cloud virtualization platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Our team doubles as an escalation point for desktop support, and we manage the Active Directory environment; Windows and/or MacOS competency is a plus. * Experience with Google Workspace administration is an asset. * Understanding of firewall and security management principles. * Understanding of secondary networking and application protocols: UDP, SMTP, NTP, SNMP, Finger. * Hands\-on experience with Linux configuration management systems (e.g., Ansible, Puppet, Chef). * Familiarity with network switching and routing equipment, including configuration and deployment. * Strong attention to detail, especially regarding grammatical nuances such as the Oxford comma and double sentence spacing. **Skills and Competencies** * **Technical Expertise:** Deep understanding of Linux/Unix systems, networking protocols, and automation tools. * **Collaboration:** Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills, working effectively across cross\-functional teams. * **Problem\-Solving:** Ability to diagnose complex systems and offer clear, actionable solutions. * **Security Mindset:** Proactively identifies and mitigates security risks in operational workflows. * **Communication**: Articulate communicator, capable of explaining technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. * **Adaptability:** Comfortable with ambiguity and excited to learn new technologies and approaches. * **Critical Thinking:** Open\-minded yet decisive, with an ability to analyze different perspectives and make informed decisions. **Compensation \& Benefits:** The salary range for this role is $135,000 – $149,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance\-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1\), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more. **ABOUT EXTRAHOP** ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet\-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud\-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments. This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in\-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise. **OUR VALUES** Our culture is rooted in our five **Values**. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team. **Lead with Purpose:** We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues. **Act with Integrity:** We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. **Find a Way:** We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done. **Innovate:** We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo. **Share Success:** We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team. **BENEFITS** **Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team.** Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits: * Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits * Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) \+ 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time * Non\-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan * FSA and Dependent Care Accounts \+ EAP, where applicable * Educational Reimbursement * 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable * Pet Insurance (US Only) * Parental Leave (US Only) * Hybrid and Remote Work Model Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today! **To learn more, visit** **our website** **or follow us on** **LinkedIn****.** **Create a Job Alert** Interested in building your career at ExtraHop? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email.

jobs.title: Lead Developer - Java
jobs.description: Working independently, the Lead Developer owns development of software products, improves overall product quality throughout the software development life cycle, and mentors other Software Engineers. This role combines strategic technical leadership, with hands\-on engineering, requiring someone who can establish team culture and architectural foundations for long\-term success.**Essential Job Functions:** * Review and analyze complex process, system and / or data requirements and specifications across a major program or project or several small projects or programs. * Serve as the technical subject matter expert for one or more areas (subsystems) for a larger system or multiple areas (subsystems) for smaller systems. * Serve as the primary designer for complex component designs for one or more areas (subsystems) for a larger system or multiple areas (subsystems) for smaller systems. * Build, test, deploy, and document complex software components for one or more areas (subsystems) for a larger system or multiple areas (subsystems) for smaller systems as well as, help others with theirs. * Create software engineering strategies that help identify and mitigate risks. * Lead other team members in peer review of code and identify re\-usable frameworks. * Interface with other team members and other teams in peer review of requirements, specifications and software. * Document and communicate development status in a timely manner including metric reporting. * Champion the collaborative resolution of defects. * Direct internal process improvement initiatives. Provide feedback on processes by offering suggestions. * Mentor and supervise junior staff in project\-level tasks. * Participate in external process improvement committees as a Development representative. * Provide backup coverage for Delivery Lead. * Assist with adherence to technology policies and comply with all security controls. * Ensure all work products meets /exceeds FINRA standards. * Demonstration of FINRA’s values. * Collaboration, both in\-person and virtually, in furtherance of FINRA’s mission of investor protection and market integrity. **Additional Details:** **Job Duties** * Design, build, and scale applications, and lead engineering teams * Design, develop, and maintain complex, enterprise\-grade applications on AWS through clean, modular, and performant code * Demonstrate solid expertise in Java and Python * Define and drive the technical architecture and technology stack for the project * Strong experience in modern data storage solutions (SQL and NoSQL), API design, and integration patterns * Apply strong understanding of software architecture patterns (microservices, event\-driven, etc.) * Proficiency with cloud\-native development on AWS * Proficiency with DevOps practices, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code * Establish engineering best practices and coding standards * Collaborate with product management, architecture, and key stakeholders to develop constructive and cooperative working relationships **Resource Management** * Recruit, interview, and onboard top engineering talent aligned with project needs * Collaboration, both in\-person and virtually, in furtherance of FINRA’s mission of investor protection and market integrity. **Education/Experience Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline with at least seven (7\) years of related experience, or equivalent training and/or work experience; jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About FacilityOS** ==================== FacilityOS is a fast\-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world. As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in\-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum. If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high\-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career. **About the Role:** We are looking for a highly capable Sr. Full Stack Engineer who can ramp up quickly, collaborate effectively with the existing team, and begin contributing meaningful delivery outcomes within the first few weeks. This role is well suited for someone who is comfortable navigating legacy systems, applying strong architectural principles, and making thoughtful technical decisions that improve delivery throughput without compromising quality. The ideal candidate brings strong backend engineering experience, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently while staying closely aligned with team standards and architectural direction. This role is a hybrid position where you’ll be required to come into our office three (3\) times a week. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, review, and maintain backend web applications and services across the FacilityOS platform. * Quickly develop a working understanding of existing platform architecture, legacy components, integration points, and modernization opportunities. * Collaborate with the engineering team to make sound technical decisions that align with established architectural principles and delivery goals. * Contribute to legacy modernization efforts using incremental, low\-risk approaches such as the Strangler Fig pattern where appropriate. * Maintain high code\-quality standards through code reviews, unit testing, static code analysis, and the adoption or improvement of engineering tools and standards. * Participate actively in peer code reviews, providing constructive feedback and helping promote maintainable, testable, and scalable solutions. * Troubleshoot and resolve application issues across environments, including staging and production, with a focus on root\-cause analysis and sustainable fixes. * Work directly with engineering leads, product stakeholders, and project managers to support business operations and project delivery. * Research, evaluate, and recommend innovative application, automation, and architectural improvements that would benefit the FacilityOS platform. **Skills and Qualifications:** * Minimum of 6 years of proven experience in backend .NET Framework / .NET Core web application development using C\#. * Minimum 5 years of experience developing web applications using Angular and Typescript * Proven ability to quickly understand complex legacy systems, identify key integration points, and contribute effectively with limited ramp\-up time. * Strong experience using object\-oriented programming, design patterns, and clean architecture principles to build maintainable, testable software. * Proven experience writing unit tests and applying quality\-focused development practices. * Proven experience designing and building RESTful services. * Experience in designing and building cloud\-native SaaS and PaaS applications (Azure / AWS). Azure cloud experience will be preferred * Solid knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL. * Ability to make sound technical decisions in collaboration with existing engineering teams. * Proactive, curious, and investigative mindset with strong attention to quality and detail. * Passion for technology, continuous improvement, and modern engineering practices. * Ability to self\-manage priorities and deliver outcomes with minimal supervision. * Strong team\-player attitude with the ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, and product stakeholders. * Hands\-on experience with Event\-Driven architecture is a plus * Hands\-on experience with Microservices is a plus **Why work at FacilityOS?** We work hard and play hard and we do both with passion and respect for one another. Our company promotes a fast\-paced, fun, friendly, and highly collaborative work environment that provides: Comprehensive health coverage A Hybrid work environment Opportunity for advancement and growth Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry! Birthday and Life Celebrations Two annual parties in a year **FacilityOS Commitment** We believe that a diverse team is the key to innovation and growth. We are an equal opportunity employer that value diversity at our company and encourage all candidates to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. FacilityOS will accommodate individuals with disabilities through each stage of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise us of any needs when your interview is booked, and we will do our best to meet your needs. Please note that all candidates must be legally eligible to work in the location in which you applied. **Background and Reference Checks** Any offer of employment may be conditional upon full background checks including a criminal record check, a credit check and employment and educational verifications. A reference check will also be conducted. *We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process such as reviewing applications. These tools assist the recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All advancement and hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us or click* *here**.* **FacilityOS thanks all candidates for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Accounts - Core
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.**About the Team** ------------------ Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty\-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin. The Accounts team sits within the Fanatics Betting and Gaming \- Shared Services domain and owns the customer account lifecycle, from registration, login, and identity verification to the geolocation, eligibility, and responsible gaming controls that decide whether a customer is allowed to play. Accuracy and customer trust are the team's core tenets, because customers trust us with their money, their identity, and their personal data. We are seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** to build and maintain the scalable, highly available, and compliant Java services behind the account lifecycle. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys owning features end to end, solving complex integration problems, and working closely with product, compliance, and operations partners. This is a US\-based remote position. ### **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain Java backend services using Spring Boot or similar frameworks. * Deliver features across registration, KYC, login and MFA, device registration, account management, tax reporting, Fanatics ID integration, and watchlist monitoring. * Build and maintain services that enforce regulatory and responsible gaming requirements, including geolocation, state and self\-exclusion, prohibited persons, loss limits, and eligibility. * Build integrations with third\-party identity, verification, geolocation, and compliance providers, designing for failure, retries, and data integrity. * Write scalable, well\-tested services with strong unit and integration test coverage. * Contribute to architecture and design discussions for APIs, event\-driven systems, and data flows. * Troubleshoot complex production issues and take part in the weekly on\-call rotation, contributing to runbooks and post\-mortems. * Partner with Product, Technical Program Management, Compliance, Support, and client engineering to turn business and regulatory requirements into technical solutions, and take part in sprint planning and agile delivery. * Mentor junior to mid\-level engineering teammates through code reviews, design feedback, and pairing. * Follow engineering best practices (CI/CD, testing, observability, feature flagging, documentation) and improve reliability and maintainability by addressing technical debt. ### **Experience and Skills** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience with Java. * Strong experience building and supporting production Java backend services with Spring Boot or similar frameworks. * Experience developing REST APIs and integrating distributed systems and data flows. * Experience with event\-driven architectures such as Kafka or similar messaging platforms. * Experience working in AWS or other cloud environments. * Experience with relational and NoSQL data stores such as Postgres and MongoDB. * Experience using AI tools or coding assistants to improve engineering productivity. * Experience with identity and account systems (registration, authentication, MFA, OAuth2/OIDC), KYC, fraud, or payments is preferred. * Experience with compliance\-driven systems such as geolocation, responsible gaming, or regulatory data handling is preferred. * Experience building highly available, regulated, or enterprise\-scale applications is preferred. * Experience with observability tooling (for example Datadog) and operating services on call is a plus. * Strong troubleshooting, ownership, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and with cross\-functional partners. Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in\-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi\-day cultural immersion in New York City for full\-time, non\-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ \#LI\-VG1 By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*

jobs.title: IT Manager - AI Platform Engineering & Data Science
jobs.description: **Job Posting:** Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best\-in\-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in. **IT Manager, AI Platform Engineering \& Data Science** The Manager, Platform Engineering \& Data Science is a key technology leader within Ferguson's AI Technology and Innovation organization, responsible for building and evolving the platforms, engineering standards, and cloud capabilities that enable scalable AI, machine learning, and software delivery across the enterprise. This role leads a team of platform engineers, architects, and technical specialists who provide the foundational capabilities that power AI innovation, modern application development, and data science initiatives. Working across a hybrid\-cloud environment, with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary hyperscaler and Azure supporting hybrid workloads and legacy integrations, this leader will drive platform strategy, cloud architecture, developer experience, DevSecOps maturity, and MLOps capabilities that accelerate the delivery of secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. Reporting to the Director, AI Technology and Innovation, the Manager, Platform Engineering \& Data Science will collaborate closely with experts in AI Engineering, Data Science, Product, Architecture, and IT to modernize technology platforms, improve engineering efficiency, and enable teams to move rapidly from experimentation to production while delivering measurable business value. **Location:** This role is approved to be remote within the United States; however, candidates must reside in the Eastern or Central time zones to support collaboration with team members based in Newport News, VA, and our Global Capability Center (GCC) team in India. Associates located near Newport News may work in a hybrid arrangement in accordance with company policy. Occasional travel to Ferguson headquarters in Newport News, VA, and other company locations, including Tampa, FL, is expected.**Duties and Responsibilities:** * Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of platform engineers, architects, and technical specialists. * Define and execute the platform engineering, cloud, and data science roadmap in support of Ferguson's AI and technology strategy. * Design, build, and optimize scalable, secure, and reliable platform capabilities across Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and hybrid\-cloud environments. * Partner with AI Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Architecture teams to enable the development, deployment, and operation of AI and machine learning solutions. * Drive DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and platform reliability standards to improve delivery speed, quality, and operational efficiency. * Own and enhance MLOps and data science platform capabilities, supporting model development, training, deployment, and monitoring at scale. * Establish engineering standards, architecture patterns, API strategies, and reusable platform services that accelerate software delivery. * Lead platform modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption, developer experience improvements, automation, and legacy technology retirement. * Manage project delivery, budgets, vendor relationships, and team capacity to ensure successful execution of critical initiatives. * Supervise platform performance, security, availability, and scalability while proactively identifying and mitigating risks. * Build strong partnerships with business and technology leaders to align platform investments with organizational priorities. * Stay ahead of emerging cloud, AI, data, and engineering technologies to drive innovation and continuous improvement. **Qualifications and Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science or related field preferred, or equivalent experience. * Must have at least 5 years of hands\-on experience in platform engineering. Experience in machine learning implementation and data analytics enablement is required. You should have broad knowledge of how platform capabilities support integration and innovation across different business domains. * Must have prior experience directly leading engineering or technical talent, including performance management and career development for direct reports; experience with offshore/onsite consultants preferred. * Must have direct experience in software programming with Java and/or Python, along with Software Architecture and Engineering expertise. * Must have experience in secure software delivery (DevSecOps) and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and pipeline development. * Must have hands\-on experience architecting and operating platform services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary hyperscaler, with working knowledge of Azure to support hybrid\-cloud workloads and legacy system integration. * Experience enabling data science and ML workflows using cloud\-native tooling (e.g., Vertex AI, BigQuery, or equivalent feature\-store, pipeline\-orchestration, and model\-serving constructs) strongly preferred. * Must have experience creating operational dashboards, telemetry configurations and alerting templates for end\-to\-end flow of data services using APM and Data Logging solutions such as AppDynamics, DataDog etc. * Solid understanding and experience implementing software design patterns and modern standards. * Must be a hands\-on software engineer able to work alongside a cross\-functional team of software engineers, software architects, data scientists, and software quality engineers as needed. * Demonstrates high aptitude, initiative, and self\-drive — proactively finds opportunities to improve the platform and data science tooling rather than waiting for direction, and leads technical work hands\-on rather than purely delegating. * Strong leadership and interpersonal relationship building skills. * Strong written communication skills with the ability to deliver compelling presentations. At Ferguson, we care for each other. We value our well\-being just as much as our hard work. We are committed to a holistic approach towards benefits plans and programs that support the mental, physical and financial well\-being of our associates. Our competitive offering not only includes benefits like health, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance and a 401(k) with a company match, but our associates also enjoy additional meaningful and inclusive enhancements that are adaptable to their diverse situations and needs, including mental health coverage, gender affirming and family building benefits, paid parental leave, associate discounts, community involvement opportunities and more! \#LI\-REMOTE * **Pay Range:** * *Actual pay rate may vary depending upon location. jobs.description: **Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.** Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $49 billion in annual system\-wide sales and over 33,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories. RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities. RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc. At Restaurant Brands International (RBI), we recognize that exceptional digital experiences significantly influence our guests’ decisions. At Firehouse Subs, our digital platforms directly power guest engagement, ordering, promotions, loyalty, and franchise operations across North America. We are seeking a hands\-on Engineer to lead technical design, architecture, and delivery of scalable, high\-performance digital solutions. This role will directly impact millions of guest interactions while supporting franchisee\-facing tools and operational systems. This is not a traditional people\-management\-only role. The ideal candidate is a senior technical leader who contributes production code daily (50–70% hands\-on), drives architectural direction, elevates engineering standards, and mentors engineers to improve overall team capability. You will collaborate closely with Product, Design, Data, and Brand leadership to build innovative digital solutions that enhance guest satisfaction, drive sales growth, and modernize the Firehouse Subs technology ecosystem. RBI follows a 5 day, in\-office work schedule to support collaboration. Candidates will be expected to work onsite 5 days per week out of our office in **Jacksonville, FL.** **What You'll Do:** * Design, develop, and deliver robust technical solutions for critical guest\-facing and franchisee\-facing digital features. * Lead architecture and system design decisions, creating clear and actionable Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). * Contribute meaningful production code across React, Node.js, and TypeScript\-based systems. * Improve performance and scalability of services handling high transaction volumes. * Raise the bar on engineering processes, CI/CD pipelines, automation, and developer experience. * Elevate overall code quality through rigorous design and code reviews, mentorship, and engineering best practices. * Lead development of new features from concept through deployment, ensuring reliability and maintainability. * Implement strong observability and incident triage methodologies using tools such as Datadog or similar platforms. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Drive modernization of legacy systems toward cloud\-native and distributed architectures. * Champion testing practices including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing. * Mentor engineers and foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and technical excellence. **What You'll Need To Succeed:** * 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including leading complex technical initiatives. * Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Node.js. * Experience with GraphQL (Apollo Federation preferred). * Cloud expertise, preferably AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred). * Experience designing and operating distributed, high\-traffic systems. * Strong understanding of relational and non\-relational database systems. * Experience with CI/CD tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and automation pipelines. * Familiarity with observability tools (Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch). * Strong understanding of testing methodologies (TDD/BDD). * Proven mentorship and leadership capabilities. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience in QSR, retail, or consumer\-facing digital businesses preferred. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent industry experience. \#Firehousesubs Benefits at all of our global offices are focused on physical, mental and financial wellness. We offer unique and progressive benefits, including a comprehensive global paid parental leave program that supports employees as they expand their families, free telemedicine and mental wellness support. Restaurant Brands International and all of its affiliated companies (collectively, RBI) are equal opportunity and affirmative action employers that do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, provincial or federal laws, rules, or regulations. RBI's policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment. Accommodation is available for applicants with disabilities upon request.

Independently lead high\-impact data engineering workstreams from problem definition through measurable production outcomes. Evaluate architectures across approved cloud platforms based on security, correctness, performance, recoverability, and cost.
