Evaluate compute placement, data movement, throughput, latency, delivery guarantees, recoverability, and operating cost. Apply FinOps discipline: monitor cloud compute and storage spend, identify wasteful patterns, and right\-size workloads. **Correctness and resilience:** Engineer idempotent, replayable pipelines with deduplication, schema\-evolution handling, and late\-arriving data support. Build reconciliation, control\-total, checkpoint, and bounded automated recovery tooling with human escalation, supporting Finance and Operations sign\-off. **Trusted analytics:** Develop curated datasets, documented models, and semantic layers for internal and partner\-facing reporting. Partner with business users and BI on definitions, validation, lineage, and controlled access. **Agentic coding:** Delegate bounded tasks to approved coding agents, supply repository context, manage handoffs, and independently validate generated code and data. Retain human ownership of quality, security, and release decisions. **Governed AI workflows:** Build retrieval and tool\-using agents over approved data and MCP servers. Implement permission\-aware access as defined by data owners briefed by Security, along with state management, evaluations, tracing, recovery, and approvals. Treat retrieved content as untrusted. **Defensive AI engineering:** Build and test defensive AI controls in partnership with Security, including segmented agent trust zones, isolated execution, policy\-enforced access, and auditable tool use. Work within Security\-provided sandbox environments and governance to evaluate emerging AI security and adversarial testing techniques through controlled, authorized exercises, producing evidence of meaningful testing to support go\-live decisions. Measure containment, detection, and effects on legitimate workflows. **Applied modeling:** Prototype small\-model or machine\-learning applications for classification, extraction, entity matching, and data\-quality triage. Compare reproducible evaluations against simpler approaches before recommending production use. **Production accountability:** Own reliability, operational readiness, runbooks, and remediation within assigned workstreams, following Change Management processes; collaborate on?CI/CD, identity, networking, secrets, observability, capacity, incidents, and costs. Produce audit evidence, support control testing, and maintain rollback plans and appropriate human approvals. **Team leverage:** Mentor through design and code reviews; convert proven approaches into reusable components and playbooks. Help develop validated engineering and security patterns. Requirements: **What We're Looking For:** * 5\+ years of production data engineering experience, or equivalent scope, delivering reliable cloud\-based solutions. * Demonstrated success independently leading ambiguous work through sustained production use while mentoring engineers and improving team practices. * Strong Python and advanced SQL, including automated testing, query\-plan analysis, performance tuning, and transformation validation. * Production experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, AWS, or a comparable platform, including orchestration and data modeling. Depth and transferable judgment matter more than familiarity with every listed product. * Experience integrating APIs, files, databases, or data shares, including incremental processing, backfills, schema changes, reconciliation, and recovery. * Demonstrable use of coding agents to delegate meaningful work, manage context and handoffs, verify changes, and deliver tested results. * Hands\-on experience building a retrieval, agent, or LLM\-enabled workflow over real data; understanding of evaluation, prompt\-injection risks, permission boundaries, and limitations. * Practical knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, least privilege, secrets management, observability, and troubleshooting. * Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into focused solutions and explain tradeoffs to non\-technical users. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Advanced Snowflake engineering, including secure sharing, Snowpark, performance optimization, and cost governance. * Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Dataverse, Power BI semantic models, or warehouse\-to\-lakehouse modernization. * Event streaming and enterprise message queues, including Azure Service Bus and Azure Event Hubs alongside Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, and comparable platforms ; partitioning, ordering, replay, idempotent consumers, backpressure, and failure recovery. * AWS data services, secure cross\-cloud integration, infrastructure automation, or private\-network architectures. * Production agent systems, MCP integrations, persistent state, evaluation, tracing, and recovery. * Agent security, sandboxing, adversarial evaluation, or deception engineering; familiarity with emerging AI security research is a plus, not a prerequisite. * Small\-model fine\-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, quantization, self\-hosted inference, or reproducible model evaluation. * Banking, fintech, payments, or another regulated environment. * Relevant certifications, or a master's or doctoral degree in a related field.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description: **TITLE:** Staff Product Manager **REPORTING TO:** CTO **LOCATION:** Brooklyn, NY OR Marina Del Rey, CA (Onsite Monday \- Friday) **Who Is Flip?** There are 3 runaway categories in B2B AI — coding, legal, and customer support. We're at the center of the third, with a one\-of\-one market position and hundreds of diehard fan clients, from Under Armour to Tory Burch to some of the largest healthcare institutions in the country. The market is dividing into two camps: generic tooling\-and\-FDE players building custom agents from scratch, and industry\-specific solutions winning on client love due to speed of ROI. We're firmly the latter. Retail and healthcare alone represent $5B\+ TAMs each, and we're still early. We built the company on a simple idea: the best way to grow is to have a reference list as long as your customer list. We're a team of 100\+ now, with offices in NYC, LA, and the UK. Both are true. **What You'll Do** ------------------ You'll work on problems like: * Automating complex customer calls (subscriptions, billing, healthcare workflows) * Designing AI agent behavior in ambiguous, multi\-turn conversations * Building systems that combine voice, AI, APIs, integrations, and real time decisioning * Moving client outcomes: automation rate, resolution rate, revenue collected, retention, and ROI **Day\-to\-Day** * Own one or more of Flip's most complex product areas end to end, from the client problem through measurable outcome * Work directly with enterprise clients, from executives to frontline agents; watch real workflows, find the underlying problem, and push back when the requested solution isn't the right one * Get your own answers: write SQL, call APIs directly, and use scripts, notebooks, and AI coding tools to prototype before asking engineering to productize * Run tight loops of problem prototype client feedback production, measured in days, not weeks * Partner with engineers as a technical peer on architecture, integrations, evals, failure modes, latency, and reliability; debug in production alongside them * Ship as part of our WEEKLY product releases (https://flipcx.com/product\-releases/) * Turn one\-off client solutions into scalable product used across hundreds of brands * Build and lead a team: hire, manage, and develop PMs and Product Owners, sharpen how we make decisions, and model the builder mentality **Who You Are** --------------- * 8\+ years of experience in product, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or as a technical founder, with recent work where you personally built and shipped * You've owned products where success depended on getting system behavior right: AI agents, voice, LLM products, automation, integrations, or enterprise workflow software * Equally credible with clients and engineers; no one needs to translate for you in either direction * Hands on and technical: comfortable with SQL, APIs, data, and prototyping tools, and you default to doing over coordinating * You think in outcomes (revenue, retention, efficiency), not roadmaps shipped * You have stories where you went from problem to working prototype in hours or days, and from there to production * You've managed and grown product teams while staying hands on, and you've operated without a big support structure: no dedicated analyst, researcher, or program manager * You still love getting into the product, the data, and the client workflow yourself, even with years of seniority * Eager and willing to support your teammates, just like they will with you! **Nice to Have** * Experience at an AI/agent, voice, or communications infrastructure company * Healthcare or commerce/CX workflow experience * Background as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Founding PM, or engineer who moved into product * Experience with evals, model quality, or telephony **More About Us** * We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada * We've raised \+$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A \- backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders \& executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive, and Simon Data * Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year * In office 5 days/week \#FlippinLegend Our customers span the globe, and so do our offices. jobs.title: Associate in Research, 12 Month – Applied Research & Commercialization Hub (National High Magnetic Field Laboratory)
jobs.description: **Department** -------------- Applied Research \& Commercialization Hub (ARCH) \- National High Magnetic Field Laboratory The National High Magnetic Field Laboratory is building ARCH, the Applied Research and Commercialization Hub, and is hiring a physicist who will run its laboratory. ARCH exists to move magnet\-based measurement technology from something that works once, in the hands of the person who invented it, to something that runs to a date for someone who needs the answer. The laboratory sits alongside the world’s highest\-field DC magnets, a millikelvin suite reaching 20 mK, a maker's space with CNC, manual machining and 3D printing, and the machine shop. Its first book of work is commercial measurement: thermal expansion, low\-temperature thermal conductivity and magnetization on materials that go into quantum\-computing hardware, delivered to a specification and a deadline. Behind that sits a seed\-funded project portfolio and a pipeline of new capability. **Responsibilities** -------------------- The Associate in Research runs that laboratory under the Director’s technical direction and works the seam between the MagLab’s research programs and ARCH. Techniques are invented across this laboratory every year. A few of them are worth maturing into something repeatable, and the judgment about which few, and about what maturing them costs, is the core of this job. The successful candidate will spend part of their week designing and running measurements at the bench, part of it deciding what the laboratory takes on next, and part of it in front of engineers from companies who want to know whether the MagLab can answer their question. * **Run the ARCH laboratory.** Own the day\-to\-day operation: schedule, throughput, equipment readiness, consumables, records, safety. Set up the laboratory from the ground with the Director as it comes online. * **Design, run and interpret measurements.** Take a problem from specification to data to a defensible interpretation, at low temperature and high field, on samples the laboratory has not seen before. * **Mature techniques into capabilities.** Work with scientists and technical staff across the MagLab’s facilities to find measurement methods worth hardening, then take them from a working demonstration to a documented, repeatable procedure with known uncertainty. * **Scope what the laboratory can sell.** Assess a candidate job for feasibility, magnet time, staff effort, uncertainty and cost, and say plainly what ARCH can and cannot deliver. * **Carry the technical side of customer engagements.** Translate a company’s problem into a measurement plan, agree what a result will and will not settle, and report back in terms an engineer outside the field can use. * **Deliver seed\-funded projects.** Run assigned projects against milestones, report monthly on progress and risk, and prepare the evidence for the twelve\-month Go/No\-Go review. * **Put AI to work in the laboratory.** Automate measurement sequences, analysis and reporting. Apply machine learning and current AI tooling to shorten the path from raw data to an answer, and to open up experiments that were impractical when each run needed watching. * **Mentor, train and supervise.** Run the ARCH intern line, and train new staff and collaborators on the laboratory’s equipment and procedures. Co\-supervise graduate students hosted from other institutions, whose academic supervision stays with their home group, with scope to take on direct supervision as the laboratory’s grant\-funded student base develops. ARCH expects AI to change how this laboratory works and wants somebody keen to push that. Measurement sequences that run unattended overnight. Less time between raw data and an answer. Experiments that were impractical when every run needed a person watching it. The laboratory is being built now, so whoever arrives gets to decide how much of it is automated from the start. There is room in the role to build a student presence over time. ARCH holds no graduate students in its first year. For a candidate who wants them, the route runs through co\-supervision of students whose degree and thesis sit with their home institution, widening as the laboratory’s stock of running capabilities and its grant base grow, alongside its links into the FAMU\-FSU College of Engineering. The project portfolio throws off problems a thesis can be built on. **Qualifications** ------------------ Ph.D.in physics or a closely related field, and post\-doctoral research experience or an equivalent period in industrial R\&D. * Demonstrated expertise designing, building and running low\-temperature measurements in high magnetic fields, and interpreting the resulting data. * Evidence of taking an experimental method beyond its first working version to something another person can run reliably. * Hands\-on competence with cryogenic systems, vacuum hardware, low\-noise wiring and general laboratory instrumentation. * Ability to plan work agains nd willingness to support and enhance the MagLab’s high\-level safety environment. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience working with an industrial partner, a sponsored research agreement, a quote, or an NDA. * Experience mentoring early\-career researchers or junior technical staff, and an interest in supervising or co\-supervising graduate students as the laboratory’s student base develops. * Depth in one or more of: thermal transport, thermal expansion and dilatometry, magnetometry, electrical transport, calorimetry. * Experience with dilution refrigerators and with commercial measurement platforms such as the PPMS. * Instrument control and data acquisition programming (Python, LabVIEW) and data analysis at scale. * Practical use of machine learning or current AI tooling on experimental data, instrument automation, or analysis pipelines. * Proficiency with CAD, 3D printing, basic machining and electronics prototyping. * Track record of winning external research funding. * Experience authoring standard operating procedures and conducting safety training. **Helpful** ----------- **What You Gain at FSU** * Opportunity to work at a world\-renowned national research laboratory. * Meaningful contributions to scientific discovery and student learning * A collaborative environment that values your expertise and invests in your growth. **Contact Info** ---------------- Dr. Alimamy Bangura **University Information** -------------------------- One of the nation's elite research universities, Florida State University preserves, expands, and disseminates knowledge in the sciences, technology, arts, humanities, and professions, while embracing a philosophy of learning strongly rooted in the traditions of the liberal arts and critical thinking. Founded in 1851, Florida State University is the oldest continuous site of higher education in Florida. FSU is a community steeped in tradition that fosters research and encourages creativity. At FSU, there’s the excitement of being part of a vibrant academic and professional community, surrounded by people whose ideas are shaping tomorrow’s news! Learn more about Florida State University and our campuses. **FSU Total Rewards** --------------------- FSU offers a robust Total Rewards package. Visit our FSU Total Rewards website to learn more about our Compensation, Benefits, Wellness, Recognition, and Employee Development programs. Use our FSU Total Compensation Calculator to calculate Total Compensation options based on potential salary, benefits and retirement contributions, earned leave, and other employment\-related perks. **How To Apply** ---------------- If qualified and interested in a specific Faculty job opening as advertised, apply through the FSU Faculty Careers site (jobs.fsu.edu). If you are a current FSU employee, apply through myFSU Self Service. Applicants are required to complete the online application with all applicable information. Applications must include education details even if attaching a Vita. This position requires that you have three confidential professional letters of recommendation submitted on your behalf. Follow the steps below to request these letters through our system: 1\) After submitting your application, click the Careers link; 2\) Click the My References link; 3\) Click the Send/View Reference Request button next to the appropriate position; and 4\) Follow the steps on that page to send your references a system generated email requesting they submit a letter of recommendation on your behalf. You may also return to the My References link and click on "Send/View Reference Request" to see if your references have responded, add additional references, or resend requests. **Considerations** ------------------ This is a Faculty position. This position requires successful completion of a criminal history background check. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- FSU is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

robotic systems and automated manufacturing cells * Troubleshoot and resolve mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, PLC, and robotic control system issues, independently or with support depending on adaptability, and the ability to work independently while knowing when to collaborate or escalate * Willingness to relocate anywhere within the United States * Comfort with regional travel up to 80% and overnight travel up to 50% * Genuine enthusiasm for learning, exploring new places, and building a long\-term career in robotics and automation **Bonus points if you have:** * Hands\-on experience with industrial robots from FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, ABB, or Universal Robots * PLC programming or advanced troubleshooting experience, particularly with Allen\-Bradley or Siemens * Experience with industrial networks, HMIs, VFDs, robotic safety systems, or industrial communication protocols * Familiarity with palletizing, case packing, pick\-and\-place, machine tending, or conveyor systems * jobs.title: AI Design Engineer
jobs.description: **AI DESIGN ENGINEER** **Custom Millwork, Casework \& Fixtures** **Location: Tacoma, WA · Full\-Time · On\-Site** **Travel: Some travel to El Paso, TX and Phoenix, AZ** **Reports to: Director of AI \& Automation and Director of Operations** **Industry: Commercial Construction \& Manufacturing** **Compensation: $105,000 – $165,000 plus bonus** It's 11:40 on a Tuesday night, and you're doing it again. The house is quiet. You've got an AI model open on one monitor and a reception desk elevation on the other. You're trying to get the model to read an architect's PDF, find the casework, and give you a cabinet schedule your engineering software can actually use. It half\-works. You're grinning anyway. At 7:00 tomorrow morning you'll walk into a drafting room where that same architect's PDF gets redrawn by hand, line by line. The submittal goes out, comes back covered in redlines, goes out again, comes back again. Someone re\-keys dimensions that already exist in three other files. The most experienced engineer in the building carries the shop's construction standards in their head, and nobody has written them down because nobody has the time. You mentioned AI in a meeting once. Someone called it "your computer thing," and the room moved on. You're not crazy. You're early. We've been looking for you. **This Industry Still Draws Like It's 1998\.** Here it is plainly. Custom millwork, cabinetry, and commercial construction have worked the same way for a long time. Drafting is still manual. Design intent arrives as a PDF and a skilled person redraws it. A single wall\-paneling submittal has to show every joint condition, the panel core, veneer species and cut, leaf and panel matching, room\-match sequencing, grain direction, blocking heights, and the hardware schedule. Every line is drawn by a human, and when the architect changes one dimension, a human redraws all of it. Engineering is still translation. Product libraries help. But every custom reception desk, feature wall, art display, and curved transaction top still starts with a person converting someone else's drawing into parts, joinery, and machining. Manufacturing is still manual everywhere except the robots. The CNC router is the future. The tape measure, the paper traveler, and the re\-keyed cut list are not. That isn't where this industry is going. Frontier doesn't intend to wait for a software vendor to deliver the future in a version 14\.0 update. **We Don't Want Someone to Use Better Software. We Want Someone to Change the Industry.** This is not a CAD manager job. We're not looking for someone to maintain our libraries, run our upgrade cycle, or train people on new buttons. We want the person who is going to work out what engineering, drafting, and design look like when AI is part of the crew, prove it on real projects that get built on our floor and installed in real buildings, and then watch the rest of the industry try to catch up. That's the job: you, Frontier, and the tip of the spear. **Ownership Is Making a Bet. The Bet Is You.** Most manufacturers our size put their big money into equipment: a new CNC router, a panel saw, an edgebander line, a robot cell. We buy machines too. We're manufacturers, and we love machines. But Frontier's ownership believes the bigger opportunity is this one. Changing how we engineer, draft, and design is a bigger lever than the next large piece of capital equipment. That isn't a line in a slide deck. It's how ownership thinks about where money goes. Frontier is an aggressively AI\-forward company with AI\-forward ownership. Our leadership doesn't just "support" AI. They use it, they understand it, and they fund it the way manufacturers fund equipment. We've already hired a Director of AI \& Automation to drive AI across the business. This role takes that same commitment to the core of what we make: the drawings, the engineering, and the design behind every piece of millwork that leaves our shop. You will work for that Director, alongside the leadership of our cabinet engineering and drafting team. **Efficiency That Grows the Shop** The point of making drafting and engineering faster is not to shrink the team. It is to take the capacity we free up and put it into more work, more complex projects, and more people growing into this craft in a technological world. Every hour we pull out of redraw, re\-keying, and tribal\-knowledge bottlenecks is an hour we can put into taking on more volume, training the next generation of engineers and drafters, and opening roles that did not exist when every line had to be drawn by hand. Frontier intends to grow and expand the operation. AI is how we create the room to do that without burning out the people who already carry the standards in their heads. This role amplifies craftspeople. It does not replace them. The efficiency pickups fund growth, new opportunities, and a bigger shop that can compete on both craft and technology. **Signs This Is You** * You have a folder somewhere n the software vendors. Nobody has written it. That's the job. If you need clean, structured data and a defined process before you can do anything, this isn't the role. If you look at a stack of redlined PDFs and see the next ten years of your career, we should talk. What you will have is something almost nobody in this industry gets: ownership that understands what you're trying to do, funds it like equipment, and will clear obstacles out of your way. And a clear mandate: the wins you create are meant to help us grow, not just do the same work with fewer people. **About Frontier Door \& Cabinet** We are builders. True American manufacturers. Frontier Door \& Cabinet has been in business for nearly 30 years. We started as a garage operation and grew into one of the largest specialty contractors in the Pacific Northwest, focused on Division 08 (doors, frames, and hardware) and Division 12 (cabinets and countertops) for commercial construction, with operations in Tacoma, El Paso, and Phoenix. Our facilities run CNC routers, panel saws, and edgebanders, and our estimating team quotes nearly every available project in our markets. Cabinets get installed. Projects have deadlines, budgets, and general contractors who don't care about your technology roadmap. They care that the casework matched the submittal and showed up on time. That pressure is exactly why AI matters so much here. The gap between where this industry is and where it could be is enormous, and we intend to be the company that closes it first, and to use that advantage to expand what we can take on. **What We Offer** * Competitive salary ($105,000 – $165,000 depending on experience) plus bonus * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) * A real budget for AI tools, hardware, training, and industry events (IWF, AWFS, AWI), funded the way we fund production equipment * Direct access to ownership and the leadership team, without layers in between * The chance to build something the whole industry ends up copying, and to help grow a real manufacturing operation while you do it **How to Apply** Send your resume and answers to two questions. No cover letter. 1\. Show us the most interesting thing you've built with AI on your own time. A repo, a screen recording, a screenshot, or a photo of the whiteboard all work. We want proof that you build things. 2\. Name the first drafting or engineering task you'd eliminate, and tell us how you'd do it. If you've spent years thinking "this could all be so much better" while the rest of the shop kept doing it the old way, this is your chance to stop thinking it and start building it. **The Fine Print: The Software** Software isn't the point of this job. But you should know we speak the language, and that you'll be walking into a familiar world. The people we want have lived inside some combination of these: * Microvellum on AutoCAD / BricsCAD: parametric casework engineering, shop drawings, CNC output * Cabinet Vision: design\-to\-manufacture for cabinets and casework * AlphaCAM: CNC router and stone programming, nesting * SolidWorks (and SWOOD): complex fixtures and mixed wood, metal, and glass assemblies * AutoCAD, Revit, Rhino \+ Grasshopper, Inventor * Bluebeam Revu: submittals, redlines, and revision tracking **Also familiar:** TopSolid'Wood, imos iX, 2020 / Design Flex, Moraware CounterGo, SlabSmith, digital templating (Prodim, LPI) **On the AI side:** whatever is best this month. Python, LLM APIs, agents, AutoLISP, .NET, the SolidWorks API. You don't need all of them. You need to know why each one still takes so many clicks and have a theory about how few it should take. *Frontier Door \& Cabinet, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*

Stay hands\-on: review architectures and step into critical customer moments when needed. * **What We're Looking For** ========================== **Leadership and Organizational Experience** -------------------------------------------- * 5\+ years leading customer\-facing technical teams efits. **Working at Genesys** * **AI at enterprise scale** – Build, support and operate AI\-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150\+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year. * **A flexible\-first culture** – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work. * **Growth in the AI era** – Build future\-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support. * **Time to recharge and give back** – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well\-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families. * **Recognized globally** – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys. jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer I
jobs.description: Our mission is to make biology easier to engineer. Ginkgo is constructing, editing, and redesigning the living world in order to answer the globe’s growing challenges in health, energy, food, materials, and more. Our bioengineers make use of an in\-house automated foundry for designing and building new organisms. **Ginkgo Introduction** Ginkgo is a high\-growth, well\-capitalized public biotech company headquartered in Boston that is redesigning the living world to solve some of the globe's growing challenges in health, energy, food, materials, and more. Ginkgo is constructing, editing, and redesigning the living world in order to answer the globe's growing challenges in health, energy, food, materials, and more. Our mission to "make biology easier to engineer" is poised to disrupt multiple industries by leveraging our innovative data, automation, and scale in biological engineering. **Team Introduction** We're looking for motivated, curious, and detail\-oriented engineers who are excited by the challenges of scaling and improving our Autonomous Lab Technology. The Automation Team is developing an industry\-leading autonomous lab, integrating robotics, lab equipment, and industrial manufacturing processes into a novel modular platform for accelerating the pace of scientific discovery. Ginkgo is hiring a Mechatronics Engineer I to join our in\-house automation and integration team. This team is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying automation solutions to both internal labs and external automation customers, as well as providing expertise and support for deployed systems. **Job Description** As a Mechatronics Engineer I, you will learn about all aspects of our RAC system’s technology while contributing design work towards new RAC accessories, new instrument integrations, and even new product areas that will support the advancement of our Autonomous Lab. You will work hands\-on in our Boston headquarters supporting Nebula (the world’s largest autonomous lab) and developing new tech for our internal initiatives and for our external customers. You’ll collaborate hand\-in\-hand with biologists, software developers, and other engineers to advance the hardware and aid in the development of software infrastructure that enables walkaway automation for various laboratory applications. Ideal candidates will demonstrate keen attention to detail, excitement for learning, and a passion for producing high\-quality work. Our systems are complex and multidisciplinary; being able to work across domains (e.g., mechanical, electrical, software) will ensure success in this role. You will be responsible for developing custom hardware solutions, participating in robot trajectory design and programming, managing the fabrication, inventory, and assembly of parts, gathering test data and performing deep evaluations, and producing design documentation for integrating your work into our product line. Experience with Solidworks is a plus. Coding or robotics experience is also a plus. Like all Mechatronics engineers on the team, you will have tasks sourced from a number of different projects on your to\-do list. You should expect variety in your day\-to\-day work, along with an agile environment where priorities shift quickly in response to new projects and updated customer needs. You will be expected to fully own your projects, from concept, to delivery, to second tier support. **Responsibilities** * Lead the design, development, and deployment of projects that support Ginkgo’s autonomous lab product * Own end\-to\-end SolidWorks CAD design for custom mechatronic assemblies, including detailed drawings and PDM Vault management * Manage mechanical BOM accuracy and revision control within Aligni PLM * Participate in team design reviews, both providing and receiving feedback, and provide detailed asynchronous review and feedback on both 3D designs from peer engineers and 2D drawings from our Drafting team * Design, program, and optimize robot trajectories for industrial six\-axis robot arms, ensuring safe, repeatable, and efficient motion in workcell environments * Collaborate with biologists on automation equipment design and operation to translate scientific requirements into robust engineering solutions * Work with vendors to source components, and to build understanding of vendor needs and capabilities * Support change management and upgrade/retrofit deployment across our existing fleet of deployed enclosures and hardware configurations, helping balance standardization goals with the practical realities of a diverse installed base * Support the performance evaluation, optimization, and maintenance of Nebula, the world’s largest autonomous lab * Support RAC deployment efforts as we deliver new systems to external customers and expand our in\-house RAC installations **Minimum Requirements** * BS or MS in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Systems, Robotics Engineering or equivalent * Experience designing a complex custom mechatron stem, including mechanical and electronic component specification and selection, custom part design, and assembly * Experience using a 3D CAD tool such as Solidworks, Autodesk Inventor, or OnShape for from\-scratch modeling of parts and assemblies * Experience reading and producing 2D manufacturing drawings * Experience with basic electronics debugging and system troubleshooting techniques * Experience with data collection and analysis techniques * Windows proficiency, and fluency in productivity software tools including spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation tools We do not expect that any one candidate will have all of the following experiences \- each is independently a preferred or "nice\-to\-have" capability. * Familiarity with lab automation equipment fundamentals (liquid handlers from Agilent, Hamilton, and Beckman/Labcyte; plate sealers, bulk dispensers, etc.) * Experience with conveyor or transport systems (e.g., MagneMotion or similar) * Demonstrable fabrication experience or hands\-on 'workshop' skills * Experience with robot teaching, programming, or simulation * Experience with scripting or coding in a language like Python or JavaScript, command line navigation, and familiarity with version control and code repositories such as Git **Closing** We also feel that it's important to point out the obvious here \- there's a serious lack of diversity in our industry, and that needs to change. Our goal is to help drive that change. Ginkgo is deeply committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all of its practices, especially when it comes to growing our team. Our culture promotes inclusion and embraces how rewarding it is to work with people from all walks of life. We're developing a powerful biological engineering platform, so we must remain mindful of the many ways our technology can \- and will \- impact people around the world. We care about how our platform is used, and having a diverse team to build it gives us the best chance that it's something we'll be proud of as it continues to grow. Therefore, it's critical that we incorporate the diverse voices and visions of all those who play a role in the future of biology. It is the policy of Ginkgo Bioworks to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and employment applicants. **Special Requirements / Materials to be Provided by Candidates** * Portfolio or examples of SolidWorks designs and/or robot trajectory programming work are strongly encouraged * In all applications, application source and EEO (equal employment opportunity) data fields along with links (LinkedIn, GitHub) are included in the post for the candidate to populate. **Ginkgo has implemented a return to office policy effective October 1, 2025 with required in office days 5x per week.** ***Some teams may require to be onsite 4\-5 days per week and this will be discussed as part of the interview process.*** **This policy applies to all employees who live within 50 miles of Ginkgo’s offices in Boston, MA, Emeryville, CA and West Sacramento, CA.** It is the policy of Ginkgo Bioworks to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees, employment applicants, and EOE disability/vet. **Privacy Notice** I understand that I am applying for employment with Ginkgo Bioworks and am being asked to provide information in connection with my application. I further understand that Ginkgo gathers this information through a third\-party service provider and that Ginkgo may also use other service providers to assist in the application process. Ginkgo may share my information with such third\-party service providers in connection with my application and for the start of employment. Ginkgo will treat my information in accordance with Ginkgo's Privacy Policy. By submitting this job application, I am acknowledging that I have reviewed and agree to Ginkgo's Privacy Policy as well as the privacy policies of the third\-party service providers used by Ginkgo's associated with the application process.

jobs.description: **Junior Full Stack Developer** **— Internal Tools \& Network Platforms** ***GLS \| Engineering / Operations \| Remote (US) \| High\-ownership role*** **Role Overview** GLS is hiring a Full Stack Developer to build and maintain the internal tools and operational platforms that run our network business: monitoring dashboards, automation utilities, workflow tooling, and systems that integrate with live infrastructure across a multi\-datacenter environment. We do not want vibe coding (blindly accepting AI\-generated diffs). We expect engineers to own outcomes through design, review, testing, security hygiene, and maintainability. **What You'll Build** Internal operational tooling that engineers and NOC/SOC teams rely on daily. A custom monitoring/metrics platform spanning time\-series data, dashboards, and alerting workflows. Integrations with live network/infrastructure APIs (devices, services, systems). Automation that reduces toil and speeds execution with auditability and guardrails. **Key Responsibilities** Backend Engineering (Go \+ Python) * Design and implement backend services and REST APIs in Go and Python. * Build durable internal services used for operational workflows and monitoring workloads. * Create clean abstractions around infrastructure and device APIs. **Frontend Engineering (Angular)** * Build modern internal UIs in Angular for dashboards, tooling, and operational visibility. * Deliver practical UX: fast, readable, and optimized for operators under pressure. **Data \& Database Engineering (PostgreSQL \+ ClickHouse)** * Design schemas and write performant queries for PostgreSQL. * Work with ClickHouse (or similar columnar/time\-series systems) for large\-scale metrics. * Optimize query patterns and data lifecycle for operational analytics and dashboards. **Infrastructure Integration** * Build software that interfaces with network/infrastructure APIs and operational platforms. * Work closely with systems/network engineers to translate real\-world requirements into reliable software. **Automation \& GitOps Workflows** * Build automation utilities using Python and Bash. * Support Git\-based workflows, CI/CD, and GitOps conventions where appropriate. **Required Skills \& Qualifications** **Languages** Strong proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript. **Frontend** Hands\-on Angular experience building internal dashboards/tools. **Databases** Strong PostgreSQL experience; exposure to ClickHouse (or similar) preferred; familiarity with caching (e.g., Redis). **Linux \& Delivery** Comfortable in Linux environments; experience with Docker; basic Kubernetes/container familiarity; Git\-based workflows. **API Engineering** Proven experience building/consuming REST APIs and integrating with external/internal systems. **Tooling** Git, Docker, Ansible (or similar configuration management). **Communication** Can work independently on loosely\-defined problems and communicate clearly with infrastructure\-focused teams. **Nice to Have (Strong Signals)** The following skills and experience are not required but demonstrate valuable depth and would accelerate your impact in this role: * Candidates that can use AI in their day\-to\-day life. * GitOps tooling: ArgoCD, Fleet, Helm, operators * Networking fundamentals: IP, VLANs, routing, firewall concepts * Observability experience: metrics pipelines, time\-series systems, log pipelines (e.g., Elasticsearch) **What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)** * Ship meaningful improvements to internal tooling and/or monitoring workflows. * Deliver at least one end\-to\-end feature: UI \+ API \+ database \+ operational integration. * Contribute reusable automation patterns that reduce toil for the team (agent or script\-based). **Why GLS** You'll build software that directly supports real operational outcomes. Real users, real systems, real impact. High ownership, low bureaucracy, strong technical collaboration with infrastructure experts. Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Vision insurance * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Customer Engineer III, Cloud AI, Google Cloud
jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Atlanta, GA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Cambridge, MA, USA; Houston, TX, USA; New York, NY, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Miami, FL, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role. * Experience with AI agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), agentic design patterns (e.g., tool\-use, multi\-agent collaboration), and integrating models into autonomous workflows via advanced API prompting and RAG. * Experience with machine learning model development and deployment. * Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders. * Experience using programming languages to design demos, prototypes, or workshops for customers. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience in architecting and developing software or infrastructure for scalable, distributed systems. * Experience in building machine learning solutions and leveraging specific machine learning architectures (e.g., LLMs, Diffusion, and Multimodal Models). * Experience developing and deploying Generative AI applications, with a focus on implementing RAG pipelines, integrating vector databases, and orchestrating LLM interactions via APIs. * Experience in the hospitality, travel, power, manufacturing or energy industry. * Ability to learn quickly, understand, and work with new emerging technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the cloud/IT technology space. **About the job** ----------------- When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products. As a Customer Engineer (CE) with a specialty in Cloud Artificial Intelligence (AI), you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of complex, specialized workloads. You will leverage your deep expertise in our product areas, in partnership with Platform Customer Engineers (CEs), to be writing code to develop prototypes, proofs\-of\-concept (POCs), and demos to promote new specialized solutions to customers. You will solve AI customer issues and provide a critical feedback loop to influence product development. You will have excellent organizational, communication, and presentation skills, engaging with customers to understand their business and technical requirements, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge, and technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $152000 \- $221000 (USD) \+ 42\.86% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Drive the technical win for workloads within Cloud AI to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp. * Combine business strategies, development, and prototyping to provide functional, customer\-tailored solutions that secure buy\-in from customer domain experts. * Provide deep technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building lasting customer relationships. * Leverage learnings from customer engagements to contribute to reusable solutions and assets with the Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team. * Work within product and engineering management systems to document, prioritize, and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C\+\+, Java, JavaScript). * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role. * 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role. * Experience with GenAI techniques (e.g., LLMs, Multi\-Modal, Large Vision Models) or with GenAI\-related concepts (language modeling, computer vision). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects. * 5 years of experience leading ML design and optimizing end\-to\-end Machine Learning (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning). **About the job** ----------------- Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes way beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started \- and as a manager, you guide the way. With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large\-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. Google Drive is committed to creating a secure, intelligent, and universally accessible means of storing, sharing, organizing, and finding information. The immediate top focus is leveraging Generative AI to fundamentally revolutionize how users interact with their content, unlocking unprecedented value from their personal and enterprise knowledge. in this role, you will leverage state\-of\-the\-art AI to transform the vast knowledge stored in drive into features that supercharge user productivity. While your primary mandate is delivering user\-facing features, you will also architect and maintain the critical backend infrastructure responsible for processing and serving derived data to power these AI experiences at scale. AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre\-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5\-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead a team of software engineers to deliver excellent, scalable, efficient, and sustainable products. * Provide technical leadership and hold high technical excellence. Contribute thought leadership and system design opinions. * Collaborate with other Engineering teams, Product Managers, and cross\-functional leaders, and manage important deadlines. * Exhibit strong product instincts, understand how the team's technical work meets the business needs for the customers. Negotiate with cross\-functional partners to arrive at the best balance between engineering effort, system complexity, and customer value. * Recruit top talent, develop and support your team. Provide an environment where everyone can do their very best work. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: Superconducting Circuit Designer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Great Sky is a technology startup based with a mission to rebuild AI from first principles. We are pursuing neuroscience\-inspired hardware and algorithms that overcome the greatest challenges in scaling AI systems. We’re seeking a highly motivated superconducting circuit designer to contribute to Great Sky’s AI hardware platform. We are open to mid\-level through senior candidates; title and scope will depend on experience. **The Challenge:** Today’s AI systems are limited by data movement, latency, and energy efficiency. Great Sky is developing superconducting neural\-network hardware that combines ultra\-fast analog computation, local memory, and optical fan\-out. Scaling this platform requires disciplined circuit design, verification, and tapeout execution across increasingly complex superconducting circuits. **Your Role:** You will help us realize highly efficient superconducting circuits on the path to massively scaled neural networks that enable inference with orders of magnitude speedups over the state of the art. **How You’ll Make An Impact:** ------------------------------ * Design of superconducting electronic circuits, including those based on Josephson junctions, SQUIDs, arrays of superconducting\-nanowire single\-photon detectors, and thin\-film amplifiers such as nTrons * Adaptation of existing circuits to advanced manufacturing processes. * Support for post\-layout simulation and verification of passive and active superconducting circuits * Collaboration with the fabrication team and external foundries to ensure successful manufacturing of chips * Collaboration with the algorithms and measurement teams to maintain consistency between simulation, design and performance **What success looks like in the first year** --------------------------------------------- * Significantly extend and augment our library of superconducting device primitives. * Optimize existing circuits to substantially improve speed, energy efficiency, and scalability. * Efficiently leverage our Python\-based design and layout flow. * Designs operation verified through simulations and measurements. **What You Bring:** ------------------- **Required:** * MS or equivalent experience in physics, electrical engineering, or a related field * 3\+ years of experience in circuit design and/or in superconducting circuits * Familiarity with state\-of\-the\-art literature in superconducting electronics * Experience with numerical analysis and simulation of superconducting circuits, preferably some prior experience with WR\-SPICE or JoSim * Experience with electromagnetic simulation workflows **Preferred:** * Strong scripting ability in Python or a similar language, applied to parametric or automated layout generation * Strong mathematical foundations in linear algebra, differential equations, probability, dynamical systems, optimization, and statistics * Experience building or maintaining parametric cells, layout generators, or scripted layout flows. * Experience contributing to large tapeouts with complex foundry processes * Experience with CMOS analog or mixed\-signal design **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Meaningful equity ownership in an early\-stage deep tech company * Employer\-matched 401(k) * Health, dental, vision, and life insurance * Flexible PTO * Support for ongoing learning, conference attendance, and skill development Our culture is onsite by default (we're founded by scientists who are used to working in the lab), with flexibility for hybrid arrangements. For the right person and role, we're open to filling roles remotely Compensation Range: $160K \- $200K

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, WarehouseOS
jobs.description: **About WarehouseOS** --------------------- WarehouseOS is the warehouse management system fulfillment teams run their day on. It’s the software floor staff hold in their hands for an entire shift, and what warehouse managers rely on to plan, monitor, and improve operations. Our customers range from fast\-growing brands to established third\-party logistics providers moving thousands of orders a day. We build software for real\-world warehouse environments where reliability, clarity, and speed matter. WarehouseOS is part of a broader software strategy at Hoj Innovations, a company with more than six decades of experience designing, installing, and optimizing warehouse operations. Across more than 100,000 completed projects, Hoj has developed deep operational expertise in a category increasingly shaped by software. WarehouseOS is the starting point for building software capabilities that can serve the company’s wider portfolio over time. We are looking for people who want to help shape that future. **About the role** ------------------ We are hiring our first Staff Software Engineer to lead WarehouseOS workstreams, from clarifying ambiguous problems through rollout and production follow\-through. You will report directly to the Director of Software Engineering, who also leads product direction, and partner with our Principal Technical Program Manager on sequencing, dependencies, and coordination across workstreams. We are deliberately moving more technical decision\-making from the Director into the engineering team. You’ll make technical calls without routine sign\-off. When a decision would shift priorities, commitments, or spend, you’ll bring in the people who own those. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role. You will write production code while leading technical work, reviewing changes, and helping other engineers grow. The balance will shift with the work. The role is based in Salt Lake City, Utah and requires a full\-time in\-office presence. The salary range is **$145,000–$180,000**, depending on experience and qualifications. **The work ahead** ------------------ The work spans an established product, modernization of older systems, and new capabilities. Our .NET services support warehouse order flow, device traffic from the floor, and integrations with customer and partner systems. The challenges include developing a sustainable approach to retaining and accessing growing volumes of historical warehouse data, evolving existing systems without disrupting warehouse operations, and making production easier to understand and support. These problems require investigation and judgment, not a predetermined architecture or a mandate to rewrite everything. **In this role, you will:** --------------------------- * Lead engineering workstreams, taking ownership of technical delivery, rollout readiness, and production follow\-through. * Make and document technical decisions about implementation approaches, component boundaries, data models, APIs, and testing strategies. Revisit tradeoffs when evidence or requirements change. * Break work into pieces other engineers can own, provide context for them to make decisions, and help resolve technical obstacles. * Partner with the Director on customer needs, scope, priorities, and risk, and with the Principal Technical Program Manager on sequencing and cross\-workstream dependencies. * Share code\-review responsibility, mentor engineers through review and pairing, and establish review practices proportionate to the risk of a change. * Build and evolve production services with attention to data integrity, reliability, maintainability, and performance under real warehouse load. * Improve observability, runbooks, release practices, and incident response, and address technical debt where it meaningfully reduces risk or enables delivery. **What success looks like in your first six months** ---------------------------------------------------- Working with the Director and the team, you will establish priorities and aim to: * Lead a workstream from design through production, with clear tradeoffs, meaningful ownership by other engineers, and a supported rollout. * Establish a practical design\-review approach that enables more engineers to make sound decisions independently. * Identify and improve a specific reliability or delivery problem with the team, establishing a baseline and demonstrating the improvement. **We’re looking for someone who:** ---------------------------------- * Has a degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated experience. * Has 8\+ years of professional software development experience, including multiple projects led from design through production. * Has designed, shipped, and operated production systems, and can explain the alternatives considered, the tradeoffs made, and what happened after release. * Has deep experience with C\# and ASP.NET Core, or a comparable modern backend stack with the ability to come up to speed quickly. * Can turn an incompletely defined problem into a practical technical approach, accounting for scope, risk, dependencies, and the realities of an existing system. * Understands relational data deeply and can reason about integrity, consistency, and performance under real load. * Writes clearly and helps other engineers grow through design discussions, documentation, code review, and pairing. * Disagrees constructively, seeks relevant expertise, and changes course when better evidence or reasoning emerges. * Has used modern delivery and observability tooling to improve how a team builds and operates software, not just to complete individual tasks. * Is comfortable in a growing organization where some systems and practices are established and others still need to be built. **Even better if you:** ----------------------- * Have experience in warehouse management, logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, industrial automation, or other operations\-heavy software. * Have built or operated integrations with hardware, scanners, mobile devices, or customer and vendor systems. * Have worked with microservice or event\-driven architectures and understand where they help and where they add unnecessary complexity. * Have experience running software on Linux in production, including containers and cloud infrastructure. * Have led incident reviews or improved on\-call practices to reduce recurring operational problems. * Use AI development tools thoughtfully to improve productivity while maintaining quality and accountability. **Benefits and perks** ---------------------- * Flex PTO * Medical, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, medical advice line access, flexible spending accounts, and parental leave * Disability and life insurance options * Employer dollar match to HSA and 401(k) * Team\-building events and monthly catered office lunches **Optional: share a technical decision** ---------------------------------------- If you’d like, include a few paragraphs about a technical decision where there was meaningful disagreement or where you changed your mind. Describe the options, how you reached a decision, how you worked with others, and what you learned from the outcome. An anonymized example is welcome. Please do not include confidential information from a current or former employer.

jobs.title: Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Hellyeah AI** Hellyeah is the agentic operating system for distribution. AI agents plan, execute and optimize growth work, and humans approve it. A small engineering team runs several live products, with coding agents as part of how we ship. **The role** You will own the platform our products and agents run on: the gateway every model call passes through, the runtime for our production agents, and the clusters, data stores, pipelines, secrets and release paths underneath. We're hiring two engineers, one in San Francisco and one in Shanghai. One will lean toward the AI platform and the other toward the core platform. You'll share ownership and on\-call, and work closely with our CTO. This role is onsite five days a week. On\-call includes nights and weekends, and days often run past 10 hours. **Why this role:** You'll own the whole platform, work directly with our CTO, and build the agents that run it. We run production AI across text, speech and video, mostly through third\-party model APIs, with some self\-hosted serving. The gateway supports internal teams, our products and customers. We do not train models. If you only want to work on model training, look elsewhere. If you want to make a multi\-provider AI stack reliable, secure and affordable, keep reading. Product teams own product features. IT support, marketing sites and SEO sit outside this role. **What you'll do** *The AI platform* * **Run the model gateway.** Own routing, fallbacks, provider failover, rate limits and rollouts for 90\+ model deployments across OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Google and AWS Bedrock. Benchmark new providers on latency, quality, cost and failure behavior before they take traffic, and escalate to vendors when they fall short. * **Make the gateway multi\-tenant.** Give each team and customer the right keys, routes, limits and usage metering, and reconcile usage against provider invoices. * **Run the AI developer platform.** Own shared coding\-agent access, including seats, quotas and per\-user limits, plus the remote workspaces our engineers use. One heavy user should never slow down everyone else. * **Run production agents safely.** Own sandboxing, credential scoping and pinned releases for long\-running agents on Kubernetes. * **Automate your own job.** Expect to build a lot of autonomous infra workflows and infra agents that take on routine requests and alerts, with a person approving risky actions. * **Own infrastructure and AI spend.** Reconcile provider bills against usage, tie spend to a team and product, and catch anomalies early. Right\-size clusters, spend vendor credits before they expire, and handle quota and billing escalations with cloud and model vendors. *The core platform* * **Keep clusters and cloud healthy.** Debug and upgrade EKS, AKS and bare\-metal k3s through Argo CD and Kustomize. Manage AWS, Azure and GCP through reviewed Terraform. * **Run the edge.** Own Cloudflare across a dozen domains: DNS, WAF, TLS, CDN and object storage, plus GeoDNS, load balancers, egress IPs and email authentication. * **Ship new services fast.** Point a coding agent at an open\-source repo and have it in production the same day: manifests or Helm, pinned images, Postgres and Redis, SSO, DNS, TLS, secrets and backups, all through GitOps. Make it highly available when it needs to be, and give each service a named owner. Build production infrastructure for new product launches the same way. * **Hack your way to a solution.** When something blocks you, read the source, patch it, work around it or build what's missing. You always have one more way to solve the problem. * **Lead migrations.** Move workloads between regions, clouds and platforms with a tested rollback, retire what's left behind, and bring stray services under GitOps. * **Operate the data layer.** Upgrade and migrate production PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse and Redis, run schema changes safely, and prove backups by restoring them. * **Keep data pipelines flowing.** Run Airbyte, Airflow, Dataform and CDC into BigQuery so product and finance data stay fresh, and catch a stalled sync before it fills a production disk. *Reliability and security* * **Own reliability.** Set SLOs and alerts people trust, lead incidents across infrastructure and product services, including realtime speech, write the reviews, and automate the triage you keep repeating. * **Own observability.** Keep metrics, logs and traces flowing and usable across every cluster and the gateway. Maintain Grafana, Prometheus, Loki and Datadog, build on OpenTelemetry, add telemetry to new services, and manage retention and cost, so engineers and agents can see what's happening without asking you. * **Own infrastructure security.** Rotate credentials, replace static keys with workload identity, find exposed secrets and vulnerable dependencies, respond to exposures, and control access to customer data. * **Make access self\-serve.** Replace manual grants with SSO, workload identity and scoped secrets, so engineers get what they need without asking you. Own the OAuth clients and API apps we run on ad and commerce platforms, including their reviews. *The team around you* * **Give product teams a paved road.** Build the release pipelines, canaries, preview environments and guardrails that let them ship and operate their own services. * **Review and teach.** Review infrastructure changes from engineers, founders and their agents, and share the runbooks and agent skills that keep everyone fast. **Your first 90 days** * Join on\-call and run an incident review. * Take a new model from benchmark to production traffic. * Reconcile one month of gateway usage against provider invoices. * Cut manual access requests in half. * Put one recurring request or alert under agent handling, with a person approving risky actions. * Make sure a second person can run each critical system. **What you'll bring** * 5\+ years running production infrastructure, with real on\-call experience * Deep Kubernetes debugging, including stateful workloads, and hands\-on experience running Kubernetes on bare metal: storage, networking, upgrades and node failure * Hands\-on work with LLM APIs in production: routing, rate limits, streaming, failure modes and cost * You've handed real operational work to agents or automation, with guardrails, approvals and recovery when a run dies * Enough Go or Python to read an unfamiliar codebase and ship a fix * Hands\-on observability: you can maintain Grafana, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry collectors, write metric and log queries, and build a dashboard people use **You'll also need** * GitOps and Terraform in production, ideally across more than one cloud * Networking fundamentals: DNS, TLS, load balancing, WAF and routing * You've taken a third\-party service to production end to end, including SSO, backups and upgrades * You've led a region, cloud or database migration with a tested rollback * You've cut a real cloud or AI bill and can show the numbers * Security judgment: least privilege, secret handling, credential rotation, safe rollouts * Daily use of coding agents, plus clear views on what they should not touch unreviewed * You follow the current agent landscape, including Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, open\-source Codex and Vercel's eve, and can explain agent harness best practices: durable runs, sandboxing, scoped credentials, human approval, memory, tracing and evals * The confidence to say no to a risky change and explain why, including to a founder * Written English for daily work with teammates in the US, China and India **Nice to have** * LiteLLM or a similar LLM gateway * LLM serving, such as SGLang or vLLM * Multi\-tenant API platforms, including metering and billing * Data pipelines, such as Airbyte, Airflow or CDC into BigQuery * Realtime audio or WebSocket services * Agent sandboxing, such as gVisor, Landlock or agent\-sandbox * Langfuse or other LLM tracing * Remote dev environments, such as Coder * FinOps across several clouds * Mandarin **How we hire** A detailed application form, an online assessment, a technical interview, a 30\-minute deep dive with our CTO on a project you've built, then a paid work trial before any offer. You'll see how we work and we'll see how you work.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Req Id: 33299 **Systems Engineer** ==================== **The Company** Ingles Markets began in 1963 as a single supermarket and has since grown into a regional grocery store chain with just under 200 retail locations operating in 6 southeastern states, a 1\.6\-million\-square foot distribution center, two truck fleets, and a milk processing plant. Ingles Markets’ headquarters and distribution center are located just 15 minutes outside of Asheville, NC in the town of Black Mountain. **The Team** We are a lean team that services 27,000 employees across 6 states. We work hard as a collective to ensure everything is accomplished, even if it is not in our job description. While we do take things seriously, we like to have fun while we are doing it, so we can create the most impact and difference in our community. **The Position** The Systems Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing complex systems and infrastructure that support the functioning of the company's technological environment. They play a crucial role in ensuring the seamless operation, performance, and reliability of hardware, software, and networks, while considering both technical and company requirements. This is a hybrid working position and will require regular visits to the corporate office. **Hard Skill Requirements:** * Linux and Windows administration experience * Scripting and coding (Bash, PowerShell, Python, YAML, Ansible) * Virtualization: VMware vSphere, KVM (qemu), Cloud infrastructure (GCP, AWS, Azure) * Working knowledge of HA/Clustering/DR **Key Responsibilities:** * Collaborate with multiple teams across the company to design and architect complex systems, including hardware, software, networks, and cloud infrastructure. Balance performance, scalability, security, and cost\-effectiveness while considering company needs. * Contribute to implementing and deploying systems, ensuring proper installation, configuration, and integration. Test and troubleshoot systems to identify and resolve any issues that may arise during the implementation phase. * Deploy and manage VMware vSphere environments to ensure optimal performance and reliability. * Implement cross\-application integrations using bash, python, ansible, or similar solutions to streamline processes and enhance system functionality. * Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimization strategies to enhance overall system efficiency, responsiveness, and reliability. This may involve performance tuning, load balancing, and capacity planning. * Integrate security best practices into system designs, configurations, and processes. Implement and maintain security measures such as encryption, access controls, and intrusion detection systems to safeguard sensitive data and ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations. * Ensure uptime and availability of systems by planning and implementing high\-availability practices as needed by the company. Ensuring hardware is maintained regularly and support contracts are up to date to provide repairs in a timely manner. **The Ideal Candidate:** * Bachelor's of Science in Computer Science or related field of education requirements may be substituted with equivalent work experience. * 5\+ years designing and implementing complex systems and/or integrated systems within IT. * Working knowledge of: HA/Clustering/DR Design, Network Communications, Virtualization (VMware, KVM) and cloud infrastructure (GCP, AWS, Azure) * Strong organizational skills, problem\-solving, and communication skills. Able to work on projects as part of a team and individually * Project management skills to handle multiple tasks and priorities effectively. * Must live in AL, GA, NC, SC, TN, or VA. **Nearest Major Market:** Asheville

jobs.title: Associate Engineer
jobs.description: **Requisition Number: 106879** **Associate Engineer** **Location:**This role is fully onsite in our Fort Worth, TX office. **Shift:** 9:30am \- 6:00pm CST **Salary:** $80,000 **Insight at a Glance** * 14,000\+ engaged teammates globally * $8\.2 billion in revenue in 2025 * Certified as a Great Place to work in 9 Countries in 2025 * Fortune 500 Company (No. 447\) in 2025 * Received 25\+ industry and partner awards in the past year * $1\.4M\+ total charitable contributions in 2024 by Insight globally Now is the time to bring your expertise to Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people\-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a **Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator** with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organizations through complex digital decisions. **About the role** The Associate Engineer supports the safe, accurate, and timely integration, configuration, validation, and documentation of customer technology solutions in Insight’s lab environment. The role performs hands\-on server configuration, network switch operating system updates, component and platform firmware updates, and controlled VLAN change management. Working from approved procedures, engineering designs, bills of materials, and customer requirements, the Associate Engineer prepares systems for deployment while maintaining configuration quality, asset traceability, security, and schedule commitments. This position will also help expand the lab’s capability to build and validate artificial intelligence infrastructure racks. The Associate Engineer will support rack\-level assembly, cabling, power and cooling readiness, firmware baselines, network configuration, burn\-in, validation, and handoff of compute\-intensive solutions under the direction of senior engineering resources. Along the way, you will get to: Lab Integration and Server Configuration * Receive, stage, inventory, inspect, and prepare servers, storage, networking equipment, accelerators, and related components for integration. * Perform server configuration using approved work instructions, including BIOS/UEFI settings, management\-controller configuration, storage and RAID setup, boot configuration, operating\-system or hypervisor deployment, and baseline validation. * Install or replace approved components such as processors, memory, storage devices, network adapters, host bus adapters, graphics processing units, power supplies, rails, and cable assemblies. * Execute build plans and bills of materials accurately; identify discrepancies, incompatible components, missing items, and damaged equipment before work proceeds. * Run prescribed diagnostics, burn\-in, health checks, and functional tests; document results and escalate failures with reproducible evidence.
