jobs.description: **2D/3D CAD Modeling \& Data Specialist** **Department: GM Applications** **Reports To: Senior Manager for Automotive Automation Solutions \& Simulation** **FLSA Status: Exempt** **Location: Remote****Updated: October 2026** **THE COMPANY** Invio Automation is a leader in Industry 4\.0, delivering high\-value automation solutions that help customers accelerate growth in specialized markets such as medical devices, life sciences, and advanced manufacturing. With deep domain expertise and extensive engineering capabilities, Invio partners with clients from early\-stage product design and R\&D through to full\-scale automation. Customers value Invio’s commitment to precision, quality, efficiency, and safety, and rely on its innovative, scalable solutions to support long\-term growth. Headquartered in Michigan, Invio Automation is supported by a vast design library, a growing North American presence with global reach, and a team of over 600 experienced professionals across the Midwest and northeast. Invio operates through two integrated segments: * The **Solutions Segment** delivers engineered systems for precision manufacturing, including robotic cells, multi\-station assembly lines, and other automation solutions. * The **Technologies Segment** focuses on advanced autonomous systems and ergonomic tooling, including heavyweight Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), turnkey assembly solutions, and custom lift\-assist tools for safety\-critical applications. Together, these segments enable Invio to deliver tailored automation solutions that improve performance and achieve high efficiency across the production lifecycle. Visit https://invioautomation.com/ for more information. **DESCRIPTION** The primary responsibility of this position is to collect, organize, and interpret technical and operational data and use that information to develop accurate 2D layouts and 3D CAD models of manufacturing equipment, production lines, and industrial facilities. jobs.title: Microsoft 365 Security Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **The Role** ============ The Inviso Microsoft 365 Security Engineer is a hands\-on technical consultant who designs, implements, and optimizes security, compliance, identity, and governance solutions across Microsoft 365\. This role focuses on helping clients secure Microsoft 365 environments using Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, and emerging Microsoft agent security and governance capabilities, including Agent 365\. The Engineer translates security and compliance requirements into practical technical controls and works directly with client teams to implement, validate, and operationalize those solutions. As part of Inviso’s Microsoft Solutions Group (MSG), the Engineer works across client engagements, partnering with architects, consultants, security teams, and client stakeholders to deliver secure, governed Microsoft 365 environments. **This is a 100% remote role working in the US and requiring US time\-zone availability.** **Key Activities for this Role** ================================ * Design, configure, and implement Microsoft Purview security, compliance, data governance, and information protection capabilities. * Configure and optimize Purview Information Protection, sensitivity labels, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), retention, eDiscovery, and related compliance controls. * Implement security and governance capabilities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI agents using Agent 365 and related Microsoft security technologies. * Design and implement identity and access controls using Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, MFA, RBAC, identity governance, and privileged access. * Assess Microsoft 365 environments, identify security and compliance gaps, and develop actionable recommendations and remediation plans. * Configure and integrate Microsoft Defender, Microsoft 365 security, compliance, identity, and governance capabilities across customer environments. * Partner directly with client security, compliance, identity, and IT teams to translate business and regulatory requirements into technical solutions. * Develop technical documentation, configuration standards, governance frameworks, implementation plans, and operational procedures. * Support client workshops, technical discovery, solution design, implementation, testing, and knowledge transfer. * Maintain delivery activities, technical work items, documentation, and project status while meeting Inviso quality and utilization expectations. **Experience \& Skills Required** ================================= * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience implementing and supporting Microsoft 365 security, compliance, or identity solutions in enterprise environments. * Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Purview, including Information Protection, sensitivity labels, Data Loss Prevention, retention, eDiscovery, or related compliance capabilities. * Experience implementing Microsoft Entra ID security controls, including Conditional Access, MFA, RBAC, privileged access, and identity governance. * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI agents, Agent 365, or security and governance controls for enterprise AI workloads. * Experience with Microsoft Defender and Microsoft 365 security capabilities, including integration across identity, applications, endpoints, and cloud services. * Understanding of Zero Trust principles and their application across Microsoft 365 identity, data, applications, and collaboration services. * Experience assessing existing environments, identifying security or compliance gaps, and implementing remediation recommendations. * Proficiency with PowerShell and automation for Microsoft 365 administration, security, compliance, and configuration. * Strong consulting and customer\-facing skills with the ability to lead technical discussions and clearly communicate recommendations. * Strong written documentation skills and experience working within structured consulting or project delivery teams. **Desired Qualifications** ========================== * Microsoft security certifications such as SC\-100, SC\-300, SC\-400, or equivalent Microsoft 365 security and compliance certifications preferred. * Experience securing Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, or other enterprise AI and agent\-based solutions. * Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud Apps, or broader Microsoft Security technologies. * Experience working in consulting, professional services, or complex enterprise Microsoft 365 environments. * Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field or equivalent professional experience preferred. **Compensation** ================ At Inviso, we believe great talent should be rewarded with competitive pay, meaningful benefits, and room to grow. The salary for this role ranges from $90,000 to $115,000 annually, reflecting the cost of labor across multiple US geographic markets. Beyond base pay, we offer a strong benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, annual training reimbursement, paid time off, paid holidays, and additional perks designed to support your well\-being and long\-term success. **Why You’ll Love Working at Inviso:** ====================================== * **Do work that matters.** We are a global technology and business consulting firm that helps organizations implement AI, modern data platforms, and digital marketing strategies. * **Work somewhere people choose to stay.** Our low attrition, strong average tenure, and employees who have spent 10, 15, or even 20 years with Inviso speak volumes about our culture and how we care for our people. * **Bring your ideas and be heard.** You will join a collaborative, people\-first environment where ideas matter, contributions are recognized, and excellent work creates real opportunities for growth. * **Keep learning and growing.** Inviso invests in employees through continuous learning, mentorship, collaboration, and career development across a diverse global organization. * **Join a company with deep industry credibility.** Inviso has worked closely with Microsoft for more than 20 years and is proud to be a top\-rated supplier and Managed Partner with numerous credentials.

approach to execution, documentation, and follow\-through. * Genuine curiosity and a willingness to learn technologies outside your current experience. * Practical experience using AI coding assistants or language models as part of a development workflow. * Good judgment about validating AI\-generated code and protecting confidential or sensitive company information. **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer/Data Science or Analytics. jobs.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!** **Job Overview** ---------------- This position requires problem solving skills with the ability to provide conceptual and strategic solutions. Desired personal qualities include a willingness to seek out challenges and new experiences, and a passion for achieving established goals. This position requires personal interaction with others to achieve desired results, and the integrity to place emphasis on how results were achieved as well as the results themselves. Success in this position demands a positive attitude toward change and a willingness to embrace best practices. **Key Job Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Develop machine automation \& autonomy software including perception, mapping, localization, and path planning using geometric based, machine learning and fusion techniques for underground machines * Drive all aspects of automation \& autonomy software development including requirement review, effort estimation, design, reviews, programming, functional testing, and release. * Design, program, and unit test efficient software that satisfies programming standards, conforms to defined architectural structure, and meets functional requirements. * Design software interfaces to integrate custom and COTS (Commercial Off\-The\-Shelf) sensors * Perform reviews and functional testing of peer software as needed to support team based agile software practices. * Coach entry to mid\-level engineers in robotics software development * Comply with version management and development branching policies using Git. * Implement effective Change Management to achieve the desired organizational outcomes by successfully changing behaviors as needed. * Travel Requirements: Up to 10% of domestic, international, and underground mine travel is required. **Qualifications/Requirements** ------------------------------- Basic Qualifications: * Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Robotics, Computer Vision, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Bachelor’s degree with 8\+ years or Master’s degree with 6\+ years of industry experience in Robotics, Autonomous Vehicles, or Autonomous Systems, with expertise in Perception, Localization/Positioning, Path Planning, and Autonomous Navigation. * Demonstrated success designing, developing, and sustaining complex, mission\-critical, high\-reliability robotics software systems deployed in production environments. * Expert\-level proficiency in C\+\+ development on Linux platforms, with a proven ability to architect scalable, maintainable, and high\-performance software solutions. * Strong technical leadership experience driving large complex robotics projects from concept definition and research through implementation, validation, deployment, and field support, delivering measurable business and customer impact. * Hands\-on experience with ROS2, CUDA, DDS, and distributed robotic software architectures. * Experience integrating and utilizing multiple sensing technologies, including LiDAR, cameras, radar, IMUs, and other sensors. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a demonstrated ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams including software, controls, embedded systems, hardware, systems engineering, and product management. * Customer\-focused, collaborative team player with strong accountability and ownership, consistently delivering high\-quality results while meeting project commitments and deadlines. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with real\-time sensor fusion, machine learning and deep learning techniques * Experience with Unreal Engine or other simulation environments * Experience in team leadership, specifically mentoring and coaching engineers in the deployment of complex robotics software systems * Experience developing with MATLAB, and Python beneficial * Experience working with GPUs, and CPUs is a plus * Familiarity with safety critical system design and industry standards is a plus. * Knowledge of common machine control sensors, actuators, and other typical control devices. * Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to deliver high\-quality results while adapting to priorities in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment. **Key Skills Required by Komatsu** ---------------------------------- **COLLABORATION** Working together with one or more people to complete a project or task or develop ideas or processes. **ADAPTABILITY** Having the ability to adjust to changes in their environment. **HUNTER MENTALITY** A combination of traits that can help someone achieve their goals with consistency and precision. **BUSINESS ACCUMEN** Having the ability to understand business situations and make sound decisions that lead to successful outcomes. **APPLICATION OF KNOWLEDGE** Being able to use what you’ve learned to make decisions and complete tasks in different situations. **LEADERSHIP** The ability to guide, influence or lead others to accomplish a shared goal. **Company Benefits** Komatsu provides an extensive and robust employee benefits package that is designed to enhance the well\-being of our employees and family members. Connected by our core values of ambition, perseverance, collaboration and authenticity, we are committed to continually advancing in our support of diversity and inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together. **Company Information** Komatsu develops and supplies technologies, equipment and services for the construction, mining, forklift, industrial and forestry markets. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu employs more than 64,000 people worldwide, operating in more than 140 countries. For more than a century, the company has been creating value for its customers through manufacturing and technology innovation, partnering with others to empower a sustainable future where people, business and the planet thrive together. Since the company’s founding in 1921, Komatsu has been committed to supporting individuals and communities through job training, skills development and giving back. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, join Komatsu to be a part of something big and help advance modern society. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Principal AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. **The Role** **Why Kyndryl** Kyndryl's Security \& Resiliency practice helps clients anticipate, protect against, withstand, and recover from cyber threats and operational disruption. We bring together deep technical expertise, modern platforms, and a culture of continuous learning to build secure and resilient environments. At Kyndryl, curiosity, collaboration, and customer focus are central to how we work. We invest in skills and give people opportunities to learn, contribute, and grow. **The Role** Kyndryl is seeking a Principal AI Security Engineer to secure internal AI solutions, agents, copilots, model platforms, and frontier AI capabilities. This hands\-on senior technical role will write code, build controls, integrate them into enterprise platforms, and translate security requirements into reusable guardrails and measurable risk reduction. **What You Will Do** * Design, develop, test, and deploy controls for AI applications, agents, copilots, and shared AI platforms. * Build reusable services, APIs, libraries, policy checks, automation, and platform integrations. * Implement identity, authorization, secrets, data access, tool\-use, egress, rate\-limiting, logging, and human\-approval controls. * Perform AI threat modeling and technical security reviews and drive remediation. * Build adversarial tests and automated checks for prompt injection, unsafe tool execution, misuse, and control bypass. * Integrate AI security telemetry, detections, alerts, and response workflows. * Lead through engineering depth, reusable patterns, mentoring, and enterprise influence. Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID\-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID\-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment. **Who You Are** **Required Qualifications** * 10 or more years of experience in security engineering, application security, product security, cloud security, software engineering, platform engineering, or a related field. * Experience implementing authentication, authorization, secrets management, API security, logging, monitoring, and secure development controls. * Experience implementing technical controls that are unique to the evolving AI risk landscape. * Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD. * Ability to conduct threat modeling and convert findings into working engineering solutions. Development experience in Python, Java, C\#, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing or securing generative AI applications, agents, copilots, or machine learning platforms. * Experience with AI gateways, model routing, RAG, vector databases, orchestration, MCP, or model\-serving platforms. * Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, prompt injection defenses, or automated control validation. Your actual compensation may vary depending on multiple factors legally permitted in the applicable jurisdiction, including, but not limited to, geography, relevant job\-related skills, education and experience, certification and licenses, internal pay equity, and market and business consideration. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations: California (San Francisco Bay Area): $215,640 to $409,800 California (All Other): $197,640 to $375,600 Colorado: $179,760 to $341,520 Massachusetts/ Virginia: $179,760 to $375,600 New York City: $215,640 to $409,800 Washington: $197,600 to $375,600 Washington DC: $197,640 to $375,600 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. **Equal Opportunity Employer** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. **Being You** Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way. **What You Can Expect** With state\-of\-the\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed. **Get Referred!** If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

We strive for o ur engineers to work within small, agile, self\-managed teams that emphasise best practice and believe quality is everyone’s responsibility. Candidates must bring an enthusiastic “you build it you run it” mindset whilst making sure they share their knowledge while removing constraints. **What You will Bring:** * We are looking for someone who has 8\+ years in: architecting and building cloud native solutions via Infrastructure as Code (IAC) defining patterns and practices * DevOps Automation across various Technologies such as those detailed in the Tech Profile, including Secrets Mgmt, Code/Binary Scans and other SDLC tools such as Maven / Ansible. * working at scale in large enterprise organisations implementing niche, operational requirements * defining standards on observability and implementing cloud alerting solutions * Cloud Technology across cloud service providers: Azure, AWS \& GCP * has an open and collaborative mentality and is able to communicate with Senior Members of Dev, Infra and architecture teams as needed. * Relevant experience may include AWS, Linux/Unix, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Ansible, Git\-based source control, Jenkins or comparable CI/CD platforms, Python, Bash, PowerShell, Kafka, SQL/Oracle, Contr are met. * Raise and resolve issues promptly, maintaining effective communication with partners. * Take ownership of live service issues, ensuring root causes are identified and resolved to prevent recurrence. * Implement changes in line with existing policies, ensuring minimal disruption to services. * Train Level 1 teams to perform effective triage of application issues. * Document support processes, service models, technical specifications, and user guides. * Collaborate across IT teams to establish common standards. * Identify operational risks, implement short\-term solutions, and track long\-term resolutions. * Drive operational improvements in processes, performance, and reliability. * Onboard new applications, integrating them into the operations architecture. * Support development changes, including time and cost estimation, impact analysis, and timely delivery. * Assist in architectural design for network, infrastructure, database, and applications. * Participate in on\-call support and weekend testing as part of operational requirements. * Propose application system changes, better uses, enhancements and developments and liaises with vendors and other IT teams. * Provide hands on solution expertise for complex change, support and recovery queries and issues. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Hardware
jobs.description: **ABOUT LVT** LVT is redefining how businesses operate in the physical world, moving beyond traditional security solutions to deliver AI\-driven, actionable intelligence that makes sites smarter, safer, and more secure. Since pioneering our first mobile, solar\-powered units, our commitment to scrappy, hands\-on innovation has made us an established leader and one of the fastest\-growing companies in intelligent site technology. We are building the next generation of solutions—from our physical units in the field to a powerful Agentic AI platform—that allows our customers to gain unprecedented visibility and control over safety, compliance, and operations. This is your chance to join a cutting\-edge team that isn't just watching the world change, but actively building the technology that is changing it. We’re a team that’s focused on growth and innovation, and we’re proud that our crew, products, and leadership are being recognized for it. * **A Top\-Tier Growth Company:** Named one of the *Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies 2025* and *\#10 on the Inc. 5000 Rocky Mountain Regional* list for 2025\. * **Innovative Leadership:** Our CEO, Ryan Porter, was named an *EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2025*, and our CTO, Steve Lindsey, was inducted into the *Silicon Slopes CTO Hall of Fame* in 2024\. * **Product \& Software Excellence:** We were named one of *The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies of 2023* and are a winner of the *Security Today Govies Award* for 2025\. **ABOUT THIS ROLE** As a Technical Program Manager, you will own the delivery of new features for LVT's deployed hardware models and for the next\-generation models still in development. You will run programs end to end, from scope and schedule through cross\-team dependencies, risk, and release, across firmware, hardware, backend software, and go\-to\-market. You will give stakeholders clear communication and real visibility into execution, and you will prioritize aggressively so effort is put toward features customers value. This role is built for a TPM ready to own programs and improve how the team operates. LVT is a flexible\-first company, and this role is in person at our office in American Fork, UT, where you will work alongside the hardware, firmware, and software teams you partner with. Because our work involves physical hardware, occasional travel (approximately 5–15%) may be needed to visit our facilities or partners. **ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Own Feature Programs End to End:** Drive scope, schedule, dependencies, and risk for new features on existing hardware models, from intake through release to the field. * **Deliver Features for Models in Development:** Align feature timelines with hardware milestones across prototyping, validation, and production so software and hardware land together. * **Resolve Cross\-Team Blockers:** Work directly with engineers across firmware, hardware, and backend software to clear blockers, and escalate only the risks that need a leadership decision. * **Prioritize Aggressively:** Protect the critical path by declining or deferring work that doesn't serve the plan, and make tradeoffs visible to the people who own them. * **Communicate Without Surprises:** Tailor updates to each audience so stakeholders always know status, risks, and the decisions needed from them. * **Build Visibility Into Execution:** Maintain accurate roadmaps, dashboards, and status reporting in Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet that take minutes to read, not hours. * **Recover Slipping Programs:** Replan quickly when schedules slip, bringing options and a recommendation to escalation conversations rather than only the problem. * **Pressure\-Test Plans and Estimates:** Use working knowledge of LVT's hardware, firmware, and cloud architecture to spot unrealistic estimates and hold credible conversations with engineers. * **Improve How the Team Operates:** Refine templates, status reporting, and ceremonies for your programs, onboard new TPMs, and contribute to TPM candidate interviews. **OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE** * **Program Ownership:** You have run programs end to end with minimal supervision and can point to features or products you shipped on time and on scope. * **Technical Credibility:** You understand the systems your programs touch well enough to identify risk and challenge estimates. You don't need to be an engineer, but engineers can't fool you. * **Clear Communicator:** You write and speak concisely, adjust to your audience, and surface bad news early. * **Prioritization Discipline:** You say no to work that doesn't serve the plan, and you explain the tradeoff instead of absorbing the request. * **Cross\-Functional Influence:** You earn trust across Product, Software, Firmware, and Hardware and keep multiple teams working from the same plan, even as it shifts. * **Judgment on Escalation:** You know which risks to solve yourself and which to raise, and you raise them with a proposed path forward. * **Experience:** You likely have 3–6 years of experience in technical program management or a related role, with fluency in Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar tools. * **A Plus:** Experience with hardware\+edge\+cloud products including validation, manufacturing, or supply chain. **BENEFITS** We believe you do your best work when your whole life is supported. We invest in our crew’s health, families, and financial futures with a benefits package designed to support you inside and outside the office. Full\-time benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO. ***LVT IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.*** *All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. All candidates must pass a drug screening and background check upon employment. Some roles may also require passing a federal background check and fingerprinting. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, and/or to perform essential job functions, please reach out to your recruiter.*

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Detection & Response
jobs.description: Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU. If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us. * Note: This position requires presence in our Bellevue, San Francisco, or San Jose office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday. **About the Role** Lambda Security protects some of the world's most valuable digital assets: invaluable training data, model weights representing immense computational investments, and the sensitive inputs required to leverage best of breed AI models. We're responsible for securing every byte that powers breakthrough artificial intelligence. Reporting to the Security Engineering Lead, you will serve as a hands\-on technical expert on the Detection \& Response team—acting as an intelligent backstop that ensures Lambda is the safest place to build with AI by catching security issues in real\-time while enabling our business to move at hypergrowth velocity. You will help transform reactive security operations into a proactive threat management engine, dedicating the majority of your effort to automation, threat hunting, detection engineering, and incident response capability building rather than constant firefighting. You will directly affect customers’ trust in the safety of their data by implementing enterprise\-grade detection capabilities, automating incident response workflows, and hardening our multi\-cloud and bare metal infrastructure. With unique access to LLMs hosted on our own infrastructure, you will pioneer AI\-powered security solutions that wouldn't be possible anywhere else. Key priorities include maintaining 24/7 operational resilience through smart automation, rapid incident investigation and mitigation, and advancing our technical D\&R capabilities. If you're excited about building detection and response automation so efficient that security operations become "almost boring," where code handles the routine so you can focus on novel threats, we want to talk. We value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and skills, and we are excited to hear from candidates who can bring unique perspectives to our team. If you do not exactly meet this description but believe you may be a good fit, **please still apply** and help us understand your readiness for a Senior Security Engineer role. **Your application is not a waste of our time.** **What You’ll Do** Detection Engineering \& Threat Hunting: * Design, build, and maintain robust detection rules, signatures, and behavioral analytics across Lambda's cloud, bare\-metal, and internal infrastructure * Conduct proactive threat hunting operations to uncover hidden threat actors, novel attack vectors, and zero\-day vulnerabilities across multi\-cloud and AI workloads * Develop custom detection logic and playbooks as code, eliminating manual triage toil and reducing time\-to\-detect and time\-to\-respond * Pioneer AI\-powered detection and investigation workflows leveraging our internal LLM infrastructure to automate log analysis and threat intelligence context Incident Response \& Security Architecture: * Lead technical incident response investigations for complex security events, performing deep\-dive forensic analysis, root\-cause identification, and containment * Architect automated response capabilities and orchestration pipelines (SOAR) to programmatically isolate compromised assets and revoke compromised credentials * Partner with Platform and Infrastructure engineering teams to harden systems, build security instrumentation, and ensure telemetry coverage across all services Operational Execution \& Continuous Improvement: * Participate in an engineering on\-call rotation to maintain 24/7 operational readiness and rapid incident containment * Conduct post\-incident reviews to extract technical learnings, drive root\-cause remediation, and prevent recurring incidents * Mentor junior and mid\-level security engineers, sharing technical domain expertise and promoting best practices in detection engineering and automation **You** * 5\+ years of hands\-on security engineering experience specializing in detection engineering, threat hunting, or digital forensics and incident response (DFIR) * Strong programming/scripting proficiency (e.g., Python, Go, Rust, or Bash) with a track record of building automated security tools and pipelines * Deep technical knowledge of cloud infrastructure security (AWS/GCP), Linux system internals, container runtime security, and network telemetry * Clear understanding of the unique requirements of securing a cloud infrastructure provider * Proven experience writing detection rules (SIEM, YARA, Sigma, Falco, or EDR queries) and managing detections through software development best practices * Hands\-on experience conducting forensic investigations and triaging complex, multi\-stage attacks across cloud environments * Strong technical communication skills with the ability to document complex vulnerabilities, incident post\-mortems, and architectural designs clearly * Thrives in high\-ambiguity environments where you must build structure while executing at startup pace **Nice to Have** * Excitement about leveraging our direct access to state\-of\-the\-art LLMs to revolutionize security operations—imagine AI\-powered threat hunting, automated security report generation, and intelligent vulnerability prioritization at a scale only possible when you host the AI infrastructure yourself. * Experience building D\&R programs at AI/ML companies * Track record using AI/ML for security operations automation (yes, we know it’s all brand new) * Background scaling security during hypergrowth (10x growth phases) * Experience with eBPF, kernel\-level telemetry, or specialized bare\-metal host security tools * Experience with both build and buy decisions for security tooling * Experience driving or providing significant evidence for compliance audits, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA/HITECH, or FedRAMP. **Salary Range Information** The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. **About Lambda** * Founded in 2012, with 500\+ employees, and growing fast * Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In\-Q\-Tel (IQT), KHK \& Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove * We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG * Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers * We offer generous cash \& equity compensation * Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents * Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles * 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees) * Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use **Equal Opportunity Employer** Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law. Compensation Range: $266K \- $395K

The illumend platform aims to make meaningful risk management accessible to all businesses by providing an intuitive interface for non\-insurance professionals to track compliance. validating data from insurance documents, checking coverage against contract requirements, and AI assistants and agents that help users act on what they find * Design LLM pipelines and integrations (prompting, structured outputs, tool use, retrieval) across Python/FastAPI backend services and React/TypeScript frontends * Build evaluation sets and automated checks to measure accuracy, catch regressions, and improve model output over time, and monitor quality, latency, and cost in production * Fully embed AI development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) into your daily workflow to accelerate coding, refactoring, test generation, prototyping, and documentation, while reviewing and validating everything you ship * Build fast, functional prototypes to test new AI capabilities, then iterate and harden them for production * Dig into raw customer documents, data, edge cases, and API specs rather than relying on secondhand information * Make pragmatic technical decisions that put stability, security, and ROI ahead of novel or overly complex tech Required Skills: **What You Will Need to be Successful*** Senior\-level experience building production web applications, with strong Python (FastAPI) skills and working knowledge of React, TypeScript, Next.js, and PostgreSQL * Hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-powered features to production, including prompt design, structured outputs, tool use and agents, and retrieval * Experience evaluating AI output: building test sets, measuring accuracy, and handling failure cases such as hallucinations and low\-confidence results * Experience extracting structured data from unstructured documents (PDFs, scanned forms) is a strong plus * Mastery of AI coding assistants and agents in daily engineering work, backed by a clear method for reviewing and validating their output * Ability to quickly learn a complex, regulation\-heavy B2B domain; insurance experience is a plus * A strong commitment to engineering standards, maintainability, and security, balanced with business pragmatism * Thrives in a lean, fast\-paced environment; self\-driven, adaptable, and comfortable owning features end to end with minimal supervision * Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain AI tradeoffs and limitations to product and business partners and raise risks early Equal Opportunities: **Equal Opportunities** Left Field Labs is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and team members, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. This includes the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance related to an applicant's criminal history (LAMC 189\.00\). Left Field Labs makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled team members. Left Field Labs is an E\-Verify employer. E\-Verify is an Internet based system operated by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in partnership with the Social Security Administration (SSA) that allows participating employers to electronically verify the employment eligibility of their newly hired employees in the United States. Compensation: **Compensation** The salary range for this role is $155,000 to $175,000 and applies only to jobs performed in Culver City, California. This range represents the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. Please note that we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

jobs.description: **Summary** The Elite Network Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, managing, and troubleshooting complex network infrastructures across a diverse portfolio of business clients. The position requires multi\-tenant engineering expertise, rapid problem\-solving skills across varied environments, and exceptional client\-facing communication. The Elite Network Engineer serves as a technical escalation point, drive network architecture projects, and ensure high availability and security for our client base. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Designs, configures, and deploy sscalable LAN, WAN, WLAN, and cloud\-network architectures tailored to individual client needs. * Supports, monitors, and optimizes diverse client networks across various vendor ecosystems (Cisco, Meraki, Fortinet, Aruba, Palo Alto, etc.). * Acts as a Tier 2/3 technical escalation point for complex network outages, routing issues, performance bottlenecks, and security events. * Utilizes RMM (Remote Monitoring and Management), PSA (Professional Services Automation), and network documentation tools to maintain visibility, track SLAs, and automate routine operational tasks. * Conducts network discovery assessments for prospective and new MSP clients, documents existing topologies, identify security/operational risks, and creates remediation roadmaps. * Communicates technical concepts clearly to technical and non\-technical client stakeholders. Interfaces with ISPs and hardware vendors to resolve service issues and manage RMA processes. * Implements and enforces network security best practices, including firewall policy configuration, VPNs (IPsec/SSL), micro\-segmentation, zero\-trust network access (ZTNA), and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS). * Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis through performing behaviors consistent with the organization's values. * Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as policies and procedures of Logicalis in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical and professional behaviors. * Supports and conducts self in a manner consistent with customer service expectations. **Supervisory Responsibilities** This role does not have supervisory responsibilities. **Qualifications** To perform this job successfully, an individual should be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. jobs.title: AI Engineer, Medical Vision Language Models
jobs.description: Lumexa Imaging is one of the country's largest providers of outpatient medical imaging. With over 5,000 team members and more than 185 outpatient imaging centers across 13 states, our team conducts more than 4 million outpatient studies annually. We are the partner of choice for health systems and radiologists, delivering best\-in\-class clinical excellence, operations, and state\-of\-the\-art technology across our platform. Lumexa Imaging is hiring an early\-career AI Engineer to help build, adapt, and deploy vision language models (VLMs) and imaging foundation models for clinical radiology. You will work hands\-on using agentic coding tools (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex) to transition ideas from radiologists into validated, deployed models. This is a build\-focused role centered on model development and deployment. Initial priorities include building clinical LLM pipelines (prior report summarization, scanned document summarization, and relevant prior selection) on infrastructure shared with our VLM work. **Why this role is a rare opportunity:** You will have access to a large, growing repository of clinical imaging and reporting data. A central part of this job is leveraging this real\-world, domain\-specific data, consistent with applicable privacy, security, and governance requirements, to develop, adapt, and evaluate AI models beyond what is possible using public data alone. You will work closely with the Chief Clinical AI Officer, the Clinical Applications team, and Infrastructure and Information Security. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * VLM Development and Adaptation: Fine\-tune and adapt open VLMs (e.g., Qwen\-VL, LLaVA\-Med, MedGemma, InternVL) and imaging foundation models for report drafting, impression generation, finding detection, and prior comparison. Apply parameter\-efficient methods (LoRA, QLoRA) and full fine\-tuning under senior guidance. * Vision Encoders and Representation Learning: Work with vision encoders, contrastive image\-text models (CLIP, SigLIP), and self\-supervised approaches (JEPA). Build and maintain embedding pipelines for retrieval, cohort discovery, case similarity search, and drift detection * Data Curation: Curate and version datasets from our internal PACS and reporting systems, including DICOM header, burned\-in pixel, and paired\-report de\-identification * Agentic Engineering: Use Claude Code and OpenAI Codex daily to build, test, and maintain code. Maintain project context (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md), and help build and run MCP servers for internal system access * Deployment and MLOps: Deploy models via containerized inference and GPU serving (vLLM, Triton), support CI/CD pipelines, and monitor production models for drift and performance * Evaluation: Build automated evaluation harnesses for clinical accuracy, negation, laterality, and hallucination scoring against radiologist ground truth * Workflow Automation: Build agentic and LLM driven tools for operational workflows, such as converting unstructured requests into RIS scheduling actions and supporting intelligent operations dashboards **Required Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning transformer models in PyTorch (vision, multimodal, or language) using Hugging Face, MONAI, or similar (via internships, research, open\-source work, or projects) * Working knowledge of embeddings and vector search * Experience with open VLMs such as Qwen\-VL or LLaVA * Daily use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex) * Familiarity with Docker and GPU\-based model serving * Comfort working with real\-world data and a reproducible approach to experiments **Preferred Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience with vision encoders and contrastive models (CLIP, SigLIP, JEPA) * Exposure to medical VLMs, imaging foundation models, or self\-supervised methods (DINOv2, MAE) * Experience building MCP servers in Python or TypeScript * Familiarity with medical imaging formats (DICOM, HL7, FHIR) and HIPAA/PHI handling * Awareness of MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, model registries) * Awareness of FDA considerations for clinical AI (510(k), PCCP) **Education/Licensing/Certification:** Degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) **Experience (years and type):** Experience 0 to 3 years (internships, research, or projects count) **Travel Required (% of time):** Minimal, up to 10% **Physical Requirements \& Work Environment:** Standard remote office work Lumexa Imaging provides a competitive compensation program to attract, retain, and motivate a high\-performance workforce. Lumexa Imaging is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description: **About Marex** Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world's major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 2,300 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas. For more information visit https://www.marex.com/ Marex has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology\-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order\-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award\-winning data, insights and analytics. **Role Summary** The Technology Department, reporting to the CEO, delivers secure, scalable digital tools, software services, and infrastructure across all business units. Agile development teams align with specific business areas, while other teams handle enterprise\-wide IT operations, support, security, and architecture. The Data \& AI team drives productivity, compliance and insight through the firm's Data Lakehouse, enabling decentralized access to data, enhancing client experiences, promoting data\-driven decision\-making, and ensuring the efficient and auditable use of data in line with commercial terms and obligations. The team works closely with the Data Office, which defines enterprise data products, requirements and governance standards. Technology is responsible for engineering, delivering and operating the platforms and data solutions that enable those products. While the Data Office sits outside Technology, this role partners closely with both functions to deliver scalable, business\-aligned outcomes. We are seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and deliver performant data pipelines across the enterprise data platform, sourcing from diverse systems to power Business Intelligence and AI solutions. The role is accountable for the safe, reliable, and frequent delivery of production\-grade data pipelines, ensuring accurate, timely data across the business. Working closely with DataOps, AI Engineering, Analytics Engineering, the role combines strong hands\-on engineering with the judgement to translate governance, risk, and control requirements into scalable pipeline patterns, contributing to a culture of quality, automation, and operational excellence that supports delivery at the pace of the business. In addition, the role will collaborate closely with Data Modelers and Data Analysts in the Data Office to enable the delivery and implementation of enterprise data products in an iterative fashion. **Overall Responsibilities** * Design and implement data pipelines within Databricks, feeding data from diverse source systems for Business Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions * Design and evolve the Data Platform, applying Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) principles to ensure clean, reliable data progression * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data workloads within Databricks, enabling controlled, automated promotion across development, staging, and production environments * Apply test\-driven development practices to data pipelines, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing * Monitor and support existing data pipelines, implementing data quality checks and observability to maintain platform trust and stability * Perform data transformation within the firm's Databricks platform for Business Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions, applying advanced data modelling skills * Apply performance analysis and tuning to optimize pipeline efficiency and platform scalability * Apply software engineering and SDLC best practices consistently across data workloads * Build reusable pipeline components, templates, and patterns to support consistency and accelerate delivery * Ensure data security policies are applied appropriately across the data platform, supporting governance, risk, and control requirements * Support production readiness and contribute to post\-incident learning, feeding into continuous improvement of the platform's reliability and resilience * Ensuring compliance with the company's regulatory requirements under the FCA * Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with * Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integ aking * Strong hands\-on expertise with Databricks, Spark, and modern cloud technologies, with AWS experience highly valued * Advanced programming and data engineering skills, including Python, SQL, and the development of high\-performance data pipelines * Experience building and optimizing both real\-time and batch data processing solutions * A passion for engineering excellence, with a focus on automation, CI/CD, reliability, observability, and data quality * Experience working with large, complex datasets and delivering innovative solutions in dynamic, fast\-paced environments * Ability to navigate regulated environments while balancing business needs, governance, and risk requirements * Collaborative mindset with experience working in Agile teams and partnering across technology, operations, and business stakeholders **Skills and Experience** * Experience in financial services, with exposure to ETD and OTC derivatives markets preferred * Experience working with cloud platforms, including AWS and Azure * Hands\-on experience with data orchestration and transformation tools such as Apache Airflow, dbt, and Databricks Lakeflow * Strong experience with Databricks, including Asset Bundles for pipeline packaging and deployment * Infrastructure as Code (IaC) experience using Terraform or similar tools * Proficiency with Git\-based version control and DevOps tools (e.g., GitHub, Bitbucket) * Advanced use of developer productivity tools, including VS Code and AI\-assisted coding solutions * Experience supporting machine learning pipelines and model lifecycle management (MLOps) * Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional certification preferred **Salary Range: $180,000 to $210,000 per year and eligible for discretionary bonus** **Company Values** Acting as a role model for the values of the Company: **Respect** \- Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly. **Integrity** \- Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves. **Collaborative** \- We work in teams \- open and direct communication and the willingness to work hard and collaboratively are the basis for effective teamwork. Working well with others is necessary for us to succeed at what we do. **Developing our People** \- Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to “grow our own” and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers. **Adaptable and Nimble** \- Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client's various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non\-bureaucratic, but well controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction. **Conduct Rules** You must: * Act with integrity. * Act with due skill, care and diligence. * Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators (where applicable). * Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly. * Observe proper standard of market conduct. * Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers. Marex is fully committed to being an inclusive employer and providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Grow Your Career. Make a Difference. Join MDK.** At MDK, technology does more than support the work. It helps move our business and clients forward. We’re seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer who brings strong technical judgment, practical problem\-solving, and a commitment to building reliable solutions. In this role, you’ll develop, maintain, and modernize MDK’s legal case\-management platform. You’ll work across front\-end applications, back\-end services, integrations, and databases. You’ll also help shape technical solutions, improve system reliability, and mentor junior developers while partnering with business and technical teams. **A Culture of Collaboration, Growth, and Belonging** At MDK, a law firm built on purpose and progress, we believe people thrive when they feel respected, connected, and empowered to grow. Our culture is rooted in creativity, support, and open communication, where learning is continuous and every team member is encouraged to bring their whole self to work. We value diverse perspectives and foster belonging through cross\-team collaboration and employee\-led programs that reflect who we are. From wellness initiatives to community engagement, MDK is a place where people feel seen and supported. What makes MDK’s culture compelling: * Professional growth supported by regular one\-on\-one conversations with leaders * Flexibility and time off that prioritize real work\-life balance * Volunteer Time Off that connects employees with causes they care about * Inclusive programs like our Culture Council, affinity groups, book club and Art@MDK * A collaborative environment built on shared success and open feedback **Your Role in Action** * Design, develop, maintain, and improve software across MDK’s legal case\-management platform. * Build and support back\-end services, Web APIs, background processes, and responsive web applications using C\#, .NET, and modern front\-end technologies. * Design and optimize SQL Server databases, T\-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, indexes, and data models. * Integrate internal applications with third\-party systems through APIs, file exchanges, queues, and document\-automation tools. * Modernize established applications through practical, incremental improvements while maintaining production stability. * Improve automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, code\-quality controls, and repeatable deployment processes. * Monitor production performance, lead root\-cause analysis, and implement lasting solutions to system issues. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship through code reviews, design discussions, documentation, and collaboration with junior developers. * Partner with business and technical teams to understand needs, recommend practical solutions, and explain technical decisions clearly. * Support MDK’s mission, values, initiatives, and team goals through collaboration, accountability, and technical leadership. *The responsibilities defined above are not an all\-inclusive list, but a general summary of typical duties. Individuals in this position may be asked to perform a wide range of related tasks.* **Your Background \& Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum of 10 years of professional software development experience, including substantial full stack responsibility. * Deep experience with C\# and .NET, including .NET Framework and modern .NET technologies such as ASP.NET Core and Web API. * Strong front\-end development experience with Angular, React, or Vue, along with TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. * Advanced SQL Server and T\-SQL experience, including database design and performance tuning. * Hands\-on experience with Elasticsearch, including indexing, mappings, queries, aggregations, or observability use cases. * Experience with Git, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines, preferably in Azure DevOps. * Demonstrated ability to design solutions across multiple applications and translate business needs into workable technical plans. * Experience mentoring developers and improving team coding, design, testing, and documentation practices. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Demonstrated professionalism, sound judgment, integrity, and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information. * Strong collaboration and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to challenge existing approaches when appropriate and recommend practical solutions. * Experience with WPF, Azure services, Power BI, SSIS/SSRS, document automation, message queues, Playwright, or AI\-assisted development tools is preferred. **Your Work Style** Success in this role also comes from how you approach your work, decisions, and team. You: * Bring flexibility and adaptability, staying open to new ideas and better ways of working. * Approach complex problems with curiosity, sound judgment, and a desire to keep learning. * Take ownership of your work and remain effective when priorities or technical challenges change. * Collaborate openly, share knowledge, and provide constructive guidance to others. * Communicate respectfully, listen to different perspectives, and explain technical decisions clearly. **Your Schedule \& Benefits** Our team works Monday through Friday during general business hours. After a successful orientation period, we offer a hybrid schedule that provides flexibility to work both from home and in the office. MDK provides a comprehensive benefits package, which includes: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Company\-paid disability and life insurance * 401(k) plan with employer contribution * Paid time off We also offer additional ways to support your well\-being and growth, including: * Paid time to volunteer in the community * Paid holidays * Casual dress code * Opportunities for career development and advancement Please see more about our benefits on our website: www.mdklegal.com **Focused on Purpose. Driven by People.** Founded in 2002, MDK is a legal and professional services firm that supports the mortgage servicing and vacation ownership industries. With a coast\-to\-coast footprint, we deliver consistent, high\-quality support across the country. Our approach combines deep legal expertise, business insight, and innovative technology to help clients optimize operations, maintain compliance, and drive growth. We help clients solve complex challenges by blending legal insight with business strategy. That work starts with our people. When you join MDK, you become part of a team that’s creating uncommon paths to success—for our clients, for our colleagues, and for the future of legal services. **Ready to take the next step? Apply now to join Team MDK** Learn more about MDK by visiting www.mdklegal.com or visit us on LinkedIn or Instagram. MDK Legal and affiliates are Equal Opportunity Employers. We have a no tolerance policy for discrimination at our workplace. We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to all applicants. We respect everyone from fair wages to equal opportunities for growth and movement here at MDK.

jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Founded in 1969, Metro Sales Inc. built its reputation selling office supplies and equipment across the Twin Cities. Decades later, we've grown into one of the largest office technology and solutions providers in the Midwest. Build AI tools and internal software that support our Technicians, Service Desk, and Sales. Production work from your first weeks! You'll join a portfolio that is already in production, work with existing templates and build it into larger apps. * **AI and Claude enablement:** Read\-only MCP servers for N\-central, Huntress, SentinelOne, ThreatLocker, Avanan, IT Glue and FortiAnalyzer, plus a TypeScript server covering the full ConnectWise Manage API. Team workflow skills, small tools and staff workshop demos. New connectors start from our house template. * **Service desk AI:** Workflows that categorize and summarize new ConnectWise tickets, then search IT Glue and resolved tickets and write suggestions for the technician. * **Automation and data:** About 80 n8n workflows for FortiGate backups, upgrades and drift scoring, Teams onboarding notices, dashboards, and syncs between ConnectWise, N\-central, IT Glue and Pax8\. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details. **Job Summary:** The Red Team Analyst supports MUFG Red Team operations by executing adversary‑emulation activities focused on AI‑enabled technologies. This role is designed for early‑career professionals with a computer science background and practical coding experience, enabling them to develop offensive security skills while contributing to risk reduction across the enterprise. Under the direction of senior operators, the analyst participates in threat‑led assessments, AI security testing, and purple team exercises, helping identify how real‑world adversaries could exploit application logic, automation pipelines, and AI‑assisted capabilities. **Primary Responsibilities:** Adversary Emulation \& Testing Support * Participate in Red Team missions designed to simulate real‑world attacker behavior against MUFG applications and platforms. * Execute assigned activities during: + adversary simulation and emulation (ASE) + assumed‑breach scenarios + purple team and control‑validation exercises * Safely conduct testing activities aligned to approved scopes, deconfliction requirements, and operational guardrails. AI \& Automation Workflow Testing * Support adversarial testing of AI‑enabled capabilities, including: + prompt injection and misuse scenarios + unintended data access or disclosure via AI tools + bypass of AI guardrails and safety controls * Assist in assessing AI‑assisted developer tools, copilots, and automation platforms. * Help evaluate how AI interacts with identity, permissions, APIs, and data sources. Tooling \& Research * Research emerging attacker techniques targeting: + modern application stacks + CI/CD and developer tooling + AI/LLM systems * Contribute to Red Team playbooks, test cases, and repeatable workflows. * Support senior operators in engagement reporting and evidence collection. * Participate in post‑engagement discussions with defensive and engineering teams. * Develop and operationalize custom ML/LLM models for cybersecurity use cases * Advance preventative, detective, and responsive security controls through applied AI innovation * Evaluate emerging AI capabilities for cybersecurity and mature predictive, proactive threat response **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * Demonstrated experience through internships, co‑ops, academic projects, or personal work. * Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn adversarial thinking. * Hands\-on experience with agentic AI, LLMs, and custom ML model development * Proficiency with open\-source AI frameworks and tooling (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, SageMaker) **Preferred Qualifications:** * Familiarity with: + REST APIs, OAuth/OIDC, JWT + CI/CD pipelines or DevOps tooling * Hands‑on experience using or experimenting with AI/LLM tools or prompt‑driven workflows. * Familiarity with enterprise cloud AI platforms (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, or GCP Vertex AI) **Other:** * As per MUFG’s work policy for all personnel, candidates must work onsite for 4 days and 1 day remotely. * The typical base pay range for this role is between $80K \- $100K depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Healthcare quality is complex. Medisolv helps make it manageable — and actionable. We partner with hospitals, health systems, ACOs, and payers to bring clarity to quality data, connecting clinical and claims information into a single, reliable view. More than 1,800 organizations and 130M\+ patient records rely on Medisolv to measure, report, and improve performance across 500\+ measures tied to CMS, The Joint Commission, and other programs. With support from Bessemer Venture Partners Forge, we're continuing to grow our platform and expand our impact — investing in advanced analytics, AI, and new capabilities that help healthcare organizations stay ahead of change and improve outcomes with confidence. Reporting to Director of AI \& Data Engineering, we are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our team. **About the Role** The Senior Data Engineer will provide hands\-on technical leadership for Medisolv's healthcare data platform and customer implementations. You will design, build, and operate reliable data products that transform payer and quality data into trusted measure calculations, forecasts, and decision\-ready insights. This is a senior individual\-contributor role with broad ownership across Snowflake, dbt, orchestration, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, data quality, and production operations. You will partner closely with product, domain experts, application engineers, security, and client\-facing teams while helping the engineering team establish scalable patterns and sound technical decisions. **What You'll Do** * Own the design and evolution of scalable Snowflake and dbt data models supporting healthcare quality measurement, forecasting, reporting, and customer\-specific workflows. * Lead complex ingestion and connector implementations for claims, enrollment, eligibility, pharmacy, survey, plan, and reference data delivered through SFTP, object storage, data shares, and APIs. * Set engineering patterns for orchestration, incremental processing, dependency management, reruns, reconciliation, and production support across Airflow and related workflows. * Drive cloud modernization work across AWS and Azure, including Terraform\-based infrastructure, secure connectivity, secrets management, environment promotion, and operational readiness. * Strengthen CI/CD and release practices using GitHub Actions and related tooling, with automated tests, security checks, observability, and controlled production deployment. * Translate healthcare quality requirements into maintainable technical designs, partnering with domain experts on CMS Star Ratings, HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS, PQA, measure calculations, and scenario modeling. * Investigate complex data and platform issues, lead root\-cause analysis, and implement durable improvements to reliability, performance, cost, and data trust. * Provide technical mentorship through architecture reviews, pull\-request feedback, documentation, and reusable patterns without direct people\-management responsibility. * Collaborate with product, client delivery, security, and engineering leaders to scope work, surface dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver against customer commitments. **What You'll Accomplish — Your Performance Objectives** **In your first 30 days, you will:** * Build working knowledge of the Lilac platform, healthcare\-quality domain, Snowflake/dbt model layers, orchestration, cloud environments, release processes, and active customer commitments. * Partner with engineering and domain leads to map critical data flows from ingestion through measure calculation, forecasting, reporting, and application consumption. * Review current architecture, operational risks, and the AWS\-to\-Azure migration plan; complete an initial production\-support shadowing cycle. **In your first 60 days, you will:** * Assume technical ownership of a meaningful data\-platform or customer\-integration workstream, including design, implementation plan, tests, observability, and rollout criteria. * Deliver or materially advance a production\-ready Snowflake/dbt, ingestion, or cloud\-infrastructure enhancement with measurable quality or reliability outcomes. * Establish clear design and review practices for the workstream and mentor teammates through code, model, and infrastructure reviews. **In your first 90 days, you will:** * Independently lead a cross\-functional delivery from requirements through production validation, including dependency management, data reconciliation, release coordination, and post\-release monitoring. * Recommend and begin implementing prioritized improvements to scalability, test coverage, operational resilience, security, or cloud portability. * Be a trusted technical owner for a core platform area and a reliable partner for healthcare\-domain, product, and customer\-delivery stakeholders. **Who We're Looking For — The Competencies That Matter** **Required** * Substantial professional experience building and operating production data platforms, with senior\-level ownership of architecture, delivery, and operational outcomes. * Advanced SQL and data\-modeling expertise, including hands\-on production experience with Snowflake and dbt or closely comparable modern cloud\-warehouse tooling. * Experience designing robust batch data pipelines and ingestion frameworks, including schema mapping, incremental processing, testing, reconciliation, and failure recovery. * Strong software engineering skills in Python or another production language, with disciplined version control, code review, automated testing, and documentation practices. * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD, including Terraform and GitHub Actions or comparable tools. * Experience operating across AWS and/or Azure, with practical knowledge of networking, identity, secrets, object storage, monitoring, and secure environment design. * Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical work across engineering, product, domain, security, and client\-facing stakeholders. * Commitment to secure handling of regulated healthcare data, least\-privilege access, auditability, and production reliability. **Strongly Preferred** * Healthcare payer data experience, especially Medicare Advantage, CMS Star Ratings, HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS, PQA, claims, enrollment, eligibility, pharmacy, or quality\-measure calculations. * Experience with Apache Airflow or comparable orchestration and with targeted reruns, backfills, data\-quality monitoring, and production incident response. * Experience migrating data platforms or containerized workloads from AWS to Azure, including Azure App Service, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Private Link, or Azure DevOps Pipelines. * Experience with forecasting, What\-If/scenario modeling, financial or reward calculations, semantic models, or customer\-specific analytics products. * Experience with Go/Golang, OIDC/SAML/RBAC, Cognito or enterprise identity integrations, Sigma, or Snowflake\-native analytics capabilities. **What You Bring — Professional Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, data science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Professional certifications in Snowflake, dbt, AWS, Azure, or Terraform are helpful but not required. * Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment under operational pressure, and the ability to make complex technical tradeoffs understandable. **How to Be a Medisolver — Our Values** * Customer Success Obsession * All\-Star Team Collaboration * Continuous Improvement through Curiosity \& Data\-Driven Learning * Courage with Kindness * Execution Focus — We Do Business, Not Just Talk Business *Medisolv is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that diversity drives innovation, and we are dedicated to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued and respected.* *All candidates must successfully pass a pre\-employment background check and be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship is not available. This is a U.S.\-based/onshore role supporting work with regulated and PHI\-sensitive healthcare data.*
