jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **America is strongest when ability can rise** The right person can change the trajectory of a team, a company, or an entire field. Yet most hiring still filters on what is easiest to read: the right degree, the right employer, the right network. Those are poor proxies for what someone can actually do. When they miss real ability, a company loses performance and an idea goes unbuilt. MeritFirst builds objective, efficient ways for people to demonstrate critical thinking, problem\-solving, adaptability, and execution, so companies can hire on demonstrated ability rather than pedigree. For the worker, that means upward mobility. For the company, better performance. At scale, national growth. **The role** Our product has to produce a signal that deserves to influence real decisions about people. Candidates need to trust that they got a fair chance to show what they can do. Employers need to trust that the signal predicts performance better than the credentials they already use. Earning both takes careful product judgment, rigorous measurement, and software that is reliable and explainable. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own major parts of that system end to end, from the candidate experience and assessment engine to employer workflows and evaluation. You will join a small team and work directly with our founder, candidates, and customers. Roadmaps here do not arrive fully specified. You'll decide what should exist, ship the first version, watch how it behaves, and improve it quickly. You will also make the engineers around you better through the systems you architect and the code you review. We use AI heavily. However, if you can't reason about and explain each line of your code, your work isn't ready. Our standard is a system we understand, can explain, test, and trust. **What we're working on** * Hands\-on challenges that show how candidates work with AI * Voice and video interviews * Scoring that employers can audit and candidates can trust * Integrations with the hiring tools employers already use Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Postgres, and Vercel. Engineering team size: 3\. Location: onsite in Austin, Texas. **What you'll do** * **Own an area end to end.** Early on, you'll take on one of our highest\-leverage product areas: its design, code, production health, and roadmap. * **Lead technical design.** Turn ambiguous problems into written designs, make the tradeoffs explicit, and align the team before the big work starts. * **Build evaluation worth trusting.** Make results consistent, auditable, and hard to game. Use AI where it measurably helps, and build the evals that prove it. * **Close the learning loop.** Connect assessment results, employer decisions, and on\-the\-job outcomes so the product gets more predictive over time. * **Treat trust as a technical requirement.** Reliability, security, and privacy are product properties from day one. * **Raise the bar.** Give code reviews that teach, mentor other engineers, and help hire the people who join next. **You'll thrive here if you** * Have led the design and delivery of significant production systems, and operated them long enough to live with your decisions. * Have deep expertise in one part of the stack and can work across the rest. * Debug relentlessly: form hypotheses, follow evidence, and dig beneath frameworks and libraries until you understand the issue. * Know when to build the simplest thing that works vs. when to invest in a foundation. * Have built software before LLMs and treat AI\-written code like code from a stranger. * Have made other engineers better through design review, code review, or mentorship. * Communicate clearly, disagree directly, and can explain a technical tradeoff to a non\-engineer. **This probably isn't the role if you** * Want requirements and architecture fully specified before you start. * Want to lead others without staying hands\-on in the code. * Love building something new but lose interest in maintaining what you ship. * Want a predictable 9\-to\-5\. * Are more excited by the idea of meritocracy, or by AI hype, than by the hard work of building something people can trust. **How we hire** Our process tests demonstrated ability, not pedigree or interview polish. Some steps may be with AI and some without. We want to see your foundations, how you reason, and how you use modern tools without giving up judgment. Along the way, you'll use the MeritFirst product yourself.

jobs.title: Advanced Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Title: Advanced Quality Engineer** **Reports to: Senior Advanced Quality Engineer** **Location: Spartanburg, SC** **People First. Safety is the Foundation.** At Motus, we launch complex automotive products into production environments where failure is not an option. We are preparing for the largest and most complex launch in our company’s history, where execution, precision, and quality will define success—and be highly visible across our organization and customer base. Every launch is a commitment: quality is built into the process through disciplined Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), not inspected at the end. We are seeking an Advanced Quality Engineer (AQE) with deep experience in new product development (NPD), APQP, and PPAP who thrives in high\-velocity automotive manufacturing environments. This role sits at the center of execution—where engineering, manufacturing, supplier quality, and customer requirements (CSR) converge. This is not a support role. This is a launch ownership role. If you are energized by accountability, cross\-functional leadership, and solving problems before they impact the customer, this is where you will stand out. **What You’ll Own** As the Advanced Quality Engineer (APQP Lead), you will own end\-to\-end quality execution from concept through Start of Production (SOP)—ensuring compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, and customer\-specific requirements (CSR). You are accountable for launch readiness, PPAP success, and zero\-surprise execution. You will: * Own APQP execution across all phases of new product development (NPD) * Serve as the primary quality interface with customers (OEMs) and suppliers (Tier 1 / Tier 2\) * Drive PPAP readiness, submission, and approval (Level 3 / Level 5\) * Lead development and validation of DFMEA, PFMEA, Process Flow Diagrams, and Control Plans * Ensure AIAG Core Tools are applied with rigor—not as a checkbox exercise **What Success Looks Like** * First\-pass PPAP approvals—no rework, no surprises * Flawless launch execution with no late\-stage quality escapes * All APQP deliverables complete and validated prior to SOP * Suppliers that are truly capable—not just document\-ready * Strong confidence from customers and internal leadership **How You’ll Make an Impact** In a high\-pressure, high\-visibility launch environment, you will: * Lead production buyoffs, Run at Rate, and PSO (Process Sign\-Off) with customers * Drive root cause analysis (RCA) using 8D, 5 Whys, and structured problem solving * Own corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and eliminate repeat issues * Ensure MSA, Gage R\&R, and fixture validation are completed and capable * Apply SPC and capability analysis (Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk) to validate process performance * Partner with manufacturing and engineering to identify and eliminate risk before SOP * Drive supplier APQP and PPAP readiness, holding the supply base accountable * Act as escalation point for quality issues, customer concerns, and CSR requirements **What You Bring (Required Minimum Skills / Experience):** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, or related field * 3\+ years of experience in automotive quality engineering / manufacturing quality * Proven ownership of: + APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) + PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) + AIAG Core Tools (FMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA) * Strong working knowledge of IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 QMS * Experience with: + SPC (Statistical Process Control) + MSA / Gage R\&R + Capability analysis (Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk) * Proficiency in GD\&T and blueprint interpretation * Demonstrated success leading 8D problem solving and root cause analysis (RCA) * Ability to manage multiple NPD / launch programs simultaneously * Strong communication skills with customers, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams * Willingness to travel up to 20% **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in automotive Tier 1 / Tier 2 manufacturing environments * Familiarity with OEM requirements (BMW, Ford, GM, Stellantis, etc.) * Experience with customer portals, CSRs, and launch systems * Certification in IATF 16949 or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) **Why This Role Matters** This is a launch\-critical Advanced Quality Engineering role, not a maintenance or audit position. Your work directly determines whether programs: * Launch on time * Meet customer expectations * Perform in the field You won’t be measured by activity; you’ll be measured by outcomes. When you own the launch, quality follows. And in this role**,** failure is not an option. **\#AdvancedQualityEngineer \#AutomotiveQuality \#Tier1Supplier \#APQP \#PPAP \#FMEA \#IATF16949 \#8D \#RootCauseAnalysis \#NewProductIntroduction \#ManufacturingQuality \#HiringNow \#MotusIntegrated** **Who We Are** Motus Integrated Technologies is a dynamic global leader in manufacturing high\-quality headliners, and interior trim solution products for the automotive industry. Headquartered in Holland, Michigan, Motus operates advanced manufacturing facilities across North America (U.S. and Mexico) and maintains a global presence with 5 locations. Motus is part of the Atlas Holdings portfolio, an industrial holding company based in Greenwich, Connecticut. Motus offers a vibrant working environment where innovation and forward\-thinking are at the forefront of what we do. generation (RAG), including document processing, embeddings, search and the quality of information supplied to models. * Integrate and maintain models such as Qwen for vision and Gemma for answer generation, including local deployment on Apple silicon. * Work with our application developers on Apple Intelligence and the Foundation Models framework. * Develop Model Context Protocol (MCP) and API integrations for customer\-facing services such as flight schedules, fare search and booking workflows, using authoritative business systems for current information. * Create repeatable evaluations, investigate incorrect answers and integration failures, and improve accuracy, response time and reliability. * Document your work and build maintainable systems with appropriate security, privacy and monitoring. **What we are looking for** * Demonstrated ability to build working software, including an LLM application, retrieval system, AI integration or substantial related project. * Collaborate with industry leaders, general contractors, and trade partners to turn visionary builds into operational excellence. Be part of a team that is setting the standard for AI infrastructure, developing a flawless and scalable environment for ground breaking technology! **What you'll be doing:** * Assess modular deployment solutions from top providers, ensuring they align with DSX scalable deployment units. Conduct factory and site reviews, monitor installation quality, and drive correction of deficiencies. * Coordinate liquid\-cooling interfaces from facility water systems through coolant distribution units (CDUs), technology cooling loops, manifolds, and rack connections, ensuring compatibility and reliability. * Coordinate power distribution interfaces, working with electrical specialists on capacity, redundancy, grounding, and protection to ensure systems are ready for AI workload changes. * Integrate building management systems (BMS), electrical power monitoring systems (EPMS), and equipment controls, ensuring systems respond accurately during normal operation and recovery. * Evaluate commissioning requirements with commissioning authorities, contractors, and OEMs, reviewing scripts, prerequisites, and evidence before acceptance. Manage factory\-to\-site module connections, support handover of as\-built records, O\&M manuals, and operator training, turning deployment lessons into DSX reference architectures. * **What we need to see:** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 12\+ years of progressively responsible MEP coordination, construction delivery, systems integration, or commissioning experience, including data centers or comparable critical facilities. * Experience as a general contractor MEP coordinator or MEP manager, coordinating multiple trades from preconstruction through turnover. * Hands\-on knowledge of liquid cooling systems for high\-density AI racks, encompassing CDUs and hydraulic connections. * Practical understanding of data center electrical distribution, UPS and backup power, and coordination between electrical and mechanical systems. * Understanding of controls integration, BMS and EPMS, and system failover. * Direct experience supporting Level 1 through Level 5 commissioning, including reviewing test scripts. * Ability to interpret MEP drawings, electrical one\-line diagrams, and coordinated BIM models. * Practical understanding of relevant building, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection standards. NVIDIA is hiring world class Software Engineers with AI Compiler and distributed systems experience for its Deep Learning Compiler Technology team. The team builds JaxPP, NVIDIA's open\-source library for pipeline parallelism in JAX. JaxPP turns a JAX training program into per\-stage tasks and runs them across many GPUs. With it, very large models can be trained on NVIDIA GPU clusters using unmodified JAX and XLA. Join the team that is developing advanced compiler and runtime technology for the entire deep learning community. **What you'll be doing:** * Design and implement program transformations on JAX programs (jaxpr) for large\-scale training, on top of unmodified JAX and XLA: pipeline schedules, placement of tasks across stages, sharding (including JAX explicit sharding), and overlap of communication with computation. * Develop technologies and products involving optimizing compilers and runtime execution frameworks for accelerating deep learning training on large scale distributed systems. * Work on compiling a graph intermediate representation (IR) to target specific code, and build the distributed runtime that dispatches per\-stage programs to many GPUs and moves data between stages through communication libraries such as NCCL. * Contribute to advancing the state of the art in compiler technology for delivering high performance on large\-scale training workloads, including mixture\-of\-experts models. * Collaborate with members of the software framework teams (for example JAX and XLA) and the hardware architecture teams to accelerate the next generation of deep learning software, and work on integrating JaxPP into JAX training frameworks, including MaxText. Strong communication skills are required, including working directly with engineers at partner companies to debug and tune large training runs, along with the ability to work in a dynamic product\-oriented team. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Experience with JAX internals (jaxpr, tracing, sharding, shard\_map), or with XLA, StableHLO, or MLIR. * Experience building or tuning large training jobs with pipeline, tensor, expert, and data parallelism, for example in MaxText or Megatron\-LM, and debugging their performance on large GPU clusters. * Knowledge of GPU communication libraries such as NCCL, NVSHMEM, or RDMA, and of CPU and/or GPU architecture. jobs.title: Software Engineer 5 - Android (DVX Mobile Core)
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. The DVX Mobile Core team is responsible for developing and advancing the architecture of our member app for Android . We aim to leverage the systems and infrastructure that is broadly available at Netflix and figure out the best ways to adopt and apply it on Android. The Core team works with a wide range of engineering groups within the company to enable easier and more efficient patterns and canvases to be deployed to our members. Some of these changes are purely engineering\-based, for example to improve key user metrics, while others serve to adopt cleaner development patterns for downstream product engineering. We are part of a global, diverse organization that includes people of all genders, sexual orientations, upbringings, nationalities, ages, and socioeconomic \& educational backgrounds. We encourage engineers passionate about building well\-structured mobile experiences to apply. What this role is: * You'll own major, multi\-quarter initiatives that make other engineers faster and more confident. Today, that work falls into four themes: * Architecture. Product teams duplicate effort and step on each other. You'll help build coherent, reusable architecture, including server\-driven UI, a data\-centric approach to app development, modularization, and unidirectional state flow, so teams can move independently at scale. * Quality. Regressions are too easy to ship and too hard to see. You'll help make quality measurable through testing, trusted telemetry, and clear reliability standards in a high\-commit\-volume codebase. * Player. Product teams should spend their time on differentiated viewing experiences, not plumbing. You'll help deliver a reliable, extensible player framework they can build on. Innovation. Engineering across Mobile can move faster. You'll turn emerging technologies, including AI, into practical tools that accelerate it. * What you'll do: * Own outcomes end to end * Take ambiguous problems from idea to adoption: define scope, design the solution, document key trade\-offs, deliver, and measure whether it worked. * Influence technical roadmaps and drive forward\-looking technical solutions with minimal supervision. * Run projects like an owner: break work into milestones, surface risk early and manage cross\-team dependencies. * Ship the pragmatic solution and change course when the evidence says so. * Build what others build on * Design and build UI infrastructure and architecture that make the right way the easy way. * Write the documentation and migration paths that let other teams adopt your work without you in the room. * Raise the quality bar with testable code, automated tests (JVM unit, Espresso, Paparazzi bitmap diffs), and telemetry that make regressions visible. * Elevate the people around you * Treat engineers as your customers. Understand their use cases, and let them shape the solution. * Mentor less\-experienced engineers and help set the technical bar for the team. Track emerging Android technologies, and turn the promising ones into real tools and modernized code. * You're likely a fit if you have: * Owned something big. You've led a multi\-month, cross\-team technical initiative from ambiguity to adoption, and you can tell us how you scoped it, planned it, and measured its impact. * Driven your own agenda. You've spotted a problem nobody assigned you, built the case, and delivered the fix. * Run projects with discipline. You have a record of delivering in milestones, early risk communication, and delivering results. * Deep Android expertise. You're strong in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, and you've applied architecture patterns (MVVM, unidirectional flow, modularization) in a large codebase. You can work in Java and GraphQL when needed. * Practical judgment. You weigh business, user, and architectural trade\-offs, and you know when good enough is right. * Clear communication. You build trust across product, design, and engineering by being curious, direct, and selfless. Bonus: server\-driven UI, Circuit, Paparazzi, media playback or player frameworks, telemetry and reliability engineering, or AI\-assisted development workflows. * Why this role: * A rare moment. You'll help lay the mobile foundation for one of the world's most\-used entertainment apps. * Leverage. One good framework multiplies the output of 100\+ engineers and reaches hundreds of millions of members. * Real ownership. You'll get the business context you need and decide scope, design, and trade\-offs. * Hard problems, good people. You'll work with talented peers across a wide range of devices and network conditions, in a culture of open communication where you value others' opinions to cover your blind spots. * A high\-performance culture. If you've read about Netflix's culture and think you'd thrive in it, we'd like to talk. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $388,000\.00 \- $558,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, Records Platform (T3\)** **About Neumo** Neumo builds the cloud software that powers government. More than 4,500 state, local and federal agencies across North America run on our platforms, processing over 900 million transactions and collecting $44 billion in revenue for the communities they serve. jobs.title: AI Security Engineer, Defensive Automation
jobs.description: **About Norm Ai** Norm Ai, the agentic law company, has a client base with a combined $30 trillion in assets under management. Norm Ai pioneered Legal Engineering, the process that empowers lawyers to build and supervise domain\-specific AI agents with Norm’s proprietary suite of no\-code software tools. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end\-to\-end. We look for practical, hands\-on experience, not theoretical familiarity. **This Role:** -------------- We’re hiring AI Security Engineers to build automated, AI\-driven systems that find, prioritize, and fix security weaknesses faster than attackers can exploit them. You’ll work across the full lifecycle, from discovery and threat modeling through remediation and response, and go deep in either offensive research or defensive operations based on your strengths. You’ll report to the Chief Security Officer and work closely with Engineering. **What You’ll Do:** ------------------- ### **Across the Role** * **Build defensive automation:** Design, build, and improve AI\-driven security tooling, with the testing, safeguards, and human oversight you’d expect of production systems. * **Threat\-model:** Assess new and existing systems for risk, and use those models to decide where detection and remediation effort goes. * **Respond to incidents:** Join the response rotation for critical vulnerabilities and security events, from assessing exposure through remediation. * **Measure and communicate:** Track how well our security work is performing, and explain risks and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. ### **Research Focus** * **Find unknown weaknesses:** Proactively hunt for previously unknown weaknesses using both automated and manual techniques, in a safe and controlled way. * **Validate findings:** Confirm and reproduce findings, and feed what you learn back into the automation to make it better. ### **Operations Focus** * **Run vulnerability management at scale:** Triage, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities, automating as much of the process as you can. * **Turn threat information into priorities:** Bring threat intelligence and external advisories into decisions about what gets fixed first. **What We’re Looking For:** --------------------------- ### **Core Qualifications** * Strong software engineering skills, with production code in at least one modern language * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs or AI agents * Solid application security and cloud security fundamentals * Experience running threat models * Calm, structured judgment during incidents ### **Deep Expertise in at Least One Area** * **Research:** Vulnerability research, offensive security or red teaming, exploit development, CVE credits, or bug bounty work * **Operations:** Vulnerability management at scale, detection and response, security automation, or software supply\-chain security ### **Nice to Haves** * Threat intelligence experience * Experience in highly regulated industries * Experience securing multi\-tenant SaaS **Compensation and Benefits:** ------------------------------ **Base Salary**: $155,000 to $215,000 per year The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. **Equity:** Included **Benefits:** 401(k) with employer match, health, dental, vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, free lunch in office daily, employee referral bonus program **Relocation:** Financial support to ease your move to New York City, designed to make the transition smooth and stress\-free. **Location / Office Requirement:** Washington, DC (preferred), New York City **Work model:** Hybrid **Travel expectation:** Travel to NYC headquarters at least once per quarter To learn more about Norm Ai, visit our **website**.

jobs.title: Compiler Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Normal Computing \| Build with Us** ------------------------------------- Normal is an applied AI company solving the hardest problems in AI and silicon. We build foundational hardware and software for the semiconductor industry, critical AI infrastructure, and the broader systems that power our world, in partnership with the world's most advanced institutions. We work as one team across New York City, Silicon Valley (Mountain View), and London. **The Role** ------------ Normal's hardware runs the most memory\-bound parts of large\-model inference inside memory itself, rather than shuttling weights to a processor. The software that makes this programmable doesn't exist yet in any standard form. Getting a model correct on that hardware is the frontend's job; making it fast is yours. Our hardware does not look like a CPU or GPU, so its compiler backend can't be borrowed from one. As a Compiler Engineer focused on the backend, you will help design and build the custom compilation that maps LLM inference onto it, from scheduling and memory planning to the code our hardware actually executes. You will work at the boundary between the compiler and the hardware, closely enough to know when an optimization belongs at a different layer, or when the right answer is a new abstraction. Our chip is pre\-silicon, so you will measure your work against our simulators and FPGA prototypes first, and against silicon as it arrives. **What You Will Own** --------------------- * **Code Generation**: Build the passes that turn lowered programs into the code our hardware executes, designing new compilation approaches where conventional ones don't fit. Success means correct, efficient code for every operation our models need. * **Scheduling and Memory Planning**: Own how work and data are scheduled and placed across our hardware's resources, measured by utilization and end\-to\-end latency on LLM inference. * **Fusion and Dispatch**: Own fusion and dispatch decisions for LLM inference, so the hardware spends its time computing rather than moving data. * **Hardware Co\-Design**: Work the abstraction layer between the compiler and the hardware, and feed compiler constraints back to our hardware architects while the design can still change. * **Profiling and Validation**: Validate every optimization with measured results from simulators, FPGA prototypes, and then silicon, and maintain a performance regression suite the team trusts. * **Cross\-Team Handoffs**: Take lowered programs from our frontend compiler engineers, and decide with the team which operations the compiler generates and which use hand\-tuned kernels. **What Makes You a Great Fit** ------------------------------ * Deep experience with compiler optimization or code generation for accelerators or other non\-CPU targets: scheduling, tiling, fusion, or resource allocation * Comfort working close to hardware: you think in terms of memory bandwidth and utilization as well as asymptotic complexity * Willingness to design compilation approaches from first principles when existing ones don't fit the hardware * Track record of shipping optimizations that moved a measured performance number * Comfort building software for hardware that is still evolving, from simulation through bring\-up * Fluency in Python, and familiarity with C, C\+\+, or Rust **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Experience with PyTorch's compilation stack (TorchDynamo, FX, Inductor, torch.export) or other ML compilers, such as IREE, TVM, or XLA * Experience compiling for in\-memory, spatial, or other non\-von\-Neumann compute targets * Background in hardware design tools such as logic synthesis or place\-and\-route * Experience building or using cycle\-level or performance simulators to guide optimization decisions * Contributions to open\-source compiler or kernel infrastructure (e.g., PyTorch, Triton, TVM, MLIR, LLVM) * Publishing or presenting compiler or performance work at venues such as MLSys, ASPLOS, or CGO ***Equal Employment Opportunity Statement*** *Normal Computing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.* ***Accessibility Accommodations*** *Normal Computing is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@normalcomputing.com.* ***Privacy Notice*** *By submitting your application, you agree that Normal Computing may collect, use, and store your personal information for employment\-related purposes in accordance with our* *Applicant Privacy Notice**.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Orb:** We're a team that cares deeply about the work, the people we do it with, and the customers we do it for. Our values, *customer centricity, minutes matter, run with it, attention to detail, and go further together* are at the core of everything we do. **About the role:** As a member of the infrastructure team, you'll play a key role in maintaining a high bar for reliability. Our customers depend on our systems being operational, as downtime can directly lead to lost revenue. You'll be responsible for the infrastructure powering the entire product, from event ingestion, API services, alerting, invoicing, and everything in between. **In this role, you will:** * Lead infrastructure resiliency efforts \- recovery mechanisms, tenant isolation, load spike handling, etc * Improve observability and operability of our systems * Build performance\-critical, user\-facing infrastructure (e.g. real\-time event processing) * Plan scaling initiatives to handle large customer growth * Partner with other engineering teams to ensure we build reliable product features * Learn from a talented peer group, and share your expertise **About you:** * You think deeply about edge cases, failure modes, bottlenecks, etc * You have a knack for investigating and debugging tricky errors and performance issues * You enjoy building scalable infrastructure for a high\-growth product * You can effectively mentor fellow engineers on best practices (observability, rollout strategies, risk mitigation, etc) * You have 9\+ years of experience in software engineering, and you've worked in in the infrastructure domain for 2\+ years **Orb's Tech Stack:** At Orb, we believe great engineers can learn any stack, so you do not need experience with these specific tools and we encourage you to apply regardless. * **Frontend:** Typescript \+ React \+ Tailwind CSS * **Backend:** Python * **Datastores:** PostgreSQL \+ Clickhouse * **Streaming Platforms:** Kafka \+ Spark Streaming * **Cloud Platform:** AWS **Why Adyen x Orb?** This is an exceptional opportunity to join a solid, established company with a startup mindset, characterized by small teams, direct communication, and work on important challenges. jobs.description: Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design: –Build and design fault\-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. –Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. –Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load\-shedding, throttling, and rate\-limiting. –Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Performance: –Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. –Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health.. System Design \& Architecture \- Correctness / Availability: –Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. –Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault\-injection, brown\-out) to evaluate system correctness. –Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. Operational Troubleshooting \& Incident Management: –Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. –Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. –Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. –Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. –Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. Compliance \& Security: –Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi\-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. –Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. –Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. Automation \& Change Management: –Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. –Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. Core Responsibilities Planning \& Execution: –Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately\-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. Collaboration \& Partnership: –Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. Problem Solving: –Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. Continuous Learning: –Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. Continuous Improvement: –Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. Performance and Development: –Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agent Delivery
jobs.description: **About Pallet** Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We've raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end\-to\-end visibility, and control. As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting\-edge AI capabilities, we're positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy. Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology. **$135,000 \- $180,000** *Full\-time / Onsite (5 days/week)* **About The Role** We're hiring a Software Engineer, Agent Delivery to deploy production AI agents inside some of the world's largest supply chain companies. You'll work directly with customer operators, engineers, and executives to understand how critical workflows actually run. Then you'll design integrations, debug production systems, and ship AI\-powered workflows into environments that are often undocumented, fragmented, and business\-critical. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer operations. You'll own deployments from initial discovery through production launch, spending time with customers both remotely and onsite, solving complex operational problems and turning those solutions into reusable product capabilities. Success in this role is measured by outcomes: can you get systems live, make them reliable, and solve problems in environments you don't fully control? Every deployment teaches us something new about how supply chain companies operate. The patterns you uncover become product features, and what you solve for one customer often becomes a capability we ship across the platform. **The impact you will have** * Lead high\-impact customer deployments from problem definition through production, designing, prototyping, building, and deploying AI agents and workflows that change how work gets done and run reliably at scale. * Embed in customer workflows and build relationships from ICs and operators up to executives, turning messy business requirements into clear technical solutions that solve the underlying problem, not just the first request. * Make design decisions across agent behavior, application logic, data, evals, security, and reliability, and set the patterns for how Pallet agents are deployed in production. * Connect Pallet agents to the systems, APIs, and data customers already rely on, working directly with their engineering and ops teams to get around technical constraints. * Stay accountable after launch by debugging failures, evaluating and improving agent quality, and working with Engineering and Product to clear anything blocking a successful deployment. * Turn what you learn in the field into reusable agents, integrations, evals, and frameworks, and bring recurring needs and product gaps back to Product and Engineering to shape the core platform. **Who You Are** * 1\+ years of experience building and owning production systems in high\-growth startups or similarly demanding environments. * Strong experience working with APIs, integrations, authentication systems, and event\-driven architectures. * Proven ability to debug complex systems in production. * Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments where documentation is incomplete, and requirements evolve quickly. * Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience working directly with customers is a strong plus **Our Tech Stack** * Backend: Node \+ TypeScript on Encore.dev. Event\-driven design with message passing and queues. Hosted on GCP * Database: PostgreSQL * LLMs: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google for foundation models; fine\-tuned models on Vertex AI * Browser Automation: Playwright * Frontend: Next.js \+ React \+ TypeScript. Hosted on Vercel * Observability: Datadog for logging and metrics **Location:** New York, Flatiron, 5 days a week The estimated salary range for this role is $135,000–$180,000, depending on experience and skill set. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and growth opportunities. Final compensation will be determined based on a combination of factors, including experience, qualifications, and location. **Our Benefits** We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously. * Health, Vision, and Dental benefits * ️ Take\-what\-you\-need Paid Vacation * ➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance ❤️‍* Short\-Term Disability Coverage * Generous salary and equity for all staff * 401k option; helping you save for the future ‍‍‍* Paid parental leave to support growing families * Yearly learning and development stipend * Commuter benefits for Bay Area and New York employees * Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office * Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space for remote employees * Free professional headshot * Daily catered lunches and dinners provided in office * Complimentary On\-Site Gym: Our SF office has a fully equipped gym * ✈️ Onboarding trip to one of our offices if you work remotely * Monthly happy hours Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA **Workplace Policy** We are an in\-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other. Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us. **Equal Opportunity** Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring. **Candidate Privacy Notice** Please review Pallet's Candidate Privacy Notice here. **Accommodations** Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please contact us at **recruiting@pallet.com**.

We believe that diverse teams build better products. * **Learning Opportunities:** You'll grow your skills through close mentorship from senior engineers and a clearly defined engineering career pathway. * **Modern Technology:** Gain hands\-on experience with modern web application stacks, cloud technologies like AWS, and observability and CI/CD tools. ### **What You'll Work On** * Develop and maintain infrastructure as code, including writing, testing, and deploying new Terraform modules to manage production cloud resources on AWS, including EC2, S3, IAM, and VPC * Enhance our CI/CD pipelines using industry\-standard tools like Jenkins * Build new dashboards and set up monitoring with Datadog to ensure the health and performance of key applications. * Write and maintain automation scripts in Python or Bash to streamline routine operational tasks. * Work with containerization technologies and concepts using Docker * Use AI\-assisted coding tools as part of your everyday workflow to write, test, and review code more effectively * Participate in sprint ceremonies and deliver assigned sprint work, with code reviewed and supported by senior engineers * Join the team's on\-call rotation and learn to respond to alerts as you grow into the role ### **What You'll Bring** * A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 0\-1 years of professional experience in software, platform, or DevOps engineering; jobs.title: Forward Deployment (FD) Agentic Solutions Consultant - Sales
jobs.description: About Patra: Patra is an outcome\-focused operating partner working exclusively for the insurance industry. Combining expert global teams, process intelligence, and purpose\-built technology, Patra delivers measurable results to clients. With 20 years of deep domain expertise, exceptional client retention rates, and significant sustained investment in AI, Patra partners with agencies, brokers, MGAs, MGUs, and carriers to transform how insurance operations are delivered. Core Duties: **Role summary** Every Patra client runs its insurance operations a little differently, shaped by its own people, systems, and book of business. As a Forward Deployed (FD) Agentic Solutions Consultant – Sales, you will partner with Patra’s Client Experience (CX) and Sales teams to show clients what their operations could look like when targeted processes are reengineered with agentic AI. You will join client conversations to listen closely to how work gets done today, ideate with the client and the account team on where agents can take on that work, and rapidly turn those ideas into working agentic AI prototypes and future\-state journey maps, often in days rather than months. Your prototypes make the opportunity tangible: a client can watch real agents run the reengineered process in a synthetic version of their world, test it against realistic scenarios, and commit to it. They then become the blueprint for Patra’s FD squads, the forward\-deployed delivery teams that build them into POC and production systems. The role suits a curious, client\-facing builder who understands insurance operations, can translate a messy manual process into a clear agent\-plus\-expert design, and is happiest putting a working prototype in front of a client and collaborating with sales team to gain client commitments that can be actualized. **Key responsibilities****Discover alongside CX and Sales** * Join client meetings and working sessions with CX and Sales to understand the client’s goals, pain points, and how targeted processes such as submission intake, enrichment, classification, quoting, bind checking, policy checking, and certificates run today. * Listen for where agentic AI can create the most value, and help the account team qualify and prioritize which processes to pursue first. * Capture current\-state journey maps that show the steps, handoffs, systems, documents, and people involved. **Ideate and prototype** * Facilitate ideation with clients and account teams on how a process could be reengineered with agentic AI, and capture the result as a future\-state journey map. * Rapidly build working agentic AI prototypes, often in days: real agents built with real AI tools, running in a synthetic environment of mock systems, documents, and data that mirrors the client’s operation. * Design the agent\-plus\-expert model each prototype demonstrates: what the agent does, what a human reviews, and where it escalates. * Iterate quickly on client feedback until the prototype tells a clear, credible story. **Demonstrate value and win commitment** * Present prototypes and journey maps to client stakeholders, from operations leads to executives, in plain business terms. * Partner with Sales to build the business case: estimated cost replaced, cycle time cut, errors avoided, and the baseline KPIs a POC would measure. * Help shape proposals, POC scope, and success criteria so client commitments are realistic and deliverable. **Hand off and harvest** * Hand off prototypes, journey maps, and requirements to FD squads so they can move quickly into POC and production builds. * Apply Patra’s AI governance standards to prototyping work, including approved models and tools, and using synthetic data in place of real client data. * Build and maintain a reusable library of prototypes, synthetic data sets, and journey\-map templates, and share field insights with Patra’s product team. **Required qualifications*** 8\+ years in insurance operations, distribution, or Insurtech, with direct exposure to agency, broker, MGA, or carrier workflows. * 2\+ years designing, building, or owning AI or automation solutions as a product manager, solutions or sales engineer, or consultant, with at least some taken into production. * Demonstrated ability to rapidly build working agentic AI prototypes with real AI tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT and the OpenAI API, Microsoft Copilot Studio, n8n, LangGraph, or comparable agent frameworks and low\-code platforms, including the synthetic data and mock systems they run against, rather than slides or click\-through demos. * Hands\-on understanding of LLM\-based systems: agent workflow design, retrieval (RAG), prompt and schema design, and evaluation. * Strong discovery and listening skills: able to facilitate client working sessions, uncover how a process really runs, and translate it into current\- and future\-state journey maps. * Experience partnering with Sales, CX, or account teams in pre\-sales, solution design, or client advisory settings. * Ability to frame the business case for automation in terms of cost, cycle time, and accuracy, ideally backed by results you have delivered. * Experience working with cross\-functional teams of engineers, product managers, and operations staff. * Comfort presenting prototypes and business cases to client executives, including the C‑suite. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. **Preferred qualifications*** Line\-of\-business knowledge in one or more of Patra’s markets: Retail P\&C, also known as personal lines (auto, home, umbrella); Commercial P\&C, including E\&S and specialty lines such as D\&O, EPL, Tech E\&O, cyber, and professional liability; and Retail Employee Benefits (group health, life, disability, and voluntary benefits). * A portfolio of agentic AI prototypes you can walk us through, ideally for insurance or other document\-heavy service operations. * Experience with document\-heavy workflows across lines: applications and submissions, bind bundles, policy documents, endorsements and renewals, certificates, and benefits enrollment and census data. * Enterprise AI governance experience: usage policies, model approval, vendor vetting, and risk frameworks. * Technical depth in Python and AWS, plus familiarity with the systems insurance operations run on, such as CRMs, agency and policy management systems, benefits administration platforms, and integration and API tools. * Graduate coursework or a degree in computer science, AI, or machine learning. * Partner or channel experience with wholesalers and brokerages. * Experience working with global delivery teams across the US, India, and the Philippines. **Location and logistics** -------------------------- * **Travel:** Periodic client on\-site visits for discovery sessions, ideation workshops, and prototype presentations; up to 25%. * **Hours:** Primarily aligned with US client and Sales team schedules, with occasional overlap with India and Philippines delivery teams during handoffs. jobs.title: OSP Engineer
jobs.description: At **PEARCE**, **we've got a career for you!** Pearce is a leading technology\-enabled provider of asset management solutions for mission\-critical electromechanical infrastructure throughout North America. Pearce provides technical maintenance, repair, operations, and engineering services for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, backup power generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), critical cooling systems, and other electrical and mechanical infrastructure across end markets such as renewable energy, telecom, and data centers. Founded in 1998, Pearce has more than 4,000 employees and 28 locations across the U.S. Pearce is a wholly owned subsidiary of CBRE Group, Inc., the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm. To learn more about Pearce visit http://www.pearce\-services.com. **Your Impact** --------------- As an **OSP Engineer III supporting the Frontier program** at Pearce, you will lead complex outside plant (OSP) engineering projects supporting Frontier's fiber and copper telecommunications infrastructure. You will oversee engineering activities from initial design and field validation through permitting, construction readiness, and project closeout. This position requires experience with **Frontier engineering standards, systems, and workflows**, including **Varasset, FROGS, and Infinium**. You will maintain accurate engineering records, manage work orders, develop construction\-ready designs, and ensure compliance with Frontier requirements and industry standards. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- ### **OSP Engineering, Design \& Technical Leadership** * Lead engineering activities for Frontier OSP projects involving aerial, underground, buried, conduit, fiber, and copper infrastructure. * Develop engineering designs, construction work prints, splicing diagrams, bills of materials (BOMs), and supporting documentation. * Perform work order engineering for new construction, road moves, relocations, network modifications, and copper\-to\-fiber conversions. * Review existing network facilities and determine engineering requirements for expansions and upgrades. * Conduct route planning, constructability reviews, and design optimization. * Resolve engineering conflicts involving pole attachments, conduit capacity, cable placement, and existing infrastructure. * Provide technical guidance to junior engineers. ### **Frontier Systems \& Engineering Documentation** * Utilize **Varasset, FROGS, and Infinium** to support Frontier engineering workflows, work order management, and project documentation, as applicable. * Create, update, and maintain engineering records within Frontier\-required systems. * Track engineering activities and project milestones through applicable Frontier platforms. * Ensure engineering documentation and work orders are accurate and current. * Troubleshoot documentation discrepancies and coordinate corrections. * Follow Frontier engineering procedures and quality standards. ### **Field Validation, Standards \& Compliance** * Perform and coordinate field surveys for aerial and underground telecommunications facilities. * Evaluate pole conditions, cable routes, conduit availability, and construction feasibility. * Ensure designs comply with **NESC**, Frontier specifications, and applicable regulations. * Identify construction conflicts and recommend engineering solutions. * Review field findings, redlines, and as\-built documentation. * Support field inspections and resolve engineering issues during construction. ### **Permitting, Right\-of\-Way \& Joint Use** * Develop and review engineering documentation for municipal, county, state, and utility permits. * Coordinate right\-of\-way (ROW), easement, and access requirements. * Support pole attachment applications, pole loading analysis, make\-ready engineering, and joint\-use coordination. * Work with utilities, permitting agencies, and construction teams to resolve design conflicts. * Ensure permit documentation aligns with Frontier requirements. ### **Project Tracking, Quality Assurance \& Coordination** * Manage engineering work orders and ensure timely completion of deliverables. * Monitor schedules, project progress, and outstanding action items. * Perform QA/QC reviews of engineering designs, work prints, and system records. * Identify potential engineering delays and documentation issues. * Coordinate with project managers, construction teams, permitting specialists, and Frontier stakeholders. * Maintain accurate project status updates and support project closeout. **Core Experience** ------------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * **OSP Engineering Experience:** Experience engineering aerial, underground, buried, fiber, and copper telecommunications networks. * **Frontier Program Experience:** Experience supporting Frontier engineering projects, work orders, and documentation standards. * **Frontier Systems:** Experience using **Varasset, FROGS, and Infinium** to support engineering workflows and project records. * **Work Order Engineering:** Experience with road moves, relocations, network modifications, and construction work prints. * **Engineering Design:** Ability to develop and review engineering plans, splicing information, and bills of materials. * **Field Engineering:** Experience conducting field verification and reviewing existing telecommunications facilities. * **NESC Knowledge:** Working knowledge of NESC standards and OSP engineering practices. * **Permitting \& Joint Use:** Experience coordinating permits, pole attachments, and make\-ready activities. * **Quality Assurance:** Ability to review engineering documentation for accuracy and compliance. * **Technical Tools:** Proficiency with engineering record systems, Microsoft Office, CAD or comparable applications, and field measurement equipment. * **Project Coordination:** Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and communicate effectively. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working directly with **Frontier Communications** or a contractor supporting Frontier programs. * Familiarity with Frontier fiber expansion, copper\-to\-fiber conversions, road moves, and network relocations. * Experience with OSP engineering tools such as AutoCAD, IQGeo, Katapult, O\-Calc, or comparable platforms. * Experience performing QA/QC reviews and mentoring junior OSP engineers. * Understanding of aerial and underground construction methods and utility coordination. * Ability to troubleshoot engineering issues and resolve discrepancies between field conditions and client systems. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Deliver accurate, construction\-ready OSP engineering packages that meet Frontier requirements. * Maintain complete and current engineering records in Varasset, FROGS, Infinium, and other applicable systems. * Complete engineering work orders on schedule while meeting quality expectations. * Minimize design revisions, documentation discrepancies, and construction delays. * Build effective relationships with Frontier stakeholders, construction teams, and internal personnel. * Contribute to engineering quality and continuous improvement across the Frontier program. **What We Offer** Pearce offers a family\-friendly and innovative culture with opportunities for growth, competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, HSA option. To help you recharge, we have paid vacation and paid holidays. For your future, we offer a company\-matching 401(k) Retirement, Life Insurance, Tuition reimbursement, and professional development training. To help you be successful at work, as required for the role, we will provide a company vehicle, phone, laptop, or tablet along with all necessary tools and safety equipment. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are modernizing Pearson's content platform into a set of shared platform services. You will be one of the principal engineers leading that work hands\-on. You design the target systems and move content and users onto them safely. Full stack here goes beyond front end and back end: the work spans user interfaces, workflow orchestration, AI, backend services, and cloud infrastructure. You will stay deep in design and implementation while raising the technical judgment and execution of the engineers around you. **What you will own** * The technical plan and delivery for several technology tracks, such as consolidations, migrations, and other large\-scale initiatives, from target design through launch. * Migrations of large volumes of content and data, such as assessment items or media assets, with verification that nothing is lost or broken for downstream products. * Shared capabilities that should be built once and used everywhere, like media handling, search, rendering, or AI content services, exposed through clean APIs. * An honest, costed view of the technical debt in your systems and what to fix first. * Escalated incidents on your systems: you are the technical point of contact when one has business impact, and you stay on it through root cause and the fix that prevents a repeat. * Security and stability for the applications you own. That covers runtime and framework upgrades, vulnerability and penetration test remediation, secure data handling, and disaster recovery plans that are documented, exercised, and audit ready. * Shared standards across teams for design patterns, tooling, reliability, observability, performance, and evaluation, including how AI\-powered workflows are measured, tested, and kept safe. * The long\-term technical roadmap for your area, and the subject\-matter expertise that comes with it. **How you will work** This is a hands\-on engineering role, not an architecture role. You own the designs, the code on the critical path, and the engineering calls that decide whether an initiative succeeds. Hold views grounded in evidence, and change them when the evidence changes. * Evaluate frameworks, tools, and vendors, and pilot practices like contract testing, automated regression, and zero\-downtime migration before teams adopt them. * Run technical feasibility reviews for new AI capabilities, and work with internal teams and external partners to assess and co\-develop them. * Use AI coding tools daily, particularly for large upgrades and refactors, and help teams adopt them with sound review habits. * Act as a technical multiplier: review critical designs, mentor engineers, and improve engineering practices. We will ask you to walk us through a document you wrote. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **Preferred qualifications** * Content platform experience: authoring and content management, digital asset management, content transformation pipelines, content delivery, or assessment systems. * Content and learning standards such as EPUB, XML/XSLT, QTI, or LTI. * Built or operated an LLM\-backed feature in production, using Python and services such as AWS Bedrock or Azure OpenAI, and understands the problems AI brings: nondeterminism, evaluation, latency, and safety. * Moved a product off a commercial platform, such as a DAM or CMS, onto in\-house services. * Search and caching with OpenSearch or Solr and Redis. * Worked with distributed teams and delivery partners across US and India time zones. **About PSG\-CP** Pearson is the world's lifelong learning company. PSG\-CP (Pearson Software Group \- Content Platform) builds and runs the platform behind how Pearson creates, delivers, and measures learning content, for every Pearson line of business. Apply now and help shape the future of learning. Compensation at Pearson is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. jobs.title: Battery Test Engineer - Aeromechanical
jobs.description: Pivotal is the leader in the emerging market of electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft. We design, develop, and manufacture light eVTOL aircraft and are renowned for the BlackFly aircraft the world's first light eVTOL to fly manned missions and enter the consumer market. Efficient, compact, and simple, Pivotal aircraft are designed for a wide range of consumer, public service, and defense applications. Our distinctive tilt\-aircraft architecture and scalable platform have been flying for over 10 years. Last year we announced our next\-generation aircraft, the Helix, which is rapidly progressing toward general release and scalable production in 2026\. Mobility is one of the most highly\-valued areas of modern technology investments. This is the right company, in the right space, the right strategy, at the right time. If you are ready for adventure, we invite you to join our amazing team and grow with us. **About the Job** ----------------- The Battery Engineering team at Pivotal is seeking a hands\-on Battery Test Engineer to own the design and execution of battery performance characterization, thermal\-runaway, abuse, environmental, and durability testing. This engineer will translate system risks and requirements into safe, instrumented, repeatable tests at the cell and pack levels, then convert test results into defensible engineering evidence and actionable design improvements. ### **Responsibilities** * Own test planning and hands\-on execution for lithium\-ion cells and aircraft battery packs. * Plan and execute electrical and thermal performance characterization of cell candidates and prototype packs, including capacity, DCIR, power capability, mission\-profile cycling, and thermal response across temperature. * Operate high\-power battery cyclers, cell cyclers, and environmental chambers, and maintain test profiles, data pipelines, and test\-article configuration records. * Deliver correlation\-ready datasets to the simulation team and support model\-versus\-test comparison. * Design, build, and execute thermal\-runaway initiation, propagation, containment, venting, and mitigation tests, including fabrication of test articles, trigger methods, fixtures, and instrumentation appropriate to test objectives. * Develop environmental and durability tests covering temperature, thermal cycling, altitude or low\-pressure exposure, humidity, vibration, mechanical shock, and transportation conditions as applicable. * Define test objectives, hazards, instrumentation needs, data\-acquisition architecture, trigger logic, sampling rates, acceptance criteria, and stop conditions. * Prepare test articles, fixtures, chambers, power equipment, cooling systems, sensors, high\-speed video, thermal imaging, and data\-acquisition systems. * Lead test readiness reviews, job\-hazard analyses, emergency planning, exclusion\-zone definition, and coordination with EHS, facilities, fire\-safety, and external laboratories. * Execute testing safely, monitor tests in real time, respond to anomalies, and protect personnel, facilities, test assets, and data integrity. * Analyze temperature, voltage, current, pressure, gas, flame, ejecta, and propagation behavior, as applicable to the test objective and facility capability. * Author clear test plans, procedures, reports, nonconformance records, root\-cause assessments, and design recommendations. * Support model correlation and work with design engineers to improve containment, cooling, sensing, venting, and protection strategies. * Manage external test laboratories, including statement\-of\-work development, setup reviews, witnessing, data acceptance, and issue resolution. * Maintain calibrated instrumentation, safe lab practices, test configuration control, data traceability, and lessons learned. * Support transportation and environmental compliance test programs, including UN 38\.3 activities, when applicable to the product and program phase. ### **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field. * Three or more years of hands\-on battery, environmental, abuse, reliability, or aerospace hardware testing experience. * Experience designing instrumented tests and selecting thermocouples, voltage and current measurement, pressure sensing, thermal imaging, and data\-acquisition hardware. * Working knowledge of lithium\-ion battery hazards, high\-voltage safety, stored\-energy hazards, fire risk, and safe test operations. * Experience developing test fixtures, procedures, hazard controls, and technical reports. * Ability to troubleshoot hardware, instrumentation, wiring, communications, and data\-quality issues in the laboratory. * Ability to work on\-site and safely support physically hands\-on test setup and execution. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience conducting or witnessing battery thermal\-runaway, propagation, overcharge, external heating, short\-circuit, crush, or penetration testing. * Experience with environmental chambers, vibration systems, thermal cycling, altitude chambers, shock testing, and high\-power battery pack cyclers (e.g., Chroma, etc.) or cell cyclers (e.g., Biologic, Arbin). * Experience with electric aircraft, EV, UAV, aerospace, defense, or other safety\-critical energy systems. * Familiarity with UN 38\.3 and relevant battery or aerospace environmental\-test standards, with the judgment to confirm applicability before defining a compliance plan. * Experience with LabVIEW, Python, MATLAB, Dewesoft, NI hardware, or comparable data\-acquisition and analysis environments. * Experience with fire\-safe test cells, exhaust and gas handling, remote monitoring, blast or fragment protection, and emergency\-response coordination. * Experience managing outside laboratories and reviewing supplier test evidence. ### **Ideal Candidate** * Has a strong laboratory and test\-floor mindset and takes personal ownership of safe execution and high\-quality data. * Balances urgency with disciplined readiness reviews, hazard controls, and configuration management. * Can move from requirement or failure concern to a practical test method, fixture, procedure, and evidence package. * Communicates unexpected results quickly and objectively and helps the team turn failures into design learning. ### **Attributes Aligned with Our Core Values** * Safety Above All: Demonstrates a proactive safety mindset by embedding safety into daily work, identifying and mitigating risks, encouraging open dialogue about safety concerns, and continuously improving practices and protocols. * Customer Focus: Puts customers at the center of every action by understanding their challenges, delivering meaningful value, and supporting their success. * Work Better Together: Seeks and values diverse perspectives, builds cross\-functional relationships, and fosters trust through empathetic, fact\-based communication and commitment to shared decisions. * Be the Pilot: Drives results with clarity and purpose by focusing on what matters most, adapting to change, taking initiative, and owning outcomes. * Embrace the Unknown: Navigates ambiguity with resilience and bold thinking, challenges the status quo, and combines innovative ideas with practical approaches to overcome obstacles and drive progress. * Respect for People: Fosters a high\-performance culture grounded in respect, professionalism, and support by balancing high expectations with a healthy, collaborative environment and being a trusted, dependable teammate. Applicants must be eligible for employment in the United States and willing to work onsite at our HQ office in Palo Alto, CA. Pivotal offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, and 401k plans. Pivotal is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Pivotal does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
