We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam. ### **About the Team** We’re part of Plaid’s Data organization, building models that help millions of people better understand and grow their financial lives. We apply machine learning to high\-impact product challenges, working across product areas to develop solutions that create meaningful customer value. We focus on credit, building models to the standards required in lending and supporting the next wave of cash\-flow\-based underwriting. We value technical expertise, creativity, user empathy, and teamwork, and we’re guided by Plaid’s principles of impact, growing together, openness and positivity, and inventing tomorrow. ### **About the Role** As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Credit team, you’ll design, build, and deploy scalable machine learning solutions that support LendScore and the future of cash\-flow\-based underwriting. You’ll work across the full model lifecycle—from experimentation and offline training through production serving and monitoring—and partner with engineers and cross\-functional teams to turn data and new modeling approaches into reliable systems. In this role, you will: * Develop and productionize AI and machine learning models, from offline training through online serving and ongoing monitoring. * Experiment with modeling approaches and strategies for credit use cases, balancing model performance with the requirements of lending environments. * Partner with engineering teams to ingest signals and build the systems needed to bring models into production. * Contribute to both 0\-to\-1 problems and the scaling and improvement of established solutions. * Collaborate with teams across Plaid to help define the machine learning roadmap. * Dive into data and use evidence\-based analysis to guide day\-to\-day decisions. ### **What Excites You** * Building products that can empower millions of people through well\-known and emerging fintech applications. * Experimenting with modern machine learning techniques on meaningful credit and lending problems. * Working across the full lifecycle of machine learning systems, from exploration to production and ongoing improvement. * Taking on both greenfield challenges and opportunities to scale solutions that are already delivering value. * Joining a high\-ownership, bottom\-up team where your work can shape the roadmap and drive business impact. ### **What Excites Us** * 2\+ years of experience training and serving AI or machine learning models in a production environment. * Experience in fintech lending and a strong understanding of how models are built and used in lending. * Experience building or working with data\-intensive backend applications in large, distributed systems. * Ability to code and iterate independently using data infrastructure tools such as Python, Spark, Jupyter notebooks, and standard machine learning libraries. * A track record of taking ownership and driving projects to business impact. * Ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical teams. * Master’s degree or equivalent work experience in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a closely related field. * Nice to have: Experience in data analytics or data engineering. Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid! Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com. Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Plaid provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefit plans. Compensation Range: $211,680 \- $272,160

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: About the Company Platform9 Systems is a cloud software company headquartered in California. Founded in 2013, the company specializes in simplifying enterprise private cloud infrastructure and cloud\-native technology. Its solutions help organizations manage Kubernetes, virtual machines, distributed systems, and hybrid cloud environments. Platform9 focuses on making cloud infrastructure easier to deploy, operate, and scale. Job Description Platform9 Systems is seeking a motivated Software Engineer to help design, develop, and maintain modern cloud\-native software products. The ideal candidate will contribute to engineering projects involving distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and container\-based technologies. The successful candidate will collaborate with engineering teams to develop scalable software solutions, improve application performance, and support reliable cloud infrastructure operations. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, and maintain cloud\-native software applications. * Build software services for distributed cloud environments. * Develop and improve backend components using modern programming languages. * Collaborate with engineering teams on product design and implementation. * Troubleshoot software defects and infrastructure\-related issues. * Improve application performance, scalability, and reliability. * Participate in code reviews and software testing. * Support Kubernetes\-based products and cloud infrastructure deployments. * Maintain technical documentation and development standards. Requirements * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Strong programming knowledge in Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+. * Understanding of software engineering principles and data structures. * Knowledge of Linux or Unix operating systems. * Familiarity with cloud computing and distributed systems. * Understanding of networking concepts and software development practices. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work collaboratively in a technical environment. Preferred Skills * Experience with Kubernetes and containerization technologies. * Familiarity with OpenStack or DevStack. * Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and virtualization. * Experience developing distributed systems or SaaS applications. * Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and automated testing. * Understanding of networking protocols and cloud\-native architecture. Compensation Estimated annual salary range: **$112,000 – $160,000**, depending on experience, technical skills, and job\-related qualifications. Additional compensation may include equity or other incentives, subject to employer policy. Benefits Potential benefits include: * Medical healthcare coverage. * Competitive compensation and equity opportunities. * Hybrid work arrangements. * Wellness benefits. * Professional development and certification opportunities. * Employee recognition programs. * Team\-building activities. Benefits and eligibility depend on the employer's current policies. Pay: $112,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Relocation assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior AIOps Engineer
jobs.description: Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by 1\) providing the best services for homebuyers, 2\) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance, 3\) to protect the whole home. As a leader in the home services software\-as\-a\-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home\-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies. In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED. **Job Title:** Senior AIOps Engineer I **Location:** United States **Workplace Type:** Remote **Job Summary** The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love for you to be a part of it as our Senior AIOps Engineer I. In this role, you will partner with product managers, platform engineers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers to make sure our AI and ML\-powered systems are reliable, observable, secure, and cost\-efficient in production. You will focus on how AI systems run in the real world: monitoring model performance and drift, keeping deployment pipelines robust, managing incidents, and standing up new AI infrastructure. Our AI/ML stack is built on Python and runs on Kubernetes (GKE) and Google Cloud Platform, using tools such as Union Cloud (Flyte), BentoML, Feast, Label Studio, BigQuery, and Dataflow. On the GenAI side, we operate a centralized LLM routing and gateway service, run batch prediction services for large\-scale inference, and are building out RAG infrastructure. You will help evolve this stack so teams can ship AI features quickly and safely. **What You Will Do As A Senior AIOps Engineer I** * Own production reliability for AI/ML services by monitoring availability and performance, defining SLOs and SLIs (latency, error rates, model performance) tied to user experience and business impact, and owning recurring model refresh cycles (retraining, validation, and redeployment) to prevent staleness and drift. * Design and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for models and data pipelines, and integrate model and system metrics with existing observability stacks and dashboards (Datadog, Opik, and others). * Streamline deployment workflows with data scientists and ML engineers (blue/green, canary, A/B, and shadow deployments), improve CI/CD pipelines and release processes for AI services, and support the productionization of image\-based ML models, including batch prediction workflows. * Provision, deploy, configure, and maintain new AI infrastructure as it is adopted, including AI gateways, RAG platforms, LLM observability tools, agentic workflows, and no\-code agent builders, using tools such as Union Cloud, BentoML, Feast, Kubernetes, Terraform, and GCP services. * Build automation and tooling to reduce manual operational work around model promotion, configuration, environment management, and Docker image maintenance, and support multi\-BU infrastructure provisioning (separate environments, projects, roles, and CI/CD integrations). * Own the operational health of Label Studio, our production data annotation platform, including supporting GCS buckets, BigQuery pipelines, and database and SSO dependencies, and supporting bi\-weekly annotation project cycles. * Stand up and operate RAG and vector database infrastructure, including embedding pipelines and context retrieval APIs, and optimize embedding storage and retrieval performance at scale. * Monitor and optimize LLM token usage and costs across providers, maintain centralized cost tracking dashboards and alerting across business units, and recommend cost\-efficient model routing and provider selection strategies. * Participate in an on\-call rotation for AI/ML systems, triage and resolve production incidents, and lead and contribute to post\-incident reviews that drive lasting improvements. * Develop production\-grade services and tooling, primarily in Python, on Kubernetes, applying strong engineering practices (testing, code reviews, CI/CD, observability, security), and document standards, architecture diagrams, and operational playbooks for other teams. **What You Will Bring As A Senior AIOps Engineer I** * A curious and driven mindset, with a strong interest in how AI systems behave in production and how to make them more reliable and observable. * 4\+ years of applicable experience, including at least 3 years in commercial software engineering or production operations (SRE, DevOps, Platform, or ML Platform), operating services on Kubernetes and/or major cloud platforms. * Experience operating product siness and interviewing needs. At this time, Porch Group does not consider applicants from the following states or jurisdictions for Remote positions: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Mississippi, Nebraska, Montana, New Hampshire, West Virginia, or the District of Columbia. **What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member** Pay Range\*: $135,000 to $189,000 annually * Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job\-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location. Additionally, you will be eligible to receive long\-term incentive awards, subject to program guidelines and approvals. Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing. * Our traditional healthcare benefits include three (3\) Medical plan options, two (2\) Dental plan options, and a Vision plan from which to choose. * Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Accident plans are offered on a voluntary basis. * We offer pre\-tax savings options including a partially employer funded Health Savings Account and employee Flexible Savings Accounts including healthcare, dependent care, and transportation savings options. * We provide company paid Basic Life and AD\&D, Short and Long\-Term Disability benefits. We also offer Voluntary Life and AD\&D plans. * Both traditional and Roth 401(k) plans are available with a discretionary employer match. * Supportlinc is part of our employer paid wellbeing program and provides employees and their families access to on demand guided meditation and mindfulness exercises, mental health coaching, clinical care and online access to confidential resources including will preparation. * LifeBalance is a free resource to employees and their families for year\-round discounts on things like gym memberships, travel, appliances, movies, pet insurance and more. * Our wellness programs include flexible paid vacation, company\-paid holidays of typically nine per year, paid sick time, paid parental leave, identity theft program, travel assistance, and fitness and other discounts programs. \#LI\-NH1 \#LI\-Remote **What’s next?** Submit your application and our Porch Group Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have! Porch is committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. Porch is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. Porch Group is an E\-Verify employer. E\-Verify is a web\-based system that allows an employer to determine an employee's eligibility to work in the US using information reported on an employee's Form I\-9\. The E\-Verify system confirms eligibility with both the Social Security Administration (SSA) and Department of Homeland Security (DHS). For more information, please go to the USCIS E\-Verify website.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** **Controls Engineer – Building Automation Systems (BAS)Employment Type:** Full\-time Experience Required: 5\+ years' Work Arrangement: On\-site preferred; remote work acceptable. **Department:** Building Automation / Controls **About the Role** We are looking for an experienced, detail\-oriented Controls Engineer to join our Building Automation Systems (BAS) team. This position will primarily focus on systems integration, programming, configuration, and troubleshooting of building automation systems for commercial HVAC applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong working knowledge of Niagara N4 and experience integrating building automation equipment and systems from multiple manufacturers. In addition to systems integration, this role will support the development of control drawings, project submittals, and as\-built documentation to ensure successful project installation and commissioning.This position is best suited for an experienced controls professional who enjoys solving technical challenges, working across multiple control platforms, and developing reliable solutions for complex HVAC systems.Key ResponsibilitiesPrimary Responsibilities – Systems Integration\- Develop, configure, and integrate building automation systems using the Niagara N4 platform.\- Integrate HVAC equipment, controllers, and third\-party systems across multiple manufacturers and communication protocols.\- Develop and modify control logic, graphics, schedules, alarms, trends, and system databases.\- Troubleshoot communication issues, integration problems, and control system deficiencies.\- Support system commissioning, startup, functional testing, and troubleshooting.\- Coordinate with project managers, field technicians, and other team members to ensure successful project completion.\- Assist with remote monitoring, system optimization, and ongoing controls support.Secondary Responsibilities – Engineering Documentation\- Develop and revise HVAC control drawings and wiring diagrams.\- Prepare project submittals, sequences of operation, and control documentation.\- Produce and maintain accurate as\-built drawings and project records.\- Review project specifications and mechanical drawings to support system design and implementation.\- Assist with estimating and technical review of building automation projects as needed.Required Qualifications\- Current Niagara N4 Certification is required.\- Minimum of 5 years of experience in building automation, HVAC controls, systems integration, or a closely related field.\- Demonstrated experience configuring, programming, integrating, and troubleshooting building automation systems.\- Working knowledge of commercial HVAC systems, control sequences, and network communications.\- Strong understanding of BACnet, Modbus, and other common building automation communication protocols.\- Strong jobs.title: Sr. Performance Engineer
jobs.description: **Location: Plano, TX (5 days on\-site)** **Final Inperson interview is required in cleint location: Plano, TX.** **Senior Performance Engineer** **About the Role** The client is seeking an experienced Senior Performance Engineer to join its enterprise applications team. The successful candidate will lead performance engineering for a business\-critical enterprise application suite in preparation for its go\-live at a Client property. The role is responsible for establishing performance baselines, validating that the application scales to production traffic volumes, and confirming that it operates within its sized capacity on production hardware. The application is hosted on Red Hat OpenShift running on on\-premises servers, across both non\-production and production environments. As this infrastructure has fixed capacity, and additional hardware requires significant procurement lead time, accurate measurement and forecasting are central to the position. The Senior Performance Engineer will work independently, conducting their own research and analysis, and will collaborate closely with development, database, platform engineering and vendor teams. **Key Responsibilities** · Establish, measure and maintain performance baselines for each release across API, service and user\-interface scenarios, weighted in proportion to actual usage. · Develop workload models, including transaction volumes, concurrent users, transactions per second and test durations, derived from production traffic data and agreed with business stakeholders and vendors. · Design, develop and maintain performance test scripts using JMeter, Artillery and Playwright, reusing existing test assets where appropriate. · Execute load and endurance tests throughout each release cycle in a dedicated performance environment. · Validate application scalability at and beyond production traffic volumes, assess utilization of CPU, memory, database and storage capacity, and report remaining headroom and capacity limits in time to inform hardware planning. · Analyze test results against baselines, identify regressions promptly, and determine root causes using platform, database and application metrics. · Partner with developers, database administrators and platform engineers to resolve performance issues, including query optimization, resource configuration, runtime tuning and scaling. · Prepare performance reports and present findings and recommendations to support formal release approval. · Work with platform engineering to ensure the performance environment remains representative of production and is managed through GitOps practices. · Identify and coordinate dependencies required for testing, including interface inventories, test accounts, test data and integration stubs. · Prepare and maintain production\-scale, anonymized test data sets. **Qualifications and Experience** · Minimum of seven years of experience in performance engineering or performance testing of enterprise web applications, including leading performance testing for major releases or system go\-lives and presenting capacity findings to senior leadership. · Demonstrated ability to work independently, including researching unfamiliar systems, forming and testing hypotheses, and drawing sound conclusions with minimal direction. · Experience in capacity planning for fixed, on\-premises infrastructure, including sizing workloads to available hardware, extrapolating results from non\-production to production environments, and forecasting future capacity requirements. · Hands\-on scripting experience with JMeter and at least one additional load testing tool such as Artillery, k6, Gatling or Locust. · Experience with user\-interface performance testing using Playwright or a comparable browser automation tool. · Strong understanding of load and endurance testing, workload modeling based on production traffic, and percentile\-based performance analysis. · Experience testing REST APIs and service\-to\-service communication in distributed systems. · Hands\-on expertise with Kubernetes, including configuring resource requests and limits, horizontal and vertical scaling, node scheduling, and analyzing pod, node and cluster\-level metrics and logs to diagnose performance issues. · Proficiency with Kubernetes tooling, including kubectl and the OpenShift CLI (oc), Helm and Kustomize, for deploying, inspecting and troubleshooting workloads. · Proficiency in interpreting monitoring data from tools such as Prometheus and Grafana to identify bottlenecks across application, database and infrastructure layers. · Strong SQL skills and familiarity with relational database performance, preferably PostgreSQL. · Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, JavaScript or Java. · Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and business audiences. **Preferred Qualifications** · Experience with on\-premises Red Hat OpenShift deployments, particularly on bare\-metal infrastructure. · Familiarity with GitOps practices and tools such as Argo CD or OpenShift GitOps. · Experience in Java and JVM performance tuning, including memory management, garbage collection and thread pool configuration. · Experience with application performance monitoring (APM) tools for distributed tracing. · Experience in regulated industries such as gaming, hospitality or financial services. · Knowledge of enterprise storage performance, including block and network file storage. · Experience establishing performance testing within a release process that includes formal approval gates. **Technical Environment** The role works with JMeter, Artillery and Playwright for test execution; Red Hat OpenShift on bare\-metal servers in Client's datacenters, across non\-production and production environments; a dedicated performance environment hosting the full application stack; GitOps\-based deployment; OpenShift monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana; and PostgreSQL databases. Experience: * performance engineering or performance testing : 10 years (Required) * script JMeter \& least Artillery, k6, Gatling or Locust.: 10 years (Required) * user\-interface performance testing using Playwright : 10 years (Required) * testing REST APIs and service\-to\-service communication : 10 years (Required) * Kubernetes, include configuring resource requests and limits: 10 years (Required) * SQL skills \& familiar with relational database performance: 10 years (Required) * program or script language, as Python, JavaScript or Java: 10 years (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Vehicle Software Engineer
jobs.description: Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable. Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud\-seeding science with weather\-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities. Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course\-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you. The vehicle software team builds the software that operates Rainmaker’s cloud\-seeding vehicles, connecting flight control, onboard computing, sensors, payloads, and ground operations. We work closely with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, and flight operations teams to turn new hardware into reliable systems that can be built, deployed, and operated at scale. Our goal is to make every vehicle a dependable tool for delivering more freshwater where it is needed. ### **About the Role** You will own vehicle software capabilities from the operator interface to the onboard systems that execute a mission. Your work will span ground stations, mission planning and execution, failsafe behaviors, sensing, payload and sensor integration, and autonomy. You will build software that helps operators make good decisions, lets vehicles carry out missions reliably, and handles failures predictably. You will take projects from architecture and prototyping through simulation, hardware integration, flight testing, deployment, and field support. We’re looking for a high\-agency engineer who identifies what needs to happen, turns incomplete requirements into a clear plan, and follows through until the system works reliably in real operating conditions. This is a hands\-on technical ownership role with the autonomy to shape the vehicle software and the responsibility to deliver it.### **What You'll Do** * Own the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of vehicle software capabilities across onboard computers and ground systems, with clear contracts for commands, telemetry, state, and failure behavior. * Build operator interfaces and ground\-station workflows for vehicle preparation, preflight checks, mission control, health monitoring, and intervention. Make vehicle state, command outcomes, and required operator actions clear. * Develop mission planning and execution software that turns operational goals into validated flight paths and geofences, accounts for vehicle endurance, coordinates flight and seeding activity, and supports mission changes as conditions evolve. * Design and validate arming checks, interlocks, and failsafe behaviors for communication loss, degraded sensing, low power, process failures, and unexpected vehicle states, including clear transitions between autonomous behavior and operator control. * Integrate sensors, cameras, and seeding payloads with onboard software and flight\-control systems. Ensure measurements, calibration, timestamps, device health, and payload commands are reliable and observable. * Develop autonomy that uses sensing and vehicle state to execute missions within operating limits, handle contingencies, and reduce operator workload. * Build dependable communication between vehicles and ground stations, accounting for intermittent links, stale telemetry, and commands that may be delayed, duplicated, or unacknowledged. * Build automated tests, software\-in\-the\-loop simulation, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop coverage that catch regressions and exercise failure modes before releases reach the fleet. * Partner with hardware engineers and flight operations to validate new capabilities on the bench and in flight, and make deployment, configuration, calibration, and diagnostics repeatable. * Investigate field failures using logs, telemetry, and mission replay; resolve root causes and turn what you learn into better software, tests, and operator workflows. ### **What We're Looking For** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience developing software for vehicles, robotics, or other systems that interact with the physical world, including deployment into production or field use. * Demonstrated ownership of a software capability from design through integration, release, and ongoing support, including making technical decisions independently and resolving failures in real operating conditions. * Strong systems programming skills in Rust or C/C\+\+, with the willingness to work primarily in Rust and contribute to TypeScript\-based operator interfaces. Our stack includes Rust onboard services and ground\-station backends, React/TypeScript interfaces in Electron, and PX4 flight\-control integration over MAVLink. * Experience developing and debugging software on Linux, including concurrent processes, network communication, and interfaces to hardware or flight\-control systems. * Practical experience in one or more of the following: operator interfaces and ground stations, mission planning, autonomy, sensing, or payload integration, with the willingness to work across these boundaries. * The ability to reason about distributed system state, timing, and failures, and implement robust state machines, fault detection, failsafes, and recovery paths. * A practical approach to operator\-facing software: you can turn field workflows into clear controls, useful feedback, and predictable system behavior. * Experience building maintainable software with version control, reproducible builds, automated testing, and disciplined release practices. * Evidence of high agency: you surface problems without waiting to be assigned, make sound decisions with incomplete information, ask for help when it matters, and close the loop on results. * Clear communication and the ability to work closely with hardware engineers and operators, explain tradeoffs, and document decisions so others can operate and support what you ship. ### **What Will Set Your Apart** * Experience deploying drones or autonomous robots and supporting real\-world flight or field operations. * Familiarity with PX4, MAVLink, ground\-control systems, or flight\-critical software. * Experience building operator interfaces with React, TypeScript, or Electron, particularly mapping tools or geospatial mission\-planning workflows. * Experience with sensor fusion, state estimation, path planning, or autonomous mission execution. * Experience integrating payloads, sensors, or embedded controllers over interfaces such as CAN, serial, or Ethernet. * Experience validating safety\-related behaviors through simulation, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, fault injection, and field testing. ### **What Success Looks Like In the First 90 Days** You understand how operators plan and execute missions and can trace commands, telemetry, and failure behavior between the ground station, onboard software, flight controller, sensors, and payloads. You have identified the most consequential reliability risks and operator pain points, and the team has a clear plan for what to address first. You have delivered a meaningful vehicle software improvement through simulation and integration testing into an operational release, working with flight operations to verify its behavior in the field. You have demonstrated both its intended behavior and its response to relevant failures, and improved at least one recurring source of friction in mission planning, operation, testing, deployment, or diagnostics. **Supporting the people behind the mission** Making Earth more habitable is ambitious work. We want the people doing it to feel supported—in the work we share and the lives they’re building. * **A stake in what we build.** Meaningful stock options and the opportunity to help shape Rainmaker as an early member of the team. * **Support for your health.** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance. * **An investment in your future.** A 401(k) with employer matching to help you build long\-term savings. * **Time to recharge.** Unlimited PTO for rest, exploration, and the people and pursuits that matter to you. * **Time for a growing family.** Paid parental leave for both parents to welcome a child and spend time together. * **Lunch together.** Daily lunch provided at our El Segundo headquarters—a chance to share a meal and connect with teammates. * **Help making the move.** Relocation assistance for eligible roles to support your transition to Rainmaker.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Benchmarks & Evaluation
jobs.description: **About Ramp** ============== Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7\.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. **About Ramp Labs** ------------------- Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research group. We post\-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 70,000\+ companies use to move money. We think the defensible part of an AI product is the loop: proprietary environments, evals that track what customers care about, and models trained against both. **About the Role** ------------------ Every model decision at Ramp Labs runs through a benchmark. Which model to route to. Whether a post\-training run worked. Whether an agent is ready to post a corrective journal entry to a customer's ledger without a human in the loop. You'll own Ramp's benchmarking effort. You'll turn real finance work (expense policy review, invoice coding, month\-end close, spreadsheet Q\&A) into benchmarks and RL environments, build the graders, and tell the team what is actually improving. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Build benchmarks from real workflows: turn agent traces, customer edge cases and expert labels into versioned benchmark suites for long\-horizon agents that run for hours across tools and systems, plus tool use, multi\-step reasoning and financial judgment * Own the benchmarking effort: decide what we measure, run benchmark suites across models and agent versions, and report results the team makes decisions on * Design graders: rubrics, programmatic checks and llm\-as\-judge, calibrated against human agreement, with a clear view of where each one breaks * Close the loop with post\-training: turn evals into reward functions and RL environments, and catch reward hacking and contamination before they ship * Publish external benchmarks and write\-ups on how models perform at real finance work **What You Need** ----------------- * Hands\-on experience building LLM benchmarks or evals that people used to make real decisions * Strong Python and software engineering; your eval code is reproducible and fast * Statistical judgment: variance, confidence intervals, sample size, inter\-rater agreement, and knowing when a delta is noise * Working knowledge of post\-training (SFT, RL with verifiable rewards) and how evals feed into it * Comfort with SQL and large datasets; you'll work directly from production traces * Taste for what is worth measuring **Nice\-to\-Have** ------------------ * Industry experience on an eval, benchmarking or post\-training team * Built RL environments or verifiers for agentic tasks * Published benchmark or evaluation research (NeurIPS Datasets \& Benchmarks, ICML, ACL) * Built or contributed to eval frameworks (verifiers, lm\-evaluation\-harness, HELM or similar) * Familiarity with accounting, finance or other expert\-domain work * Public work we can look at: a benchmark, an eval suite, a failure\-analysis write\-up **Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)** ---------------------------------------------------------------- * Flexible PTO * Centralized home\-office equipment ordering * Health and wellness stipend * Budget for intra\-office travel * Weekly coffee stipend **United States** ----------------- * 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents * One Medical annual membership * 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp * Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay * Pet insurance * In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more * Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed) **Canada** ---------- * Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life * Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage * Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime) * Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP \+ DPSP) * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay * Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health **United Kingdom** ------------------ * Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite * Virtual GP and at\-home care via eMed x Livi * Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay **Referral Instructions** ------------------------- If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf. **Other notices** ----------------- Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. *Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @**Ramp.com* *email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.* Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice Compensation Range: $204\.4K \- $352K

jobs.title: Senior Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Job Title:** Senior Information Security Engineer **Department:** Operations – Services **Reports To:** RavenTek Program Manager **Location:** Remote **Schedule:** Monday – Friday **Hours:** Full\-time, 40\-hours/week **FLSA Status:** Hourly, Nonexempt **Clearance:** Public Trust **Position Summary** The Senior Information Security Engineer will support the development, implementation, and maintenance of information security standards and configuration baselines to ensure systems meet established security requirements. This position is responsible for evaluating security configurations, identifying vulnerabilities, and applying industry best practices and federal security guidelines to strengthen system security and compliance. The role requires collaboration with technical teams and stakeholders to deliver secure, reliable, and effective IT solutions. The performance of this position is key to RavenTek's performance on the contract and therefore RavenTek's mission to support the customer. Requirements: **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Develop, review, and maintain security configuration baselines using vendor documentation, CIS benchmarks, and STIGs. * Customize existing CIS and STIG benchmarks to meet organizational and customer\-specific security requirements. * Review and assess existing security configurations to identify vulnerabilities, security weaknesses, and compliance gaps. * Research and analyze identified vulnerabilities using the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) and Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE). * Translate technical security baseline requirements into applicable FISMA, NIST, and customer\-specific security requirements. * Apply NIST 800\-series guidance to support risk management, security control implementation, and ongoing security compliance activities. * Develop and maintain technical documentation related to security configuration baselines, standards, and security controls. * Provide technical recommendations to address identified security vulnerabilities and improve system configurations. * Collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to support the implementation of security baselines and compliance requirements. * Enter actual time worked, once complete, at the end of the day, or no later than 10:00 a.m. the following workday, and submit timesheets at the end of each pay period. * Submit Status Reports on a regular basis, as required. * Monitor RavenTek email on a regular basis, at least 3 times per week, and respond accordingly. * Complete required compliance training as assigned. * Other duties as assigned. **Knowledge and Critical Skills** * Knowledge of the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) and Common Vulnerability Enumeration (CVE). * Ability to create security baselines from scratch using vendor documentation. * Ability to modify CIS and STIG benchmarks to meet organizational requirements. * Ability to translate low\-level security baseline requirements into high\-level FISMA and NIST requirements and client\-specific security. * Ability to apply practical knowledge of commonly applied information security principles, concepts, and methodologies to resolve well\-defined questions or conditions. * Ability to meet deadlines and exercise efficiency in planning, prioritizing, and accomplishing assigned information and industrial security\-related tasks. * Analytical skills: proactive, flexible, attention to detail, and organizational skills required. * Excellent written and spoken communication, presentation abilities, and teamwork skills. **Education \& Work Experience** * High school diploma or GED required. * Bachelor's degree preferred. * Minimum of 5 years of experience supporting Information Technology (IT) operations. * Experience creating security baselines using CIS and STIG benchmarks. * Experience working with the NIST 800 Special Publication series guidance for risk management and security control implementation, including 800\-30,800\-37, 800\-53, 800\-60, 800\-63, 800\-115, or 800\-137\. * Experience reviewing, developing, or customizing general security configuration baselines. * Experience with networking technologies (Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto); operating systems (Windows Server, Red Hat Linux); cloud services and platforms (AWS, Azure, Salesforce, Okta, Office 365, ServiceNow); or mobile technologies (iOS, XenMobile) is preferred. * Experience designing, building, and implementing automation tools using Ansible, Chef, or Puppet is preferred. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, including CloudFormation or Terraform, is preferred. * Experience with container platforms, including OpenShift, is preferred. * Experience with chaos engineering and blue\-green deployments is preferred. * Experience with serverless technologies, including AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, and SAM, is preferred. * Experience with application performance analysis and monitoring tools, including ELK, is preferred. * Experience with JSON or YAML is preferred. **Certifications, Licenses** * AWS Certified Solutions Architect, preferred. * AWS Certified Developer, preferred. * Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), preferred. * Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE), preferred. * Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), preferred. * EBSA or ECSS Certification, preferred. **Special Requirements** * Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust and/or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements. **Work Environment** Employee will be working indoors in a home office environment. Potential moderate temperature fluctuations. Typical indoor and computer related noise level, and typical office, paper, and equipment related dust. Exposure to video display terminals occurs on a regular basis. **Physical Demands** To successfully perform the essential functions of the job, the employee needs to be able to sit at a workstation for extended periods; use hand(s) to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear; see to read printed materials and computer screens; mobility to work in a typical office setting. Ability to work on desktop or laptop computer for extended periods of time reading, reviewing/analyzing information, and may be required to provide recommendations, summaries and/or reports in written format. Must be able to effectively communicate with others verbally and in writing. Employee must be able to lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically up to 20 pounds. Regular and predictable attendance is essential. **ADA:** RavenTek will make reasonable accommodations in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990\. **EEO/AA:** RavenTek does not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sex, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, height, weight, or marital status in employment or the provision of services and is an equal access/equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. *This job description is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position and will be reviewed periodically as duties and responsibilities change with business necessity. Essential job functions are subject to modification. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Customer Data Platform (CDP) & Personalization
jobs.description: **Description** At Realtor.com®, we help people discover and create their perfect home. We bring together real estate data, consumer experiences and technology to support people throughout their home journey. Realtor.com is building a Customer Data Platform on Twilio Segment so we can recognize consumers across web, apps, email and push and give each person an experience that fits where they are in their home search. It’s heading to production now, and we need engineers to help build and run it. We’re hiring a Software Engineer for the CDP’s serving path: the profile store and the Personalization Activation Subgraph, a federated GraphQL service between the CDP and our site and apps. Personalization has to be fast and safe. If anything is slow or down, users and search engines just get the standard page. The work is backend\-first but goes all the way to the screen. You’ll write resolvers and profile store code, wire the subgraph into our server\-rendered pages and CMS, and build the components that render each treatment, its fallback and its exposure events. Over time you’ll own treatments end to end, from the CDP trait to the pixel on the page. You’ll start alongside a senior engineer and our vendor, then help bring the platform in\-house with data engineering, Identity \& Authentication, Web Platform, Mobile, Notifications and MarTech. Top Reasons to Apply: * Help build a new platform with real executive sponsorship. * Work on a system that sits at the meeting point of identity, data and the consumer experience on one of the largest real estate sites in the U.S. * Grow quickly with senior engineers on work that spans backend, front end and data What You’ll Do: * Build and maintain an Apollo Federation v2 subgraph that serves profile traits, audiences and personalization decisions to web, CMS and native clients, using our schema conventions, resilience patterns (timeouts, circuit breakers, kill switches, flags) and router\-provided identity so a CDP failure never breaks a page. * Help build the RDC\-owned profile store and its refresh pipeline (event consumers, backfills, rate\-limited batching) to serve traits in single\-digit milliseconds, partnering with Web Platform on caching. * Bring personalization into server\-rendered React pages, islands and CMS experiments with Apollo Client components that load without flicker, never block the page and protect Core Web Vitals, with clean exposure and engagement tracking through Segment. * Help build the Kafka integration that sends identity events to the CDP without PII leakage, and enforce consent and opt\-out so suppressed users are never personalized or tracked. * Ship through EKS, Argo CD, Helm and CircleCI, join on\-call once ramped up, build the dashboards, alerts and runbooks for your services, and turn product requirements into flagged, A/B\-tested features with short design docs. What You’ll Bring: * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, including building and supporting services in production. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. * Experience shipping user\-facing features across both a backend service and the UI. * Solid TypeScript/Node.js for backend work (our subgraphs are Node/TypeScript). * React and TypeScript on the front end, with some experience in server\-side rendering (Next.js or similar) and a GraphQL client such as Apollo Client. * Working knowledge of GraphQL APIs: schema design, resolvers and error handling. * Familiarity with caching and key\-value stores (Redis, DynamoDB or similar) and why latency matters for page rendering. * Understanding of basic resilience patterns: timeouts, retries and fallbacks. * Experience with AWS, Docker and CI/CD pipelines. * Habit of writing tests and adding logging and metrics to the code you ship. * Clear written communication and comfort asking questions and raising risks early. Preferred * Apollo Federation v2 experience: subgraphs, entities and @key, composition checks with Rover/GraphOS. * Hands\-on work with a Customer Data Platform, ideally Twilio Segment (Engage audiences, computed traits, Profile API, Destinations). mParticle, Tealium, Braze or Amperity also count. * Kafka or another event streaming system, including idempotency and ordering. * Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and front\-end performance tuning. * Feature flag and experimentation tools (LaunchDarkly, Amplitude Experiment, Optimizely) and exposure logging. * OAuth 2\.0/OIDC and JWT basics, or identity platforms like Auth0 or Okta. * Client\-side analytics (Segment analytics.js, Amplitude or similar). * Kubernetes, Argo CD, Helm and Terraform. * Observability tools such as New Relic or Datadog. * Awareness of privacy requirements around PII, consent and opt\-out (CCPA/CPRA). * Micro\-frontend, design system or headless CMS experience. How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: At Red River Managed Services, we provide a welcoming and positive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to do their best work, fostering a one\-team mentality. Our employees work together to foster wise decision\-making that relies on data, experience, and collaboration. We seek self\-motivated individuals who are open to an environment based on this teamwork and shared success. Our team works directly with our clients to create innovative solutions, challenge the status quo, and deliver first in class solutions. Our client\-centric culture works to anticipate needs with an urgency to resolve issues and build long\-term client relationships. We start by learning as much as we can about who they are, how they work, and what they’re striving for so we can feel their problems as our own. Partnering with our clients means their desired outcomes are always top of mind, their challenges and strengths guiding our efforts. customer service skills, both written and oral * Ability to explain just about anything technical to anyone, regardless of their background * Ability to context switch and balance multiple clients and priorities through good communication and strong task management and prioritization * Experience working in a dynamic IT environment * Ability to develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures States for any employer without sponsorship **Some of the technical skills we are expecting:** * Servers: Active Directory, Domain, SSL Certificate, Backups, Antivirus * Cloud: Azure, Office 365, AWS, Google * Network: Firewalls, Switches, Wireless, Voice, DHCP, TCP/IP, DNS, Routing * Applications and Products: Office 365, Common Line of Business Apps, Barracuda, Fortinet, Cisco, HP * Hands\-on technical experience with Windows Server operating systems, anti\-virus and antispam products, identity management solutions, Server Virtualization, and Group Policy **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree (preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems) or related field experience required * Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Azure, AWS, Cisco, Microsoft, ITIL) strongly preferred **Additional Information** What you should know about Resultant: * Rezzers are humble, hungry, and smart. jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** HarmonEyes is the world's only open, AI\-powered eye\-tracking platform that identifies and predicts a person's cognitive, emotional, and physical state based on eye movements alone. Compatible with any camera\-based device, HarmonEyes provides a one\-stop shop to analyze eye\-tracking data, develop models, and deploy solutions to applications at scale with the Theia™ SDK. Backed by 60\+ years of eye\-tracking experience and born from the largest validated eye\-tracking database (14 million unique records), HarmonEyes is used by the world's leading organizations in technology, aviation/automotive, healthcare, and elite performance in military and sports. **Job Description** **Job Description** As a Platform Engineer, you'll build and own the software that takes our ML models from research to production: the Theia SDK that runs real\-time inference at the edge, the APIs and services our customers and partners integrate with, and the cloud infrastructure behind our data and model pipelines. You'll work closely with our ML engineers and researchers, so you'll need to understand how models are trained, evaluated, and deployed, but your core focus is building reliable, well\-designed systems around them. **What You'll Do** * **SDK Development:** Design, build, and maintain the Theia SDK in Python and C\+\+, delivering real\-time eye\-tracking inference across desktop, mobile, embedded, and XR platforms. Own packaging, performance, versioning, and the developer experience. * **API \& Backend Development:** Design and implement APIs and backend services for data ingestion, model serving, licensing, and customer integrations, with a focus on clean interfaces, reliability, and security. * **Cloud Engineering:** Build and operate infrastructure on AWS, including containerized services on Kubernetes, infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD, and monitoring. * **Full Stack:** Build internal tools, dashboards, and customer\-facing web interfaces that make our data and models accessible. * **Data Science Engineering:** Build and scale the pipelines that process millions of eye\-tracking records for training, evaluation, and analytics. Clean, transform, validate, and analyze large tabular datasets, and build the tooling that lets our ML team explore and work with data efficiently. * **ML Productionization:** Partner with ML engineers to deploy, optimize, and monitor models in production and at the edge, including model conversion, latency and memory optimization, and inference pipelines. **Qualifications** **Qualifications** *Required* * 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience building production systems * Strong Python skills, including packaging and distributing libraries * Working familiarity with C\+\+ (reading, modifying, and building C\+\+ code in a cross\-platform codebase) * Experience designing and building APIs (REST, gRPC, or similar) and backend services * Hands\-on experience with AWS, containers, and CI/CD * Experience working with large tabular datasets in pandas (data cleaning, transformation, aggregation, and performance at scale) * Working familiarity with machine learning: you understand the model lifecycle and have helped deploy or integrate ML models in a product * Strong communication skills and comfort working across engineering and research teams *Nice to Have* * Experience building and shipping SDKs or libraries used by external developers * SQL and database engineering (schema design, query optimization, PostgreSQL or similar) * Kubernetes and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform or similar) * Frontend experience (React or similar) * Edge or on\-device inference (ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, TFLite, Core ML, or similar) * Python compilation or distribution tooling (Nuitka, Cython, pybind11, or similar) * Exposure to time\-series, sensor, or signal\-processing data * Interest in VR/AR, eye tracking, or human\-computer interaction * 1 year experience in a research setting (developing or working with ML research domains) **Additional Information** **Why Join Us** * Remote role with room to grow into automation, tooling, and AI\-engineering work—not a pure manual\-QA seat * Direct exposure to a novel technical stack: real\-time eye\-tracking, ML pipelines, SDKs, and VR/AR integrations * Tight feedback loop with senior engineering and leadership—the work you ship is felt across the company How to Apply This position reports into the engineering team. We're looking for someone who pairs solid QA fundamentals with curiosity for automation and AI\-assisted workflows. With your submission please attach: * Your resume * GitHub profile, portfolio, or links to relevant work (test suites, scripts, automations welcome) * A short note on a bug you're proud of finding—or an automation/script that saved you or your team meaningful time

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Cloud
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** At Rippling, we are not just building AI features, we are building an autonomous operating system for work. We are investing heavily in the next generation of enterprise AI: intelligent background automation, systems that monitor and improve themselves, and a custom intelligence layer built on Rippling's unique data and workflows. The opportunity is to push the boundaries of what machine learning can do in the enterprise through purpose\-built ML systems that learn from Rippling's proprietary data graph to deliver compounding intelligence across every product surface. You will be joining the team that recently launched Rippling AI, the fastest\-growing product in Rippling's history. The models and ML systems you build will be the intelligence powering every AI surface at Rippling. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will own the end\-to\-end ML lifecycle for projects within the AI Cloud team: problem formulation, data preparation, model development, evaluation, and production deployment. You will partner with Staff engineers and cross\-functional teammates to make Rippling's agents reliable, accurate, and continuously improving. This is a deeply hands\-on role, with opportunities to lead project\-level technical decisions and contribute to the team's broader ML direction. **What you will do** * Own the end\-to\-end machine learning lifecycle for high\-impact AI projects, from problem definition through production deployment and iteration. * Design and implement ML systems—including fine\-tuned LLMs, RAG, reward models, and multi\-agent orchestration—tailored to Rippling's enterprise domain. * Build robust evaluation and experimentation capabilities: offline benchmarks, A/B testing, and continuous monitoring of model quality. * Develop training pipelines and data flywheels that leverage Rippling's structured data graph. * Take ML techniques from research to production: evaluate where RLHF, distillation, structured decoding, and tool\-use training can improve model quality, reliability, and efficiency. * Build and improve feedback loops, active learning workflows, and automated retraining pipelines. * Partner closely with Product and Platform teams to translate requirements into reliable ML systems and deliver measurable product improvements. * Contribute to design and code reviews, share ML best practices, and mentor engineers within the team. * Stay current with ML research and apply relevant advances to production systems. **What you will need** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years focused on ML, with experience shipping and operating ML systems in production. * Strong practical experience with modern ML, including LLMs, transformer architectures, fine\-tuning, and RAG; familiarity with RLHF or related model\-alignment techniques. * Strong fundamentals in classical ML and statistics. * Hands\-on proficiency with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX and production ML infrastructure. * Experience building evaluation systems for generative AI. * Demonstrated ability to independently deliver complex ML projects, make sound technical tradeoffs, and collaborate across functions. * Strong product instincts and an ability to connect model improvements to customer outcomes. * Clear, precise communication to diverse audiences. * Comfort with ambiguity and high velocity. * Publications in top ML venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, EMNLP) are a plus. * Experience with enterprise data or knowledge graphs is a plus. **Additional Information** Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 172,800 \- 288,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: ### **RESULTS. INNOVATION. VALUES. ACCOUNTABILITY.** That's RIVA. We're a mission\-driven IT services company and systems integrator supporting digital transformation and modernization for federal government agencies. Since 2009, we've partnered with our customers to solve complex challenges through smart, practical innovation to deliver real outcomes where they matter most. Our teams are made up of industry\-leading experts who are passionate about doing great work and making a difference. We don't just develop solutions, we support efforts that strengthen communities and serve the public good. RIVA's culture is built on four core values: Results, Innovation, Values, and Accountability. They guide how we work, how we collaborate, and how we measure success. Our employee\-first approach is rooted in trust, ownership, and meaningful work. By investing in our people and fostering a flexible, supportive environment, employees have the opportunity to grow their skills, contribute ideas, and make an impact from day one. all while supporting missions that matter. ### **POSITION OVERVIEW** RIVA Solutions seeks an AI Subject Matter Expert to support the USPTO P\-TACTS program, the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) case tracking and electronic filing system. You will design, build, and evaluate production AI solutions that turn unstructured legal filings into reliable, structured data. A current example: a pipeline that reads PTAB petitions, institution decisions, and final written decisions, then extracts trial\-level and claim\-level outcomes. The team measures the pipeline against analyst\-labeled ground truth. The output supports reporting that PTAB delivers to Congress. You will work mainly in Python on Databricks, inside a secured federal environment. Development runs on remote instances through VPN. LLM access runs through an agency AI gateway, and approved models trail the commercial market. You will work directly with government stakeholders and engineers to turn mission needs into working, maintainable, and measurable applications. ### **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Build LLM pipelines that extract structured data from long, unstructured legal documents. * Decide when a task needs a flexible agentic harness and when it needs a constrained, step\-by\-step pipeline. Build either one. * Validate model outputs against schemas, allowed values, and business rules. Handle failures without losing records silently. * Design evaluations against ground truth. Choose the right metric for the problem, run error analysis, and report results in plain terms. * Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code every day to build, test, and review code. * Keep pipelines stable as approved models change, using version pinning, regression test sets, and prompt versioning. * Advise the customer on future use cases, including fine\-tuning small language models or adapters when the data supports it. ### **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of applied ML, data science, or AI engineering experience, including 2\+ years building applications on large language models in production or near\-production settings. * Strong Python skills, including data work with pandas or PySpark. * Solid ML fundamentals: classification, train and test splits, overfitting, data leakage, and model selection. * Hands\-on evaluation skill: precision, recall, F1, confusion matrices, class imbalance, and comparison to labeled ground truth. * Production experience building with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling, and prompt design. * Experience building or debugging an agent harness, and the judgment to explain when a structured pipeline is the better choice. * Experience validating LLM output with schemas (for example, Pydantic or JSON Schema), retries, and exception handling. * Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot. * Hands\-on experience building and running ML or LLM workloads on Databricks or a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Examples: data pipelines in PySpark or notebooks, calling hosted models through Databricks Model Serving, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, or Vertex AI, and tracking experiments in MLflow. * AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer \- Associate, or an equivalent cloud ML certification. An active AWS Certified Machine Learning \- Specialty also counts. * Eligibility to obtain a USPTO Public Trust and authorization to work in the U.S. ### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Databricks experience, including Jobs, Delta Lake, MLflow, and Unity Catalog. PyTorch experience, including fine\-tuning small language models or training LoRA adapters. * AWS experience, including Amazon Bedrock. * Information extraction from scanned or long documents, including OCR and layout analysis. * Retrieval augmented generation and vector databases. * MLOps experience: pipeline orchestration, evaluation sets run in CI, and monitoring of output quality over time. * Experience working through an enterprise AI gateway with cost tracking and request filtering. * Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional, Databricks Certified Machine Learning Associate, Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer \- Associate, or an equivalent cloud certification. * Experience with USPTO, PTAB, or patent and legal data. * Prior delivery on federal government contracts, including FISMA Moderate systems. ### **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY \& ACCOMMODATION** We believe great teams are built from different backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences, and we mean that beyond the buzzwords. RIVA is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation at any point in our process, send an email to talent@rivasolutionsinc.com, we'll be happy to help. ### **VETERAN SUPPORT \& ACCESSIBILITY** As a federal contractor, RIVA follows the requirements of the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act, supporting the employment and advancement of protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you're a veteran, we encourage you to self\-identify during the application process, it helps us track our hiring commitments and, in some cases, may support priority referral for open roles. RIVA also invites applicants to voluntarily self\-identify as having a disability during the application process, not because it affects your chances of being hired, but because it helps us measure how well we're living up to our commitments and identify where we can do better.
