jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Economy ML
jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 26704 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. The Economy ML team is building the machine learning backbone for Roblox’s virtual economy—from intelligent pricing and personalized storefronts to dynamic layout optimization and avatar content understanding. We partner closely with Marketplace, Payments, and Developer Monetization to deliver ML systems that drive long‑term value across engagement, retention, and creator earnings. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the team, you will build models that power ranking, personalization, pricing, and optimization across Roblox’s economic surfaces, including Marketplace, Developer Monetization, and Payments. Your work will directly shape how users discover virtual items, how creators earn, and how the platform grows sustainably. **You Will:** * **Design and iterate** on modern retrieval, ranking, and generative recommendation models (e.g., transformer\-based sequential models over user behavior) that personalize item and widget recommendations across the Marketplace and other shopping experiences. * Make these models **efficient to train and serve at scale**: choose architectures and modeling approaches with compute, latency, and cost budgets in mind, and partner with ML infrastructure engineers on distributed training and production serving. * Work backwards from ambiguous product problems and opportunities to design and ship **end‑to‑end ML solutions** across Economy surfaces, owning the full lifecycle: data and feature exploration, modeling, evaluation, and production deployment on Roblox’s ML platform. * Develop models and policies that optimize **pricing, conversion, and revenue** while balancing ecosystem health, payer experience, and creator success. * Design and run robust **experiments** (A/B tests and multi‑cell experiments), tying your work to core metrics such as engagement, bookings, and creator earnings. * Keep models healthy in production: set up monitoring for data and prediction quality, catch drift and regressions early, and help define the team’s on\-call practices for ML services. * Partner cross‑functionally with Product, Backend, Data Science, Design, and other Marketplace / Economy teams to define roadmaps, requirements, and success metrics for ML‑driven features. * Contribute to the **technical direction** of the Economy ML team: help shape our modeling roadmap, experimentation strategy, and approaches to long‑term reward optimization across the economy. * Mentor other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and hands\-on guidance, helping raise the technical bar of the broader Economy organization. **You Have:** * 3\+ years of industry experience building recommendation, search, or ranking systems for a high\-scale product. Experience with pricing or content understanding is a plus. * Deep, hands\-on expertise in modern recommender architectures (e.g., sequence models of user behavior, multi\-task ranking, large sparse embeddings) and in making them efficient to train and serve: comfortable with multi\-GPU training and with the tradeoffs between model quality, latency, and cost. Experience applying LLM or multimodal techniques to recommendation is a plus. * Fluent in the ML lifecycle: Comfortable taking a problem from messy data and product ambiguity through modeling, evaluation, and stable production deployment, with strong coding skills in Python and PyTorch. * You think in terms of impact on users, creators, and the business, and you can reason clearly about how model choices affect metrics like LTV, engagement, conversion, and creator earnings. * You are comfortable designing experiments, diagnosing metric movements, and iterating quickly while maintaining statistical rigor and healthy guardrails for the ecosystem. * You enjoy working closely with engineers, product managers, data scientists, and designers across Marketplace, Payments, and Developer Monetization, and you can drive alignment in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments. * You take a long‑term view of the Roblox economy, are comfortable challenging assumptions, and can balance quick wins with foundational investments in data, infrastructure, and modeling quality. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sage Care** ------------------- Sage Care is a fast growing, early stage healthcare startup transforming care navigation with AI. Our platform helps patients find the right care, enables providers to focus on the people who need them most, and improves access, quality, and economic outcomes at scale. Founded by leaders from Apple, Uber, and Carbon Health, Sage Care is backed by top tier investors including General Catalyst and Chelsea Clinton. As our first dedicated Security Engineer, you'll own security and compliance across our platform, applications, identity, and SaaS footprint, and you'll share ownership of the GCP and Kubernetes infrastructure that runs it. You'll set the guidelines engineering teams follow, implement the controls that matter most yourself, and be the technical voice in front of customer security teams. You'll report to the Head of Core Platform, Infrastructure and Security, who serves as Sage's Security Officer and HIPAA Lead. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Run our compliance program: SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA safeguards, risk assessments, vendor BAAs, and pen test remediation, with Vanta as the system of record. Extend it to HITRUST and international requirements as we grow. * Lead customer security reviews, questionnaires, and audits with hospital IT and security teams across all customers, in the U.S. and MENA. * Set security guidelines for engineering: secure design review for new services, application security standards, dependency and code scanning, and secrets handling. Decide what must be done and work with teams to get it done. * Own identity and access: Auth0, Google Workspace, SSO and MFA, access reviews, and least privilege across cloud and SaaS. * Build and operate infrastructure alongside the DevOps team: GCP, GKE, Terraform, and CI/CD, with IAM hardening, network controls, and policy as code built in. * Govern PHI: access policy, audit logging, retention, and security review of new data flows, including BigQuery. * Own detection and incident response: logging and alerting, runbooks, and the breach notification process. * Secure our AI agents: threat model prompt injection, tool misuse, and sensitive data disclosure in voice and LLM workflows. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- Required * 5\+ years in security engineering or infrastructure with security ownership. * Hands on SOC 2 and HIPAA experience in production environments, with Vanta, Drata, or similar. * Application security experience: secure code review, threat modeling, and CI/CD scanning. * Identity and access management experience with Auth0, Okta, or similar, and SSO/MFA across SaaS. * Strong GCP or AWS security, plus Kubernetes and Terraform in production. * Scripting in Python or Go. * Clear communication with engineers, auditors, and customer security teams; comfortable leading customer facing reviews. Nice to Have * Healthcare experience handling PHI. * HITRUST, ISO 27001, or UAE or other international healthcare compliance. * Securing LLM or voice AI products. * Experience as an early or first security hire at a startup. **How We Work** --------------- At Sage Care, our values shape how we build, collaborate, and serve. * **Do Good Through Serving People:** We serve users, teammates, and communities with integrity, compassion, kindness, and optimism. * **Innovate with Safety, Evidence, and Transparency:** We move quickly while prioritizing trust, safety, ethical decision making, and evidence based approaches. * **Lead with Curiosity and Kindness:** We ask questions before making assumptions and approach discovery, debate, and problem solving with humility and care. * **We, Not Me:** We believe the best work happens through collaboration, mutual respect, and constructive feedback. * **Efficiency and AI in All We Do:** We use automation and AI thoughtfully to work smarter, create leverage, and build better products. jobs.title: ELECTRONIC TECHNICIAN B - ENGINEERING DEPT-OPTICS TEAM
jobs.location: White Sands Missile Range, NM, US
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** Operates, maintains, troubleshoots, repairs, and installs various types of electronic and electro\-mechanical equipment and related devices used on Optical tracking systems such as LATS and MATS KTMS, VTMs, and mobile DOAMS. The tracking mount instrumentation includes such items as personal and industrial computers and terminals and VME\-based systems, industrial, measuring, and controlling equipment; and remote control systems. Must be familiar with multiple digital IO interface protocols (such as Ethernet and RS\-232\), common operating systems, Optics and equipment\-specific software, and word processing and spreadsheet programs. Applies technical knowledge of electronics principles and software in determining equipment malfunctions, and applies skills in restoring equipment operations. Sets up, operates and maintains a variety of electronic instrumentation equipment such as ROSS/ICE computers, PC Trackers, Servo and read out chassis by Brashear, Digital Control Systems, and mount control PCs. Applies technical knowledge to solve complex problems that typically cannot be solved solely by referencing manufacturers' manuals or similar documents. Examples of such problems may include determining the location and function of circuitry, evaluating electromagnetic radiation, isolating malfunctions, and incorporating engineering changes. Performance test electronic systems and equipment prior to test support to verify operation is within OEM and test support parameters. Understands and follows PMSP, calibration, security, safety, property control, and environmental procedures. May be required to complete daily, monthly, and maintenance reports. Work typically requires a detailed understanding of the interrelationships of circuits. Exercises judgment in performing such tasks as making circuit analyses, calculating waveforms, and tracing relationships in signal flow. Uses complex test instruments such as waveform generators, logic analyzers, digital oscilloscopes, IR scopes, hyper terminals, and complex computer control equipment. Work may be reviewed by a supervisor or engineer for general compliance with accepted practices. Must be able to provide technical guidance to lower level technicians as well as operating and maintenance instructions to equipment operators. Work will include cross\-utilization into other jobs as required. May require some overtime, weekend work, and possibly TDY assignments. **Minimum Qualification Requirements:** Demonstration of satisfactory skill and good performance in the particular field; two years progressive experience in the specific field in addition to graduation from a two year resident course at a technical institute, or a total of five years progressive experience in the specific field. Demonstrated experience must include expertise in operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of optical tracking instruments such as LATS, MATS, VTMs, and DOAMS, their computer control systems, networks, servo control systems; associated electronic, electrical, mechanical, fiber optics and computerized support equipment; and the interface to high speed digital video and IR systems. A minimum of four years of progressive computer experience in PC operations as applied to computer\-controlled instrumentation is required. Experience using Windows XP or later Operating System software and computer networks. Must possess a valid driver’s license. Applicant selected may be subject to a security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. \*If you are interested in this opportunity, please submit your application through the SRS Careers website using the following link: https://www.vscyberhosting.com/srs/ \*This is a civilian position Pay: $42\.32 per hour Expected hours: No less than 40\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.description: Description: **State Bar of Wisconsin is seeking an Infrastructure and Network Engineer (hybrid position)** The State Bar of Wisconsin is in search of an experienced Infrastructure and Network Engineer to support and maintain our network, servers, virtualization environment, Microsoft 365 services, and cybersecurity infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be an energetic, self\-starter who can complete projects and tasks with little day\-to\-day direction. We are looking for someone who will thrive in a small IT shop, loves to learn, and will take ownership and get it done. This person will also value excellent customer service and collaboration equally with technical elegance and skill. * Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. **Who We Are** The State Bar of Wisconsin is a professional association, created by the Wisconsin Supreme Court, for all attorneys who hold a Wisconsin law license. With more than 25,000 members, the State Bar exists to serve its members and the public by promoting the law and access to justice. We aid the courts in improving the administration of justice, provide continuing legal education and other services for our members, support the education of law students, and educate the public about the legal system. The State Bar of Wisconsin also provides public services \- such as attorney referrals and public education – and supports programs that provide reduced\-fee legal assistance for low\-income state residents. **What You Will Love** * The people, the culture and the flexible work environment! We care about our people, our work, and our members. We value work/life balance and offer excellent benefits and flexibility to support our employees and their families. Once trained, this position is eligible to work from home up to 3 days per week while working in the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. * Working with a mission\-driven organization that acts with integrity, promotes justice, and works toward a fair and just legal system. * Variety in your job! You’ll have the opportunity to work with a variety of technologies and tools to lay the foundation for the future. * Working with a collaborative, small IT team where you will be challenged and have autonomy to make impactful decisions. No two days will be the same and you will thrive in a dynamic, changing environment. **What You Will Do** * Support and maintain Microsoft Hyper\-V and SCVMM, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and related infrastructure. * Support Cisco switching, wireless, VLANs, VPN, routing, and network connectivity. * Monitor and troubleshoot network, server, virtualization, storage, and infrastructure issues. * Support Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, MFA, and identity services. * Assist with Cisco security technologies, including ISE and Umbrella, and support F5 application delivery and security infrastructure. * Perform system maintenance, patching, upgrades, configuration changes, and infrastructure lifecycle activities. * Assist with cybersecurity monitoring, vulnerability remediation, endpoint security, and incident response. * Support backup, recovery, and disaster recovery systems and testing. * Provide Tier 2 technical support for escalated infrastructure, network, authentication, and security issues. * Maintain network diagrams, system documentation, configurations, and technical procedures. * Participate in infrastructure, cloud, networking, virtualization, and cybersecurity projects. * Coordinate with vendors, consultants, and managed service providers. Requirements: **What We Are Looking For** * Two\-year degree in computer science or equivalent work experience in network administration. Bachelor’s degree preferred. * 3–5 years of experience in network administration, systems administration, infrastructure support, or a related IT role. * Experience supporting Windows Server and Active Directory. * Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, switching, routing, VPNs, firewalls, and wireless networking. * Experience supporting Microsoft 365 and Entra ID. * Experience with Hyper\-V, VMware, or another enterprise virtualization platform. * Working knowledge of cybersecurity and endpoint security fundamentals. * Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills. * Experience in gathering and analyzing business requirements * Project management experience * Experience with any of the following is beneficial but not required: Microsoft Hyper\-V, SCVMM, Intune, Cisco Networking, Cisco ISE, Cisco Umbrella, F5, Enterprise Storage and Backup/Disaster Recovery, HPE Servers * Relevant certifications such as CCNA, Microsoft, CompTIA Network\+, Security\+, or similar are a plus. **Compensation and Benefits** The State Bar of Wisconsin offers competitive compensation with annual merit increases and excellent benefits including: * 3 weeks of paid vacation per year * 2 weeks of paid sick time per year * Excellent and low\-cost health and dental insurance * Fully paid life and long\-term disability insurance * 2 weeks paid parental leave * 10 paid holidays plus 2 personal days * Hybrid work schedules and flexibility * 8% 401(k) contribution!! * The State Bar is also a “qualified employer” for the federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. **How To Apply** To apply, upload your resume and cover letter. This position will be posted until it is filled but priority will be given to applicants who submit early, so don’t wait. Apply today! **The State Bar of Wisconsin is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a fair, merit\-based hiring process. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds and seek to create a supportive, welcoming environment for all. Candidates who share these values are encouraged to apply.**

The Systems Administrator 3 will be instrumental in the implementation, deployment, and support of the Division’s timekeeping and records management system, while ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of existing technology systems. Responsibilities include assisting with and maintaining IT security plans, policies, and procedures to safeguard Division resources and support compliance with organizational security requirements. jobs.title: Director, AI/ML Engineering
jobs.description: Job ID: 2020988 Career Area: Engineering Position Type: Salaried Location: Headquarters \& Technology Center – Auburn Hills 48326, US Date Posted: November 2, 2026 Brand: FCA Group **Role Summary** ---------------- The Director of AI/ML Engineering — North America builds and leads our North American AI/ML engineering organization: a team of full\-stack AI/ML engineers delivering production AI products for engineering, quality, and vehicle\-data use cases. This is a hands\-on engineering leadership role with a deliberate emphasis on **solution development** — complete, production solutions including the user touchpoints and applications on top of them: we are looking for a leader with deep, current software\-development experience — someone who has shipped and operated real solutions end\-to\-end, not only models — to balance and strengthen a team whose roots are in data science and ML. You will build a North America team of 6–8 engineers — including hiring through an active pipeline — and own the delivery and production health of the AI/ML products your teams build. The AI \& ML Engineering organization is global: expect significant coordination across regions, and project teams that may be globally dispersed. **How we operate (read this before applying)** ---------------------------------------------- Our products are owned end\-to\-end by engineering leaders — you and your teams carry them from design through production and into maintain\-and\-optimize. **Direction, requirements, and priorities come through our program and product\-management partners.** This is a deliberate operating model, not a gap: the role succeeds through strong delivery inside that partnership — shaping requirements, pushing back with evidence, and building trust with program teams — not through sole control of product direction. Leaders here own products and stay close to the work; this is not a pass\-through people\-management position. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Team leadership \& growth** * Build and lead the North America AI/ML engineering team (6–8 engineers, including hiring) — recruiting, coaching, performance, and career development * Drive an active recruiting pipeline (external search partners \+ internal talent acquisition); raise the bar on engineering craft with every hire * Develop engineers toward the full\-stack AI/ML profile: comfortable across data, modeling, services, and application layers **Solution \& product delivery** The workload spans two distinct AI development modes, and this role delivers both: * **Agentic systems (primary growth area):** lead the build\-out of agentic AI capability — tool\-using, multi\-step agents that orchestrate data, models, and services to automate engineering and quality workflows. This is where the team is growing and where the Director is expected to lead from the front: agent architectures, orchestration frameworks, tool/API design for agent consumption, evaluation and guardrails for autonomous behavior * **Generative AI workloads:** deliver and evolve LLM\-powered product features — summarization, retrieval\-augmented generation, content generation, conversational interfaces — as an established and continuing part of the portfolio * Own delivery of production AI/ML solutions end\-to\-end: data pipelines, model services, the agentic and generative components above, APIs, and the user touchpoints — applications and dashboards — on top of them * Set and enforce engineering standards — architecture, code review, testing, CI/CD — and stay hands\-on: expect to read and review code * Work closely with the dedicated MLOps team and hand off to them for production release and operation — build to their readiness standards and gates, and route production\-driven code changes back through your teams * Champion AI\-native engineering practice — agentic development tooling, high AI\-assisted throughput with engineering discipline **Cross\-functional leadership** * Partner with program and product\-management teams on scope, priorities, and delivery commitments; communicate progress with evidence * Operate as part of a global organization — significant coordination with teams and functional leads across regions (data science, MLOps, data engineering); project teams may be globally dispersed, and NA\-built products align with global platforms and standards * Contribute to the AI/ML Engineering leadership team: org design, capacity planning, and the maintain/optimize\-vs\-new\-development balance as products graduate into production **EOE/Disability/Veteran** At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome applications from all people without regard to sex, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any characteristic protected by law. We believe that diverse teams reflect our identity as a global company, enabling us to better address the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future. Our benefits reflects the STELLANTIS commitment to helping you reach your personal and professional goals. In addition to an environment that promotes career development, we offer benefits for a healthy lifestyle and a rewarding future, designed to take care of you and your family, in various stages of life. As a global company, our employee packages will vary by country, customary norms and the legal entity into which you are hired. We care about your privacy. For more information on how your personal data is processed, please read the specific Privacy Statement provided by the respective entities whose job offer you have selected.

jobs.title: Propulsion Base Software Sr Core Development Engineer
jobs.description: The Propulsion Base Software Core Development Engineer is responsible for contributing to the development of embedded software for EE/core and propulsion control modules. This role involves software requirements analysis, design, development, integration, and validation of base software components. The engineer will actively participate in technical reviews, collaborate across teams and suppliers, and ensure delivery of high\-quality, standards\-compliant software. Experience in low\-level driver development, AUTOSAR\-based systems, and virtualization methodologies is highly desirable. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and integrate embedded low\-level driver software for ICE propulsion and electrified powertrain control modules. * Implement and optimize hardware interface drivers for peripherals such as SPI, I2C, UART, ADCs, timers, PWM, and driver circuits (e.g., HSD/LSD, H\-Bridge). * Contribute to MCAL integration and development of complex device drivers aligned with AUTOSAR architecture. * Analyze software requirements and translate them into scalable design and robust implementation. * Perform hardware\-software integration including interpreting schematics, validating electrical interfaces, and supporting hardware bring\-up. * Debug and resolve complex embedded system issues using tools such as Lauterbach, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. * Optimize embedded software for real\-time performance, deterministic behavior, and efficient memory utilization on multicore microcontrollers. * Collaborate with Base Software Architecture teams to align with AUTOSAR, RTE integration, and system\-level design. * Conduct and participate in reviews of requirements, design documents, source code, and test plans. * Ensure compliance with automotive software standards and processes including MISRA\-C, ASPICE, and ISO 26262\. * Develop and execute software verification strategies including unit, integration, and system\-level validation (white box, black box, gray box). * Support virtualization and simulation\-based development methodologies within the software lifecycle. * Create and maintain technical documentation including design specifications, interface documentation, and test plans. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (systems, hardware, validation, calibration, and suppliers) to ensure seamless integration. * Drive defect resolution, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities. * Support vehicle integration, software bring\-up, and production readiness activities. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. * 8 years of related experience * Embedded C/C\+\+ software development experience in a real\-time operating system (RTOS) environment. * Experience in Vector/ETAS/AUTOSAR Basic Software configuration (OS, MCAL, IOHWAB, FEE, WDG, etc.). * Hands\-on experience with low\-level driver development and microcontroller\-based systems. * Experience with multicore microprocessors and strong ability to interpret hardware schematics. * Understanding of Functional Safety concepts (ISO 26262\). * Experience with development tools including compilers, emulators, Lauterbach debuggers, and automation scripting. * Experience in software verification and validation including white box, black box, and gray box testing. * Familiarity with automotive software quality standards such as MISRA\-C. * Strong understanding of hardware interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, SENT, ADCs, timers, I/O, and communication peripherals. * Experience with hardware\-software integration and debugging using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills. * Ability to adapt to changing environments with minimal impact on productivity. * Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, and ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Computer, or related discipline). * Academic or project experience in programs such as Formula SAE or SAE EcoCar. * Experience with automotive data acquisition and analysis tools such as ETAS, INCA, CANoe, or CANalyzer. * Hands\-on experience with automotive microcontrollers (e.g., Infineon AURIX, NXP, or similar). * Strong understanding of propulsion systems including internal combustion engines, hybrid systems, battery electric vehicles, and vehicle subsystems. * Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering teams. * Exposure to simulation, virtualization, SIL/HIL, or model\-based development environments. * Experience with Electrobit EB tresos Studio MCAL configuration. * Experience with advanced peripherals such as GTM, PWM, high\-speed timers, and ADC synchronization. * Experience supporting hardware bring\-up, early software enablement, and production software delivery. **Our Benefits \- Designed with You in Mind** **Comprehensive Health \& Well\-being Coverage** From your very first day, you'll have access to medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage \- ensuring you and your family stay healthy and protected. **Generous Paid Time Off** We believe in work\-life balance. That's why we offer: 17\+ paid holidays, including shut\-down from December 24th through New Years Day every year. Vacation, float \& wellbeing days, sick time and fully paid parental leave when your family needs you most. **Competitive Retirement Savings Plans** We help you plan for the future with: * An employer match on contributions to your 401k, Roth, and Catch\-Up plans * An employer contribution, even if you don't contribute **Income Protection \& Insurance Options** Benefit from included and optional disability, life, and other insurance programs \- because your peace of mind matters. **Company Vehicle Lease Program** Eligible employees and their immediate families can enjoy company vehicle lease options with included insurance, maintenance, and unlimited mileage. Plus, take advantage of exclusive discounts on Stellantis products. **Family Building Benefit** We proudly support all paths to parenthood\- including fertility and infertility treatments, adoption services, and gestational surrogacy. **Support for Your Growth and Giving Back** We believe in investing in your future and your passions: * Tuition reimbursement * Student loan refinancing programs * 18 paid volunteer hours each year to make a difference in your community **And so much more!** When you join us, you're not just building a career \- you're joining a company that supports you, inside and outside of work.

jobs.title: Sr. Process Engineer
jobs.description: **Stellantis Financial Services (SFS)** is the new captive finance company for one of the world's leading automakers and a mobility provider with iconic brands including Abarth, Alfa Romeo, Chrysler, Citroën, Dodge, DS Automobiles, Fiat, Jeep®, Lancia, Maserati, Opel, Peugeot, Ram, Vauxhall, Free2move and Leasys. Our exciting growth provides opportunities to advance your career as we successfully lead products and services from a small to midsize company in just a few years. Join our world class team and culture and contribute to our core mission which is enhancing our customer's experience. **Position Summary** -------------------- As a Senior Process Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting initiatives to optimize operational efficiency, enhance customer satisfaction, and drive continuous improvement at Stellantis Financial Services. You will be responsible for identifying, designing, and implementing process enhancements that align with business objectives and regulatory requirements. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- * Facilitate cross\-functional teams in process improvement projects using Kaizen, Design Thinking, Lean, Six Sigma, and other methodologies. * Consult with business leaders and define issues with recommendations to improve current state with solutions with AI. * Manage complex initiatives, timelines, budgets, and deliverables to ensure successful outcomes. * Lead the Process Engineering Framework roadmap, including routines, standards and enterprise process management system. * Lead the enterprise process management system implementation including but not limited to, enterprise process taxonomy, process migration and training. * Partner with various departments, including operations, compliance, IT, and customer service, to understand challenges and develop solutions with appropriate AI solutions. * Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders to foster a culture of continuous improvement. * Ensure processes comply with financial regulations and industry standards. * Collaborate with compliance and risk management teams to identify controls and mitigate potential risks. * Drive organizational change by identifying root causes, implementing improvements and communicating benefits effectively. * Provide training and support to teams to ensure successful adoption of new processes. * Evaluate and recommend technology solutions to automate and enhance processes. * Work closely with IT to integrate technology into process improvement initiatives. * All other duties assigned. **Qualifications and Competencies Required** -------------------------------------------- To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. ### **Required Experience** * Minimum of 7 years’ experience in the following related functions: Process management experience in Operations, Finance or Regulatory. ### **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations Management, or a related field. ### **Skills Required** * Expertise in Lean Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt certification preferred), and other process improvement methodologies. * Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and performance measurement. * Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and manage complex projects. * Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. * Familiarity with financial services regulations and compliance requirements. * Proficiency in process modeling tools and technology platforms (e.g., BPM, RPA). * Travel 0\-10% as required on an as needed basis. * Must have reliable transportation and live within a commutable distance to one of the following cities: + Atlanta, GA + Dallas, TX + Detroit, MI + Houston, TX + Phoenix, AZ ### **Qualifications Preferred** * Process Management certification preferred; Lean Six Sigma, Design for Six Sigma (DFSS), and Design Thinking certifications strongly desired. * Strong strategic thinking and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify and implement process improvement opportunities. * Proven experience facilitating process improvement events, workshops, and cross\-functional initiatives that drive operational excellence. * Ability to effectively navigate ambiguity, assess complex situations, and make sound business decisions. * Results\-oriented mindset with a demonstrated focus on achieving measurable outcomes and sustainable improvements. * Adaptable and effective in fast\-paced, highly regulated environments, with strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills. **Physical Demands** -------------------- The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision. **Work Environment** -------------------- The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. **Work Schedule** ----------------- This position requires the ability to work various shifts to accommodate business needs. Typically, between the hours of 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM Monday through Friday and on weekends as needed. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- Stellantis Financial Services, Inc. (SFS) is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing its employees an environment that is free of harassment, discrimination, and intimidation. It is the policy of SFS to comply with all applicable employment laws and regulations and to provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and to not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity or expression, change of sex, and/or transgender status or any protected status. Candidates must possess authorization to work in the United States. This policy applies to recruitment and placement, promotion, training, transfer, retention, rate of pay and all other terms and conditions of employment. Employment and promotion decisions will be based solely on merit, ability, achievement, experience, conduct and other legitimate business reasons. ### **Work Authorization Requirement** **An applicant must be authorized to work in the United States to be eligible for this position. Stellantis Financial Services, Inc. will not sponsor applicants for work visas of any type for this position.**

jobs.title: AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description: Location: Northbrook, IL, US, 60062 **Job Description** ------------------- Stepan Company is building an enterprise\-wide AI capability through its RISE (Results\-Driven Intelligence for Stepan Excellence) program — focused on delivering real business value through automation, AI, and intelligent agents. We are seeking a **Senior AI Solutions Developer** to design, build, and deploy enterprise\-grade AI solutions. This is a hands\-on, senior engineering role responsible for end\-to\-end solution delivery, from ideation through production and adoption. While our primary ecosystem is Microsoft (Copilot, Power Platform, Azure), we are looking for a well\-rounded AI engineer who can apply the best tools and frameworks for the problem—including modern LLM frameworks, agent orchestration platforms, and cloud\-native architectures. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and build AI solutions * Develop scalable AI\-powered applications, copilots, and autonomous agents that solve real business problems across functions * Agentic AI and automation * Design and implement multi\-step, agent\-driven workflows that leverage LLMs, APIs, enterprise data, and orchestration frameworks to execute business processes end\-to\-end * Modern AI roles increasingly focus on orchestrating agents that plan, reason, and act using external tools and systems. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: With constant innovation, cutting\-edge technology, and fast\-paced development, we’re looking for talented professionals to join our **Information Technology** team to help us continue delivering an unparalleled customer experience. The **Data Engineering** department oversees the standardization, management, and adoption of services that support key technology initiatives, while also collaborating on cloud architecture, automation, data pipeline development, and data modeling to support business intelligence and data science goals. This team plays a critical role in leveraging data assets to drive actionable insights and innovation across the organization. The **Data Engineer** is responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines that move and transform data from Stuller’s systems into its cloud data warehouse. Working with senior team members, this role follows established data modeling patterns to support business intelligence, analytics, and data science. This role provides the opportunity to develop end\-to\-end data solutions using a modern data engineering technology stack. The Data Engineer will write and test dbt models, gain exposure to the semantic layer and analytics engineering practices, and develop reliable solutions through regular design and code reviews. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Build, test, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that move data from ingestion to consumption using established tools and patterns, including Airflow. * Write and test dbt models under the guidance of senior team members. * Write performant SQL while following established schema conventions in the Snowflake data warehouse. * Transform and integrate data from multiple sources into models that support reporting and analytics. * Support semantic layer development and analytics engineering practices under senior team guidance. * Monitor data workflows, troubleshoot issues, and help identify and resolve data quality concerns. * Follow established data security, governance, testing, and deployment practices. * Develop awareness of warehouse compute costs and avoid wasteful query patterns. * Collaborate with analytics and data science teams to understand and support their data needs. * Complete well\-defined tasks reliably, participate in regular design and code reviews, incorporate feedback, and escalate blockers appropriately. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience. * Foundational understanding of SQL and relational database concepts. * Exposure to ETL/ELT concepts and pipeline tools, including Airflow. * Basic familiarity with dbt or a similar transformation framework, or a strong aptitude to learn. * Understanding of core data warehouse concepts, including schemas, roles, and warehouses. * Awareness of the cost implications of compute\-intensive queries. * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to quality and detail. * Strong communication skills within a team setting. * Ability to manage assigned work, follow established guidelines, incorporate feedback through regular reviews, and escalate blockers appropriately. * Demonstrated curiosity, reliability, integrity, and commitment to continuous learning. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with Snowflake, AWS, or Python. * Experience with data modeling in analytics environments. * Familiarity with semantic layers or analytics engineering practices. * Experience with Agile development practices. Stuller is the jewelry industry's largest manufacturer, supplier, and technology developer in North America. With a customer base spanning the globe, we serve jewelry professionals through an unmatched selection of quality products, expert and friendly service, and the fastest delivery. We are powered by our employees, their creativity, their energy, and their commitment to creating exceptional experiences. We are committed to our employees' comprehensive health and happiness. Our award\-winning wellness initiatives and benefits help Stuller to stand out as one of the top employers in Louisiana. Learn more about our benefits by clicking here.

jobs.description: **Why Join Sunrise Senior Living** ================================== **At Sunrise Senior Living, we believe meaningful work starts with purpose. The unique responsibilities for this role include but are not limited to the essential functions listed as follows: * Build applications that matter. The requirements listed throughout this job description are representative of the knowledge, skills and abilities required. Qualifications: * 5\+ years of professional experience in software engineering, DevOps, or a combination of both, with meaningful hands\-on capability across application development and production operations * Experience running production workloads on AWS, with an understanding of what it takes to deploy, monitor, troubleshoot and improve them * The ability to build production\-quality applications in a modern language such as Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, C\# or Java. We also offer benefits and other compensation that include: * Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Plans * Retirement Savings Plans * Employee Assistant Program / Discount Program * Paid time off (PTO), sick time, and holiday pay * myFlexPay offered to get paid within hours of a shift * Tuition Reimbursement * In addition to base compensation, Sunrise may offer discretionary and/or non\-discretionary bonuses. The eligibility to receive such a bonus will depend on the employee’s position, plan/program offered by Sunrise at the time, and required performance pursuant to the plan/program. * Some benefits have eligibility requirements ***Apply today to learn why Sunrise Senior Living is a certified Great Place to Work®*** ======================================================================================== **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Sunrise Senior Living is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Back-End - Mail (LatAm)
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Hub \- San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering, Product, Design, and MarketingEngineering ***We are only able to consider candidates based in Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico****. For candidates based in these countries, Superhuman offers a fully remote working model for this particular role on the Mail team. This gives team members plenty of focus time and the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they're based, while staying closely connected to a collaborative, tight\-knit team culture.* **About Superhuman** -------------------- Superhuman is the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here. **The Opportunity** ------------------- Superhuman is building the AI productivity platform that works everywhere people do \- and the back end is where the intelligence lives. On the Mail team, our Back\-End engineers build the systems that power calendar, scheduling, and AI\-driven workflows, from the real\-time infrastructure behind Superhuman Mail to the services that connect our AI layer to users across desktop, web, and mobile. This is backend work at the intersection of systems engineering and AI. You’ll join the Mail team at a pivotal moment: as "AI Home" in our product and new integrations raise the bar, we’re modernizing our calendar backend, including calendar syncing, notification infrastructure, and the APIs that serve every client. That architecture is what makes agent\-based features, like meeting notes and scheduling agents, possible without slowing the product down. You’ll work in Go, Postgres, Kubernetes, and AWS, alongside a strong team of product engineers. Superhuman’s engineers have the freedom to innovate and shape the product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale AI\-powered features across every surface. You can hear more from our team on our technical blog. **As a Back\-End Engineer, you will:** * Build and operate high\-throughput production services that power AI agent orchestration, connector integrations, and real\-time data pipelines. * Design and build core platform services — task schedulers, session and conversation history, client\-server protocols, and the APIs that connect our AI engine to every product surface. * Work across the Superhuman product suite — whether that's Go, Mail, Docs, or Enterprise — depending on where you and the team see the best fit. * Collaborate closely with ML/AI, Product, and Front\-End engineers to ship AI\-powered features end to end. * Build and evolve infrastructure as code, targeting high availability for both consumer and enterprise customers. * Contribute to an engineering culture with a strong emphasis on documentation, testing, and reliability. * Mentor and grow junior engineers on the team. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years of experience in back\-end development, with strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, and system design. * Experience building, deploying, and debugging production systems at scale. * Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms (GCP, Azure). * Comfort working with AI\-powered systems — whether that's building infrastructure for LLM\-based features, managing agentic workflows, or integrating with ML pipelines. Prior experience building backend services for AI products is a plus. * Fluency with AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) and a point of view on how they change the way teams build software. * Experience with real\-time systems, event\-driven architectures, or high\-throughput API design is a plus. * Deep understanding of CI/CD and infrastructure as code. * Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage priorities across multiple projects, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams. * Strong product instincts — you care about the end\-user experience and can make good tradeoffs between speed and reliability. We invite you to share your knowledge, experience, and goals with us to help us find the best team match for you. Tell us your superpower! **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Your engagement with Superhuman is facilitated through an **Employer of Record (EOR)**. As your legal employer, the EOR administers your employment, payroll, and applicable benefits locally. Our EOR offers competitive compensation along with a comprehensive benefits package that includes the following and more: * **Health Insurance:** Medical and dental coverage for you and your family * **Paid Parental Leave:** Statutory or 10 weeks (whichever is greater) * **Paid Maternity Leave:** Statutory or 10 weeks (whichever is greater) * **Generous PTO:** Statutory or 20 vacation days (whichever is greater) regional paid holidays, and a 20\-day sabbatical after 5 years of service * **Dependent \& Pet Care Coverage:** up to the local\-currency equivalent of $950 USD while traveling for business * **Lifestyle \& Wellness Perks:** up to the local\-currency equivalent of $120 USD/quarter wellness budget * **Learning \& Development:** up to the local\-currency equivalent of $2,000 USD annual budget for books, courses, and professional training * **Work From Home:** Statutory or up to the local currency equivalent of $200 USD (whichever is greater) Specific benefits and administration vary by country and EOR requirements. The expected base salary range for this role varies by country of residence: * Brazil: R$538,000 \- R$562,000 * Argentina: ARS $152,000,000 \- $160,000,000 * Mexico: MXN $1,843,000 \- $1,928,000 Final compensation within these ranges is determined based on experience, qualifications, and local market factors. Ranges are administered through the EOR in accordance with local requirements. **We encourage you to apply** ----------------------------- At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI
jobs.description: **Real people. Real service.** At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of **G**enerosity, **R**espect, **I**nnovation, **T**eamwork, and GRIT, we're dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry\-leading e\-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers. We are looking for a **Technical Product Manager \- AI** to join our Product, Systems, and Insights Team. This individual will report into our Senior Director, PSI and will own the strategy and execution of AI\-driven technology initiatives across the business. You will partner closely with developers and business stakeholders to discover, define, and ship AI solutions that create measurable value. If you are interested in both strategic vision and hands\-on execution, we want to hear from you! This **remote** position is open to individuals who live in, or are open to relocating to, the following states: *Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.* This position requires travel to our headquarters in Melville, NY 6 times per year for internal meetings and team building activities. We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you're also welcome to work on\-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open. **Role Type:** Full\-Time, Exempt **Location:** Remote **Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with time zone flexibility **Base Salary:** The expected starting salary for the position is **$121,971 to $152,464** within a full position range of $121,971 to $182,956 annually. This range reflects the long\-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint. **Responsibilities:** * Define and own the AI product roadmap, spanning customer\-facing features (search \& discovery, personalization, recommendations, and agentic self\-service) and internal tools (RAG\-based co\-pilots, content generation, workflow automation, and decision support systems) * Partner with developers to scope, architect, and deliver AI solutions, from proof of concept through production deployment * Lead discovery: identify high\-value AI opportunities by engaging with customers, business teams, and data; translate findings into clear problem statements and testable hypotheses * Write detailed requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria in JIRA and Confluence with sufficient technical depth for AI/ML development * Design and manage experiments and A/B tests to evaluate AI feature performance; analyze results and drive iteration * Act as translator between business stakeholders and technical teams, articulating AI capabilities and limitations in business terms, and framing business goals in technically actionable ways * Monitor AI product performance post\-launch; define and track relevant metrics (accuracy, engagement, conversion, latency, etc.) and respond to regressions or emerging opportunities * Champion responsible AI practices across all initiatives, including data privacy, model fairness, security, and quality standards * Enable internal adoption of AI tools by developing documentation, playbooks, training materials, and demos for business teams * Stay current on the AI/ML and bring actionable insights back to the roadmap **Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field * 5–8 years of product management experience, with at least 2 years leading AI/ML or data\-driven product initiatives * Product Management experience specifically within an ecommerce setting strongly preferred * Strong working knowledge of modern AI/ML approaches: large language models and prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, recommendation systems, search/ranking, and personalization * Demonstrated experience partnering with data science and ML engineering teams to ship production\-ready AI features * Technical fluency sufficient to read API documentation, understand data schemas and model architecture tradeoffs, and engage meaningfully in system design discussions * Proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, and agile/scrum methodologies * Strong analytical skills; comfortable defining success metrics, designing experiments, and interpreting quantitative results * Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, able to align executives, engineers, and business partners around a shared visi :** * Experience with LLM evaluation, prompt design, and AI quality assessment is a plus * CSPO, SAFe POPM, or relevant AI/ML certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional ML Engineer, or similar) **Why work with us:** * **We have awesome benefits** – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include: + Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and voluntary life insurance options + 401(k) with up to 4% company match + Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays + Company\-paid basic life insurance and long\-term disability + Discounted auto, home, and pet insurance programs + Flexible Spending Account (FSA) + Confidential mental health, financial planning, and legal support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) + Company\-provided equipment and one\-time $250 work from home stipend + $750 annual professional development budget + $25 monthly Grubhub credit + Company rewards and recognition program + And more! * **We empower ownership** – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company's growth and accomplishments. * **We promote work\-life balance** –We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our wellness initiatives and ask about our Flex\-Time Policy! * **We support growth** –We encourage you to embrace continuous learning and take on new challenges. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands\-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, internal mobility options, and professional development budget. * **We give back** – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee\-nominated contributions, support for non\-profit organizations, Volunteer Paid Time Off, and more. * **We listen** – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check\-ins, employee listening initiatives, and company\-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day. **Check us out and learn more at:** **https://www.supplyhouse.com/our\-company****!** **Additional Details:** * Remote employees are expected to work in a distraction\-free environment. Personal devices, background noise, and other distractions should be kept to a minimum to avoid disrupting virtual meetings or business operations. * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full\-time basis. SupplyHouse.com will not sponsor applicants for work visas. * SupplyHouse.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. * To ensure fairness and trust in our hiring process, we ask that all application materials, assessments, and interview responses reflect your own thinking and perspective. You may use AI tools to assist in preparing your responses, as long as this use is clearly disclosed and you can speak authentically to your ideas and work. Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem\-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills. * We are committed to providing a safe and secure work environment and conduct thorough background checks on all potential employees in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. * All emails from the SupplyHouse team will only be sent from an @supplyhouse.com email address. Please exercise caution if you receive an email from an alternate domain.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Terranova** ------------------- Terranova is a hard\-tech company developing innovative systems to reshape the physical world. We combine mechanical engineering, robotics, automation, and real\-world field operations to tackle complex engineering challenges. We're looking for an **AI Engineer** to help us build smarter, more efficient ways of working across our engineering, manufacturing, and field operations. **About the Role** ------------------ As an AI Engineer at Terranova, you'll develop practical AI\-powered tools, software, and analytical models that improve how our team designs, builds, tests, and operates complex machinery. This is a highly hands\-on role focused on solving real engineering and operational problems. You'll work closely with mechanical, electrical, software, and field engineers to identify inefficiencies, automate repetitive workflows, and turn operational data into actionable insights. We're looking for someone who can independently identify opportunities, rapidly prototype solutions, and deploy tools that make a measurable difference in how the company operates. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **AI Tools \& Workflow Automation** * Design and build internal AI\-powered tools that streamline engineering, manufacturing, and operational workflows. * Identify repetitive, manual, or cumbersome processes and develop software solutions to automate them. * Integrate AI tools with existing engineering software, databases, documentation, and operational systems. * Build internal applications that help engineers and operators access information, make decisions, and complete tasks more efficiently. **Data Analysis \& Process Optimization** * Develop systems to collect, track, and analyze metrics across shop operations, equipment performance, and field activities. * Analyze field injection data, including flow rates, pressures, material consumption, ground uplift, and operational efficiency. * Build dashboards, reporting tools, and data pipelines to visualize performance and identify opportunities for improvement. * Help quantify engineering and manufacturing processes to establish benchmarks, monitor performance, and reduce inefficiencies. * Develop models to predict operational outcomes, improve process parameters, and support engineering decisions. **Modeling \& Applied AI** * Build and deploy machine learning, statistical, and predictive models for engineering applications. * Use LLMs, AI agents, and other emerging technologies to automate complex workflows and improve internal productivity. * Develop tools for analyzing experimental results, identifying trends, and optimizing system performance. * Explore new applications of AI across robotics, manufacturing, equipment monitoring, and field operations. **Cross\-Functional Engineering** * Work directly with engineers, technicians, and operators to understand challenges and develop practical solutions. * Take projects from problem identification through prototyping, implementation, and iteration. * Build lightweight, maintainable tools that can be deployed quickly and improved based on real\-world feedback. * Proactively identify opportunities where software, data, or AI can improve the company's efficiency and capabilities. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Strong proficiency in Python and experience building software tools, automation scripts, and data\-processing pipelines. * Experience working with LLM APIs, AI agents, machine learning frameworks, or applied AI systems. * Ability to build end\-to\-end applications, from data ingestion and backend logic to simple user interfaces. * Strong data analysis skills, including SQL, Pandas, and statistical modeling. * Experience integrating APIs, databases, and third\-party software platforms. * Comfortable working with messy, incomplete, or unstructured real\-world data. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to independently take loosely defined problems and turn them into working solutions. * Interest in physical engineering systems, manufacturing, robotics, or industrial operations. * Ability to work closely with multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical concepts clearly. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with industrial automation, PLCs, sensors, or equipment telemetry. * Familiarity with mechanical engineering, fluid systems, hydraulics, or manufacturing processes. * Experience with time\-series data, predictive modeling, or optimization algorithms. * Experience developing computer vision applications for industrial monitoring or quality control. * Familiarity with CAD software, engineering simulations, or engineering data pipelines. * Experience deploying internal tools using modern web frameworks and cloud services. **Why Terranova?** ------------------ At Terranova, you'll have the opportunity to apply AI to real\-world engineering problems rather than building software in isolation. Your work will directly influence how physical systems are designed, manufactured, tested, and operated. You'll have significant ownership over projects, the freedom to experiment with new technologies, and the ability to see your solutions implemented in the shop and in the field. We're looking for a builder who enjoys moving quickly, solving ambiguous problems, and using AI and software to make complex engineering operations more efficient.

This is not a configuration role. Oracle configuration is owned by the client's systems integrator. This role owns the data: mapping, business rules, FBDI load files, mock conversion cycles and reconciliation, with Tessera's platform and AI agents doing the extraction, transformation and loading at scale. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **1\. FBDI Loads and Reconciliation (30%)** ------------------------------------------- * Own FBDI and HDL template usage per object, and work with the systems integrator on load sequencing, environments and load error resolution. * Run mock conversion cycles end to end and diagnose load failures in Oracle Fusion terms. * Set reconciliation controls (counts, balances, aging, subledger to GL) and drive reconciliation to the client's exit criteria, including 100% reconciliation for Fixed Assets and Projects. * Secure business validation and sign\-off for each release. **3\. Client and Partner Leadership (25%)** ------------------------------------------- * Act as the senior Oracle point of contact on site with the client's finance SMEs, data conversion lead and systems integrator. * Lead mapping reviews, exception decisions and sign\-off sessions, and explain differences in accounting language. * Flag scope, risk and readiness issues early, including source system access, environment readiness and SME availability. **4\. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $225K

jobs.title: Oracle Financials Solution Architect-Finance to Manage (EBS and Fusion)
jobs.description: **Oracle Financials Solution Architect — Finance to Manage (EBS and Fusion)** ============================================================================= **Center of Excellence \| Working alongside Tessera AI Agents** **Location:** US\-based or near\-shore (Latin America). Both are open, and we will evaluate strong candidates from either. **Remote:** Yes, with travel to customer sites for workshops, pre\-sales meetings and go\-lives as needed. **Experience:** 15\+ years **Employment type:** Full\-time, permanent for US\-based candidates; long\-term contract for near\-shore candidates. **Positions:** 1 **Start date:** Immediate. **Engagement model:** Multi\-engagement solution architect role with a strong pre\-sales component. Approximately 60% delivery across several concurrent Oracle Financials engagements (discovery, design, hands\-on configuration and testing), 25% pre\-sales and client leadership, 15% platform enablement and product input. Works US business hours alongside customers, Oracle module consultants, Forward Deployed Engineers and the Principal Architects. **About Tessera Labs** ---------------------- Tessera is an AI\-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi\-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI\-native platform. For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for Oracle and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI\-powered, multi\-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English. **Role Summary** ---------------- We are looking for an Oracle Financials Solution Architect to own Finance to Manage — General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and the close — across several customer engagements at the same time, in both Oracle E\-Business Suite and Oracle Fusion Cloud. You run the discovery, lead the conversations with finance leadership, architect the design, configure it with your own hands and prove it works in testing. This is not a role where the design is handed to someone else to build. Many of our customers are not upgrading from one Oracle version to another. They come from a completely different ERP — PeopleSoft, JD Edwards, NetSuite, SAP ECC, Infor or a home\-grown finance system — and the chart of accounts, subledgers, intercompany and close process have to be redesigned, not migrated. You need to be able to read the legacy finance landscape, understand how the business really closes its books, and translate that into a clean Oracle design. You will also be one of the faces of our Oracle finance capability in front of prospects. You will run discovery calls and demos, shape solutions and estimates, contribute to proposals and statements of work, and stand in front of a CFO or controller to explain how we will get them there. Strong client communication is not a nice\-to\-have in this role; it is half of it. Exposure to Cost Accounting is a strong plus, because many of our customers are manufacturers and distributors where finance and costing cannot be designed apart. You will do this work with Tessera’s AI agents, not instead of them. The platform analyses the legacy configuration and data, drafts process models and fit\-gap, generates configuration and test scripts. What it cannot do is decide how many ledgers a customer really needs, or whether a legacy intercompany process is a requirement or a workaround. That judgment is the role, and every time you exercise it we expect it to go back into the platform. Two outcomes define the job. The first is a finance solution the customer’s controller signs off and closes the books on — reconciled, auditable and simpler than what it replaced. The second is that we win and deliver the next one faster, because what you learned is captured in the platform and in our pre\-sales material rather than in your head. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **1\. Discovery and Solution Architecture (25%)** * Lead finance discovery with the controller, accounting, AP, AR and treasury teams: read the legacy configuration, reports and close checklists, and separate real requirements from habits and workarounds. * Translate the legacy finance model into Oracle — chart of accounts and segment redesign, ledgers (primary, secondary and reporting currencies), le ral Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets and Cash Management in both EBS and Fusion. You configure the system yourself rather than only writing the design. * Strong accounting and enterprise\-structure design: chart of accounts, ledgers and legal entities, Subledger Accounting / Accounting Hub, intercompany, multi\-currency and the period\-end close. * Proven pre\-sales experience on Oracle opportunities: discovery calls, solution demos, orals, estimates, and contributions to proposals, RFP responses and statements of work. * Excellent client communication: able to lead workshops with finance teams, present to a CFO or controller, and hold difficult conversations in a way that keeps the relationship. * Experience leading testing for finance — CRPs, SIT, UAT and mock closes with reconciliation — through to go\-live and the first closes after it. * Proven ability to work on several engagements at once without losing control of any of them. * Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months. * Excellent verbal and written business English, with strong presentation ability to both business and technical audiences. * Experience working with distributed (onshore, nearshore and offshore) delivery teams, with strong asynchronous communication discipline. * Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Who This Role Is Not For** ---------------------------- If your experience is configuring one module to a design someone else agreed, this is not the role — the work here starts with discovery and ends with a closed period. If you are an architect who no longer configures or tests yourself, you will find the hands\-on share of this role uncomfortable. If you have only ever moved customers from one Oracle release to another, you will under\-estimate how much of a different ERP’s finance model has to be understood before it can be replaced. And if you would rather not be in front of prospects, or see pre\-sales as somebody else’s job, this role will not suit you. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Cost Accounting experience in EBS Cost Management or Fusion Cost Management — standard and actual costing, cost elements, receipt accounting, landed cost and the cost\-to\-ledger flow — and exposure to Profitability and Cost Management. * Fusion Revenue Management (ASC 606 / IFRS 15\) and Advanced Collections. * Financial reporting and consolidation: FSG, Financial Reporting Center, Smart View, OTBI, and EPM or close tools such as Oracle FCCS or OneStream. * Migrations specifically from PeopleSoft, JD Edwards or SAP ECC to Oracle Fusion, including chart\-of\-accounts redesign and opening\-balance conversion. * Manufacturing, distribution, retail or financial services industry experience. * A CPA, CA, ACCA or equivalent accounting qualification, or an Oracle Financials certification for EBS or Fusion. * Prior experience partnering with AI, automation or RPA tooling inside an enterprise delivery context. * Spanish, Portuguese or German is a plus but not a must\-have. **First\-Year Measures of Success** ----------------------------------- * Month 1: Fluent in the Tessera platform. Leading finance on at least one engagement and supporting at least one live Oracle pursuit in pre\-sales. * Month 3: Finance design signed off and configuration underway on that engagement, a mock close completed or planned, finance pre\-sales material and estimating inputs in place, and reusable finance content live in the Tessera platform. *No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs’ name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $230K

jobs.description: **Oracle Fusion Data Conversion Consultant (Functional and Technical)** *Working alongside Tessera Labs' Mosaic AI Agents* **Location:** US East Coast **Remote:** Yes **Engagement type:** Fixed\-term contract (initial 3 to 6 months), full\-time capacity, with possibility of extension **Start date:** Immediate (November) **Openings:** 3 (Financials; Procurement; Projects and Time and Labor) **Engagement model:** Senior data conversion role working with Tessera Labs' Forward Deployed Engineers and Mosaic AI agents, under the direction of the on\-site Oracle Data Migration Architect.
