Backed by Foundation Capital and led by a world\-class founding team, we combine deep enterprise ERP expertise with autonomous AI agents to deliver transformation outcomes at a fraction of the traditional time and cost. Our mission is to bring real AI automation to the enterprise, delivering speed, precision, and measurable impact. We operate with extreme ownership, move fast, and hold ourselves to the same rigor as the best traditional system integrators while working at AI\-native speed. **Role Summary** ================ We are seeking hands\-on Oracle Fusion data conversion consultants for a multi\-release conversion from PeopleSoft and other legacy finance systems into Oracle Fusion Cloud, for a large US financial services client. FBDI Files, Loads and Errors (30%)** ------------------------------------------ * Prepare and check FBDI files for each mock conversion cycle. * Analyse load errors in Oracle Fusion terms and drive fixes in mapping, data or sequencing. * Support test loads and full\-volume loads in each release window. **3\. Reconciliation and Sign\-off (25%)** ------------------------------------------ * Reconcile converted data to legacy by counts and balances, to the client's exit criteria for each mock. * Prepare reconciliation evidence and explain differences to finance users. * Support business validation and sign\-off. **4\. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $225K

jobs.title: Associate/Full Professor of Electrical Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Title** Associate/Full Professor of Electrical Engineering**Agency** Texas A\&M University \- Texarkana**Department** College of Engineering and Computing \- Engineering**Proposed Minimum Salary** Commensurate**Job Location** Texarkana, Texas**Job Type** Faculty**Job Description** The College of Engineering and Computing invites applications for a full\-time, nine\-month, tenure\-track faculty position at the rank of Associate/Full Professor of Electrical Engineering who will contribute to both the Electrical Engineering and Computer Engineering programs, with an anticipated start date of Fall 2027\. The successful candidate will teach and develop undergraduate and graduate courses in robotics, control systems, and computer engineering; support student success through teaching, mentoring, and advising; collaborate with colleagues across the college; and contribute to teaching, scholarship, service, and the advancement of departmental and college strategic goals. Consistent with the University's R2 research aspirations, the successful candidate will establish a productive research program, pursue external funding, disseminate scholarly work, and engage students in research. The focus areas of robotics, control systems, and computer engineering offer significant opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration, graduate education, industry partnerships, and sponsored research. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, along with a commitment to a student\-centered learning environment, are essential. Working closely with college leadership and faculty colleagues, the successful candidate will contribute to implementing and continuously improving the 126\-credit\-hour electrical engineering curriculum, develop teaching and research laboratories, participate in ABET assessment and accreditation activities, and build partnerships with industry and research organizations. The faculty member will help create a dynamic learning environment that provides students with hands\-on experiences through laboratories, undergraduate research, design projects, industry\-sponsored projects, internships, and other experiential learning opportunities, while supporting the continued growth of the program, the college, and the university. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Establish an active scholarly program involving peer\-reviewed publications, external funding, and meaningful undergraduate research appropriate to the rank. * Teach undergraduate and graduate courses and laboratories that support the Electrical Engineering and Computer Engineering programs, particularly in robotics, control systems, artificial intelligence, and related engineering areas. * Develop courses, laboratory experiences, and instructional materials supporting the 126\-credit\-hour curriculum. * Assess student learning and use results to improve courses and program effectiveness. * Advise and mentor students on academic, research, professional, and career matters. * Contribute to curriculum development, ABET preparation, continuous improvement, and accreditation. * Lead or support the development, safe operation, and improvement of electrical engineering teaching and research laboratories. * Serve on division, college, and university committees. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES:** **Minimum Qualifications** * An earned Ph.D. in electrical/computer engineering or a closely related field. * A record of, or demonstrated potential for, effective teaching in electrical and computer engineering courses and laboratories. * A record of active and impactful research, scholarly publication, and external funding appropriate to the rank sought. * Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a growing college. * For appointment at the Associate Professor rank, a record of teaching, scholarship, and service that meets Texas A\&M University Texarkana standards for appointment at that rank; normally, this includes at least five (5\) years of successful service at the Assistant Professor rank or equivalent experience. * For appointment at the Professor rank, a record of teaching, scholarship, and service that meets Texas A\&M University Texarkana standards for appointment at that rank; normally, this includes at least five (5\) years of successful service at the Associate Professor rank or equivalent experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Ability to teach and develop courses relevant to electrical and computer engineering, with demonstrated expertise in one or more areas, including robotics, control systems, artificial intelligence, or intelligent systems. * Experience with curriculum development, innovative and experiential teaching practices, and the development, commissioning, or operation of electrical engineering laboratories. * Familiarity with ABET accreditation, outcomes\-based assessment, and continuous program improvement. * Evidence of the ability to engage undergraduate students in research, design, and industry\-sponsored projects. * Professional Engineering (PE) licensure or eligibility to obtain the PE license. * Experience with program development. **Other Requirements** * Eligibility to work in the United States at the time of hire. No pre\-employment sponsorship is authorized for this position. * Ability to travel or work beyond normal office hours when required for program activities. * Ability to maintain confidentiality in academic and student matters. **SUPERVISION OF PERSONNEL:** This position generally does not supervise employees. **ABOUT TEXAS A\&M UNIVERSITY TEXARKANA** Texas A\&M University Texarkana is a regional comprehensive university committed to academic excellence, student success, applied research, and service to the communities of Northeast Texas and the surrounding region. The College of Engineering and Computing is developing programs that address workforce needs, create pathways for first\-generation and transfer students, and connect engineering education with industry, innovation, and economic development. **Applicants should submit the following materials:** * Cover letter describing the candidate’s interest in the position and alignment with the mission of the University and College. * Curriculum vitae. * Teaching statement that includes the candidate’s teaching philosophy, courses, and laboratories the candidate is prepared to teach or develop, and evidence of teaching effectiveness. * Statement of research interests and plans, including opportunities to engage undergraduate students. * Unofficial graduate transcript. * Contact information for three professional references with at least one being from a previous/current supervisor. For applicants with degrees from non\-U.S. institutions, transcripts and academic records must be evaluated on a course\-by\-course basis by **WES** or another **NACES\-approved** agency as part of the application. If documents are not in English, notarized English translations are required. Applicants are responsible for all evaluation and translation/notarization costs. Please remember once you submit your application you will not be able to “revise” or upload any documents. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check. jobs.title: Release Engineer
jobs.description: **Position summary:** The Release Engineer is responsible for executing and supporting software releases across The Clearing House's payment platforms, including CHIPS, Real Time Payments (RTP), EPN, and SVPCO. This role supports deployments across Quality Engineering (QE), Bank Test (BT), and Production environments, ensuring accuracy, operational stability, and compliance with established change and release management controls. The Release Engineer serves as a technical resource for deployment automation and tooling, working closely with Product Engineering, Operations, and other technology teams to maintain deployment configurations, troubleshoot issues, and support new initiatives. Responsibilities also include ownership and continuous improvement of release execution and governance processes, release tracking, version accuracy, documentation, and audit compliance. This position requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-paced, highly regulated environment. The Clearing House operates in a 24x7x365 environment, requiring occasional evening and weekend work to execute or support planned software deployments. **About The Clearing House:** The Clearing House Payments Company L.L.C. is a bank\-owned industry utility that shapes the payments landscape and provides infrastructure for safe, reliable, and efficient payments. We see an economy where everyone is connected and a future where modern payments make life easier. The Clearing House operates four payment systems: a high\-value wire\-transfer system (the CHIPS® network), the country’s first and largest instant payments system (the RTP® network), an automated clearinghouse network (the EPN® network), and a check image exchange network (the Image Exchange Network). TCH also operates a bank account number tokenization service, runs a payments association known as the TCH Payments Authority, and maintains the rules for private\-sector check image exchange through its ECCHO® business line. **Qualifications required:** The candidate must be self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and capable of working independently or collaboratively in a fast\-paced, highly regulated environment. Strong technical troubleshooting, organizational, and communication skills are essential, along with the ability to manage multiple concurrent release activities. * Experience with software release engineering, application deployments, or technical application support in enterprise environments. * Working knowledge of software release and change management processes across testing and Production environments. * Hands\-on experience administering and troubleshooting Windows Server and Linux operating systems. * Experience developing, modifying, and troubleshooting deployment automation scripts using both PowerShell and Bash/Shell scripting. * Experience with enterprise deployment automation tools, such as IBM DevOps Deploy (formerly UrbanCode Deploy), or comparable platforms. * Understanding of software version control, deployment package management, and release tracking processes. * Experience troubleshooting deployment failures, analyzing logs, identifying root causes, and coordinating technical issue resolution. * Experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) tools, such as ServiceNow or comparable platforms, and working knowledge of ITIL or equivalent change and release management practices. * Ability to develop and maintain technical deployment procedures, operational documentation, and process standards. * Experience collaborating with application development, infrastructure, operations, and other technical teams to support software releases. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to prioritize competing responsibilities and work effectively under pressure. * **Qualifications desired:** * Direct experience administering and configuring IBM DevOps Deploy (formerly UrbanCode Deploy), including application processes, components, environment properties, and deployment automation. * Experience supporting software releases in financial services or payment processing environments, preferably involving CHIPS, Real Time Payments (RTP), EPN, or SVPCO. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment tool integrations involving Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, or GitHub Actions. * Experience supporting Unisys mainframe software deployments, including MARC\-based deployment jobs, software staging, log analysis, and coordination of installation procedures with Operations teams. * Advanced PowerShell and Bash scripting skills, including deployment automation, configuration management, and troubleshooting utilities. * Direct experience with ServiceNow release and change management processes, including release records, workflow tracking, and compliance documentation. * Familiarity with ITIL\-based change and release management processes. * Experience supporting internal or external technology audits, including gathering evidence and demonstrating compliance with established controls. * Familiarity with cloud technologies, preferably Amazon Web Services (AWS), including application deployments and DevOps practices in hybrid or cloud environments. AWS certifications are a plus. Experience using generative AI tools, such as ChatGPT or comparable AI assistants, to support scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational efficiency while adhering to organizational security policies. * **Success factors/job competencies:** * **Technical Proficiency and Problem\-Solving** : Demonstrates strong technical aptitude in software deployment, automation, scripting, and troubleshooting, with the ability to investigate deployment failures and resolve technical issues effectively. * **Deployment Accuracy and Quality:** Ensures correct software version selection, deployment configurations, and adherence to established implementation procedures while minimizing deployment\-related risks. * **Release Process Ownership:** Demonstrates accountability for maintaining, enforcing, and continuously improving release execution processes, standards, and controls. * **Risk Management and Compliance** : Identifies and mitigates deployment risks while ensuring adherence to change management requirements, internal controls, and audit expectations. * **Organization and Prioritization:** Effectively manages concurrent releases, competing priorities, and time\-sensitive activities while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines. * **Communication and Collaboration:** Communicates effectively and works collaboratively with Product Engineering, Operations, infrastructure teams, management, and other stakeholders. * **Documentation and Process Discipline:** Maintains accurate release records, deployment procedures, technical documentation, and supporting evidence to ensure traceability and audit readiness. * **Initiative and Adaptability:** Proactively identifies opportunities to improve deployment reliability and efficiency while adapting to new technologies, tools, and evolving business requirements **.** * **Accountability and Independent Judgment:** Takes ownership of assigned release activities, exercises sound technical judgment within established responsibilities, and prioritizes operational stability and risk reduction. **Physical demands and work environment:** The working environment is generally favorable. Lighting and temperature are adequate, and there are no hazardous or unpleasant conditions caused by noise, dust, etc. Work is generally performed within an office environment, with standard office equipment available. Travel may be required. Candidates will report to the office three days each week. Onsite work requirements may change at any time **.** **Work Schedule** : Occasional evening and weekend work is required to execute or support planned software deployments and related release activities in support of The Clearing House's 24x7x365 operational environment. *The anticipated annual salary range for NY\-based candidates for this position is up to $125,000\. Base salary and position level will be determined by the role, experience, skill set and location. For eligible positions, discretionary incentive compensation may be awarded contingent on personal and company performance. Our benefits program includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k plan with company contribution and company match, tuition reimbursement and more.*

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer, People Data and Insights
jobs.description: **The** **mission** **of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It's why we have a world\-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It's why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world\-class digital and app destination. And it's why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it's worth paying for.** **About the Role** ------------------ The New York Times is rebuilding how we use people data. Instead of one\-off reports and ad hoc pulls, we are building governed, reusable data tools that HR leaders, HR partners, and their counterparts use to make decisions. You will help build this layer. People data at The Times lives in several systems, each with its own definitions and history. You will turn that into a modeled, tested, documented foundation that products can be built on repeatedly. You will lead the models, transformations, and data quality behind every product this team ships. You will report to the Senior Director, People Data and Insights. You will work out of the New York office on a hybrid schedule. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * You will design, build, and maintain the data models and databases that our products run on. * You will oversee the transformation layer from source systems into governed, tested, documented models. * You will turn metric definitions from the data dictionary into executable logic, so that a definition and the number it produces cannot drift apart. * You will build data quality into the pipeline: tests, validation, and reconciliation across sources that surface problems before team members do. * You will work with the Program Manager to translate product requirements into models, and push back when a requirement and the underlying data do not agree. * You will handle effective\-dated and historical data correctly, so that point\-in\-time questions get point\-in\-time answers. * You will implement and maintain access controls appropriate to compensation, demographic, and other sensitive data. * You will document models and lineage so that all can understand why something was built the way it was. * You will demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world **Basic Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or an equivalent role building production data models. * You are a SQL expert * Strong dimensional modeling skills, and the judgment to know when to normalize and when not to. * 5\+ years of experience with a transformation framework such as dbt, and with version control and code review as part of normal practice. * 5\+ years of experience handling slowly changing dimensions, dated records, and point\-in\-time reporting. **Preferred Qualifications** * 2\+ years of experience with HR or people data, and with systems such as Workday, Greenhouse, or One Model. * Python for orchestration, API work, or data validation. * 2\+ years of experience with AWS data services. * Familiarity with BI and analytics tooling such as Hex, Tableau, or Looker. * 2\+ years of experience in an organization with distinct populations operating under different rules, such as union and non\-union groups. **Additional Compensation and Benefits:** For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company\-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs. For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process. **Candidate Use of GenAI Tools:** We're excited to learn more about you and your experience. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ At Thesis, we believe everyone should have the opportunity to meet their potential. We build nootropic supplements and customer experiences that help people find the right support for their goals. Across Thesis and Stasis, we're also changing how our company works. Our teams use AI to develop creative, research customers, build digital experiences, analyze performance, and reduce repetitive operational work. We're looking for an engineer who can turn those experiments into reliable systems that people use every day. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for an AI Engineer to build the agents, integrations, and internal tools that help a small team accomplish more. You'll work with Data, Engineering, Growth, Creative, and Operations to find valuable problems, prototype solutions, and own them through deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement. This is a hands\-on software engineering role focused on applied AI. You'll build with existing models, connect them to our tools and knowledge, and make their outputs useful and trustworthy. You should be as comfortable debugging an API integration as designing an agent workflow, and care about whether your work saves time, improves decisions, or helps the business grow. We already have AI\-assisted workflows and a shared Claude skill and knowledge system. You'll build on that foundation, making successful workflows easier to reuse and bringing production engineering to the parts that need it. You won't be starting from a blank page, and you won't be limited to maintaining what's already there. **How You'll Make an Impact** ----------------------------- ### **Build agents that do useful work** * Design and ship agents that retrieve information, use tools, and complete multi\-step tasks across our business systems. * Connect workflows across tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Asana, Shopify, and Klaviyo through APIs, webhooks, and MCP integrations. * Make long\-running workflows dependable with persistent state, retries, duplicate prevention, clear approvals, and recoverable failures. ### **Accelerate creative and growth workflows** * Partner with Creative and Growth to improve the path from customer research and performance insights to briefs, scripts, creative variants, and testable landing pages. * Build workflows that combine brand knowledge, approved product claims, asset libraries, and creative performance data while keeping human review where it matters. * Help teams learn from prior experiments so each new brief or test benefits from what we've already discovered. ### **Make company knowledge and data more useful** * Extend our shared skills, knowledge base, retrieval, and context\-management systems so AI tools can find and use the right source material. * Partner with our data team to connect AI workflows to governed analytics in Metabase and Hex, backed by Snowflake, rather than inventing competing definitions of business metrics. * Use SQL and data validation to investigate issues, verify outputs, and make analytical workflows easier for non\-technical teammates to use. ### **Turn prototypes into reliable products** * Build evaluations using real business tasks. Test accuracy, task completion, tool behavior, failure recovery, latency, and cost before scaling a workflow. * Add monitoring, useful logs, version control, automated tests, and clear documentation. Own failures after launch and fix their causes. * Protect customer and company data, separate brand and account contexts, and preserve human approval for consequential actions. * Choose the simplest approach that works, including ordinary code or deterministic automation when an LLM adds no value. ### **Help the company use AI well** * Work directly with teammates to understand their workflows, ship usable interfaces, and help them adopt what you build. * Create reusable skills and integrations rather than isolated prompts that only their author can operate. * Evaluate new models and tools through practical experiments, then explain what is worth adopting and why. * Measure outcomes such as time saved, adoption, output quality, and faster experiment cycles, not just the number of automations shipped. **We're Excited About Your** ---------------------------- * Experience shipping software that real users depend on, with ownership beyond the initial prototype. * Hands\-on LLM application development using Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable APIs, including structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, and multi\-step workflows. * Strong Python or TypeScript skills, sound software design, and comfort working with APIs, authentication, databases, and asynchronous jobs. * Practical understanding of RAG, context management, and MCP. You can explain the tradeoffs and show when a simpler approach is better. * Ability to build evaluations, diagnose unreliable behavior, and improve an AI system using evidence rather than prompt tweaking alone. * Working SQL proficiency and experience validating data against established reporting or warehouse models. * Product judgment and clear communication. You can turn an ambiguous request into a focused solution, explain technical tradeoffs, and work effectively with non\-technical partners. * Curiosity, initiative, and follow\-through. You experiment independently, learn quickly, and take responsibility for whether your work is useful. Experience with Claude Code, Codex, shared agent skills, or agent orchestration platforms such as OpenClaw is a plus. So is experience with ecommerce, consumer subscriptions, creative production, multimodal generation, or analytics tools such as PostHog and Metabase. We don't expect you to have used every tool in our stack. **How You'll Work** ------------------- You'll work on problems with visible business impact, from reducing manual reporting to making creative production and customer research more effective. You'll partner closely with the people doing the work, test with real inputs, and keep improving the system after it ships. We value people who can move quickly without confusing a convincing demo with a dependable product. Bring strong engineering fundamentals, good judgment about where AI helps, and a willingness to get into the details. **In Your Application** ----------------------- Tell us about an AI system you built that people actually use. What problem did it solve, what did you personally build, how did you evaluate it, and what failed along the way? Share a demo, repository, or architecture walkthrough where possible. Please don't include confidential information from another employer. **A Few of Our Perks and Benefits** ----------------------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity. * Health, dental, and vision plans. * HSA, FSA, and pre\-tax commuter benefits. * 401k to help you plan for the future. * Flexible PTO. * Unlimited Thesis nootropics. * A strong emphasis on personal development and promoting from within. * A dog\-friendly office in Flatiron, near Union Square and Madison Square Park. **Our Values** -------------- **Meet Your Potential:** Keep learning, seek honest feedback, and help others grow. **Own Outcomes:** Take responsibility for results, act with urgency, and follow through. **Lead with Science and Data:** Seek the truth through evidence and use it to make better decisions. **Create Exceptional Experiences:** Show up for teammates and customers with care, high standards, and a sense of belonging. **Pay Transparency** -------------------- Our salary ranges reflect competitive compensation for our size and industry and are one part of a total rewards package that includes benefits and equity. The base salary hiring range for this position is $160,000–$200,000\. Final compensation will be based on the candidate's location, skill level, and experience.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, ML Systems

Real world IT judgment is still required: to direct AI effectively, catch what it misses, and make the final call on tasks before they're marked done. What You Gain * Ownership: end\-to\-end accountability for IT management and compliance at a growing AI company * Impact: direct collaboration with leadership and real influence on technical direction * Growth: clear path to a lead role as the team expands * Equity: early stage equity at an AI startup * Quality: a clean environment and a team that takes IT compliance seriously Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Product Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Product Quality Engineer** Thompson Retractor has an opportunity for a **Product Quality Engineer.** The Quality Engineer is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality systems and processes that ensure medical devices meet applicable regulatory requirements and customer expectations. This role serves as a key technical resource for inspection planning, measurement system validation, customer complaint management, and regulatory document impact assessments. The Quality Engineer will work cross\-functionally with manufacturing, engineering, and regulatory affairs to uphold compliance with 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485:2016, and the EU Medical Device Regulation (EU MDR 2017/745\). Thompson is employee\-owned and vested employees automatically receive company shares. **What you’ll do:** * Develop, author, and maintain internal Quality Inspection Plans (QIPs) for machined components and assemblies, including critical\-to\-quality (CTQ) characteristic identification. * Lead end\-to\-end APQP phases for new program launches, tracking milestones to ensure compliance with customer specifications. Compile and submit complete PPAP packages\- including PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, and dimensional results—securing on\-time customer sign\-offs. * Collaborate with manufacturing and process engineers to ensure inspection plans reflect current production processes, drawing revisions, and design intent. * Perform initial process studies (SPC) and capability analysis to verify manufacturing process stability prior to customer submission. * Review and interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T (ASME Y14\.5\), material specifications, and customer requirements to establish dimensional and functional acceptance criteria. * Collaborate with the CMM Programmer to capture, document, and maintain Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) set\-up plans, including part datum alignment, fixturing requirements, probe configurations, and reference feature sequences. * Translate CMM Programmer inputs into clear, controlled set\-up documentation (work instructions, setup sheets, and visual aids) that inspection personnel can consistently execute on the shop floor. * Serve as the primary Quality point of contact for the intake, processing, and closure of customer complaints in accordance with 21 CFR Part 820\.198 and ISO 13485 Section 8\.2\.2\. * Manage the end\-to\-end complaint lifecycle: receipt and acknowledgment, initial evaluation, complaint investigation, root cause analysis, corrective action, and formal closure. * Collaborate with the Risk Manager and Regulatory Affairs to evaluate each complaint for adverse event and MDR/Vigilance reportability; provide quality investigation findings, device history records, and risk data to support the reportability determination; ensure timely submission of Medical Device Reports (MDRs) to FDA and Vigilance Reports to Notified Bodies / Competent Authorities. * Lead and document formal impact assessments when external regulatory standards, guidance documents, or customer specifications are revised or newly issued. * Review regulatory updates for applicability to current products, processes, quality management system (QMS) procedures, and technical documentation; identify gaps and compliance risks. * Support the update or creation of quality system procedures, work instructions, forms, and technical file content to reflect regulatory changes; ensure document control compliance throughout. * Participate in internal and external audits (FDA inspections, ISO 13485 certification audits, Notified Body audits); jobs.description: **About Tolmo** --------------- Tolmo is cybersecurity for the age of AI. Coding agents now ship software faster than any human team can review or secure it; 100\+ pull requests per engineer per week is no longer an outlier, and attackers are using the same agents to find and exploit weaknesses in days, not months. The old playbook of quarterly pentests and endless alert queues breaks at this speed. We're building a new security playbook. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer – AI and Automation (Team Breeze)
jobs.description: **Who Are We?** Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it. **Compensation Overview** The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance\-based cash incentive awards. **Salary Range** $142,900\.00 \- $235,800\.00**Target Openings** 1**What Is the Opportunity?** At Travelers, we're building the future of insurance — and Team Breeze is at the center of that work. This role puts you at the intersection of large language models (LLMs), cloud\-native infrastructure, and real business impact. If you've shipped AI agent systems to production and want to do it again at scale, we'd like to talk.**What Will You Do?** * Lead the design, configuration and development of complex, high\-visibility AI applications on Team Breeze with a focus on LLM agents, retrieval pipelines and production reliability. * Design and implement agent orchestration flows using AWS Bedrock AgentCore and/or frameworks such as LangGraph, including tool calling, routing and prompt strategies for Claude models on Bedrock. * Own the retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline end to end — from document ingestion (SharePoint/LivePublish to S3\), processing and embedding in Databricks, and serving from a vector store via Python retrieval APIs (FastAPI/Haystack) — including evaluation steps that measure retrieval and answer quality before each release. * Architect and build services on AWS using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront/Lambda@Edge, Route 53, Secrets Manager/Vault and Bedrock application inference profiles to track and manage cost. * Develop and operate containerized retrieval and evaluation services on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), deployed with Helm and ArgoCD, including OpenTelemetry collector integration exporting traces to Dynatrace, S3 and Braintrust. * Implement and maintain infrastructure as code and CI/CD using Terraform (Terraform Enterprise), GitHub Actions and TEP pipelines to deliver reliable, repeatable deployments. * Build and maintain the application layer across Python and TypeScript/Node 24 (Lambda xAPIs) and React 19/Vite for front\-end UI experiences. * Lead investigation and resolution of critical, high\-impact production issues, including debugging across AWS services, Kubernetes workloads, data pipelines and observability tooling. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to teammates, fostering strong engineering practices around design documentation, testing, evaluations, code reviews and operational readiness. * Continuously apply knowledge of current AI/LLM, cloud and observability trends to improve system design, developer productivity and business outcomes. * Perform other duties as assigned. **What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?** * **LLM and Agent Systems** + Demonstrated experience shipping LLM/agent systems to production — not just demos or prototypes. + Hands\-on knowledge of tool calling, prompt and routing design, RAG retrieval quality tuning, and defining evaluations to measure LLM and retrieval performance. + Experience with Strands, LangGraph or Bedrock AgentCore is a plus. * **Cloud, Infrastructure and Operations** + Strong AWS serverless and EKS experience; able to design and debug systems spanning Lambda, API Gateway and Kubernetes\-based containers in production. + Practical experience authoring and maintaining Terraform, Helm charts and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, TEP). + Observability fluency: tracing with OpenTelemetry or Dynatrace, structured logging with correlation IDs, cost tracking and incident handling. * **Full\-Stack and Data Pipeline Ownership** + Comfortable working across Python and TypeScript/Node 24 in the service layer and React 19/Vite on the front end. + Familiar with data and retrieval pipelines from ingestion through embedding to vector\-store\-backed APIs. + Consistent habit of writing tests, evaluations and data\-quality checks. * **Delivery** + Advanced delivery skills, including the ability to determine software design strategy and methodology, use automated tests and informed feedback loops to ensure quality and production readiness, and monitor the health of work efforts and adjacent systems. * **Domain Expertise** + Demonstrated track record of developing business partnerships and influencing priorities by identifying solutions aligned with current business objectives; closely follows industry trends relevant to the domain and shares knowledge with coworkers. * **Problem Solving** + Strong problem solver who uses data and proofs of concept to find creative solutions, reflects on outcomes, measures impact and uses that information to optimize — including decisions that involve a significant number of factors with broad implications. * **Communication** + Able to describe technology concepts in ways the business can understand, document initiatives clearly and concisely, collaborate effectively regardless of role, and give and receive constructive feedback; an attentive and empathetic listener. * **Leadership** + Takes action even when there is no clear owner; inspires and motivates others and is effective at influencing team members. **What is a Must Have?** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience. * 6 additional years of software engineering experience. **What Is in It for You?** * **Health Insurance**: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment. * **Retirement:** Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar\-for\-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers. * **Paid Time Off:** Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays. * **Wellness Program:** The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs. * **Volunteer Encouragement:** We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice. **Employment Practices** Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions. If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you. Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life\-at\-travelers/benefits/.

jobs.title: C++ Developer
jobs.description: Trexquant is a growing systematic fund at the forefront of quantitative finance, with a core team of highly accomplished researchers and engineers. We are continuously optimizing and reimagining our trading infrastructure to keep pace with our expanding business. To support our rapid growth, we are seeking a talented C\+\+ Developer to join our technology team and help build and enhance the systems that power our quantitative trading platform. As a C\+\+ Developer, you will work closely with our engineering teams to design, develop, and optimize high\-performance trading systems infrastructure. Your responsibilities will span multiple greenfield areas, including order management systems (OMS), market data, trading infrastructure, and data platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong modern C\+\+ fundamentals, experience with distributed systems, and a demonstrated ability to write performant, memory\-efficient code. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain high\-performance C\+\+ infrastructure supporting our trading systems, including order management systems (OMS), market data, and data platforms. * Build and optimize scalable, distributed systems with a focus on execution speed, memory efficiency, reliability, and throughput. * Collaborate closely with engineering teams and quantitative researchers to develop innovative technical solutions, improve existing systems, and contribute to new infrastructure initiatives across the firm's trading platform. **Requirements** * Degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 1–3\+ years of software engineering experience or equivalent experience through advanced academic research (MS/PhD). * Strong proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20/23\), with a deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, memory management, multithreading, and concurrency. * Demonstrated ability to write efficient, production\-quality C\+\+ code, with an emphasis on execution speed and memory optimization. * Experience designing and developing distributed systems, with a solid understanding of networking fundamentals. * Experience developing software in a Linux environment. * Experience with trading systems, market data, or financial technology is a plus, but not required. **Benefits** * Competitive salary plus bonus based on individual and company performance. * Collaborative, casual, and friendly work environment. * PPO Health, dental and vision insurance premiums fully covered for you and your dependents. * Pre\-tax commuter benefits. * Weekly company meals. Applications are open for both Stamford, CT and New York City Offices. The base salary range is $175,000 to $200,000 depending on the candidate’s educational and professional background. Base salary is one component of Trexquant’s total compensation, which may also include a discretionary, performance\-based bonus. This position is classified as overtime\-exempt. Trexquant is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Providing Engineering and Manufacturing solutions since 1955, Triangle specializes in precision engineering and manufacturing of highly complex, tight\-tolerance machined parts and assemblies. Triangle continues to thrive in more than 107,000 square feet over four state\-of\-the\-art facilities at our Upper Saddle River, NJ campus. As a family\-owned company, we foster a workplace that supports customer\-driven, growth\-oriented values and has a passion for surpassing expectations. We invest in our associates and create a supportive, team\-based environment for learning, innovation, and advancement. Triangle is not only a family\-run business; it's also a place where our associates feel like family. We believe in the same values and bring the same passion to our work each day to make a difference in people's lives. **SUMMARY** Develop and implement custom software solutions that drive business objectives through process automation and the synergies of interconnected systems. Work with cross\-functional teams to solve operational challenges and translate business requirements into application design and features while providing the organization with a platform for making data\-driven decisions. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include the following. Remain up to date on industry trends and best practices. * Simultaneously manage multiple priorities while supporting current applications. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES** This position has no supervisory responsibilities. **QUALIFICATIONS** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Education and/or Experience** Bachelor's degree from a four\-year college or university and 2\-3 years of experience (depending on job\-level), or an equivalent combination of education and experience.* Ability to read, write and speak English fluently. * Knowledge of at least one programming language and related frameworks/libraries (JavaScript, Python, Ruby, .NET, etc.) * Experience with software design and development. * Experience with data\-driven applications and relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, FileMaker, etc.) * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams. * Data\-driven and curious, with a passion for problem solving and learning. * Detail\-oriented and organized with the ability to multi\-task and establish priorities in a fast\-paced, changing environment. **Desired** =========== * Experience with modern web development tech stacks. * Experience developing dashboards and other BI tools. * Experience with ERP systems and ERP integrations. * Experience with Microsoft based development environments (.Net, SQL Server). * Experience with FileMaker Pro. * Experience developing software in the manufacturing industry. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; sit; and use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception, and color vision. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet and occasionally loud. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. jobs.title: Android Developer
jobs.description: Android Frontend Developer (Native) About Us We are a fast\-growing, product\-led, innovative company building fintech product. Our mobile app is at the core of what we do, and we take pride in shipping a product that is fast, reliable, and beautifully crafted. We're looking for an Android developer who holds that same standard. The Role We're hiring a **Native Android Frontend Developer** to join our mobile engineering team and take ownership of building and evolving our Android application. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on crafting high\-quality, performant, and pixel\-perfect native Android experiences using **Kotlin** and the modern Android stack. You'll work directly from UI/UX designs to bring screens and interactions to life — collaborating closely with designers and backend engineers to ship features that users genuinely love. You care about the details: smooth animations, responsive layouts, intuitive gestures, and an app that feels truly native. What You'll Do **Native Android Development** * Build and maintain high\-quality native Android UI screens and components using **Kotlin** and **Jetpack Compose** (or XML/View system where applicable) * Implement responsive and adaptive layouts that work seamlessly across a wide range of Android devices and screen sizes * Develop smooth animations, transitions, and micro\-interactions that elevate the feel of the app * Integrate with RESTful APIs and backend services, handling data presentation cleanly on the frontend * Ensure all UI implementations faithfully match design specs with attention to spacing, typography, color, and behavior **Performance \& Quality** * Profile and optimize app performance — focusing on rendering speed, frame rates, memory usage, and startup time * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code following SOLID principles and Android best practices * Conduct code reviews and maintain high engineering standards across the mobile codebase * Identify and resolve UI bugs, crashes, and layout issues across various Android versions and manufacturers **Collaboration \& Delivery** * Work closely with UI/UX designers to understand design intent and flag technical constraints early in the process * Partner with backend engineers to define efficient API contracts that support the frontend experience * Participate in sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives within an Agile/Scrum workflow * Contribute to architectural decisions that improve the scalability and maintainability of the app What We're Looking For **Experience \& Technical Skills** * 3–6 years of professional Android development experience with a strong focus on the **UI/frontend layer** * Expert proficiency in **Kotlin** — clean, idiomatic, modern Kotlin is your default * Strong hands\-on experience with **Jetpack Compose** for building declarative UI * Solid understanding of the **Android View system** (ConstraintLayout, RecyclerView, Fragments) for legacy and hybrid scenarios * Deep knowledge of **Jetpack libraries** — Navigation, ViewModel, LiveData/StateFlow, Room, WorkManager * Experience consuming **REST APIs** using Retrofit, OkHttp, or similar networking libraries * Familiarity with **dependency injection** frameworks such as Hilt or Dagger * Understanding of **MVVM** and other modern Android architecture patterns (MVI, Clean Architecture) * Experience with the **Google Play Store** release process — build variants, signing, staged rollouts * Comfortable using **Android Studio**, Profiler, Layout Inspector, and debugging tools **Mindset \& Soft Skills** * A strong eye for UI detail — you notice when a shadow is off or an animation doesn't feel right * Passion for building native experiences rather than cross\-platform workarounds * A collaborative team player who communicates technical trade\-offs clearly to both engineers and non\-engineers * Self\-motivated with the ability to take a design or ticket and run with it independently * Committed to writing code that's not just functional, but maintainable and readable for your teammates Nice to Have * Experience implementing **custom views**, **Canvas drawing**, or complex gesture handling * Familiarity with **Lottie** for animation playback * Knowledge of **accessibility best practices** on Android (TalkBack, content descriptions, touch targets) * Experience with **CI/CD pipelines** for Android — GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Fastlane * Understanding of **push notifications** via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) * Contributions to open\-source Android projects or a public GitHub profile * Exposure to **offline\-first architecture** and local data sync strategies Agentic Engineering — Strong Plus Experience building LLM\-powered products and proficiency with **Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI development tools** are highly valued. We’re looking for someone whose mindset is: **“Give me the product problem. I’ll figure out how to ship it.”** Application Questions Please answer the following briefly: * **Have you independently developed and shipped any web or mobile apps?** What are they? Share links if available and describe your role. * **Have you owned an app end\-to\-end**, including development, deployment, app store releases, and production support? Give an example. * **What is your experience with native Android (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose), React Native, or iOS development?** * **How do you use AI coding tools** such as Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor in your daily development workflow? * **Tell us about a feature you built from a rough idea or design spec to production.** What decisions did you make independently? Pay: $10\.00 \- $12\.00 per hour Education: * Bachelor's (Preferred) Experience: * Android development: 3 years (Required) Language: * English (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: TrustLayer is at the forefront of revolutionizing risk management by automating and simplifying the certificate of insurance (COI) process. Our innovative platform enables businesses to ensure compliance, mitigate risk, and enhance operational efficiency. As a rapidly growing SaaS company, we are on a mission to significantly expand our market presence and impact.### **The role** As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll be the engineer our largest customers work with directly. You'll get their TrustLayer rollouts live: connecting the platform to their ERP, procurement and property management systems, migrating years of vendor and insurance data, and building the custom workflows their compliance programs need. You'll write production code, not slide decks. What you learn in the field comes back to the core team as reusable integrations, product feedback and fixes. ### **What you'll do** * Lead the technical side of enterprise onboarding, from kickoff and requirements through go\-live. * Build and maintain integrations between TrustLayer and customer systems using our APIs, webhooks, SFTP and third\-party connectors. * Plan and run data migrations: clean, map, transform and validate vendor, contract and certificate data from spreadsheets and legacy tools. * Write scripts, custom reports and workflow automations for customer\-specific needs. * Troubleshoot complex escalations with Customer Success and Support, finding root causes in code, data or configuration. * Run technical calls and workshops with customer IT, finance and risk teams. * Turn repeated customer needs into product feedback, internal tools and reusable integration patterns with Product and Engineering. * Document solutions so customers and teammates can support them after launch. ### **What you bring** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally at a B2B SaaS company. * Strong skills in at least one backend language, such as Python, TypeScript/Node.js or Ruby. * Hands\-on experience building REST API integrations, webhooks and data pipelines. * Fluent SQL and experience working with relational databases and messy real\-world data. * Comfort working directly with customers: you can explain technical trade\-offs to non\-engineers and stay calm in an escalation. * Ownership: you take a problem from "it's broken" to "it's fixed and documented" without being chased. ### **Nice to have** * Prior experience as a forward deployed, solutions or implementation engineer. * Integration experience with ERP, procurement or property management platforms (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Coupa, Yardi, Procore). * Experience with document processing, OCR or AI/LLM\-powered workflows. * Familiarity with insurance, risk management, compliance, construction or real estate. * Experience with Salesforce, integration platforms (iPaaS) or ETL tools.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Finance
jobs.description: **About Tutor** We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business. Tutor Intelligence is changing that. Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi\-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back\-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family\-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence. Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end\-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems. Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world. **The Role** As our first Applied AI Engineer on Finance, you'll build the operating system for how Tutor runs its finances: planning and forecasting, billing, the close, and the numbers leadership and the board run the company on. You'll design the process flows and change the shape of the work, and you'll do it by writing a lot of software: building whole workflows, tools, and AI agents from scratch rather than living in spreadsheets. This is a technical role where you write and own software, and you'll embed as a true member of our finance team, owning outcomes for that team through technology. You'll have full visibility into what finance does across the business, and you'll treat finance as part of the wider Tutor system: our robots, deployments, customers, and data. Tutor sells robot labor with usage\-based pricing, so billing, revenue, and unit economics all depend on what the robots actually do. You'll join our forward\-deployed AI engineering team: a strategic team of engineers already embedded across deployment, manufacturing, maintenance, and hardware and software engineering, using AI to change how each of those functions works. You'll be its first engineer dedicated to finance. You'll start by taking over and extending finance tools we've already built. From there you'll steward the area as the business grows, using the tools alongside the team and improving them to handle more scale and complexity. ### **What you'll work on** * Architect and build the systems finance runs on, including FP\&A and forecasting tools integrated with our existing systems, with live dashboards and analytics in place of spreadsheets. * Automate the close with software and AI agents: reconciliations, AP/AR, spend review, and variance explanations. * Own the usage\-to\-invoice pipeline, so billing reconciles to what our robots actually did. * Build the financial data layer that joins accounting, spend, CRM, billing, and robot operations data. * Model the business in code: pricing and deal economics, fleet and financing scenarios, and the annual operating plan. * Take over and extend the tools we already have, and keep them working as the team and the business scale. * Build in the controls, checks, and audit trails that let the numbers hold up to auditors, lenders, and investors. ### **What we're looking for** * You've architected and shipped a real system end to end, whether product, internal tooling, data, or infrastructure, and can explain the design choices behind it. * You write working software (Python, SQL, APIs, data pipelines) and build with LLMs and AI coding tools every day. * A technical background with a spike somewhere else: finance, economics, operations, strategy, or founding something. Your path probably hasn't been linear. * Demonstrated passion for, interest in, or experience with finance, and a fundamental understanding of how a company's finances work. You don't need to have held a finance title. * Precision: you build checks, sweat edge cases, and hate a number you can't explain. * High slope: you learn fast, take on ambiguous problems with little direction, and want to make a mark. * You want to be embedded in a business function. This is not a product engineering or research role. ### **Nice to haves** * Usage\-based or subscription billing systems. * A modern accounting and spend stack, and BI tools. * Technical program management (especially FinOps or fintech), product management, or a past founder or first\-of\-function role. * Hardware unit economics, equipment financing, or other capital\-intensive businesses. **Why Tutor?** Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable. Our team of 160\+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in. **Benefits** We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get:* Fully employer\-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium. * A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future. * Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full\-time salaried employees, and 16\+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1\.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees. * Regular in\-office meals and team social events throughout the year. As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond. Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Transportation Engineering (Tenure Track)
jobs.description: **Assistant Professor in Transportation Engineering (Tenure Track)** ==================================================================== ### **Position Overview** **School / Campus / College:** College of Engineering **Organization:** Civil \& Environmental Engineering **Title:** Assistant Professor in Transportation Engineering (Tenure Track) ### **Position Details** #### **Position Description** The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE) at the University of Washington invites applications for a faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor (Tenure Track), with an anticipated start date of September, 2027\. The location of this position is on the University of Washington campus in Seattle, Washington. We seek applicants who demonstrate commitment to excellence in research, teaching, and service in a diverse and inclusive academic community. The successful candidate will join our faculty on a full\-time basis for a nine\-month academic appointment, 3\-year term, renewable, beginning September 16, 2027\. The base salary range for this position will be \[$11,500 \- $13,500] per month, commensurate with experience and qualifications, or as mandated by a U.S. Department of Labor prevailing wage determination. Positive factors for consideration include, but are not limited to, candidates with a promising record of research excellence in transportation; candidates working with emerging methods, tools, or technologies, such as artificial intelligence and machine learning, robotics and automation, new sensing and data sources, quantum applications, or directions we have not anticipated; and/or candidates who bring new areas of strength for the department. Applicants are encouraged to connect their work to one or more of the Grand Challenges identified in the Department's strategic plan. All University of Washington faculty are expected to engage in teaching, research, and service. Our department offers a highly collegial and collaborative culture, with broad interdisciplinary research ties and opportunities. The UW has an active community of transportation researchers within CEE, the College of Engineering (CoE), and across the university. The candidate is expected to collaborate with colleagues within CEE, CoE, throughout the university, and externally; and to develop an externally funded research program. In teaching, the candidate will support and expand transportation course offerings at the undergraduate and graduate levels. In all aspects of this position, the candidate will be expected to contribute to a welcoming and inclusive environment in research, teaching, mentoring, and service. #### **Qualifications** Applicants for this position must meet the following minimum qualifications: * A PhD or foreign equivalent degree, in civil engineering or a related discipline, by the date of appointment. #### **Instructions** To ensure full consideration of your application, please submit all materials no later than November 29, 2026\. Priority will be given to those applications received by November 29, 2026\. Applications will only be accepted via Interfolio. The position will remain open until filled. Applications should include the following materials, noting that any content exceeding page limits will not be reviewed: 1\. a cover letter of no more than 1 page detailing the candidate’s interest in the position, relevant qualifications and experiences, and a link to their Google Scholar profile; 2\. a curriculum vitae; 3\. a two\-page research statement that includes the candidate’s vision for their research for the next 5 years, alignment of their work with one or more of the Grand Challenges identified in the department’s Strategic Plan, and the potential for research collaboration and external funding; 4\. a one\-page description of the candidate’s vision for instruction and learning in civil and environmental engineering, identifying current undergraduate and graduate courses the candidate is interested in teaching and potential new course offerings; 5\. a one\-page description of the candidate’s record of and plans for service, including service to the profession, to the department and the University, and/or engagement with public agencies, industry, and the communities affected by transportation decisions; 6\. up to three publications that illustrate the candidate’s research contributions; 7\. contact information for at least 3 referees who are prepared to provide letters of recommendation upon request. References will only be contacted for short\-listed candidates, but if asked will be expected to submit recommendations within thirty days. Applicants should articulate how their past experiences and/or future plans in research, teaching, mentoring, and/or service promote a sense of belonging and foster a welcoming and inclusive environment. Any such information should be integrated into the statements on research, teaching, and service, not included as a separate statement. #### **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** **Equal Opportunity** The University of Washington is committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful and welcoming community for all. As an equal opportunity employer, the University considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, pregnancy, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, or veteran status consistent with UW Executive Order No. 81\. **Benefits Information** The University is committed to providing excellent benefits to our faculty. For a summary of available benefits, please see UWHR benefits information. **Privacy Notice** Your application materials may be used for employment consideration and shared in accordance with UW’s Privacy Policy. **Disability Services** The University of Washington is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in its services, programs, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities. To request disability accommodation in the application process, contact the Disability Services Office at 206\-543\-6450 or dso@uw.edu.

jobs.title: Linux Infrastructure Engineer (Bare Metal, Storage & AI Factory Infrastructure)
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Linux Infrastructure Engineer** with deep expertise in Linux administration, bare metal infrastructure, enterprise storage, and next\-generation **AI Factory / GPU infrastructure platforms**. This role is focused on designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting large\-scale Linux\-based infrastructure that powers both traditional enterprise workloads and modern AI/ML environments. This is **not a DevOps\-focused role**. We already have a dedicated DevOps team and are looking for an engineer with extensive hands\-on experience in **Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS), GPU infrastructure, high\-performance storage, data center operations, and enterprise Linux platforms**. The ideal candidate will have experience building and managing infrastructure from the hardware layer up, including servers, networking, storage, GPU clusters, and AI\-ready platforms. They should be comfortable working with high\-performance computing (HPC), AI Factory environments, and large\-scale Linux deployments where performance, reliability, and operational excellence are critical. **Key Responsibilities \& Required Skills** **Linux \& Bare Metal Infrastructure** * Expert\-level Linux administration (Ubuntu required; Red Hat and SUSE preferred) * Deep expertise in **bare metal server deployment, architecture, provisioning, and lifecycle management** * Experience operating **Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS)** platforms and large\-scale infrastructure environments * Strong understanding of server hardware, including: + BIOS/UEFI + RAID controllers + Firmware management + iLO/iDRAC/IPMI + NICs and SmartNICs + HBA cards + Hardware diagnostics and troubleshooting * Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise Linux infrastructure at scale **AI Factory \& GPU Infrastructure** * Experience deploying and managing **GPU\-accelerated infrastructure** for AI/ML workloads * Understanding of NVIDIA GPU technologies including: + A100, H100, H200, B200, or equivalent GPU platforms + NVIDIA DGX and OEM GPU servers + GPU provisioning and lifecycle management + GPU monitoring and performance optimization * Knowledge of AI Factory architecture and infrastructure requirements * Experience supporting GPU clusters, AI training environments, and high\-performance computing (HPC) workloads * Understanding of: + GPU resource allocation and scheduling + Multi\-GPU systems + GPU networking requirements + High\-bandwidth, low\-latency infrastructure design * Familiarity with NVIDIA ecosystem technologies such as: + CUDA + NCCL + GPUDirect Storage + NVIDIA Fabric Manager + NVIDIA Base Command (preferred) **Enterprise Storage \& Data Platforms** * Advanced Linux storage administration: + LVM + XFS, EXT4 + NFS + iSCSI + Fibre Channel SAN + Multipath I/O * Strong hands\-on experience with **Ceph**, including: + Cluster architecture + MON, OSD, MDS + RBD, CephFS, RGW + Capacity planning + Performance tuning + Failure recovery * Experience with high\-performance AI storage platforms such as: + WEKA + VAST Data + Dell PowerScale + Pure Storage FlashBlade + NetApp * Understanding of: + NVMe\-over\-Fabrics (NVMe\-oF) + RDMA + GPUDirect Storage + Parallel file systems + AI data pipelines **Networking \& Infrastructure** * Strong networking knowledge: + Bonding + VLANs + Routing + MTU optimization + DNS + DHCP * Experience with high\-performance data center networking: + 100G/200G/400G Ethernet + RoCE + RDMA + Spine\-Leaf architectures * Familiarity with NVIDIA Spectrum\-X, Mellanox/NVIDIA ConnectX adapters, or equivalent technologies * Strong understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 infrastructure design and troubleshooting **Operations \& Reliability** * Experience with high availability, clustering, and disaster recovery * Strong troubleshooting skills across: + Linux operating systems + Hardware platforms + GPU infrastructure + Networking + Enterprise storage * Experience supporting mission\-critical production environments * Bash and Python scripting for automation and operational efficiency * Experience creating operational documentation, runbooks, and infrastructure standards * Understanding of AI infrastructure design and reference architectures * AI cloud integration for workloads * SOP and runbook development and maintenance * Incident, problem, and capacity management * Business continuity and disaster recovery planning for AI workloads * Proactive risk identification and mitigation to avoid business impact **Nice to Have** * Kubernetes infrastructure (especially AI/ML and GPU integration) * KVM, VMware, OpenShift Virtualization, or similar virtualization platforms * Ansible automation * NVIDIA Base Command Manager * Slurm or HPC workload schedulers * Observability and monitoring platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) * Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools * IPAM solutions * AWS, Azure, or hybrid cloud exposure **We Are Not Looking For** * Candidates whose experience is primarily CI/CD pipeline engineering * Engineers focused mainly on Terraform, GitOps, or application delivery pipelines * Cloud\-only administrators with limited bare metal, storage, or hardware experience * Professionals whose primary expertise is software development rather than infrastructure engineering **Ideal Candidate** Someone who has spent years designing, building, and operating enterprise Linux environments, large\-scale bare metal infrastructure, storage platforms, and modern AI Factory environments. The ideal candidate understands how to deploy and manage GPU\-enabled infrastructure, BMaaS platforms, enterprise storage, and high\-performance networking while solving complex operating system, hardware, storage, and AI infrastructure challenges. DevOps experience is a plus, but deep Linux, infrastructure, storage, BMaaS, and AI Factory expertise is the primary requirement.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Software Engineer
jobs.description: About the Company VNC Systems (Virtual Network Cyber Systems, Inc.) is a technology company specializing in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and secure software development. Founded in 2013, the company provides technology solutions for government agencies and commercial organizations. Its services include AI\-driven threat detection, cloud security, compliance automation, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps solutions. Job Overview VNC Systems is seeking a skilled Cybersecurity Software Engineer to develop, maintain, and improve secure software applications and cybersecurity platforms. The ideal candidate will have a strong software engineering background, knowledge of security principles, and experience developing reliable applications. This position involves collaborating with engineering teams to build technology solutions that protect systems, applications, and sensitive data. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, and maintain secure software applications. * Build cybersecurity tools and software components. * Identify and address application security vulnerabilities. * Develop and integrate secure APIs and backend services. * Implement secure coding practices throughout development. * Support automated security testing and vulnerability assessments. * Troubleshoot software defects and system performance issues. * Collaborate with cybersecurity and cloud engineering teams. * Participate in code reviews and software architecture discussions. * Maintain technical documentation and security standards. Required Skills * Proficiency in Python, Java, C\#, or JavaScript. * Understanding of secure software development practices. * Knowledge of application security and vulnerability management. * Familiarity with REST APIs and database technologies. * Understanding of encryption and authentication methods. * Knowledge of Git and CI/CD pipelines. * Familiarity with Linux and cloud environments. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
