jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description: Valence is the AI company behind Nadia, a personalized coach for everyone, built to advance teamwork and talent strategy at enterprise scale. Nadia embeds personalized, proactive development directly into the flow of daily work to help individuals build new skills and behaviors. At the organization level, Nadia is a tool for HR leaders to improve the reach and impact of their talent programs, driving measurable improvements for learning, culture, and performance globally. Since being released in early 2023, Nadia has logged more than two million coaching conversations in 100\+ languages. Today, Nadia is deployed at scale across the Fortune 500, across the globe, including Nestlé, Coca\-Cola, IBM, Dell, The Home Depot, CVS Health, Delta Air Lines, Kaiser Permanente, Vanguard, and more. Valence is a Series B company backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Insight Partners, with offices in New York, Toronto, London, and San Francisco. Learn more about our work with Microsoft: Valence Brings AI Coaching More Deeply Into the Flow of Work with Microsoft 365 At Valence, our team is focused on problems that actually decide whether AI changes how organizations operate: the ones with no playbook, no obvious answers, and no guarantee of success. If you want to be part of the small group that defines how AI transforms the future at a global scale, this is your chance. And this isn't for everyone. We're not looking for people who want predictability or incremental progress. We only want those who are restless at the edge of what's possible, who get bored when things feel "done," and who are driven to redefine what AI can mean for leaders, companies, and the world. Because at Valence, the work worth doing is the kind that redefines work itself. **The role** ------------ As a Sales Engineer at Valence, you will be the technical voice in our largest deals. You join calls from first meeting through signature, map how Nadia fits into a customer's systems, separate what we already do from what would be custom, and write the scope that delivery teams build from. You know how to tee up the right next technical discussions both externally with customers and internally with engineering. You know when to say "yes," when to say "yes, sequenced," when to push back, and when to find the simpler thing the customer actually needs. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Lead technical discovery with enterprise buyers, HR tech owners, IT and InfoSec. * Explain Nadia's architecture and how standard enterprise plumbing — SSO, SCIM, HRIS sync, Teams deployment, data residency, encryption keys — maps to the customer's environment. * Map the customer's architecture, sort requirements into standard connectors vs. configuration vs. custom work, and write the technical scope for the SOW. * Set realistic timelines with Engineering and route work to the right team: core engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, or solutions engineering. * Run security reviews and questionnaires, and handle CISO and IT conversations with clear, accurate answers. * Push back well. Be able to take an unconstrained view with clients, pushing a vision, while implicitly understanding the actual constraints that we have in terms of what we can deliver and on what timeline. Sometimes this takes the form of deflecting a client's "We must have X" requirement into something we can actually do. * Build the reusable assets — reference architectures, security answers, scoping templates — that make the next deal faster. * Use AI and AI First principles to build tailored demos and quick prototypes that show a customer how Nadia works with their frameworks, data and systems. * You own mapping client architectures, technical specs for customer integrations, flagging and defining implementation risk for systems we haven't integrated with before, hand\-offs to other engineering and FDE teams to deliver. **What you bring** ------------------ * 3\+ years in sales engineering, solutions architecture or a customer\-facing engineering role at a B2B SaaS company selling to large enterprises. * Hands\-on fluency with enterprise integration patterns: REST and SOAP APIs, SFTP and batch file feeds, webhooks, SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning. * Comfort with enterprise security and compliance conversations: SOC 2, data retention, encryption and BYOK, single\- vs. multi\-tenant, cloud networking such as private connectivity. * Experience scoping work that other engineers delivered, and owning whether the scope was right. * Clear writing. You can turn a 2\-hour discovery call into a one\-page architecture and a crisp list of open questions. * Judgment under pressure: you stay calm and honest when a customer is demanding and a deal is on the line. * AI fluency. You use AI tools every day, and you can explain how LLM products are prompted, grounded and evaluated, and where they fail. * A builder's instinct. You know how to use AI tools and coding agents to put together a tailored demo or lightweight prototype yourself, with scripting (Python or JavaScript), APIs or product configuration. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with HRIS and talent systems, especially Workday, or with Microsoft Teams and the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. * Experience helping customers evaluate AI quality, such as building eval sets or success criteria. * Experience as an early or first SE at a growth\-stage company. **What You'll Get** ------------------- * **Team Leadership \& Scope:** Full people leadership of Valence's enterprise deployment organization for your region, direct influence over how Valence's biggest launches are run, and real influence over the best practices Enablement builds into the playbook. * **AI\-First Deployment Leadership:** Work directly with cutting\-edge AI models in production at enterprise scale, and build deep expertise in enterprise AI deployment across some of the world's largest organizations. * **Competitive Compensation \& Benefits:** + Competitive salary including base \+ performance bonus + Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision) from day one + Generous PTO, company\-wide R\&R shutdowns, and paid parental leave + Retirement plan support (401k / pensions) * **Meaningful Equity:** Ownership in a venture\-backed company at a growth inflection point, with top\-up grants tied to performance. * **Top\-Performing Culture:** A team built for top talent: high intensity to win, growth without limits, and a culture that solves hard problems and celebrates big wins together. **Location and Work Environment** --------------------------------- We have two seats open for this role: one based in New York, NY and one based in London, UK, each working a minimum of 3 days a week in office. We will consider remote candidates elsewhere in the relevant region for the right background. Candidates must be comfortable working with colleagues across different time zones and hold valid work authorization for their country of hire. Expect regular travel to customer sites for on\-site launches and executive business reviews.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer, Multiomics and Imaging
jobs.description: **Position Summary** **:** Build the computational infrastructure for discovering how cells organize into tissues. The Biological Information Architecture (BIA) Lab, led by Dr. Felix Zhou at Vanderbilt University, seeks a strong, self\-motivated Research Engineer to help build the software, AI workflows, and computational methods that will power a new generation of biological discovery. This is not a conventional academic programming role. You will have substantial ownership over the lab’s technical direction: architecting software from the ground up, building agentic AI systems for scientific analysis, developing new computational methods, and turning promising ideas into robust tools used by researchers. We are interested in strong software engineers from industry, computationally exceptional undergraduate or master’s students, and quantitative scientists who want to work on genuinely difficult scientific problems. We care more about technical ability, curiosity, and evidence that you can build things than academic qualifications. You will also contribute to publications and grants, help establish engineering practice, mentor trainees, and help identify technologies with potential for open\-source release, licensing, or commercialization. ***This position is a term position. A term position is a staff appointment established for a defined period of time based on the operational needs of the business unit and Vanderbilt University, generally expected to exceed six months but not extend beyond one year. This position's incumbent will be evaluated at the end of a one year assignment for renewal.*** **About the Work Unit** **:** The BIA Lab is a new, interdisciplinary computational biology group built around a founding north star mission: “develop the computational tools to decode and ultimately help reprogram the rules governing how individual cells determine tissue\-scale behavior”. The lab pursues this objective through atlas\-scale multimodal data analysis: combining advanced microscopy, quantitative cell phenomics, spatial tissue profiling and multi\-omics data; first\-principles open\-minded, curiosity\-driven scientific inquiry integrating ideas across disciplines without borders, be it theoretical physics, philosophy, economics, biology, computing or mathematics. We work closely with an expansive network of internal and external collaborators, and committed to open, well\-engineered software for the wider bioimage\-analysis and computational biology community. The lab is based in Vanderbilt’s Department of Cell and Developmental Biology and affiliated with the Center for Computational Systems Biology (CCSB), a trans\-institutional center spanning Vanderbilt Basic Sciences, Vanderbilt University Medical Center, and the College of Connected Computing, placing the lab within a growing community of computational biologists, imaging scientists, and systems\-level researchers on campus. Though newly launched, the lab has a strong methods track record. We have released a suite of open\-source tools used by the community, including u\-Segment3D (3D cell segmentation); u\-Unwrap3D (geometric computing), u\-Protrude3D (surface protrusion analysis), SAM\-SPOT and MOSES (phenotyping and motion quantification), and v\-InfoTrace (information\-flow analysis in images). The opportunity now, with real ownership, is to connect and build these cell\-level tools into scalable workflows to reverse\-engineer the logic circuitry of tissue signaling. BIA lab website: https://bia\-lab\-team.github.io/BIA\_Lab\_Website/index.html BIA lab GitHub: https://github.com/BIA\-Lab\-Team BIA lab publications: https://bia\-lab\-team.github.io/BIA\_Lab\_Website/publications.html **Why Join** **:** * Direct influence over software architecture, tooling choices, and engineering culture from day one * Work at the frontier of agentic AI applied to multi\-omics and imaging science, with substantial latitude to prototype and ship your own ideas * Solve real scientific problems involving large, messy, multimodal datasets * Work closely with the PI on scientific and technical direction in a high\-trust environment with substantial autonomy. * Build tools that enable non\-expert researchers to run s ophisticated analyses at scale. * Shape your own growth path toward technical leadership, scientific softwar e, AI systems, computational biology, or technology development. * Potential opportunities for open\-source releases, technology transfer, licensing, or spin\-out development as promising technologies mature. * Join an interdisciplinary environment without borders where ideas from computing, mathematics, physics, biology, arts and philosophy can directly shape the work. **Key Functions and Expected Performance:** Shape the lab’s technical vision and roadmap * Define software architecture, development standards, and infrastructure choices for the lab * Advise the PI on build\-vs\-adopt decisions and long\-term technical strategy Design and development of agentic workflows for multi\-omics and imaging data * Build agentic, LLM\-based pipelines that automate ingestion, quality control, processing, and analysis of multi\-omics (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics) and imaging (light\-sheet, high\-content, spatial) data * Integrate agentic workflows with existing lab software and HPC/cloud compute infrastructure Evaluation, integration, and potential commercialization of new methodologies and tools * Research and assess suitability of emerging methodologies, algorithms, and open\-source packages relevant to the lab’s research direction * Turn promising research ideas into reliable, reusable software. * Identify lab\-developed technologies with translational or commercial potential and support early\-stage technology\-transfer, licensing, or spin\-out discussions. Teaching, onboarding, and community engagement * Onboard and train graduate students, postdocs, and rotation students on lab software and computational workflows. * Promote and communicate the lab’s software through open\-source releases, conferences, GitHub, forums, workshops, and other community channels. * Contribute to publications and grant writing **Experience and Skills:** Necessary * Strong software development and technical ability through research, open\-source work, internships, industry experience, competitions, or substantial independent projects. * A bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific or computational field is sufficient; exceptional candidates with unconventional backgrounds are encouraged to apply. * Strong Python skills and familiarity with scientific libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit\-image, or scikit\-learn. * Experience developing, releasing, and maintaining software projects. * Experience with, or strong interest in developing, agentic and LLM\-based workflows (e.g., Claude Agent SDK, LangChain, or similar frameworks). * Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Self\-motivated, enterprising, intellectually curious, and comfortable operating with an incompletely specified roadmap. Preferred * Experience with multi\-omics data types (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics) and/or bioimage analysis (light\-sheet, high\-content, or spatial imaging). * Knowledge of workflow orchestration and parallel/distributed computing technologies (e.g., Snakemake, Nextflow, NVIDIA CUDA, OpenMPI, or cloud\-based HPC). * Experience with production\-scale software engineering, scientific computing, or large\-scale data systems. **Education and Certifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific or computational field with strong computational emphasis. * A minimum of 1–2 years of postgraduate or industry experience in software engineering, software development, or a related field is required. * Exceptional undergraduate and master’s candidates are encouraged to apply, particularly those with substantial software\-building experience. * Master’s or PhD preferred but not required.

Working within a defined technical domain and under close supervision, this role applies established development standards, tools, and methodologies to complete well\-defined assignments while building foundational technical proficiency and professional judgment. Quality, Security \& Reliability * Performs unit testing and supports quality assurance activities to verify application functionality and performance. * Ensures application changes comply with established security, compliance, and operational standards. * Validates application functionality following deployments and updates to minimize service disruptions. * Identifies opportunities to improve application stability, maintainability, and user experience within assigned areas of responsibility. * Supports efforts to reduce defects, rework, and operational risk through attention to detail and adherence to defined processes. Documentation \& Knowledge Management * Maintains accurate technical documentation for application configurations, code changes, testing activities, and support procedures. * Documents troubleshooting findings, solutions, and implementation details to support ongoing service delivery. * Follows established documentation standards to promote consistency, maintainability, and knowledge sharing. * Maintains records of completed work to support operational continuity and future enhancements. jobs.description: * Engineering * San Francisco * Full Time **About Vercel:** ----------------- Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. **About the role** ------------------ **Developers are building faster than ever. Humans and agents are deploying more than 6 million times a day on Vercel, spinning up over 2 million Sandboxes and serving a trillion requests per month.** Every single one is powered by our own compute infrastructure . The Persistence team sits within Vercel's Compute division. This team owns the deep infrastructure within Hive (our compute platform) focussing on storage and state for all our workloads (Builds, Sandboxes and Functions). This work is redefining compute with features like Fluid Compute, Persistent Sandboxes, and Custom Images. As a Software Engineer on the Persistence team, you'll work on the infrastructure that runs 100s of instances across every region where our customers deploy code, rethinking low\-level primitives and contributing to platform features that improve the experience for thousands of developers every day. This role is based in **London, UK**. If you're within commuting distance of our London office, the role includes in\-office anchor days. If you're located further afield within the UK, the role is fully remote. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you’ll be doing:** As a part of the Strategic Analytics and Modeling team within the Transformation Command Center working on Network Capital Strategy, you will lead projects to develop and perform complex AI\-first and agentic modeling including statistical, analytical or advanced analytics on challenging long\-term network capacity questions, aiming to "right\-size" the future capacity planning needs for the multi\-billion dollar investments in our Verizon Network. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll have high autonomy to create, improve, design and execute using AI for capacity simulations and optimization, in partnership with the relevant business partners, while on the lookout for new modeling techniques, evolving technologies and emerging industry trends that can improve accuracy, speed or generally quality of simulations. Your work will help ensure that the needs of the network that serves our customer has accurate capacity plans so downstream finance teams may appropriately fund budgetary requests for next\-year expansion or operational network efforts. Responsibilities include: * Working with stakeholders to develop AI, agent\-based modeling, and algorithmic modeling for network elements and processes to support the 3\-year capital budget. * Planning and executing the design of the new capacity model, obtaining general agreement from NCS and the business team. * Operating the model across multiple checkpoints in a year, creating a hardened deployment, documentation, and plans for future automation of the process. * Planning future upgrades to the model with alternate types of algorithms, AI science or additional input features. * Actively leveraging and piloting AI tools — including agentic workflows, LLM\-assisted coding, and automated documentation/reporting — to accelerate model development, scenario testing, and stakeholder deliverables; Verizon expressly supports and encourages AI\-augmented approaches to this work. * Assertively adapt and navigate roadblocks in the software development process, self\-resolving issues and escalating roadblocks when appropriate. * Conducting occasional presentations to leaders and engineers to describe the nature of created systems. * Protecting invented Verizon Intellectual Property by pursuing patents when appropriate. **What we're looking for:** A passion for creativity, AI, innovation, process improvement, advanced algorithms, and best\-practices of independent software design. A motivated, independent individual who can properly discern next\-steps in the absence of requirements, and determine when to appropriately collaborate with the team and business partners. Proven ability to communicate technical information to technical or non\-technical audiences with an understanding that each project has the ability to change millions of dollars of spend to benefit the customer's network experience. You'll need to have: * Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Intermediate proficiency in Python (or R), SQL with a moderate history or portfolio of accomplished projects. * Intermediate proficiency in Alteryx or Knime. * Experience building or integrating agentic AI workflows (e.g., LLM\-based agents, tool\-use/function\-calling pipelines, or automation frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, or Claude/GPT\-based agents) to automate data ingestion, scenario generation, or report synthesis in support of capital planning and simulation workflows. Even better if you have one or more of the following: * Degree in business intelligence and analytics, data science, engineering, computer science, mathematics or similar. * Experience in time series analysis / forecasting. * Strong experience in engineering investigations, performance optimizations, or network capacity management. * Prior experience navigating engineering budget cycles, such as funding requests for cell\-site builds in a regional role. * Proven experience with gathering requirements and translating requirements to specific software practices. * Experience with data engineering. * Knowledge of cloud computing platforms e.g. Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services. * Experience with high performance containerized GPU environments. * Solid foundation in mathematical optimization, prescriptive modeling, and network capacity management. * Designing, architecting, and deploying full\-stack web applications and APIs—leveraging frameworks like FastAPI, custom GUIs (e.g., Flet, Marimo), and high\-performance BI dashboards—to expose optimization models, streamline data ingestion, and accelerate scenario planning for non\-technical leadership. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $101,000\.00 \- $194,000\.00\.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Virtru:** While the rest of the security industry obsesses over locking data down to prevent it from being lost or stolen, we're doing something fundamentally different at Virtru. We're setting data free so that you can intentionally share it with others, but without sacrificing security, privacy, or control. We've created both a suite of powerful data protection applications and an open platform that's sparking an ecosystem of innovation. Through the Trusted Data Format (TDF) open standard, we're not just protecting data; we're creating a new paradigm where security enables sharing rather than preventing it. Think of us as the Android of data protection: a robust platform with an open core that developers and partners can build upon, coupled with our own best\-in\-class applications that showcase what's possible when you reimagine security from the ground up. Backed by Iconiq Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Foundry Capital, and Tiger Global, we're helping Fortune 500 companies and government agencies discover that true data security means having the freedom to share, collaborate, and innovate — without compromise. **Compensation: $190,000 \- 250,000/year** **Team \& Position Details:** Virtru protects data wherever it travels, for customers ranging from commercial enterprises to the Department of Defense, the Intelligence Community, Law Enforcement, and Federal Civilian agencies. Many of these customers run Virtru inside their mission environments, and the most sensitive of those environments are cleared spaces where work happens on site, alongside the customer's own engineers. As a Senior Software Engineer in the Delivery Engineering organization, you'd be helping to build a founder team focused on making these deployments simple, easy, and fast. You will be the engineer who builds what a cleared customer needs and cannot get from the product alone: custom integrations and policy enforcement points (the components that enforce access policy inside a customer's application) delivered into the customer's environment. You will sit with customer engineers, understand how their systems really work, and ship working software that fits them. You will work directly with deployment engineers and forward deployed engineers on the customer side of each engagement, with QA to prove what you build before it ships, and with our product engineering and Platform Engineering counterparts to carry what you learn back into the product. The test of your work is simple: the second time we face the same customer need, we should be configuring something you built, not writing it again. The impact of this role is company and product wide, heavily enabling our goals to scale Virtru, partner, and customer led deployments non\-linearly without having to throw more humans at the problem. You'll be expected to come up with AI\-native design patterns that will increase our velocity without compromising our high bar for quality and security. The right candidate is excited about working on a small, nimble, highly autonomous and empowered team where everyone is expected to make high judgement, high velocity decisions independently and with urgency. If you want a role where the connection between what you build and what the customer achieves requires no explaining, this is one. **As a Senior Software Engineer in Delivery Engineering, your responsibilities will include:** * **Build custom integrations and policy enforcement points for cleared customers**, scoped against a statement of work, tested with QA, and delivered into environments Virtru does not operate. * **Work directly with customer engineers inside cleared environments** to understand their systems, agree what will be built, and explain your design to their security team. * **Turn what you build twice into a reusable asset.** When a second customer needs the same thing, the first build becomes a template, a library, or a tool that deployment engineers and forward deployed engineers can use without you. * Build on the SDKs and APIs that our product engineering teams maintain, and bring gaps and defects back to them with a clear reproduction and a documented outcome. * Write code that follows the engineering standard set by Delivery Engineering's Principal Software Engineer, and submit your work to the design review that standard calls for. * Package your work so it installs, upgrades, and runs in disconnected environments with no path to the internet. * Partner with deployment engineers and forward deployed engineers so the person who installs your work in the field has what they need: documentation, test evidence, and a clear way to report back. * Partner with our Platform Engineering counterparts on how your work is built, signed, and released. * Use AI coding agents as part of your daily workflow, and help the team learn which patterns raise quality and speed together. * Mentor and learn from peers across the organization, and help define what good looks like for  our software does, what it touches, and why it is safe to run, and you can answer the follow\-up questions. * **Nice to haves** + Windows and .NET depth: production .NET on Windows, including Windows Services, signed installers, and managed distribution. Many of our customers' end\-user environments are Windows\-heavy, and some of our policy enforcement points deploy on Windows client endpoints. + Go proficiency, which is what the Data Security Platform and OpenTDF are written in. + Kubernetes experience, including packaging and running software across more than one distribution. + Identity and authorization integration experience: OIDC, SAML, and attribute\-based access control (ABAC). + Familiarity with Zero Trust security architecture and concepts such as Policy Enforcement and Decision Points, cryptography, and identity. + Experience delivering software into air\-gapped or disconnected environments. + Experience building with AI coding agents. * **Where this role may not be a fit** + **Wanting a product\-only role with no customer contact.** Much of this job is working next to the customer, in their environment, on their problem. If you prefer to build away from customers, this role may not be for you. + **Inability to earn trust and credibility with partners and customers.** You may be the person who has to explain to a skeptical government security team why our software is safe, or to an internal VP of Engineering why we need to prioritize critical platform features. Those have to be conversations you are willing and excited to have. **Virtruvian qualities that will set you up for success:** * Thinking outside of the box to respectfully challenge your teammates and managers in the pursuit of excellence * Strong sense of urgency with an action\-oriented mindset * Able to collaborate and adapt to shifting priorities as business needs evolve * Comfortable with asynchronous communication including slack, email, zoom, etc. **Perks \& Benefits:** At Virtru, we believe people do their best work when their wellbeing is put first. This is why we make your wellbeing our priority with a thoughtful and holistic program that encompasses Occupational, Mental, Social, Physical, and Environmental Wellness by offering benefits such as… * A **Flexible PTO policy** — we strongly encourage you to take time off (in addition to 14 holidays) to ensure that you are getting the proper time needed to unplug and recharge. * A $1,500 annual **Learning \& Development Stipend** focused on providing you the resources to continually learn and professionally grow. * Frequent company\-sponsored **team celebrations** that provide ample opportunities to connect with teammates and be social! * Access to an **Employee Assistance Program** * Access to **Headspace**, a mental health app tailored to your specific needs. * A flat 3% contribution to your retirement account * **A high degree of flexibility** — Have an appointment, errand, or family emergency to take care of? Hop to it! We give you the time and space to take care of you and your own first. In addition to wellbeing, Virtru places a strong emphasis on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Our DB\&I Council is dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace and making the psychological safety of each and every one of our teammates a top priority. **Additional perks include:** * Competitive compensation * Generous parental, medical, and bereavement policies * 401K contribution and stock options * Full medical, dental, and vision benefits * New Hire Swag and IT Welcome boxes * Structured semi\-annual 360° performance reviews Virtru is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. Virtru is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Enterprise AI
jobs.description: **Company Description** Vuori is re\-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. We draw inspiration from an active coastal California lifestyle; an integration of fitness, creative expression and life. Our high energy fast paced retail environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm and purpose…while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for opportunity and for personal growth and success. **Job Description** As AI Product Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining Vuori's AI product roadmap and seeing AI capabilities through successful delivery. Working closely with AI engineers, business stakeholders, and design, you will keep the team focused on the right problems, ensure requirements are clear and actionable, and track progress from concept to production. This role is well suited for a product practitioner who is energized by the day\-to\-day of shipping AI, someone who thrives on translating stakeholder needs into crisp requirements, removing blockers so teams can move fast, and staying close to outcomes to know when something is truly working for users and the business. **What you'll get to do:** *Maintain and manage the roadmap* * Keep the AI product roadmap current, well\-sequenced, and visible to stakeholders — reflecting business priorities, engineering capacity, and what is actually being built. * Work with business and technology leaders to surface AI opportunities, assess their value, and bring them into the roadmap through a structured prioritization process. * Facilitate trade\-off conversations between stakeholders and engineering teams, helping the group land on decisions that balance impact, feasibility, and timing. * Communicate roadmap changes, sequencing decisions, and delivery status clearly and on a regular cadence, so stakeholders are never surprised. * Flag risks and dependencies early, so teams have time to adapt before they become blockers. *Drive successful delivery* * Translate business needs and user requirements into clear, detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and design can act on. * Work alongside AI engineers throughout delivery — answering questions, clarifying scope, reviewing work in progress, and making fast, informed decisions when scope needs to change. * Participate in agile ceremonies and rituals — sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives — that keep cross\-functional teams aligned and moving forward. * Manage launches end to end: rollout plans, stakeholder communication, go\-live readiness, and post\-launch monitoring. * Follow up after launch to confirm that what was built is working as intended, and surface issues quickly for resolution. *Partner and measure* * Build strong working relationships with business teams, operations, merchants, and marketing to understand their workflows, pain points, and where AI can genuinely help. * Work with engineering and data teams to track whether AI features are performing as expected — on both technical measures and user and business outcomes. * Collect and synthesize user feedback, usage data, and stakeholder input to inform a continuous improvement backlog. * Advocate for the end user throughout the development process, ensuring AI capabilities are intuitive, trustworthy, and fit for the people who use them. * Provide regular progress updates and impact summaries to senior leadership, grounded in data. **Qualifications** **Who you are:** * Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent years of experience preferred. * 5\+ years of product management experience, including 2\+ years working on AI, machine learning, or data\-driven products shipped to real users in production environments. * Demonstrated track record of managing a product roadmap and delivering features end to end, with measurable business outcomes. * Strong ability to listen to stakeholders and users and translate their needs into clear, actionable product requirements. * Solid working knowledge of AI and ML concepts — enough to have substantive conversations with engineers and make grounded trade\-off decisions. * Experience tracking and reporting on the performance of AI products, including both technical and business success metrics. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adjust for engineering, design, business, and executive audiences. * Comfort with ambiguity and a consistent bias toward action, with strong organizational and follow\-through skills. *Preferred Qualifications* * Experience shipping LLM\-powered products, conversational AI, recommendation systems, or agentic workflows to production users. * Familiarity with AI evaluation approaches, responsible AI principles, and the unique considerations of deploying AI features to real users at scale. * Experience with enterprise AI or SaaS platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, or similar. * Comfort working with data — SQL, BI dashboards, or A/B testing frameworks — to independently assess product performance. * Experience in retail, e\-commerce, direct\-to\-consumer, or a similar consumer operating environment. * Demonstrated curiosity about emerging AI technologies and a history of bringing new capabilities to market. **Additional Information** **Our investment in you:** At Vuori, we’re proud to offer the following to our employees: * Health Insurance * Savings and Retirement Plan * Employee Assistance Program * Generous Vuori Discount \& Industry Perks * Paid Time Off * Wellness \& Fitness benefits The salary range for this role is $137,300 per year \- $176,610 per year. This role is bonus eligible. Vuori is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Software Developer & Data Engineer
jobs.description: ###### **Build the food intelligence layer at WISEcode.** Most people have no real way to know what's in their food or what it does to them. The information is scattered, inconsistent, and written to sell rather than to inform. WISEcode exists to change that: to give people a source they can actually trust, and the freedom to decide for themselves once they have it. Getting there takes more than a better app. It takes a system underneath that turns fragmented food data into answers that hold up: consistent, explainable, and the same whether they reach a parent scanning a label, a brand seeking verification, or an institution making decisions at scale. That system is what we are building, and it is the reason the work compounds instead of resetting with every new product. **The Role** We are hiring a Software Developer \& Engineer to work as a senior individual contributor, serving as the second engineer on The Pantry, our new data lakehouse (DuckLake on S3 Parquet, Postgres catalog, Prefect orchestration, Python throughout). You will work alongside our Data team, combining hands\-on implementation with platform and data architecture design in an early\-stage environment where the shape of the work is still yours to define. You bring 3\+ years of experience in a similar role, along with real comfort with ambiguity and pace. jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description: We’re hiring a Senior Systems Engineer as WRA builds its new internal IT \& Cybersecurity functions. We are actively transitioning from an MSP model to a fully in\-house model, and this role will operate under the guidance of our Director of Information Technology \& Cybersecurity. This is also an excellent role for someone looking to refine their cybersecurity skillset. In this role, you will act as the primary engineer for our cloud and SaaS platforms, including Microsoft 365, Azure infrastructure, Entra ID, endpoint management, and a variety of general platforms used by each of our departments. Initially, most of your time will focus on standing up new tools and assisting in the migration of select tools used by our MSP. Afterwards, your general duties will shift to engineering Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft 365/Entra ID, endpoint management and building automations. You will be highly autonomous and will work closely with your Director to maintain and improve our current technology stack. Our 100\-person workforce is highly distributed, and your priority is engineering our tools to enable our staff to do their best work securely, efficiently and consistently. WRA has offices in the San Francisco Bay Area (San Rafael, Petaluma, and Emeryville) and in San Diego. This position may be performed fully remotely by candidates located in California, Colorado, Arizona, or Oregon but travel to our offices may be necessary 1 – 2 times per year on average. Candidates in the Denver metro area are especially encouraged to apply. ### **In this role, you will be responsible for:** Cloud Infrastructure * Own our Azure environment, including Azure Virtual Desktop and virtual servers, which enables our CAD, GIS and Accounting teams. This includes image management, patching, right\-sizing, scaling and scheduling, backups, performance optimization, and software versioning. * Deploy actionable virtual machine monitoring to measure performance (CPU, GPU, memory, disk and session latency), idle capacity and active use time, and implement alerts to monitor these metrics. * Perform root\-cause analysis of virtual infrastructure concerns and propose solutions. * Administer our Microsoft 365 environment, including Exchange, SharePoint \& OneDrive, Teams and data governance. * Engage with your Director and our specialized departments to ensure their tools are appropriately sized, configured and performant. * Co\-manage our SaaS and cloud infrastructure backup platforms, including for Microsoft 365, Azure virtual machines and other platforms. Identity \& Access Management (IAM) * Administer Entra ID and SSO, including conditional access, authentication, dynamic groups, and guest access governance. * Own employee identity lifecycle automations for onboarding, offboarding and role changes. * Maintain SCIM provisioning across our SaaS applications. Endpoint \& Mobile Device Management * Manage our Windows and limited Mac fleet by administering our endpoint management platform, including device enrollment, Autopilot, compliance \& configuration policies, app deployments and system patching. * Manage our mobile device configuration and application policies. AI \& Automations * Automate IT processes using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and other platforms to reduce or eliminate manual administrative tasks and to ensure consistent quality. * Collaborate with your Director and other stakeholders to improve our implementation of Claude AI, including Connector configurations, Skills and Design. Cybersecurity * Partner with your Director to build new security operations capabilities from product selection and concept trials through implementation and administration. * Alongside your Director, administer our security stack, including our managed detection and response platform, email security, DNS and web filtering, and vulnerability management. * Participate in our incident response process, including investigations and root\-cause analyses, and apply technical containment measures as directed or delegated. * Assist in strengthening our infrastructure to be compliant with industry\-standard benchmarks such as CMMC and NIST SP 800\-171\. General IT Support * Work with our IT Operations Specialist as needed and serve as a final escalation point for complex IT Support requests. * Participate in an on\-call rotation for critical but rare IT outages and other emergent duties. Change Management \& Documentation * Maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, and system configuration documentation. Documentation must be considered a deliverable – not a “nice to have.” * Follow industry\-standard Change Management practices for all system changes. ### **To be successful in this role, you will need:** Experience \& Location * At least 6 years of direct experience supporting a hybrid or remote workforce of at least 50 employees as an engineer. * Comfortable working fully remote with travel to our offices in California as described above. * Able to demonstrat lude lifting up to 50 lbs, climbing ladders indoors, crawling under furniture and reaching behind wall\-mounted equipment. Bonus Points for experience with or having: * Supporting CAD and GIS applications, such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, ArcGIS and spatial datasets. * Supporting Egnyte, Deltek VantagePoint, Elevia or markup tools like Bluebeam and Adobe Acrobat. * Microsoft certifications, including (but not limited to) AZ\-104, AZ\-140, AZ\-305, AZ\-700, SC\-200, SC\-300, SC\-401, MS\-102 or MD\-102\. * Familiarity with industry\-standard frameworks, such as CMMC L1/L2, NIST SP 800\-171, CCPA, SOC 2, ITSM, or ITIL. * Executing platform migrations using third\-party tools and/or PowerShell. * Integrating IAM automations into ITSM platforms such as Jira, Freshservice, Zendesk or SolarWinds. * Supporting the implementation of data retention policies. * Administering UniFi Network and Protect. WRA has an established internal leveling system for our staff that maps to salary bands that have been informed by market data. Our leveling system is dependent on years of relevant industry experience, education, and the level of responsibility and autonomy at which you’re expected to operate. We have posted a salary range that corresponds to the appropriate level for this position. In your first conversation with our recruiter, we will discuss leveling and compensation with you to make sure that our expectations are aligned. * The salary range for this position is $130,000 – $145,000 **Who are we?** WRA’s an employee\-owned environmental consultancy. We are a tenacious team of planners, engineers, and scientists, and we aim to leave the lands we love better than we found them. Our clients and partners hire us because we’re skilled at navigating through challenging projects involving wildlands, parks, community spaces, and infrastructure. We bring over four decades of expertise, long\-standing relationships, and connections to our local communities to make sure that projects are pursued in responsible ways where both people and the environment thrive. As an organization, we believe that independence and interdependence are not mutually exclusive. We invest in systems, processes, and employee programs to support our staff’s collective engagement and success. At the same time, we encourage our employees to operate with an ownership mindset, taking responsibility for outcomes and being true to our commitments. WRA’s company vision is to cultivate a sustainable future where people and the environment thrive, and that effort starts first with our staff. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment, and we have developed flexible policies, internal practices, and are investing in programs that prioritize learning and sustainability. We aim to create conditions that allow employees to prioritize their families, lead healthy and balanced lives, and to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We believe that by creating an exceptional workplace, our employees will be able to do their best work and be able to meaningfully contribute to the sustainability of the environment and the communities in which we live. WRA is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to creating a diverse environment. We recruit, employ, train, compensate and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: CTO / Senior Developer (part-time, remote)
jobs.description: Way Labs, St. Louis, Missouri. Part\-time, remote (US time zones). We are replacing a 20\-year\-old e\-commerce, warehouse and retail system with a new cloud platform, and we need one senior engineer to be its technical owner: the person who keeps it running, proves it is right, and answers the phone when something breaks. The business behind it is real and busy: several storefronts, two retail stores, a 60,000 square foot warehouse with an automated packing line, Amazon, Walmart and other marketplaces, a 3PL business and a subscription club. Millions of orders of history. How the work is done: most of the code is written by AI coding agents under the owner's direction, and the business rules have been documented module by module. You are not hired to type the code. You are hired to own it: review the architecture, run the data migration, keep the integrations and hosting healthy, and make sure the system is proven correct before each part goes live. You are comfortable working alongside AI agents, reading what they produce, and judging it by tests and evidence, not by eye. What you will do: 1\. Review the data model and architecture (a paid trial task to start). 2\. Lead the data migration: about 6\.7 million orders, 18\.5 million lines, customers, stock, gift cards and rewards, from the old Postgres database into the new one. Practice runs, reconciliation to the cent, and a rollback plan. 3\. Own the integrations: Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify, Faire; FedEx, USPS and UPS; Square, Braintree and PayPal; TaxCloud; Signifyd. 4\. Own the proof: the test suite, the replay of real order history against the old system, and the nightly side\-by\-side run before cutover. Nothing switches on without passing evidence. 5\. Hosting, security and reliability on AWS: backups with tested restores, monitoring and alerts, the web application firewall, and a weekly security review. 6\. Technical lead on the switch weekend in January. 7\. After go\-live: the responsible engineer when the owner is not around, with on\-call for real problems. What you bring: 1\. 10\+ years building and running production systems, ideally e\-commerce, order management, warehouse or ERP. 2\. Strong Postgres: schema design, large data migrations, performance and row\-level security. 3\. TypeScript and Node, with React for admin screens. 4\. Real experience with carrier, payment and marketplace APIs. 5\. AWS (or similar) operations: deployments, backups, monitoring and incident response. 6\. Hands\-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, and the judgment to verify what they produce. 7\. Calm, plain\-English communication with a non\-technical owner. You say what you checked and what you could not. Nice to have: ColdFusion (the old system), Supabase, Vercel, warehouse automation. Hours and pay: about 10 to 20 hours a week through the January cutover, then about 5 to 10 a week through April, then 2 to 4 a week plus a monthly on\-call retainer. $100 to $150 an hour depending on experience, as a contractor. Long\-term relationship. To apply: send a short note on the largest data migration you have led and how you proved it was right, plus your experience with AI coding tools. A link to your work or LinkedIn profile is enough; no cover letter needed. Pay: $100\.00 \- $150\.00 per hour Expected hours: 10\.0 – 20\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule Application Question(s): * Describe the largest data migration you have led: the size, where it moved from and to, and how you proved the result was correct. * Which of these have you integrated in production: Amazon SP\-API, Walmart, Shopify, FedEx, USPS, UPS, Square, Braintree, TaxCloud? Describe one hard problem you solved with one of them. * Which AI coding tools do you use today, and how do you check what they produce before it goes live? * At 9 PM on Black Friday, the tax service starts failing at checkout. What do you do in the first 30 minutes? * How many hours a week can you commit through January, and can you be on call after go\-live? Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: The **Lead Software Engineer** leads teams of software engineers and assures they work closely with IT Architects, Project Managers, and Business Systems Analysts to understand requirements and functional specifications, create technical design documentation, and develop WCIRB business applications. The Lead Software Engineer serves as a role model and works in accordance with IT standards and best practices and contributes to the ability of the IT organization to provide efficient and effective solutions to our business partners and customers. As a leader in the IT Engineering Team, the Lead Software Engineer plays an integral role in the development and maintenance of custom business applications at the WCIRB. As such, this position requires the ability to lead along with broad information systems experience, a detail\-oriented mindset, excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, and effective communication skills. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities*** Provide technical expertise, project oversight, communication, and collaboration within the assigned development team(s) and with stakeholders, guiding and ensuring projects meet specifications. * Play a key role in architecting, designing, and building performant and scalable solutions using the Microsoft .NET Core stack and Azure platform. * Design and develop software applications on all levels (full stack)– persistence, business logic and service layers, frontend, and APIs. * Write scalable, testable, high\-quality code that meets requirements. * Mentor engineers in Software Engineering best practices via design and code reviews. Ensure delivery of high\-quality, value\-driven, operationally efficient features that support technology platforms and business initiatives. * Own the software development life cycle. Lead development work and provide vision from project inception to architecture planning, development, release, and production. * Build robust relationships across development teams, business analysts, and all key stakeholders involved in projects. * Collaborate closely with other teams (and leaders) to help with continuous improvement of the architecture, tools, and processes. * Communicate effectively with all levels of the organization while keeping leaders apprised of strategies, operational progress, issues, concerns, mitigation, and remediation plans. **Qualifications** The individual must be able to perform each essential duty. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, or equivalent experience. * 8 – 10 years of hands\-on experience in designing/architecting enterprise software solutions including cloud\-based applications using C\#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework and Web/Rest API. * Hands\-on application development experience using Azure components such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Blob Storage, App Service, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Queues, Azure API Management, etc. * Experience using best practices, patterns and approaches to address the challenges inherent in re\-engineering existing, complex systems. * 5\+ years using Azure Dev Ops \- especially Repositories and Pipelines. * 3\+ years developing UI\-based applications leveraging modern practices and tools such as Responsive Design, Bootstrap, Modular CSS, Ajax. * 3\-5 years of prior experience leading and mentoring teams of software engineers. * Ability to build relationships, balance multiple priorities, and communicate across diverse teams. * Ability to deal with ambiguous situations. * Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology. * Effective communication and problem\-solving capabilities. **Physical Demands** The physical demands described in this section are to be representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* Job requires 80% sitting and 20% moving about the office * Significant amounts of time spent at a PC using keyboard and/or mouse * Significant amounts of time spent reading manuals and related computer course materials. **Work Environment** The work environment characteristics described in this section are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* Frequent interaction with employees of different departments and divergent skills with WCIRB software and hardware * Occasional periods of high stress and moments requiring quick, knowledgeable decision\-making **Perks \& Benefits** Our employees enjoy a state of the art, energy\-efficient, open work environment that nurtures collaboration and creativity. At the WCIRB, we go the extra mile to keep our employees happy and healthy. Our perks include:* **Hybrid work environment (40% onsite 60% remote)** * Medical, dental and vision benefits * Competitive PTO Program * 401K and pension plan * Annual incentive plan * Social activities * Community volunteer involvement ***Please note:*** *the WCIRB location in San Francisco is steps from Montgomery Street BART entrance.* WCIRB is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. The successful candidate will reside in California and will work from our headquarters in San Francisco at least 40% of the time. We are NOT able to pay for relocation costs for candidates or to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. **Thank you for your interest in the WCIRB!**

jobs.title: AI Transformation Alchemist
jobs.description: OperationsMountain View, CA (HQ) **About X, The Moonshot Factory:** X is a diverse group of inventors and entrepreneurs who build and launch technologies that aim to improve the lives of millions, even billions, of people. Our goal: 10x impact on the world’s most intractable problems, not just 10% improvement. We approach projects that have the aspiration and riskiness of research with the speed and ambition of a startup. **About the Team:** AI could make X radically better at finding bold ideas, testing them, and turning the good ones into bigger moonshots. There's no playbook for an AI\-native moonshot factory, so the only way to figure it out is to experiment, constantly and hands\-on. Our small Applied AI team builds the AI tools Xers use to do that. **About the Role:** We're looking for a product person who builds: someone who prototypes AI tools themselves and works with our engineers to ship products Xers use every day. You'll talk directly to users, learn how ideas and information move through X, and help our engineers build what teams really need. You'll do well here if AI is the first thing you reach for to solve almost any problem, you build your own AI tools on nights and weekends, and you've already used AI to make a real organization work better. You'll report to the Moonshot Philosopher. **How you will make 10x impact:** * Learn how X works, so you can find where AI will make us radically better at building moonshots. * Build working AI prototypes yourself, get them in front of Xers early, and improve them based on how people actually use them. * Work side by side with technical and research teams on their workflow problems, and bring what works back to the core AI team. **What you should have:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience building and shipping software products, in any role: product manager, engineer, founder, or forward\-deployed. * Experience building AI tools that people inside an organization use every day, and getting them adopted. * Experience building with AI on your own: an app or agent made with tools like Claude Code or Codex, not just prompts or a chatbot. **It’d be great if you also had these:** * Ability to read and write code. * Experience mapping how ideas and decisions actually move through an organization, and building from that map. jobs.description: Software EngineeringMountain View, CA, San Francisco, CA **About Tapestry** Tapestry is a group within Google working to build the AI\-powered electric grid. We are tackling one of the world’s most important infrastructure challenges: helping the energy system become more visible, understandable, reliable, affordable, abundant, and clean. Originally born at X, Alphabet’s moonshot factory, Tapestry brings together experts in energy, AI, software engineering, and products to build tools that help the electricity ecosystem plan smarter, move faster, and operate more efficiently. This is a global effort. Tapestry supports partners across the U.S., U.K., Chile, New Zealand, Australia, and Brazil as they work toward a cleaner, more resilient energy future. Joining Tapestry means doing high\-impact work with a multidisciplinary team tackling a problem that matters at global scale. Learn more about our team and our mission here. **About the role** ------------------ As a senior staff backend software engineer building Tapestry’s Agentic Data Platform you will build a data platform to serve the needs of all of Tapestry. You will design and implement LLM\-enabled semantic ingestion, enrichment, and discovery of multi\-modal data so that the platform is Agentic aware from inception. You will work closely with other software engineers, machine learning experts, power systems domain experts, and product managers across several different teams to plan, coordinate, and integrate your work. This is your dream job if you are passionate about building the foundational data services that bridge real\-world physical assets with cloud\-scale AI, ensuring our mission\-critical services are ready to serve the data needed for the modernization of the global grid. **How you will make 10X Impact** * Design and implement massive\-scale, secure, enterprise\-grade data infrastructure and shared backend services that form the Tapestry’s Agentic Data platform for data ingestion, enrichment, and retrieval. * Partner with data security and product teams to build protection mechanisms for sensitive grid data and meet data governance compliance standards. * Build low\-latency streaming infrastructure for large\-scale data processing and modeling, ensuring our AI\-driven simulations and optimizations can scale to manage the world's most complex power grids. * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, PMs, AI researchers, and power systems experts to translate complex business requirements into products driving real\-world impact. * Collaborate with technical leads across different teams to migrate them to the Data Platform with no downtime and without compromising their ability to move quickly where needed. * Interface with external partners to refine technical requirements, and rapidly develop prototypes to evaluate feasibility. **What you should have:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. * 5\-8 years of experience building enterprise\-grade complex software systems and applications with a strong grasp of Our core values \- Make Life Simple, Build for People, Move with Purpose, and Create Lasting Communities are key to who we are and what guides us from how we hire to how we recognize our team members. **Job Description** We’re looking for a back end platform software engineer who can design and write code in a multi\-tenant SaaS environment. jobs.description: Department: Foundational Technology Services, Cloud Technologies, Spinup Self\-service \& Cloud Engineering 150 Munson Street, New Haven, Connecticut Job ID: 138950WD $90,000\.00 \- $165,750\.00 **Description** --------------- Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Working within established architectural patterns and engineering standards, the Automation Engineer will use technologies such as Terraform, AnsibleAutomation Platform, ServiceNow, CI/CD tooling, Red Hat OpenShift, and Datadog to automate services across compute, networking, storage, virtualization, security, and application platforms. For additional information on the background check requirements and process visit "Learn about background checks" under the Applicant Support Resources section of Careers on the It's Your Yale website. **Health Requirements** Certain positions have associated health requirements based on specific job responsibilities. jobs.title: AI Transformation Engineer
jobs.description: Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com. The AI Transformation Office partners with departments across Yext to improve business outcomes through 30 to 60 day transformation sprints. As an **AI Transformation Engineer**, you build the production systems that make that real: retrieval, answer drafting, routing and evaluation on live data, plus the APIs, automations and pipelines around them. Each sprint ends with a handoff to the team that owns the outcome. This is not a product\-roadmap engineering role. You embed with department teams, learn how work actually gets done, and build with whatever fits. That is usually a workflow platform such as n8n first, and code only where the platform runs out. You care as much about whether someone else can run your work as whether it runs in production. You build and you teach, as one motion. **What You'll Do** Production LLM systems (40%) * Build and run production LLM workflows in n8n and similar platforms: retrieval over ticket and documentation data, answer drafting and routing. * Build APIs, integrations and data pipelines that connect CRM, support and operational systems. * Build and calibrate confidence scoring so teams know when to trust an answer, and design the review steps and approval gates where a person decides. * Protect the data you work with: scope what each workflow can read, handle PII and sensitive fields, and keep access logs. * Ship every solution monitored, error\-handled and version\-controlled, not just functional. Evals and quality (15%) * Define evals before each build: test sets, groundedness and accuracy checks, and the thresholds that decide whether output ships or needs review. * Report quality results to partner teams in plain terms. * Track LLM spend and usage by team, manage API keys, and report run rate. Knowledge transfer and enablement (20%) * Pair\-build with embedded team members so they learn by doing, not by watching. * Write documentation that scales: runbooks, admin guides, architecture diagrams and decision logs. * Train department champions at the right altitude: enough to maintain and extend, not enough to overwhelm. * Build with handoff in mind from day one. The owning team should run each system day to day within 30 days of launch. They own workflow configuration, prompts, review queues and reports. You keep the retrieval, eval and scoring code until a second engineer can take it. System design and architecture (15%) * Design integration patterns that connect CRM, support and operational systems. * Architect data flows that enable automation and AI\-powered decisions. * Evaluate new models and tools, and make build\-vs\-buy recommendations grounded in the team's real maintenance capacity. Opportunity identification (10%) * Spot automation and integration opportunities others miss by understanding how work actually gets done. * Translate technical possibilities into language department stakeholders can evaluate. * Estimate effort honestly and scope tightly: cut work that does not change the outcome, and say so early. **What You Have** * 5 to 8 years in software engineering, integration development or automation engineering. * Production experience with a workflow platform such as n8n, Zapier or Tray.io, building automations that other teams rely on. * Experience designing reliable autonomous agents: agent frameworks and patterns such as tool calling, orchestration, guardrails and human escalation, with eval feedback loops that keep output high quality and consistent. * Python or TypeScript for the work a platform cannot do, with API design skills and an understanding of how software is operated: monitoring, error handling, version control and deployment discipline. * Hands\-on production use of LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or Google), including prompt design and structured outputs. * Retrieval experience: vector databases such as Qdrant or pgvector, chunking and grounding. * Experience measuring LLM output quality with test sets, graded review or evals. * Experience handling sensitive data in production systems: PII, permissions and audit logging. * A teaching instinct. You explain what you build and why, and you notice when someone is lost before they say so. * Documentation discipline, and the ability to explain trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders without jargon. **Bonus Points** * MCP servers, agent frameworks or tool\-calling design. * Experience governing a shared LLM cost budget or API keys. * CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot), data engineering or ETL, and warehouse analytics such as Snowflake. * Familiarity with support, customer success or professional services operations. * Experience building internal tools where the users are colleagues, not customers. * Training, facilitation or mentoring experience, formal or informal. * Comfort in ambiguous environments where requirements evolve as understanding deepens. **Flex Capabilities** You bring enough business context to understand why a process exists, not only how to automate it. You can contribute to prioritization, challenge assumptions about what is worth building, and sharpen your business instincts over time. We are a small team, and everyone stretches beyond their primary role. **What Success Looks Like** Each engagement agrees on key metrics before work starts, such as deflection rate, handle time or hours saved, and measures it against a baseline taken before launch. **30 days:** You understand the systems landscape across the partner department and have identified three or more high\-impact automation or integration opportunities. The first sprint has an agreed metric, baseline and eval set. Embedded team members see you as approachable and are already learning from working alongside you. **60 days:** The first automation is live, meets the agreed quality threshold, and moves the agreed metric. At least one embedded team member can explain how it works and make minor changes without you. Documentation is current, not aspirational. **90 days:** The first system is owned by the partner team day to day, and a second is live and stable. Embedded champions can maintain and extend them, and LLM spend is tracked by team. Handoff documentation is complete enough that a new engineer could onboard from it. The department refers to your work as "ours," not "the AI team's." \#LI\-JB2 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers. It is Yext's policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form. **Security Alert** All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. Instead, please report the communication to security@yext.com.
