jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer (Full-Stack)
jobs.description: **Lead Platform Engineer (Full\-Stack) (Troy, MI \- Hybrid (Remote and In Person))** Our dynamic, mid\-sized IP law firm represents the world's leading computer software and hardware innovators—from early\-stage startups to unicorns and global Fortune 100 companies. Our work spans cutting\-edge technologies including artificial intelligence, autonomous vehicles, video encoding, quantum computing, and cloud computing. With approximately 50 attorneys and 30 staff across Michigan, California, and several other states, we are entering a phase of continued growth and organizational maturity. We are seeking a highly autonomous and experienced technical lead for our application platform on a **contract\-to\-hire** basis. You should be highly proficient in modern AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code or similar) and able to leverage them effectively for design, coding, debugging, and productivity. As our senior technical lead, you will be the primary internal technical authority, responsible for everything from database schema design in MSSQL to the overall architecture, standards, governance, and delivery of the platform and the applications built on it. You may do much of the building yourself, with work supported by third\-party developers, or direct a small team as we grow. You should be ready for both. Key Point: We expect you to use AI coding tools like Claude Code as a daily part of your workflow, and to build AI\-powered features into our applications by calling model APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI) and building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that connect AI tools to our data and systems. These should be built into the platform as reusable, governed services that attorneys and developers can build on safely. Type: Contract\-to\-hire (3–6 months), converting to full\-time. This is a new role. We are looking for someone who is eager to build something and earn the role of leading it. Salary: Salary range will be discussed with qualified candidates Excellent written and spoken English is required for this position. **Responsibilities** * End\-to\-End Ownership: Lead the full SDLC, including requirement gathering, system architecture, coding, testing, deployment, and documentation. * Platform Architecture: Design and build a platform that others can build on, including shared services, templates, and a governed path for attorneys and developers to take an application from prototype or spec to production, with sandboxes, review, and controlled promotion. Set technical direction across our Azure environment, including the core platform and the applications and workflows built on it. * Infrastructure \& DevOps: Manage and improve our Azure environments, CI/CD pipelines, and version control. * Database Ownership: Own the MSSQL / Azure SQL data layer, including schema design, backups, migrations, and performance tuning. * Security \& Compliance: Ensure all applications are secure by design, implementing authentication and authorization (Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege) and protecting against common vulnerabilities. Work with our IT on identity, network isolation, access policy, and security testing. * Technical Leadership: Scope, assign, and review work from contract or third\-party developers, set the standards they work to, and mentor attorney technologists. * Technical Roadmap: Advise leadership on technology choices, build\-versus\-buy decisions, technical debt, and future scalability requirements. **Required Skills** Backend: Expert in modern backend ecosystems, including knowledge of .NET and C\#. Must be comfortable building clean, maintainable logic independently and setting the standard others build to. * Database: Mastery of MSSQL. You must be able to design schemas and write efficient T\-SQL independently. * Frontend: Working proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, with the ability to oversee or integrate front\-end work performed by third\-party developers. Deep front\-end specialization is not required. * AI: Hands\-on experience shipping production software with AI\-assisted development tools, reviewing and governing AI\-generated code, and building features on model APIs. * Architectural: Proven ability to design platforms, templates, and patterns that other people build on, with governance and self\-service deployment, and that keep the codebase manageable as it grows. **Important Qualities** * Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines without daily supervision or a project manager. * Ability to debug issues anywhere in the stack, from a CSS alignment bug to a database deadlock or a server configuration error. * Ability to balance “perfect code” with the need to deliver functional business value in a timely manner. * Disciplined approach to documenting the codebase and system architecture so that the system remains maintainable by whoever comes next, including AI agents. * A builder who can lead: you have built systems from the ground up and led others in building them, and you are as effective working alone as directing a team. * Motivated to create something: you want to shape a new role and platform, and are results oriented. * Ability to work with technically minded attorneys as collaborators, not just users. **Qualifications** * Experience: 5\+ years of professional experience, including time as technical lead, architect, or the senior engineer responsible for production systems, ideally with at least one previous role in a startup or small\-team environment where you had high levels of independence. * Leadership: Experience directing developers or contractors, including remote or offshore teams: scoping the work, reviewing it, and holding to a standard. * Environment: Experience in a regulated or confidentiality\-sensitive field such as legal, healthcare, finance, or government. * Tools: Proficient with Git, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), Azure DevOps, and Azure. * Communication: Strong ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders, including partners and firm leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, YouTube Ads Marketplace Optimization
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. * 3 years of experience with end\-to\-end Machine Learning (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging). * Experience designing and operating distributed computing systems for large\-scale AI/ML workloads. * Experience applying Machine Learning techniques to build predictive models. * Experience in building and deploying recommendation systems models (retrieval, prediction, ranking, personalization, search quality, embedding) in production. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. * 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role. * Experience with graph algorithms and graph mining. * Experience applying analytical reasoning to software engineering problems. * Experience developing accessible technologies. * Ads experimentation and analysis. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Grow the YouTube Ads business by understanding user interest and recommend ads that are aligned with user interest. The YouTube Ads User Models are a suite of large\-scale AI systems designed to model users commercial interests by leveraging Google\-wide data sources approved for advertising purposes. Designed for multi\-task learning across various surfaces, these models are applied to numerous downstream tasks, including retrieval, user action prediction, rich user generation, and knowledge distillation for training more compact models. Work with a team of software engineers, ML engineers, and Data Scientists to understand long\-term user interest from a source of information from across the company. Build a large recommendation system using LLMs, Sequence Modeling, GNNs, and other similar algorithms. Predict likelihood of user interest in a particular ad. Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting\-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi\-billion dollar global business. Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return\-on\-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state\-of\-the\-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Apply AI, machine learning, and LLMs to optimize the YouTube Ads marketplace. * Develop sequence and graph\-based AI models to improve ads optimization. * Develop distributed data processing pipelines for large\-scale ads data. * Develop and connect various serving components within the ad stack. * Analyze and optimize the YouTube ads ecosystem and serving stack. Sequence and Graph based AI models by developing distributed data processing pipelines, develop and connect various serving components. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: Software Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. Our work helps law firms operate more efficiently and helps the injured people they serve access settlement funds more quickly and accurately. We are looking for a quality engineer who is passionate about building the testing and evaluation that keeps complex, data\-heavy products working correctly at scale. Zipliens is looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team and own quality for a product area within the applications we build for the legal industry. After several years of high growth, Zipliens has become a leader in lien resolution, a process required in most personal injury settlements. The software we build supports that work, so the quality of what we ship has a clear, real\-world impact on law firms and the people they represent. We're scaling engineering significantly this year, and quality engineering is growing along with it. QA at Zipliens is embedded in the engineering teams and combines exploratory testing with automation. You'd own quality for a feature or product area, including the test strategy, the automation behind it, and the release sign\-off for that area. You'll have established patterns and existing test suites to work from, and you'll help improve them as the team grows. We also build with AI as a first\-class part of the workflow, and that applies to testing as much as to development. Our product uses LLMs to extract structure from medical records and lien correspondence, so evaluating non\-deterministic output is a regular part of the job. We also use agentic coding tools and internal skills and harnesses we've written ourselves to build and maintain automation, and you'd be expected to use those tools well, review what they produce, and help improve them. **Requirements**### **Responsibilities:** * Own quality for a feature or product area, including the risk\-based test strategy, the regression scope, and the release sign\-off for that area. * Build and maintain the automated test suites for your area and keep them integrated with CI. When tests fail or become flaky, you'll troubleshoot them and fix the underlying cause. * Run exploratory testing against the lien workflow and develop a detailed understanding of the applications your team owns, including their risk areas and failure modes. * Test our LLM\-based features. This includes building the evaluation suite for a feature, setting acceptance thresholds with product (for example, precision and recall targets for extraction), checking LLM\-judge agreement against human labels, and adding adversarial and prompt\-injection cases. * Use agentic coding tools to build and maintain automation, and review AI\-generated tests before they merge. * Join refinement early enough to shape Acceptance Criteria with the Product Owner, flag testability gaps before development starts, and recommend coverage and risk priorities for your area. * Shepherd defects for your area from triage through resolution, writing clear, reproducible reports that engineers can act on. * Work directly with the engineers on your team day to day. QA at Zipliens is embedded in the engineering teams rather than run as a separate function. ### **Qualifications:** * 3\+ years on a QA or software development team, including experience owning test coverage for a feature or product area. * Strong skills in at least one of exploratory testing and test design, test automation and infrastructure, or AI/LLM evaluation, with working proficiency in a second. We don't expect the same depth in all three. * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining automated test suites in a modern framework (Playwright, Cypress, pytest, or similar), including diagnosing flaky tests and fixing their root causes. * Comfortable reading and writing code. Our backend is Python/Django and our frontend is React, and you should be able to read a change in either and understand what it affects and what it puts at risk. * Experience integrating tests into CI pipelines and deciding which checks should gate a merge or a deploy. * Strong SQL. Much of what we test lives in PostgreSQL, and verifying a workflow often means verifying the data it produced as well as what the UI shows. * Hands\-on experience testing LLM or ML features, whether in production or through prototypes and experimentation: building golden datasets, measuring output quality, and understanding how these systems fail. * Experience using or experimenting with agentic coding tools, and good judgment about when their output needs a closer look. * Clear written communication. You'll be writing defect reports, test plans, and release sign\-offs for engineers and product, and explaining risk to non\-technical stakeholders. ### **Nice to Have:** * Experience testing document processing or extraction from unstructured data. * Experience testing third\-party integrations, especially where the counterparty's documentation isn't solid and you need contract tests, sandboxes, or recorded fixtures to work around it. * Familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes. We have an SRE who owns the cluster \- you won't be running it, but you'll be reading logs and working out where a failure happened in it. * Experience handling sensitive data such as PHI, or working under HIPAA\-style requirements. **Benefits** * Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Company HSA contributions for HDHP participants * Flexible Spending Accounts (Health \& Dependent Care) * Company\-Paid Short\-Term Disability Coverage * Voluntary Long\-Term Disability, Life, AD\&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options * 401(k) Plan with Company Match * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time \& 10 paid Holidays) * Parental Leave Pay Disclosure: The total base salary range for this role is $77,000 \- $104,000 annually with an opportunity to earn a discretionary quarterly bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on skills and experience. Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer\-sponsored visa support now or in the future.

jobs.title: Hardware Software Integration Engineer

Identify and work with key cross\-functional partners to root cause and provide resolution * Provide feedback to engineering teams to improve future product versions * Understand the vehicle assembly and test requirements and come up with test plans and specifications to support manufacturing operations * Develop test automation, leverage in\-house analysis tools to perform debugging and improve test coverage, and enhance test infrastructure * Develop new processes and human workflows to improve fleet stability ### **Qualifications** * BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields with a minimum of 2\+ years of relevant industry experience * Experience and skill in determining the root cause of complex issues involving HW, FW, and SW * Experience with hardware interfaces such as Ethernet, CAN, USB, UART, LIN. I2C, SPI, etc and related testing/debugging tools * Familiarity with requirements and test case development * Fluency in Python or similar scripting language, git/version management tools, SW debugging tools ### **Bonus Qualifications** * Working knowledge of requirements management tools such as Polarion/JIRA * Strong EE fundamentals with familiarity in microcontroller\-based systems, high\-speed signals, sensing, power electronics, BT/LTE/NFC * Working knowledge of schematic design, PCB layout, and electrical characterization equipment (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, etc.) **Base Salary Range** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.**About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team. Follow us on LinkedIn **Accommodations** If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter. ***A Final Note:****You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

You will be a part of the technology organization and will collaborate with project leads who own AI and modeling solutions for our customers, alongside existing data engineering and BI teams who already manage our data foundations and inference services. As DEUNA’s AI efforts grow, so will the team, and this role is a technical leadership role, with potential for people leadership if the skills align. **Who You Are** * You have 5\+ years of experience applying machine learning to real production problems, ideally in payments, fintech, fraud, or other high\-volume transactional environments. * You think like a research scientist: you start from a problem, decide what data you need, choose the right modeling approach, and define how you will prove it works. * You have hands\-on depth in feature generation, model selection, training, and hyperparameter optimization, and you know when a simple model beats a complex one. * You have designed and run experiments, including A/B testing and experimentation platforms, and can explain how you validated that a model delivered impact. * You are proficient in Python and SQL and comfortable querying large datasets in tools like Snowflake. experience establishing coding standards and quality practices adopted across a domain * Demonstrated ability to decompose highly complex problems including algorithmic challenges into scalable solutions; deep understanding of system\-wide implications of technical decisions across multiple services * Experience designing integration solutions for complex domain areas; track record of driving integration implementation decisions across teams within architectural standards * Experience building knowledge bases in retail or similar domains * Familiarity with search, recommender and RAG/GraphRAG hybrid retrieval architectures * Experience defining enterprise semantic layers used across multiple product teams * Exposure to AI\-Driven systems \- optimization, predictions and Agents * Experience working with knowledge representation for LLM\-powered applications additional notes **Please note:** Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visa at this time for this role. compensation and benefits package lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay\-for\-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. Your work will help make privileged access secure, fast, measurable, and recoverable so engineers can move quickly without relying on manual reviews, tribal knowledge, or permanent admin rights. **What you'll be doing** ------------------------ **Privileged Access Workflows** * **Build** privileged access workflows across enterprise SaaS admin roles, production systems, cloud consoles, infrastructure management systems, source control, data platforms, endpoint admin, and emergency access paths * **Design** access patterns that support request, approval, justification, time\-bound elevation, and automated revocation * **Define** practical controls that reduce reliance on permanent admin rights across high\-risk environments * **Establish** clean audit trails for privileged access activity across critical systems **JIT Access and Governance Controls** * **Implement** JIT access patterns with approval, justification, expiry, revocation, and evidence collection * **Create** a privileged access baseline that defines who can approve access, what justification is required, how long access lasts, what evidence is captured, and how revocation works * **Own** exception governance for access paths that cannot yet meet the standard * **Drive** entitlement cleanup and stale privilege reduction through automation **Break\-Glass and Tiering Model** * **Design** break\-glass access standards, ownership models, monitoring, and recovery procedures * **Test** emergency access workflows and validate break\-glass readiness * **Develop** a tiering model for privileged access covering Tier 0 and Tier 1 systems, admin paths, sensitive groups, service\-owner roles, and high\-risk workflows * **Identify** the top 10 highest\-risk standing privileges and create remediation paths **Telemetry, Detection, and Measurement** * **Define** privileged access telemetry requirements for detection, investigations, audit, compliance, and executive reporting * **Partner** with Security Data to establish privileged access detections and source\-health requirements * **Track** metrics including standing privilege reduction, JIT adoption, stale admin cleanup, break\-glass test success, approval SLA, and access review closure * **Build** an inventory of top admin paths, owners, approvers, access methods, logging, expiry, and current risk **KPIs** -------- * Standing privilege reduction * JIT adoption * Stale admin cleanup * Break\-glass test success **About You** ------------- * **7\+ years** in identity security, privileged access, security engineering, infrastructure security, or related engineering roles * Hands\-on experience designing or operating privileged access, JIT, break\-glass, access request, approval, or access review workflows * Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, RBAC, SSO, MFA, access governance, admin tiering, and least privilege * Experience automating access workflows, entitlement cleanup, evidence collection, or revocation processes * Strong scripting, workflow automation, API integration, or platform engineering skills * Ability to translate access risk into practical controls that engineering and operations teams will adopt * Ability to work across enterprise systems, production environments, SaaS platforms, IT, infrastructure, and compliance stakeholders * Experience with service accounts, non\-human identities, workload identities, API tokens, automation accounts, or secrets governance * Experience securing production access, source control administration, data platforms, cloud administration, or endpoint admin workflows * Experience designing access evidence for audit, customer assurance, or incident response **What we can offer you** ------------------------- At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core. Highly competitive US compensation package (base \+ bonus \+ equity), with performance reviews every 12 months.* Join one of the fastest\-growing AI infrastructure companies — your chance to directly shape how global AI capacity is planned and deployed. ✨ * Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by leading critical cross\-functional initiatives and shaping capital strategy — always with our full support. Human\-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first.* Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments. **Equal Opportunities Statement** --------------------------------- We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ\+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio\-economic backgrounds. If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know. The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role. For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee \& Candidate Privacy Notice: Here. **Salary Range** ---------------- The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job\-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation. *For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee \& Candidate Privacy Notice:* *Here.* *Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.*

jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer - Identity & Access Management
jobs.description: ### **ABOUT onX** We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further. We’re a high\-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt \- continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver. Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals \- Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish \- is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most. We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact. Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access. ### **ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY** onX is seeking a Senior iOS Engineer who will contribute to meaningful, real\-world outcomes that have a lasting impact for customers and the business. In this role, as part of the Identity \& Access Management (IAM) team, you’ll focus on owning the iOS client libraries that power authentication, sessions and feature access across every onX app, and the pipeline for sign\-ups and entitlements. You’ll be supporting secure, reliable access to onX Hunt, Offroad, Fish and Backcountry for millions of hunters, anglers and outdoor enthusiasts, including when they’re far from a cell signal. You’ll take ownership of your work, collaborate closely with partners across the organization, and help move initiatives forward in an environment where priorities evolve, learning is celebrated, and you’re encouraged to keep stretching your skills. This role will report to a Software Engineering Manager III. ### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ***Essential Job Duties \& Functions*** * **Own the platform.** You’ll own onX’s iOS identity, subscription, and feature\-access libraries: shared Swift packages consumed by every onX iOS app. You’ll set their technical direction, decide which patterns to keep and which to replace, and see changes through to production. You’ll co\-own the API contracts with backend and push for changes when needed. * **Make auth dependable in the field.** You’ll harden token refresh and session lifecycle, lead adoption of Swift strict concurrency, and handle network loss gracefully so users stay signed in when they need the app most. * **See what’s happening.** You’ll build client\-side observability for identity flows so the team can see auth health by device, OS version and app, then use that data to find and fix problems before customers report them. * **Champion both directions.** You’ll represent iOS in IAM design work (account management, session management, passkeys, one\-time passwords, entitlements and bundling) and represent IAM in the iOS codebase, partnering with backend engineers, iOS platform leads and product teams across our apps. You’ll push for new capabilities when the current ones aren’t enough. * **Work with your Android counterpart.** You’ll be partnered on the team with an Android counterpart to keep identity and entitlement behavior consistent: shared specs, shared test cases, and joint design docs. * **Raise the bar.** You’ll grow the team’s client expertise through code review, documentation and mentoring, including backend engineers who contribute to client code. You’ll identify the next problems worth solving, write the design doc, align stakeholders, and drive it through rollout across apps. * **Adopt new technologies.** You’ll look for opportunities to embed AI as a repeatable co\-pilot in daily workflows by integrating experimentation into real work, and continuously refining its use with sound judgment and validation. * **Support for uptime and availability.** You’ll join the team\-based oncall rotation for the Identity team. While this does not require strong backend expertise, you may occasionally need to follow a runbook or escalate depending on the situation. ### **WHAT YOU’LL BRING** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Six or more years of professional software development experience, with building and shipping production iOS apps in Swift as a primary focus for at least three of those years, is required. * Deep knowledge of Swift and Swift Concurrency (async/await, actors, Sendable), and experience diagnosing race conditions and threading issues in production apps. * Experience building and maintaining a shared library or SDK used by multi , MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60\-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration. We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members. At this time, we are **NOT** able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming. ### **HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED** onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, we are open to considering candidates ranging in two levels (level II and level III). Spanning these levels, applicants can expect to make between $146,000 to $182,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based on experience, skills, certifications, and education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full\-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and a potential annual bonus of 10% based on company performance. ### **WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU** * Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth * Comprehensive health benefits, including a no\-monthly\-cost medical plan * Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non\-birthing parents * 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3\-5% * Company\-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks * Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle * Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays ### **PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS** In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem\-solving, essential for our computer\-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at PC@onxmaps.com. **Application Deadline is** **\[day of week]****,** **\[month]****\[day]** **at \[****0:00 pm****] MST** **Position open until filled.** **\#LI\-Remote** **At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger.** By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us! onX Maps will never ask for credit card or SSN details during the initial application process. For your digital safety, apply only through our legitimate website at onXmaps.com onX does not sell any Personal Information, but we may transfer employment related records to our service providers or third parties that provide business services to onX or as required by law. As part of our interview process, your conversation may be recorded for documentation purposes to allow interviewers to focus fully on the discussion. Recordings are confidential and accessible only to authorized personnel. Please note, onX respects all applicable laws regarding recording consent, and you will have an opportunity to opt\-out if preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Applied Scientist, Science Platform
jobs.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000\+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com. Reddit brings people together around their interests, questions, and experiences. Our communities generate a rich and complex ecosystem of human activity, creating scientific challenges in understanding behavior, measuring impact, and anticipating change. The Data Science Platform team builds the tools that enable a scientific understanding of Reddit. We develop Reddit's analytics agent, and the shared scientific capabilities and methods that allow data scientists and business partners to answer increasingly sophisticated questions. We are looking for a senior technical lead who combines deep expertise in statistics, machine learning and causal inference with strong software engineering ability. You will establish the scientific direction for agentic analytics, causal inference, and forecasting, turning advances in research into reliable software used across the company. As an Applied Scientist on the Science Platform team, you will work across the full development cycle: identifying important problems, evaluating research, implementing and validating methods, and shipping capabilities that others can use confidently. You will partner closely with software engineers and data scientists to build an analytics agent that can investigate questions, select appropriate methods, execute analyses, and communicate findings with clear assumptions and uncertainty. **Responsibilities:** * Define the scientific roadmap for Data Science Platform across agentic analytics, causal inference and forecasting, identifying opportunities where advances in methodology can improve decision\-making at scale across Reddit. * Research, evaluate, and implement emerging methods. Move quickly from research papers to working prototypes, validate their practical value, and develop successful approaches into maintained production capabilities. * Design and build our analytics agent's architecture and capabilities, including how the agent decomposes questions, selects scientific methods, uses data and analytical tools, checks assumptions, and produces reproducible results. * Build reusable causal inference tools that help teams estimate the effects of product changes, policies, and business decisions using observational data. * Develop shared forecasting capabilities for business and product metrics, including probabilistic predictions, hierarchical forecasts, and scenario analysis. * Create evaluation frameworks that measure the correctness and usefulness of agent\-generated analyses. Build benchmarks, simulations, and automated checks that detect methodological errors, unsupported claims, and misleading interpretations. * Own the implementation of scientific methods in production software, writing robust Python code and partnering with engineers on libraries, APIs, data pipelines, observability, and system design. * Work with data scientists and business partners to identify recurring analytical needs and translate them into accessible platform capabilities, documentation, and workflows. * Influence technical and organizational strategy through clear scientific recommendations, mentor scientists and engineers, and share methodological advances internally and externally where appropriate. **Required Qualifications:** * A doctorate in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related discipline; alternatively, a master's degree supported by comparable depth of expertise. * At least eight years of relevant industry work following a doctorate, or ten years with a master's degree, in applied science, data science, scientific software development, or related roles. * Deep knowledge of statistical inference and econometrics, with practical experience developing causal methods for observational data and evaluating the assumptions that make their conclusions credible. * Experience developing and deploying forecasting systems, including time series modeling, temporal validation, prediction intervals, and assessment of performance as underlying conditions change. * Strong software engineering skills, including substantial experience writing and maintaining production Python software. Familiarity with API design, automated testing, code review, version control, and operational monitoring. * A demonstrated ability to critically assess scientific literature, reproduce relevant findings, and turn promising methods into reliable software that solves practical problems. * Experience developing LLM applications or analytical agents, including tool use, code execution, and systematic evaluation of their outputs. * Clear communication of statistical assumptions, uncertainty, and technical tradeoffs to business audiences. * Experience developing other technical contributors through mentorship, design reviews, and collaboration across organizational boundaries. * The ability to make progress on ambiguous problems, prioritize consequential work, and deliver useful capabilities through rapid iteration. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Publications, open\-source contributions, or widely adopted internal tools in agentic analytics, causal inference, forecasting, or other related fields. * Experience building scientific libraries or platforms used by other data scientists, including interfaces that make sophisticated methods accessible to people with different levels of statistical expertise. * Experience building agents at scale that perform substantive analytical work, including retrieval of relevant data and context, selection of methods, execution of Python or SQL, and validation of findings. **Benefits:** * 100% remote opportunity (we have four office locations for hybrid/onsite work preference in NY, SF, LA and Chicago) * Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs * 401K with Employer Match * Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support * Family Planning Support * Gender\-Affirming Care * Mental Health \& Coaching Benefits * Flexible Vacation \& Paid Volunteer Time Off * Generous Paid Parental Leave \#LI\-AJ1 In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment\-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors. *Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.*

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Cloud
jobs.description: Zed is building tools for people who care deeply about making software. We’re looking for an experienced backend engineer to help build the cloud services behind Zed and Delta. The server\-side infrastructure powers many of Zed's core features: all AI connections go through this system, as do the collaboration primitives, in addition to cross\-cutting concerns like auth, billing and telemetry. We are currently rebuilding our backend from a single stateful server to a fully distributed system, and looking for someone to help lead this effort. Our cloud capabilities are growing faster than the team’s capacity to build them. We need someone who can become a trusted technical partner to the engineers already doing this work: shaping projects, writing code, making sound decisions, and sharing responsibility for the system in production. This is primarily a software engineering role. Most of your time will go toward building backend software, but you’ll also need to understand and help own the infrastructure it runs on. \#\# What you’ll work on The cloud team owns work spanning APIs, application logic, storage, asynchronous processing, deployment, and operations. Projects may include: * Building Cloud Runners that provide ephemeral compute for development work. * Evolving billing to support new products, pricing, and packaging. * Integrating with identity providers and developing authorization capabilities. * Building integrations that connect Zed and Delta to developers’ existing workflows. Some projects involve unfamiliar technical challenges. Others are straightforward capabilities that customers and the business need. We’re looking for someone who takes care with both and enjoys moving between different kinds of work as priorities evolve. Our cloud backend is built in Rust, including services compiled to WebAssembly and running on Cloudflare Workers. We use managed infrastructure to reduce operational work and invest in tests that exercise complete workflows across clients and services. \[Read more about how we’re building Zed Cloud](https://maxdeviant.com/posts/2025/head\-in\-the\-zed\-cloud/). \#\# What you’ll do * **Turn emerging needs into shipped capabilities.** Work with engineering and product partners to clarify problems, choose a practical scope, and carry projects through implementation, rollout, and operation. * **Share technical stewardship of the cloud system.** Develop the context and judgment to make consequential decisions, guide work, and become someone teammates can turn to without routing every question through the same person. * **Stay hands\-on.** Write and review code, investigate difficult bugs, and work through the details that make a service correct, maintainable, and reliable. * **Make deliberate trade\-offs.** Recognize when a focused solution is enough, when an investment will make future work easier, and when to leave something alone. * **Help others work independently.** Share context, give useful feedback, and improve the tests, interfaces, and documentation that support the team’s work. * **Own production behavior.** Participate in on\-call, respond to incidents, and address recurring problems in the software and infrastructure. As you become familiar with the system, you should be able to take on significant cloud work independently while keeping the right people involved. Success means both delivering your own projects and helping the team make good decisions without depending on any one engineer. \#\# What you’ll bring * **You’ve owned backend services from design through production and continued development.** You’ve made API and data\-model decisions, shipped changes to systems with active users, and handled failures and operational issues after launch—not just implemented isolated features. * **You’ve built and operated the cloud infrastructure behind your software.** Your work has included provisioning resources, configuring deployments and monitoring, and diagnosing production problems across application code and infrastructure. * **You’ve led projects that other engineers contributed to while writing code yourself.** You’ve clarified requirements, worked through design decisions and dependencies, and followed through on delivery. Teammates have trusted you to guide work without escalating every decision. * **You’ve worked across different kinds of backend problems.** You can point to times you took responsibility outside your usual area, learned what you needed, and delivered. You’re comfortable moving between new capabilities, integrations, and operational improvements as priorities change. * **You make technical decisions with the people affected by them.** You’ve worked with engineers and product partners to compare approaches, choose what to build now, and decide what to defer. You can explain the trade\-offs and how other people’s input changed the outcome. * **You’re ready to build in Rust.** Production Rust experience is a strong advantage, but it isn’t required. If Rust is new to you, you should be able to describe how you’ve learned an unfamiliar language or codebase and shipped production work in it. Your career should be centered on building software. You might have owned both the backend and infrastructure at a small SaaS company, or combined application engineering with time in platform, DevOps, or reliability roles. We care more about what you’ve built and owned than your previous titles or experience with a particular cloud provider.
